text: Suno kay Ong, isa man ka kahigayon ang tikang agud nga mahanas ang mga opisyales sang barangay ilabi na ang bag-uhanon.
english: Ong said the move is also an opportunity to train barangay officials especially the new ones.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga apisar may ginapatuman na nga Barangay Newly Elected Official training, may yara sa gihapon nga mga opisyal ang indi makahibalo magpamuno.
english: He also said that despite the implementation of Barangay Newly Elected Official training, there are still officials who do not know how to lead.

text: Sa idalom sang amo nga programa, may tutorial ang talatapan nga naga-edukar sa mga opisyal sa ila development plan.
english: Under the program, the office has a tutorial that educates officials on their development plan.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang House Bill 11287, ginaduso nga ma-extend ang termino sang mga barangay kag Sangguniang Kabataan officials sa anom ka tuig halin sa tatlo ka tuig.
english: Under House Bill 11287, it is proposed to extend the term of barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan officials to six years from three years.

text: Naghatag sang update si former executive secretary Salvador Medialdea kaangot sa kondisyon ni former President Rodrigo Duterte nga subong lima ka adlaw na nga yara sa detention facility sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: Former executive secretary Salvador Medialdea gave an update on the condition of former President Rodrigo Duterte who has been in the detention facility in The Hague, Netherlands for five days.

text: Suno kay Medialdea, maayo gid ang kahimtangan sang former chief executive apang nahidlaw lang ini sa kinaandan niya nga pagkaon kaangay sang uga, munggo, kag pinirito nga saging.
english: According to Medialdea, the former chief executive is in good condition but misses his usual food such as dry, munggo, and fried bananas.

text: “Okay naman siya, he’s in very high spirits … Ano lang siya, naiisip niya ang mga sumusuporta sa kanya, nagpapasalamat siya sa inyong lahat… Isa sa medyo namimiss niya yung kanyang usual na kinakain, yung tuyo, yung munggo, at higit sa lahat yung piniritong saging.
english: “He's okay, he's in very high spirits ... Whatever he is, he's thinking about those who support him, he's thankful to all of you... One of the things he misses is his usual food, the tuyo, the munggo, and most of all the fried bananas.

text: Yun ang nawawala sa kanya.
english: That's what he's missing.

text: Other than that, he’s okay, ipagdasal, keep on praying for him,” pahayag sini.
english: Other than that, he’s okay, pray, keep on praying for him,” he said.

text: Ginsiling ni Medialdea nga halos isa ka oras lamang ang ila pagkit-anay kag madamo sang protocols nga kinahanglan sundon antes ini makasulod sa pasilidad.
english: Medialdea said they only met for about an hour and there are many protocols that need to be followed before he can enter the facility.

text: Si Duterte, 79, ang nagapangatubang sang crimes against humanity charges kasunod sang iya ginpatuman nga drug war.
english: Duterte, 79, is facing crimes against humanity charges following his drug war.

text: Sang Byernes sang gab-i oras sa Pilipinas, nag-attend siya sa proceedings sang International Criminal Court (ICC) paagi sa video link.
english: On Friday night Philippine time, he attended the proceedings of the International Criminal Court (ICC) via video link.

text: Sa amo nga hearing nga naglawig sang halos tunga sa oras, ginpakumpirma lang sa iya ang iya identity, ginbasa ang charges, ginpahibalo siya sang iya mga kinamatarong sa idalom sang Rome Statute, kag gin-schedule ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23, 2025.
english: During the hearing, which lasted nearly half an hour, he was only asked to confirm his identity, read the charges, inform him of his rights under the Rome Statute, and schedule confirmation of charges for September 23, 2025.

text: Sa una niya nga pag-atubang sa chamber, si Medialdea ang nagtindog nga legal counsel.#
english: In his first appearance before the chamber, Medialdea stood as legal counsel.

text: Posibleng tumaas ang presyo ng bigas sa susunod na mga linggo matapos ipag-utos ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Rice prices are likely to rise in the coming weeks after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang suspensyon ng rice importation sa loob ng 60 araw simula Setyembre 1, 2025.
english: the suspension of rice importation for 60 days starting September 1, 2025.

text: Ayon sa Philippine Rice Industry Stakeholders Movement lead convenor Rowena Sadicon, inaasahan ang dagdag-presyo ng P1 hanggang P2 kada kilo sa retail rice bunsod ng pagtaas din ng presyo ng palay sa mga magsasaka.
english: According to Philippine Rice Industry Stakeholders Movement lead convenor Rowena Sadicon, the price increase of P1 to P2 per kilo of retail rice is expected as a result of the increase in the price of rice to farmers.

text: Ipinahayag ng Malacañang na ang suspensyon ay batay sa rekomendasyon ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Malacañang said the suspension was based on the recommendation of Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: Samantala, tinuligsa ng Federation of Free Farmers ang umano’y mabagal na aksyon ng pamahalaan para sa proteksyon ng lokal na magsasaka, na ilan ay nalubog na sa utang at nagdadalawang-isip kung magtatanim pa.
english: Meanwhile, the Federation of Free Farmers criticized the government's allegedly slow action to protect local farmers, some of whom are already in debt and hesitant to plant.

text: Batay sa datos ng Philippine Statistics Authority nitong Hulyo 2025, ang average presyo ng regular milled rice ay nasa P41.31 kada kilo mula P50.90 noong Hulyo 2024; well-milled rice, P47.60 mula P55.85; at special rice, P56.83 mula P64.42 kada kilo.
english: Based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority as of July 2025, the average price of regular milled rice is at P41.31 per kilo from P50.90 in July 2024; well-milled rice, P47.60 from P55.85; and special rice, P56.83 from P64.42 per kilo.

text: Bagaman bumaba ang presyo nitong mga nakaraang buwan dahil sa base effects at mas mababang import tariff, maaaring mag-iba ang trend kapag nag-umpisa na ang suspensyon ng importasyon.
english: Although prices have declined in recent months due to base effects and lower import tariffs, the trend may change once the suspension of imports begins.

text: Ginklaro sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group 6 (CIDG-6) nga indi pagpang-abduct kundi legit operation nga ila ginpatigayon sa Brgy.
english: The Criminal Investigation and Detection Group 6 (CIDG-6) clarified that it was not an abduction but a legit operation they conducted in Brgy.

text: Cabugao Sur Pavia, Iloilo sang Pebrero 23 .
english: Cabugao Sur Pavia, Iloilo on February 23 .

text: Ini matapos mapuhag ang pumuluyo sa natabo nga pagpalupok sang pusil kag pilit pasakay sa awto sa isa ka lalaki nga ginkilala kay Mark Alarcon kag ginsundan pa ini sang isa pa ka buy-bust operation sang armas malapit sa Pavia plaza sa isa ka babayi nga ginkilala kay Stephanie Guillem.
english: This was after residents were shocked by the shooting and forced boarding of a man identified as Mark Alarcon followed by another buy-bust operation of a firearm near Pavia plaza against a woman identified as Stephanie Guillem.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PLt.

text: Job Lujan, deputy chief sang CIDG Iloilo kag Guimaras, iya ginpahayag nga ang ila pag-aresto ang paagi sa arrest warrant kag buy-bust operation nga may kaangtanan sa kaso sang illegal nga armas ukon ang Republic Act 10591 ukon Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.
english: Job Lujan, deputy chief of CIDG Iloilo and Guimaras, said their arrest was through an arrest warrant and buy-bust operation related to illegal firearms cases or Republic Act 10591 or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.

text:
Suno pa sa iya nga ang nasambit nga operasyon ang sa idalom sang ila flagship program nga ”Oplan Paglalansag Omega.”

Suno pa sa opisyal nga may ara sang “accidental firing,” nga natabo bangud sa madugay nga pag-control sang mga personnel sa subject nga si Mark Alarcon.
english:
He said the operation is under their flagship program “Oplan Paglansanag Omega.”

The official said there was an “accidental firing,” which occurred due to the long control of the personnel on the subject Mark Alarcon.

text: Gindugang pa ni Lujan nga ginarespeto naman sang CIDG ang imbetigasyon sang Police Regional Office 6 nga ang isa ka parte sang reklamo may kaangtanan sa gin-alegar nga love quarrel nga ginlakipan sang former boyfriend naman ang sa kay Stephanie Guillem.
english: Lujan added that the CIDG respects the investigation of the Police Regional Office 6 that one part of the complaint is related to the alleged love quarrel involving the former boyfriend and that of Stephanie Guillem.

text: Ginapanindugan naman sang CIDG-6 nga nag-coordinate man ang ila provincial officer sa hepe sang kapulisan sa Pavia antes ginpatigayon ang operasyon bilang kabahin sang koordinasyon sa lokal nga kapulisan.
english: The CIDG-6 insisted that its provincial officer also coordinated with the police chief in Pavia before conducting the operation as part of coordination with the local police.

text: Gin-aresto na si former President Rodrigo Duterte subong nga adlaw, Marso 11.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte was arrested today, March 11.

text: Suno kay Atty. Martin Delgra, abogado ni Duterte, gindakop ang anay president matapos naghugpa na sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport ang eroplano nga ginasakyan sini halin sa Hong Kong.
english: According to Atty. Martin Delgra, Duterte's lawyer, said the former president was arrested after his plane from Hong Kong landed at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport.

text: Samtang suno naman sa longtime aide ni Duterte nga si Sen.
english: Meanwhile, Duterte's longtime aide, Sen.

text: Bong Go, wala nila makit-an ang arrest warrant para sa anay presidente.
english: Bong Go, they did not find the arrest warrant for the former president.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni former Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Secretary Silvestre Bello III nga ginhambalan sila ni Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.
english: Former Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Secretary Silvestre Bello III confirmed that they were told by Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.

text: Rommel Francisco Marbil nga dal-on si Duterte sa Camp Crame.
english: Rommel Francisco Marbil to take Duterte to Camp Crame.

text: Ginapahayag nga si Duterte ang subject sang warrant of arrest sang International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Duterte is reportedly the subject of a warrant of arrest by the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: ILOILO CITY-Atensyon sa mga single!
english: ILOILO CITY-Attention to singles!

text: Huo ikaw nga nagapamati nga ginbayaan,ginpahibi kag subong single na!
english: Yes you who are listening who were abandoned, made to cry and now single!

text: Kabalo ka bala nga kun single ka mas dako ang tsansa mo nga makaangkon sang long kag stress- free nga kabuhi.
english: Did you know that if you are single you have a better chance of having a long and stress- free life.

text: Didto sa Manhattan,New York may yara sang isa ka tigulang nga nag selebrar sang iya ika 110 nga kaadlawan.
english: In Manhattan, New York, there was an old man who celebrated his 110th birthday.

text: Siya si Loiuse Signore.
english: She is Loiuse Signore.

text: Ano ayhan ang sikreto ni Louise sa iya nga long life?
english: What is Louise's secret to her long life?

text: Suno kay Louise, ang isa ka sikreto niya agud maangkon ang stress- free kag malawig nga kabuhi amo nga ginpili niya nga mangin single kag mag- isahanon.
english: According to Louise, one of her secrets to a stress-free and long life is that she chose to be single and alone.

text: Dugang ni Louise, nangin masadya siya sa mga simple nga bagay nga ginhimo niya kaangay nalang sang pag exercise, kag paghampang sang Bingo kaupod ang iya mga amiga kada tapos niya panyaga.
english: Louise added that she became happy with the simple things she did like exercising, and playing Bingo with her friends every after lunch.

text: Suno pa gid kay Louise, isa sa pinakamaayo nga nangin desisyon niya sa iya nga kabuhi amo ang wala sya nagpakasal.
english: According to Louise, one of the best decisions she made in her life was not to get married.

text: Indi lang si Louise ang naga enjoy sang stress-free long life sa ila nga pamilya kaupod man niya ang iya nga manghod nga masobra 100 years old na man kag ang pagka- single man ang nangin sikreto.
english: Not only does Louise enjoy a stress-free long life in her family, she also has her brother who is more than 100 years old and being single has become a secret.

text: UPOD kita sa obserbasyon sang isa ka lokal nga brodkaster nga indi dapat mangin problema sang mga konsehal sang siyudad sang Iloilo ang matagaan sing pick-up ang kada isa sa ila.
english: We agree with the observation of a local broadcaster that it should not be a problem for the councilors of Iloilo City to be given a pick-up each of them.

text: “Maga-doble pa gani ang ila pagpaninguha sa pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo kon may pick-up,” maabtik niya nga tugda.
english: “They will even double their efforts to serve the people if there is a pick-up,” he quickly suggested.

text: UNA nga rason kon ngaa indi mangin problema ining pick-up, ina kay ginhatag ini ni Mayor Treñas nga wala sing pinilian.
english: The first reason why this pick-up will not be a problem is because Mayor Treñas gave it without discrimination.

text: Ginhatag niya ini sa tanan nga mga konsehal agud mas maayo pa gid ang ila pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo.
english: He gave it to all the councilors so that they can better serve the people.

text: In other words, wala ini sing pamulitika kay bisan ang mga konsehal sa kontra partido, katulad ni Ed Peñaredondo, Dr. Candice Tupas, kag Mandrie Malabor, maka-benepisyo man tungod mapalawak man nila ang ila pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo gamit ang dugang nga salakyan.
english: In other words, it is not political because even the councilors of the opposing party, such as Ed Peñaredondo, Dr. Candice Tupas, and Mandrie Malabor, will also benefit because they will be able to expand their services to the residents with additional vehicles.

text: Ugaling lang kay nagpamalibad ining tatlo sa pagbaton sini.
english: But these three refused to accept it.

text: Okey lang kuno sa ila nga gamiton lang ang ila kaugalingon nga mga salakyan.
english: They said it was okay for them to just use their own cars.

text: IKADUHA, “good” kon makaserbisyo gid man gihapon sila sing maayo, sunu sa ila, gamit ang ila personal nga salakyan.
english: SECOND, “good” if they can still serve well, according to them, using their personal vehicle.

text: Pero, obviously, mas maayo pa gid ang mahimo nila sa dugang nga pick-up, sunu gani sa nasambit ta nga brodkaster.
english: But, obviously, they can do better with an additional pick-up, according to the broadcaster.

text: IKATATLO, okey man ina ang concern nga indi magbaton sining pick-up sa punto nga magamit pa ang kwarta sa ginbakal sang pick-up sa kinahanglanon sang siyudad sa aton karon problema sa COVID-19.
english: THIRD, the concern of not accepting this pick-up is okay to the point that the money for the purchase of the pick-up can be used for the needs of the city in our current COVID-19 problem.

text: Ang pamangkot ugaling: Mapabay-an bala ang kinahanglanon sang mga pumuluyo sa ining aton karon problema sa COVID-19 kon matagaan sila sing dugang nga inisyatibo gamit ang pick-up?
english: The question is: Will the needs of the people in our current COVID-19 problem be neglected if they are given more initiative using the pick-up?

text: Well, depende ina sa paghaum-haum na sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Well, that depends on the residents' preparedness.

text: Sunu kay meyor, madamo naman nga mga bagay ang nahimo sang gobyerno sang siyudad para sa aton problema angot sa COVID-19, nga may bulig man sang gobyerno nasyonal.
english: According to the mayor, the city government has done many things for our problem regarding COVID-19, with the help of the national government.

text: May nakahanda naman nga kwarta ang siyudad – in fact, naka-order na ini – agud ibakal sang bakuna (vaccine) para sa mga 600,000 ka vials nga makasabat sa kinahanglanon para sa herd immunity.
english: The city has ready money – in fact, it has already ordered – to purchase vaccine for about 600,000 vials to meet the need for herd immunity.

text: Maibanan na gani ang galasutuhon diri tungod sa mga donasyon nga bakuna, nga nagalakip sang halin sa COVAX paagi sa World Health Organization (WHO).
english: The vaccine donations, including those from COVAX through the World Health Organization (WHO), will even reduce the cost of living here.

text: Ang COVAX isa ka paghugpong sang mga 64 ka manggaran nga mga nasyon agud maka-deliver sing libre sang “safe and effective” nga vaccine sa mga 92 ka kubos nga mga pungsod, lakip na diri ang Filipinas, para sa “fair distribution” sang mga vaccine sa tanan nga pungsod.
english: COVAX is a consortium of about 64 rich countries to deliver free of charge safe and effective vaccines to about 92 poor countries, including the Philippines, for fair distribution of vaccines to all countries.

text: Una sa sining COVAX-donated vaccine amo ang iya sang AstraZeneca.
english: The first of these COVAX-donated vaccines is that of AstraZeneca.

text: Gina-administer na ang mga ini, upod sa Sinovac nga gin-donar sang Tsina, sa karon sa aton mga health workers kag mga frotnliners, kon diin malapit na sa isa ka milyon ang nabakunahan.
english: They are already being administered, along with Sinovac donated by China, to our health workers and frontliners, where nearly one million have been vaccinated.

text: Malawak naman ang kampanya sa pagpabakuna sang gobyerno sang siyudad tubtub sa tanan nga kabarangayan.
english: The city government's vaccination campaign is extensive to all barangays.

text: Madasig ang pagpang-rehistro sang mabakunahan nga mga pumuluyo, nga ginahimo na gani sang iban nga barangay sa kada pamalay.
english: The registration of vaccinated residents is quick, which some barangays are even doing from house to house.

text: May nahatag naman si meyor nga dugang nga mga salakyan sa aton kapulisan agud makahulag man sila sing maayo sa pagbantay sa mga nagalabag sang ginapatuman nga minimum health protocols, katulad sang paggamit sa publiko sang face mask kag face shield kag ang pagpatuman sang social distancing.
english: The mayor has also provided additional vehicles to our police so that they can move better to monitor those who violate the minimum health protocols, such as the public use of face masks and face shields and the implementation of social distancing.

text: Ang mga pribado nga establicimiento may request man upod sa kay meyor agud mahatagan sang ila share nga vaccine halin sa gobyerno nasyonal paagi sa public-private partnership.
english: Private establishments also have a request with the mayor to be given their share of vaccine from the national government through public-private partnership.

text: Sige man ang pagpanghatag sang bulig (subsidy) sa mga naapektuhan nga mga pumuluyo sang siyudad kag sang gobyerno nasyonal.
english: The city and the national government are also continuing to distribute subsidies to the affected residents.

text: Kon may kulang pa dira, isa na seguro ang sa bahin na lang sang Konseho paagi sa mga ordinansa kag mga resolusyon nga makapasanyog pa ang pagbulig sa mga pumuluyo.
english: If there is anything missing, it is probably on the part of the Council through ordinances and resolutions that will further promote the assistance of the people.

text: Pero, may nahimo na bala sini ang mga konsehal nga indi lang sang sagad reklamo kay meyor, nga mapasalamatan man sang mga pumuluyo?
english: But, have the councilors done anything that is not just a complaint to the mayor, that the people can also appreciate?

text: In fact, ang mga konsehal, paagi sa ila inisyatibo, pwede man gani maghulag sunu sa ila personal nga ikasarang agud makabulig.
english: In fact, councilors, through their initiative, can even act according to their personal ability to help.

text: Kag diri makabulig dugang ang pick-up nga ginahatag ni meyor kon luyag nila gamiton.
english: And this is where the pick-up provided by the mayor can help if they want to use it.

text: Kwarta ini sang mga pumuluyo ang ginbakal sa sining pick-up kag kon may pasalamatan kamo, indi na bale seguro si meyor kundi ang mga pumuluyo na lang kay ila ini kwarta./PN
english: This pick-up was bought with the money of the people and if you have something to thank, the mayor doesn't care but the people because it's their money./PN

text: Isa ka mataas nga komisyon sang Vatican ang nagboto batok sa posibilidad nga pahanugutan ang kababainhan nga mangin deacon sa Simbahang Katolika.
english: A high Vatican commission has voted against the possibility of allowing women to become deacons in the Catholic Church.

text: Ini ang base sa isa ka report nga ginsumiter kay Pope Leo XIV nga ginpagguwa kahapon, Disyembre 4.
english: This is based on a report submitted to Pope Leo XIV released yesterday, December 4.

text: Sa boto nga 7-1, ginsiling sang komisyon nga ang kasaysayan kag teolohikal nga pagtuon ang wala nagapahanugot nga maordinahan ang mga kababainhan bilang deacon sa subong.
english: In a 7-1 vote, the commission said history and theological studies do not allow women to be ordained as deacons at this time.

text: Apang, ginarekomendar sa gihapon ang dugang nga pagtuod tuhoy diri.
english: However, further verification is still recommended.

text: Ini ang una nga botohay nga ginpagguwa sang Vatican ang resulta sang duha ka komisyon nga ginhimo sang nagtaliwan nga si Pope Francis agud tun-an ang posibilidad sang women deacons.
english: This is the first vote that the Vatican has released the results of two commissions set up by the late Pope Francis to study the possibility of women deacons.

text: Nagpasaka na sang complaint ang Quezon City Police District (QCPD) batok sa isa ka pulis kasunod sang iya social media posts nga naangot sa pag-aresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sang nagligad nga Martes, Marso 11.
english: The Quezon City Police District (QCPD) has filed a complaint against a policeman following his social media posts related to the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte last Tuesday, March 11.

text: Ini amo si Patrolman Francis Steve Talfion Fontillas ukon kilala man sa iya social media page nga Fonts Stv Vlogs.
english: Ini amo si Patrolman Francis Steve Talfion Fontillas ukon kilala man sa iya social media page nga Fonts Stv Vlogs.

text: Gin-file ang panumbungon sa Quezon City Prosecutor’s Office bangud sang ginaalegar nga paglapas sa Article 142 (Inciting to Sedition) sang Revised Penal Code, in relation sa Republic Act No.
english: The charge was filed with the Quezon City Prosecutor's Office for alleged violation of Article 142 (Inciting to Sedition) of the Revised Penal Code, in relation to Republic Act No.

text: 10175 (Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012).
english: 10175 (Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012).

text: Base sa Quezon City Police District Personnel Records and Management Division, si Fontillas ang naka-assign sa District Personnel and Holding Admin Section (DPHAS) as of February 20, 2025.
english: Based on the Quezon City Police District Personnel Records and Management Division, Fontillas is assigned to the District Personnel and Holding Admin Section (DPHAS) as of February 20, 2025.

text: Nag-absent without official leave (AWOL) ini humalin sang Marso 6, 2025.
english: He has been absent without official leave (AWOL) since March 6, 2025.

text:
Yari ang statement sang QCPD:

“The Quezon City Police District (QCPD) has formally filed a complaint against Patrolman Francis Steve Tallion Fontillas for violating Article 142 (Inciting to Sedition) of the Revised Penal Code, in relation to Republic Act No.
english:
Here is the QCPD’s statement:

“The Quezon City Police District (QCPD) has formally filed a complaint against Patrolman Francis Steve Tallion Fontillas for violating Article 142 (Inciting to Sedition) of the Revised Penal Code, in relation to Republic Act No.

text: 10175 (Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012) before the Quezon City Prosecutor’s Office.
english: 10175 (Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012) before the Quezon City Prosecutor’s Office.

text: This action stems from his social media posts following reports of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte’s arrest.
english: This action stems from his social media posts following reports of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte’s arrest.

text: Records from the District Personnel Records and Management Division (DPRMD) indicate that Pat.
english: Records from the District Personnel Records and Management Division (DPRMD) indicate that Pat.

text: Fontillas has been assigned to the District Personnel and Holding Admin Section (DPHAS) since February 20, 2025, but has been absent without official leave (AWOL) since March 6, 2025.
english: Fontillas has been assigned to the District Personnel and Holding Admin Section (DPHAS) since February 20, 2025, but has been absent without official leave (AWOL) since March 6, 2025.

text: The QCPD reminds all personnel to adhere to the highest standards of professionalism and discipline.
english: The QCPD reminds all personnel to adhere to the highest standards of professionalism and discipline.

text:
PNP officers shall remain apolitical and non-partisan at all times and we must refrain from posting unauthorized and biased contents in social media and other communication platforms.”

Sa latest post sang police personnel, ginklaro niya nga nag-file siya sang leave halin sang March 6-19 kag gin-aprubahan man ini apang ginkwestyon niya kun ngaa ginsiling nga nag-AWOL ini.
english:
PNP officers shall remain apolitical and non-partisan at all times and we must refrain from posting unauthorized and biased contents in social media and other communication platforms.”

In the latest post of the police personnel, he clarified that he filed for leave from March 6-19 and it was approved but he questioned why he was said to have gone AWOL.

text: “Nag-file ako ng leave from March 6-19, and it was approved and signed, witness pa ang asawa ko noong nag-file ako at noong inaprubahan ng Chief Admin, tapos sasabihin niyong AWOL ako?
english: “I filed for leave from March 6-19, and it was approved and signed, my wife was a witness when I filed and when it was approved by the Chief Admin, then you say I'm AWOL?

text: Ang kukupal niyo naman talaga!,” post sini.
english: You're really stupid!,” he posted.

text: Nagpahayag pa ini nga mahatag siya sang reward kun mapa-preso gid man siya sa amo nga mga reklamo.
english: He said he would give a reward if he was jailed for the complaints.

text: Pahayag sini, indi makabig nga inciting to sedition kun nagpabutyag lang ini sa iya panindugan bangud may yara man ini sang right to freedom of expression.
english: He said it is not considered inciting to sedition if he just expressed his position because he also has the right to freedom of expression.

text: “Inciting to sedition daw yung ginawa ko?
english: “Was what I did inciting to sedition?

text: Hahaha.
english: Hahaha.

text: Okay lang ba kayo?
english: Are you okay?

text: I only expressed my stand and my principles.
english: I only expressed my stand and my principles.

text: Ginpasibangdan sang Britanya ang Russia nga nagagamit sang troll factory agud nga magpalapta sang sala nga impormasyon sa social media may kaangtanan sa gyera sa Ukraine kag agud nga atakehon ang pila sa ila nga mga kritiko.
english: Britain has accused Russia of using a troll factory to spread misinformation on social media about the war in Ukraine and to attack some of its critics.

text: Suno sa research nga ginpondohan sang gobyerno sang United Kingdom, may yara sang daan nga factory sa Saint Petersburg kag amo ini ang ginhimo sang Russia nga troll farm.
english: According to research funded by the United Kingdom government, there is an old factory in Saint Petersburg and this is what Russia turned into a troll farm.

text: Ginpahayag nga gingamit ini nga troll farm agud nga magbilin sang mga komento sa mga comment sections sang popular websites.
english: This troll farm was allegedly used to leave comments in the comment sections of popular websites.

text: Suno sa defense ministry sang Britanya, gina-target sang mga empleyado sang troll factory ang politicians amo man ang musicians kag bands sa Britain, South Africa kag India.
english: According to the British defense ministry, troll factory employees target politicians as well as musicians and bands in Britain, South Africa and India.

text: Lakip sa gin-target sang trolls suno sa UK amo ang accounts nanday British Prime Minister Boris Johnson kag iban pa nga UK ministers, kag iban pa nga world leaders kaangay ni German Chancellor Olaf Scholz kag EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell.
english: Among those targeted by trolls according to the UK were the accounts of British Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other UK ministers, and other world leaders such as German Chancellor Olaf Scholz and EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell.

text: Ang operasyon sang trolls ang ginapahayag nga na-detect na pati sa Telegram, Twitter kag Facebook, apang mas labi nga naka-sentro sa Instagram, YouTube, kag TikTok.
english: The operation of trolls has reportedly been detected on Telegram, Twitter and Facebook, but is more focused on Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

text: Ginapahayag pa nga may yara sang mga TikTok influencers nga ginbayaran agud nga pabaskugon pa kun ano ang ginaduhol nga istorya sang Russia.
english: It is also reported that there are TikTok influencers who were paid to reinforce what the story is being pushed by Russia.

text: Hugot nga ipatuman sang Task Force on Moral Values Formation ang monitoring sa mga kabataan ilabi na ang mga menor-ede-edad kadungan sa kapiestahan ni Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria de Jaro.
english: The Task Force on Moral Values ​​Formation will strictly enforce monitoring of children especially minors during the feast of Our Lady of the Candlemas of Jaro.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Nestor Canong, Head sang Task Force on Moral Values Formation, iya ginpahayag nga hugot man ang pagpatuman sang curfew hours ilabi na sa mga kabataan kon tungang gab-i.

Suno kay Canong, dapat nga giyahan sang ginikanan ang ila mga kabataan agud nga indi maka-engage sa mga iligal nga aktibidad.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nestor Canong, Head of the Task Force on Moral Values ​​Formation, said that curfew hours are also strictly enforced especially for children at midnight.

According to Canong, parents should guide their children so that they do not engage in illegal activities.

text: Nagkooperar man ang talatapan sa tagsa ka mga punong barangay kag mga tanod agud nga mapatuman ang nasambit nga pagsulundan.
english: The office also cooperated with each barangay captain and tanod to implement the said rule.

text: Nagpakig-angot man ini sa kapulisan agud nga maka-deploy sang police visibility sa palibot sang Jaro.
english: He also contacted the police to deploy police visibility around Jaro.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga tinutuyo lamang sang Task Force on Moral Values Formation nga indi maimpluwensyahan sang malain nga aktibidad ang kapyesatahan ni Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria de Jaro.
english: He also explained that the Task Force on Moral Values ​​Formation aims to ensure that the feast of Our Lady of the Candlemas of Jaro is not influenced by bad activities.

text:
Pahanumdom sa mga nagapanag-iya sang swimming pool: ‘Siguraduha gid nga indi sige-sige ang pagtubod sang tubig sa inyo nga pool!’

Ini ang leksyon nga natun-an sa isa ka eskwelahan sa Japan matapos nga nagdangat sa $27,000 ukon P1.4 million ang balayran sini para sa tubig matapos hungod nga ginbilin sang isa ka manunudlo nga bukas ang pump sang tubig sa swimming pool sa sulod sang pila ka bulan.
english:
Reminder to swimming pool owners: 'Make sure your pool is not overflowing!'

This is the lesson learned in a school in Japan after its water bill reached $27,000 or P1.4 million after a teacher deliberately left the water pump in the swimming pool open for several months.

text: Ginrason sang wala ginhingadlan nga manunudlo nga maayo ang fresh water sa swimming pool kontra sa COVID-19.
english: The unnamed teacher argued that fresh water in the swimming pool is good against COVID-19.

text: Ini ang iya ginpanumdom rason nga ginpabay-an nga nagatubod lang ang tubig halin sa bulan sang Hunyo tubtub sa Septyembre.
english: He remembered this and left the water flowing from June to September.

text: Suno kay local education board official Akira Kojiri, may chlorine kag filtering machines nga ginagamit agud nga matinluan ang tubig sa swimming pool, apang posible suno sa iya nga ginpanumdom sang manunudlo nga ang pagpatubod lang sang bag-o nga tubig amo ang nagaisahanon nga paagi agud nga mapunggan ang Covid.
english: According to local education board official Akira Kojiri, there is chlorine and filtering machines used to clean the water in the swimming pool, but he said it is possible that the teacher reminded him that only new water is the only way to prevent Covid.

text: Pila man ka staff sa eskwelahan ang nakakita nga nagatubod ang tubig sa pool kag ginapatay man nila ang pump, apang natukiban sang ulihi nga nagamato-mato gid ang manunudlo agud nga buksan ang pump.
english: Several staff at the school also saw water flowing into the pool and turned off the pump, but it was later discovered that the teacher was struggling to turn on the pump.

text: Bangud sini, naglab-ot sa 4,000 tonelada sang sobra nga tubig ang nagamit sa pool sa sulod sang duha ka bulan.
english: As a result, 4,000 tons of excess water were used in the pool in two months.

text: Gina-engganyo sang mga otoridad sa Yokosuka, Kanagawa prefecture nga bayaran sang manunudlo kag duha ka supervisors ang katunga sang 3.5 million yen ($27,000) nga water bill.
english: Authorities in Yokosuka, Kanagawa prefecture are urging the teacher and two supervisors to pay half of the 3.5 million yen ($27,000) water bill.

text: Nagpangayo man sang pasaylo ang awtoridad sa Yokosuka bangud sa natuga sini nga financial damage sa syudad.
english: The authorities also apologized to Yokosuka for the financial damage it caused to the city.

text: Handa ang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga maghatag sang bulig sa International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) kun may iban pa nga warrant of arrest nga iga-isyu batok sa mga “co-perpetrators” ni anay presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa iya makamamatay nga war on drugs.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) is ready to assist the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) if there are other warrants of arrest issued against former President Rodrigo Duterte's co-perpetrators in his deadly war on drugs.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Jean Fajardo nga wala pa sang impormasyon nga nahatag sa ila angot sa amo nga bagay, apang nagpasalig nga may yara sang “template” ang PNP sa pagserbe sang posible arrest warrants sa iban pa nga mga indibidwal nga may kaangtanan sa drug war.
english: PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Jean Fajardo revealed that no information has been given to them regarding the matter, but assured that the PNP has a template for serving possible arrest warrants to other individuals involved in the drug war.

text: Ginserbe sang mga otoridad sang nagligad nga Martes ang warrant of arrest halin sa International Criminal Court (ICC) batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte bangud sa panumbungon nga murder bilang isa ka krimen batok sa katawhan may kaangtanan sa iya makamamatay nga drug war nga ginapahayag nagresulta sa kamatayon sang indi magnubo sa 6,000 ka tawo.
english: Authorities last Tuesday served a warrant of arrest from the International Criminal Court (ICC) against former President Rodrigo Duterte on charges of murder as a crime against humanity in connection with his deadly drug war that allegedly resulted in the deaths of at least 6,000 people.

text: Ang anay presidente sang Pilipinas ang yara subong sa detention cell sang ICC sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: The former president of the Philippines is currently in the ICC detention cell in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Naghimo siya sang iya una nga pag-atubang sa ICC sang Biyernes, paagi sa video link.
english: He made his first appearance before the ICC on Friday, via video link.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Malacañang nga wala ini sang may nabaton nga opisyal nga komunikasyon nahanungod sa anuman nga pahibalo sang Interpol para sa mga “co-perpetrators” ni Duterte may kaangtanan sa maduguon nga giyera sa droga sang iya administrasyon.
english: Earlier, Malacañang said it had not received any official communication regarding any Interpol announcement for Duterte's co-perpetrators in connection with his administration's bloody drug war.

text: Napuno sang Ilonggo-Chinese community ang Iloilo Freedom Grandstand sa ginpatigayon nga Chinese New Year Celebration sang city government.
english: The Ilonggo-Chinese community filled the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand during the Chinese New Year Celebration of the city government.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpabugal nga tuman na ka layo ang nadangtan sang pag-abyanay sang mga Ilonggo kag Chinese sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said he is proud that the friendship between Ilonggos and Chinese in the city has come a long way.

text: Suno kay Treñas, sa tagsa ka tuig nga pagselebrar sang Chinese New Year, gadako man ang kahiwatan.
english: According to Treñas, with the annual celebration of the Chinese New Year, the event also grows.

text: Ginpasalamatan man sang alkalde ang Chinese-Filipino community ukon Tsinoys nga nagbuylog sa amo nga kahiwatan sa sulod sang masobra 20 na ka tuig.
english: The mayor also thanked the Chinese-Filipino community or Tsinoys who have joined the event for more than 20 years.

text: Nagpasalamat man si Treñas Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.
english: Treñas also thanked the Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.

text: (IFFI) nga ginapangunahan nanday Rito Carlos L. Peña kag president Allan Ryan L. Tan; kag Fr.
english: (IFFI) led by Rito Carlos L. Peña and president Allan Ryan L. Tan; and Fr.

text: Joseph Raymund Patrick Sanchez, SJ, ang taskforce chairperson kag presidente sang sini nga tuig kag host, ang Ateneo de Iloilo-Santa Maria Catholic School, subong man sang iban pa nga Chinese schools.
english: Joseph Raymund Patrick Sanchez, SJ, the taskforce chairperson and president of this year and host, the Ateneo de Iloilo-Santa Maria Catholic School, as well as other Chinese schools.

text: Gin-abi-abi man sang natungdan ang presensya sang Filipino singer-songwriter kag proud Ilonggo nga si Mr. Jose Mari Chan.
english: He also welcomed the presence of Filipino singer-songwriter and proud Ilonggo Mr. Jose Mari Chan.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi magnubo sa 15,000 ka mga Chinese Filipinos ang naga-istar subong sa Iloilo City.
english: It is known that at least 15,000 Chinese Filipinos are currently living in Iloilo City.

text: Ginmando ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. ordered the

text: ang pagpataas sang subsistence allowance sang military personnel sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).
english: the increase in the subsistence allowance of military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).

text: Sa Executive Order No.
english: In Executive Order No.

text: 84 nga ginpirmahan ni Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, ginsiling sang presidente nga ang subsistence allowance ang himuon nga P350 per day halin sa P150, epektibo Enero 1, 2025.
english: 84 signed by Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, the president said the subsistence allowance will be increased to P350 per day from P150, effective January 1, 2025.

text: Ang nasambit nga allowance increase ang para sa AFP officers kag enlisted personnel.
english: The said allowance increase is for AFP officers and enlisted personnel.

text: Sakop man diri ang trainees kag probationary second lieutenants/ensigns nga nagapaidalom sa military training, Citizen Military Training cadets sa summer camp training kag reserve officers kag enlisted reservists nga nagapaidalom sa training kag assembly/mobilization test, Citizen Armed Force Geographical Unit, kag cadets.
english: It also covers trainees and probationary second lieutenants/ensigns undergoing military training, Citizen Military Training cadets in summer camp training and reserve officers and enlisted reservists undergoing training and assembly/mobilization test, Citizen Armed Force Geographical Unit, and cadets.

text: Sa rally sang Alyansa Para Sa Bagong Pilipinas sa Tacloban, Leyte, nagpabati-bati liwat si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: At the rally of the Alliance for a New Philippines in Tacloban, Leyte, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga indi pagpatay ang solusyon sa krimen kag iligal nga droga.
english: that not killing is the solution to crime and illegal drugs.

text: Bisan nga wala sini ginhinambit ang pangalan ni former President Rodrigo Duterte, ginsiling sini nga indi kinahanglan nga mangin maduguon ang solusyon.
english: Although he did not mention the name of former President Rodrigo Duterte, he said the solution does not have to be bloody.

text: Pahayag sini, sila sa Alyansa ang nagapati nga indi husto ang pagpamatay sang linibu-libo ka mga Pilipino para sa sini nga problema.
english: He said they in the Alliance believe that it is wrong to kill thousands of Filipinos for this problem.

text: Suno sa iya, ang husto nga paagi para masiguro ang kalinungan amo ang husto nga layi kag epektibo nga suporta sa kapulisan kag sa local government.
english: He said the right way to ensure peace is through proper laws and effective support to the police and local government.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga indi pagpamahog, pagpaninggit, kag pagpamuyayaw ang kinahanglanon subong sang Pilipinas.
english: He also said that threats, shouting, and insults are not what is needed in the Philippines.

text: “Ang kailangan po natin para mag-unlad ay hindi pananakot o paninigaw.
english: “What we need to move forward is not intimidation or intimidation.

text: Ang kailangan po natin ay solusyon, hindi mga maiinit at maanghang na salita na wala namang katuturan, wala namang kabuluhan, at walang kinalaman sa problema na hinaharap ninyong pang-araw-araw,” kabahin sang speech sang punong ehekutibo.
english: What we need is a solution, not hot and spicy words that have no truth, no meaning, and nothing to do with the problems you face every day,” part of the speech of the chief executive.

text: Dugang sini: “Sa laban naman kontra sa droga at sa krimen, hindi po nating kailangan dumaan sa madugong solusyon.
english: He added: “In the fight against drugs and crime, we do not need to go through bloody solutions.

text: Wala po sa amin ang niniwala na ang solusyon sa krimen at saka sa droga ay ang pumatay ng libo-libo na kapwa nating Pilipino.
english: None of us believes that the solution to crime and drugs is to kill thousands of our fellow Filipinos.

text:
Hindi po tama ‘yun.”

Wala naman nagsipot sa rally sang Alyansa ang utod ni President Marcos nga si Senator Imee Marcos.
english:
That's not right.”

President Marcos' sister, Senator Imee Marcos, did not attend the Alliance rally.

text: Nag-sorry si Imee sa mga Waray nga indi siya makatambong, kag nagpaathag nga indi niya mabaton ang ginhimo kay former President Duterte.
english: Imee apologized to the Waray that she could not attend, and explained that she cannot accept what was done to former President Duterte.

text: Ginsiling sini nga tun-an niya ang amo nga hitabo para nga makabulig nga masanagan ang mga Pilipino kag makahimo sang solusyon.
english: He said he will study the incident to help enlighten Filipinos and come up with a solution.

text: “Nagpapaumanhin ako sa mga kababayan kong Waray na hindi ako makakadalo sa rally mamaya sa Tacloban,” suno kay Imee.
english: “I apologize to my fellow Waray that I will not be able to attend the rally later in Tacloban,” Imee said.

text:
Hindi ko matanggap ang ginawa kay [former President Rodrigo Duterte.”

Martes sang gin-aresto si Duterte sa NAIA kag gindala sa The Hague sa gahum sang arrest warrant sang International Criminal Court (ICC) bangud sa ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity nga iya nahimo sa war on drugs.#
english:
I cannot accept what [former President Rodrigo Duterte) did.”

Duterte was arrested at the NAIA on Tuesday and brought to The Hague under an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC) for alleged crimes against humanity committed in the war on drugs.

text: Ginkasubo ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang pag-suspend sang US Agency for International Development (USAID) sang ila projects sa Iloilo City.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas regretted the suspension of the US Agency for International Development (USAID) of its projects in Iloilo City.

text: Ini kasunod sang 90-day pause ukon suspension sang foreign aid sang Estados Unidos sa Pilipinas.
english: This follows the 90-day pause or suspension of US foreign aid to the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga isa ang syudad ang may dako nga proyekto nga nakuha halin sa US Agency for International Development.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the city is one of the largest projects received from the US Agency for International Development.

text: Lakip na diri ang Climate Resilient City Project kag ang pagkoordinar sa urban areas sang syudad.
english: This includes the Climate Resilient City Project and coordination with urban areas of the city.

text: Apisar sini, nagalaum sa gihapon ang alkalde nga mapadayon ang amo nga mga proyekto bangud ang iban ang manogtapos na.
english: Despite this, the mayor still hopes that these projects will continue as some are nearing completion.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, naghatag sang dako nga role ang USAID sa syudad ilabi na sa health, edukasyon, kag urban development.
english: According to Fantilaga, USAID has played a major role in the city especially in health, education, and urban development.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-untat hatag sang foreign aid ang Estados Unidos pagkatapos nga nagmando si US President Donald Trump nga repasuhon kon ang alokasyon sang bulig nagasanto sa iya foreign policy.
english: The United States stopped providing foreign aid after US President Donald Trump ordered a review of whether the allocation of aid was in line with his foreign policy.

text: Apisar sang panawagan kag apelar halin sa international community, gindayon gid sang Singapore ang pagbitay sa isa ka mentally disabled nga lalaki nga may kaso sa iligal nga droga.
english: Despite calls and appeals from the international community, Singapore went ahead with the execution of a mentally disabled man on illegal drugs charges.

text: Ini amo ang Malaysian nga si Nagaenthran Dharmalingam, 34, nga naaresto sang 2009 bangud nadakpan sa tuyo sini nga pagpasulod sang tatlo ka kutsara ukon 43 grams sang heroin sa Singapore.
english: This is Malaysian Nagaenthran Dharmalingam, 34, who was arrested in 2009 for trying to smuggle three tablespoons or 43 grams of heroin into Singapore.

text: Tuman ka kontrobersyal ang kaso ni Dharmalingam bangud may yara ini sang IQ nga 69 — ang level nga ginakilala nga intellectual disability.Kun gobyerno naman ang pahambalon, nahangpan ni Dharmalingam ang nature sang iya nga ginhimo kag wala man sini nadula ang iya nga sense of judgment kun ano ang sala kag ang husto.
english: Dharmalingam's case is very controversial because he has an IQ of 69 — the level recognized as an intellectual disability. As far as the government is concerned, Dharmalingam understands the nature of what he did and has not lost his sense of judgment about what is wrong and what is right.

text: Suno pa sa korte, nag-agi man ini sa “due process in accordance with the law” bangud 11 ka tuig nga nangin sulit-sulit ang iya nga appeal.Suno naman sa utod ni Dharmalingam, temprano pa nga ginpatigayon ang pagbitay kahapon.
english: The court said he also went through "due process in accordance with the law" because he had been appealing for 11 years. According to Dharmalingam's brother, the hanging was carried out early yesterday.

text: Ginpadala ang iya nga lawas sa Malaysia kag igahaya sa Ipoh sa amo nga pungsod.
english: His body was sent to Malaysia and will be buried in Ipoh in that country.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Mercy Saavedra Cacan direkta sa Singapore, may last appeal pa ang pamilya sa korte kahapon apang wala na ginpamatian bangud isa ang Singapore sa may pinaka-istrikto nga layi pag-abot sa drug trafficking.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Mercy Saavedra Cacan directly in Singapore, the family had a last appeal in court yesterday but it was not heard because Singapore is one of the countries with the strictest laws when it comes to drug trafficking.

text: Nobyembre pa sang nagligad nga tuig naka-schedule ang pagbitay kay Dharmalingam, kag madamo ang nagpakamalaot sa sini nga akto bangud sa ginapahayag mental disability sang lalaki.
english: Dharmalingam's execution was scheduled for November last year, and many condemned the act because of the man's alleged mental disability.

text: Matapos ang pila ka tuig nga pagpakibato sa amo nga kaso, napierde si Dharmalingam sa kaso bangud ginbasura sang huwes ang argumento nga ang pagpatay sa isa ka tawo nga may problema sa paminsaron ang naga-contravene sa international law.
english: After years of fighting the case, Dharmalingam lost the case because the judge rejected the argument that killing a mentally challenged person contravened international law.

text: Suportado ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang tikang sang City Legal Office nga renegotiation sa Double Dragon Properties Corp kaangot sa Guimaras Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas supports the City Legal Office's move to renegotiate with Double Dragon Properties Corp. regarding the Guimaras Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga suportado niya ang negosasyon ilabi na kon nagatumod ini sa mas masanyog nga financial terms para sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said she supports the negotiations especially if they refer to better financial terms for the city.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, kon makit-an nga ang renegotiation ang favorable sa Iloilo City, mahimo nga ipa-recieve ini sa Double Dragon Properties Corp.
english: According to Fantilaga, if it is found that the renegotiation is favorable to Iloilo City, it can be received by Double Dragon Properties Corp.

text: Nahibaluan nga halos duha ka tuig matapos gin-umpisahan ang pagrepaso liwat sang Joint Venture Agreement (JVA) para sa Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services (GIFTS) sa Parola Wharf.
english: It is known that almost two years after the start of the review of the Joint Venture Agreement (JVA) for the Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services (GIFTS) at Parola Wharf.

text: Ginpirmahan sang 2012 sa panahon sang administrasyon sadto ni Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog, ginhatagan ang Double Dragon Properties Corp sang 25 ka tuig nga kinamatarong sa pagdevelop kag pag-operate sang 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.
english: Signed in 2012 during the administration of then-Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog, Double Dragon Properties Corp was granted a 25-year right to develop and operate the 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.

text: Ang Joint Venture ang nagahatag sa Double Dragon sang 25 year exclusive rights sa pagkolekta sang terminal, berthing and cargo fees, kag ang pagparenta sang mga commercial spaces sa terminal complex.
english: The Joint Venture gives Double Dragon 25 year exclusive rights to collect terminal, berthing and cargo fees, and the leasing of commercial spaces in the terminal complex.

text: Sa idalom sang JVA, ang bahin sang syudad naglakip sang 1-5% sang kita sa gross terminal fee, 1% sang gross berthing fee revenues, 1% sang gross cargo fee revenues, kag 1% sang gross rental revenue (wala labot ang VAT).
english: Under the JVA, the city’s share included 1-5% of gross terminal fee revenue, 1% of gross berthing fee revenues, 1% of gross cargo fee revenues, and 1% of gross rental revenue (excluding VAT).

text: Kumpiyansa ang mga taga-suporta ni anay President Rodrigo Duterte sa The Hague, Netherlands nga indi madutlan ang anay Presidente sa mga confirmation of charges batok sa iya sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Supporters of former President Rodrigo Duterte in The Hague, Netherlands are confident that the former President will not be caught in the confirmation of charges against him at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lea Manego, supporter ni ex-President Duterte, iya ginpahayag nga bag-o pa lamang nagsugod ang proseso kag wala pa sang “clear picture” may kaangtanan sa mga alegasyon batok sa anay Presidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lea Manego, a supporter of ex-President Duterte, said the process has just begun and there is no clear picture regarding the allegations against the former President.

text: Suno pa sa iya, kun may ara sang ”concrete evidence” nga ginapakita ang pihak nga kampo, may ara man sila nga mga ebidensya nga iga-representar.
english: He said that if there is concrete evidence shown by the other camp, they also have evidence to represent.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga apisar mainit ang tensyon sa tunga sang mga taga-suporta sang mga biktima sang drug war ni Duterte kag sa ila nga mga taga-suporta ni anay PRRD nagapabilin sa gihapon ang respeto sa tunga sang mga ini sa ICC.
english: He also explained that despite the heated tension between the supporters of the victims of Duterte's drug war and their supporters of the former PRRD, respect remains between them in the ICC.

text: Nagalaom man ang mga ini nga makit-an sang International Criminal Court ang positibo nga resulta sang ginpatigayon nga pagpakigbato ni Duterte sa illegal nga droga sang ini pa ang nagapungko bilang Presidente.
english: They also hope that the International Criminal Court will see the positive results of Duterte's fight against illegal drugs during his tenure as President.

text: ILOILO CITY- Paandam!
english: ILOILO CITY- Warning!

text: Mangin mahinalungon kita sa mga butang nga aton ginatapakan basi sila pa ang may dala sa aton sang kaayuhan.
english: Let us be careful of the things we step on, lest they bring us good.

text: Kaangay sang bermuda grass nga madamo gali sang dala nga benepisyo sa lawas.
english: Like bermuda grass, it has many health benefits.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, ang bermuda ang ginagamit sa Ayurvedic Medicine sa India sa linibo na ka tuig.
english: In fact, bermuda has been used in Ayurvedic Medicine in India for thousands of years.

text: Suno kay Dr. Paul Haider, isa ka spiritual teacher kag master herbalist, ang juice gikan sa bermuda grass ang maayo nga alkalizing agent, nga nagabulig sa stomach acid kag gastric ulcers, diabetes, anemia, detoxing, congestion, nagapabakod sang tul-an kag ngipon.
english: According to Dr. Paul Haider, a spiritual teacher and master herbalist, the juice from bermuda grass is good alkalizing agent, which helps with stomach acid and gastric ulcers, diabetes, anemia, detoxing, congestion, strengthens bones and teeth.

text: Ang bermuda grass isa ka maayo nga detoxing agent nga nagabulig sa pagtinlo sa atay kag cells sang lawas kag dugo paagi sa iya chlorophyll.
english: Bermuda grass is an excellent detoxing agent that helps cleanse the liver and cells of the body and blood with its chlorophyll.

text: Ang Bermuda Grass juice naga- contain sang masobra 65% chlorophyll gani nga may ability ini nga mag boost sang produksyon sang hemoglobin kag red blood cell nga makabulig sa anemia.
english: Bermuda Grass juice contains more than 65% chlorophyll so it has the ability to boost the production of hemoglobin and red blood cells which can help with anemia.

text: Ang Bermuda Grass juice nagabukas sa baga kag nagatinlo sang congestion gani makabulig ini sa trangkaso, asthma, kag bronchitis.
english: Bermuda Grass juice opens up the lungs and clears congestion so it can help with flu, asthma, and bronchitis.

text: Ang juice kon ipahid sa lawas ang makabulig sa minor rashes, irritations, kag ang paste sang Bermuda Grass ang makapugong sa pagdugo sang pilas sa panit.
english: The juice when applied to the body can help with minor rashes, irritations, and the paste of Bermuda Grass can prevent bleeding from skin wounds.

text: Manggaranon man ini sa antioxidants nga nagabulig agud malikawan ang cardiovascular disease, strokes, kag cancer.
english: It is also rich in antioxidants that help prevent cardiovascular disease, strokes, and cancer.

text: Balantayan na 8:30 subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas ang Game 1 sa 2025 National Basketball Association (NBA) finals sa tunga sang Oklahoma City Thunder kag Indiana Pacers.
english: Game 1 of the 2025 National Basketball Association (NBA) finals between the Oklahoma City Thunder and Indiana Pacers will be played at 8:30 am Philippine time.

text: Ini nga championship tilt sa tunga sang duha ka teams ang pangunahan sang ascending stars nga sanday Shai Gilgeous-Alexander sang Thunder kag Tyrese Haliburton sang Pacers.
english: This championship tilt between the two teams will be led by ascending stars Shai Gilgeous-Alexander of the Thunder and Tyrese Haliburton of the Pacers.

text: Patigayunon ini sa home court sang Thunder sa Paycom Center sa Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States.
english: It will be held on the home court of the Thunder at the Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States.

text: Ini ang una nga finals appearance sang OKC halin sang 2012.
english: It was OKC’s first finals appearance since 2012.

text: Nahimo nila ini paagi sa 4-1 series win batok sa Minnesota Timberwolves sa Western Conference finals.
english: They did so with a 4-1 series win over the Minnesota Timberwolves in the Western Conference finals.

text: Samtang, antes nakaabot sa Oklahoma, literal nga nangin mabudlay ang inagyan sang Pacers bangud sa tornado warning sa kapital nga syudad rason nga naghugpa anay ang eroplano sa Tulsa, Oklahoma.
english: Meanwhile, before reaching Oklahoma, the Pacers literally had a difficult time due to a tornado warning in the capital city that caused the plane to land in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

text: Ini naman ang una nga tion nga naka-abante sila sa final round sa NBA.
english: This is the first time they have advanced to the final round in the NBA.

text: Nahimo nila ini matapos ginlutos ang Milwaukee Bucks, ang Cleveland Cavaliers, kag ang New York Knicks sa East.
english: They did so after beating the Milwaukee Bucks, the Cleveland Cavaliers, and the New York Knicks in the East.

text: Sa injury report, si Nikola Topic lamang ang indi makahampang sa Thunder.
english: On the injury report, only Nikola Topic is out for the Thunder.

text: Sa Pacers, wala si Jarace Walker amo man si Isaiah Jackson; samtang kwestyonable pa kun maka-upod si Tony Bradley.
english: With the Pacers, Jarace Walker is gone so is Isaiah Jackson; while it is still questionable whether Tony Bradley will be able to join.

text: MADAMO nga salamat Glenda sa imo matahum nga script nga ginbalay mo halin sa amon mga panugdaon nga mga kolumnista sa Hiligaynon sa Panay News, nga ginpagwa sa 40th Anniversary Issue mismo sa natuonan sini nga petsa sa Abril 7.
english: Thank you very much Glenda for your beautiful script that you wrote from our suggestions as columnists in Hiligaynon in Panay News, which was published in the 40th Anniversary Issue itself on this date of April 7th.

text: In fact bilib ako sa imo kay napakot mo ang bisan wala namon napabutyag sa amon huna-huna sa imo ginsulat nga feature story parti sa amon.
english: In fact I admire you because you guessed what we didn't express in our minds in your feature story about us.

text: Pwede ka na gali masaligan sa pagsulat sang napalip-ut nga script para sa stage drama kag bisan gani sa pelikula!
english: You can actually be trusted to write shortened scripts for stage dramas and even movies!

text: Pero indi man pagpatam-i kay basi gwa sina “based (lang ina) on a true story” nga indi na mabal-an ang matuod kag indi.
english: But don't be too sweet because it might be "based on a true story" that you can't tell what's true and what's not.

text: Congrats Glenda kag salamat sa matahum nga scriptwriting mo sang amon mga pahayag parti sa amon tunay nga balatyagon sa kon ano ka tam-is ang pulong nga Hiligaynon, kag kon ano ini ka-importante sa lubos nga paghangop sang mga pumuluyo sa luyag namon ipabutyag sa amon sinulatan.
english: Congrats Glenda and thank you for your beautiful scriptwriting of our statements about our true feelings on how sweet the Hiligaynon language is, and how important it is for the people to fully understand what we want to express in our writing.

text:
***

Makamamatay ang balatian nga COVD-19, apang indi gid man makahaladlok ini.
english:
***

The COVD-19 disease is deadly, but it is not scary at all.

text: Naga-rebelde gani ang madamo nga pumuluyo sa mga “lockdown” nga ginapatuman sang gobyerno sa madamo nga pungsod samtang nagasinggit “FREEDOM”.
english: Many people are even rebelling against the lockdowns imposed by the government in many countries while shouting “FREEDOM”.

text: Sunu sa World Health Organization (WHO), 82 ka porsyento (%) sang malatnan sang COVID-19 iguon lang sang “mild”, 15% may “severe” nga igu, kag 3% lang ang “critical”.
english: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), 82 percent of those infected with COVID-19 will be mildly affected, 15% will be severely affected, and only 3% will be critical.

text: Sa sini nga mga “critical” (3%) mga 2% ang nagakapatay.
english: Of these “critical” (3%) about 2% die.

text: Sa masami ugaling, ang “critical” nga mga pasyente halin sa mga senior citizen (60 anyos pataas) – lakip na ang mga linghod – nga may mabug-at nga ginabatyag katulad sang diabetes, heart failure, ukon high blood pressure kag ano pa, labi na gid kon co-occurring (comorbidity) ini sa iban nga balatian nga makapabug-at pa gid sang ginabatyag nga mapalala pa sang COVID-19.
english: Often, however, “critical” patients are senior citizens (60 years old and above) – including the young – who have serious illnesses such as diabetes, heart failure, or high blood pressure and others, especially if they co-occur (comorbidity) with other illnesses that can make COVID-19 worse.

text: Gani ang mga senior citizen, kag ang kasubong nila sing ginabatyag, yara sa priority list sang vaccination program upod, ukon sunod, sa mga health workers kag frontliners.
english: So senior citizens, and those like them, are on the priority list of the vaccination program along with, or next to, health workers and frontliners.

text: Tungod sini, importante nga ang magapabakuna sa ila may go-signal gid sang doktor kon bala bagay sila bakunahan ukon indi kay ang adverse effects, labi na gid kon may serious allergy nga pwede sang bakuna (vaccine) pukawon kag magdulot pa sang indi maayo nga resulta sa ila ikaayong lawas.
english: Therefore, it is important that those who will vaccinate them have a go-signal from the doctor whether they are suitable for vaccination or not because the adverse effects, especially if there is a serious allergy that the vaccine can cause and cause bad results in their health.

text: Ang risgo sang mga health workers kag mga frontliners bisan bataon pa kag may maayo nga ikaayong lawas, tungod ini sa ila masami nga pagka-expose sa COVID-19 virus nga makahatag sa ila sang “high viral load”, ukon mataas nga kargada sang virus, nga tungod sa ila kadamuon mangin mas masupog na sa pag-atake kag magpanghalit sa nagakalain-lain nga organs sang lawas sang biktima.
english: The risk of health workers and frontliners, even if they are young and in good health, is due to their frequent exposure to the COVID-19 virus that can give them a “high viral load”, or high viral load, which because of their number will be more resistant to attack and damage the various organs of the victim's body.

text:
***

Kon ngaa ginapanugyan gid sang aton mga health authorities nga magpabakuna ang bisan ang kadam-an lang, ina tungod sa ginasiling nga “herd immunity” (at least 70%) nga maka-proteksyon na sang tanan nga pumuluyo.
english:
***

The reason why our health authorities strongly recommend that even the majority be vaccinated is because of the so-called “herd immunity” (at least 70%) that can protect all citizens.

text: Ini nga mga indi pwede mabakunahan nagalakip sang mga may peligroso nga kahimtangan kag ang may kasubong nga ginabatyag, kag ang mga kabataan (16 anyos panubo) nga tubtub karon wala pa sing ma-aprubhan nga bakuna para sa ila.
english: These ineligible include those with high-risk conditions and those with similar illnesses, and children (under 16 years of age) for whom a vaccine has not yet been approved.

text: Sa nahibal-an na sang aton mga health authorities, ang mga kabataan “rarely”, ukon sa malaka, nga mapatyan tungod sa COVID-19.
english: As our health authorities already know, children “rarely”, or rarely, die from COVID-19.

text: Ina tungod ang mga kabataan, sunu sa sining mga health authorities, may mataas nga level sang antibodies sa ila naturalisa – mga lima ka pilu (5 times) sang mga adults – gani malayo sila, sa kabug-usan, sa mga kaso “critical”.
english: That's because children, according to these health authorities, have high levels of antibodies in their naturalization – about five times that of adults – so they are far, overall, from “critical” cases.

text: Malaka man ang ila receptors sang COVID-19 virus.
english: They also have many receptors for the COVID-19 virus.

text: Dugang pa dira ang mga na-develop nila nga mga immunity sa respiratory ailments, katulad sang flu, nga pwede contributory sa ila pag-away sa COVID-19, nga isa man ka respiratory disease.
english: In addition, they have developed immunities to respiratory ailments, such as the flu, which can contribute to their fight against COVID-19, which is also a respiratory disease.

text: Notwithstanding, ginahalungan man ang ila pagkahalubilo sa iban tungod sa masami mga asymptomatic (wala sintoma) ini sila nga pwede makapanglaton sang COVID-19./PN
english: Notwithstanding, they are also protected from interacting with others because they are often asymptomatic and can spread COVID-19./PN

text: May ginapaabot nga oil price rollback sa masunod nga semana.
english: An oil price rollback is expected next week.

text:
Yari ang average estimate sa sulod sang apat ka adlaw nga trading:Gasolina: ₱ 0.15 – ₱ 0.35 /L ROLLBACKDiesel: ₱ 1.15 – ₱ 1.35 /L ROLLBACKKerosene: ₱ 1.10 – ₱ 1.30 /L ROLLBACK

Suno kay Assistant Director Rodela Romero sang Department of Energy Oil Industry Management Bureau, ang rollback ang resulta sang nagataas nga production sang mga pungsod nga kabahin sang Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) kag mga kaalyado sini.
english:
Here is the average estimate over four trading days:Gasoline: ₱ 0.15 – ₱ 0.35 /L ROLLBACKDiesel: ₱ 1.15 – ₱ 1.35 /L ROLLBACKKerosene: ₱ 1.10 – ₱ 1.30 /L ROLLBACK

According to Assistant Director Rodela Romero of the Department of Energy Oil Industry Management Bureau, the rollback is the result of rising production by countries that are part of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) and its allies.

text: Madayon na ang renegotiation sang Iloilo City Legal Office kaangot sa joint venture agreement sang city government kag Double Dragon Properties Corp kaangot man sa Guimaras Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project.
english: The Iloilo City Legal Office is renegotiating the joint venture agreement between the city government and Double Dragon Properties Corp regarding the Guimaras Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, Chairman sang Committee on Transportation sang City Council, iya ginpahayag nga paagi sa resolusyon nga ginpasar sang konseho, mahatagan sang kahigayunan ang City Legal Office nga makig-istorya sa bahin sang Double Dragon Properties Corp.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, Chairman of the Committee on Transportation of the City Council, said that through the resolution passed by the council, the City Legal Office will be given the opportunity to negotiate with the Double Dragon Properties Corp.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, sugod 2023 sa ila pagpatigayon sang pagsinapol, wala gid sang bisan isa sa committee hearing ang gintambongan sang nasambit nga kompanya.
english: According to Cabaluna, starting in 2023 when they held meetings, not a single committee hearing was attended by the company.

text: Sang ginpatawag man ang amo nga kompanya sang City Legal, wala man sila sang may ginplastar rason nga gindirekta na lang sang komitiba ang renegotiation sang joint venture agreement.
english: When the company was summoned by City Legal, they did not present anything so the committee directed the renegotiation of the joint venture agreement.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kinahanglan i-renegotiate ang agreement bangud tuman ka disbentaha sa bahin sa city government.
english: He also said that the agreement needs to be renegotiated because it is very disadvantageous on the part of the city government.

text: Ang letter sang renegotiation ang mangin epektibo 60 days sugod mabaton sang City Legal Office kag Double Dragon Properties Corp.
english: The letter of renegotiation will be effective 60 days from receipt by the City Legal Office and Double Dragon Properties Corp.

text: Nahibaluan nga halos duha ka tuig matapos gin-umpisahan ang pagrepaso liwat sang Joint Venture Agreement (JVA) para sa Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services (GIFTS) sa Parola Wharf.
english: It is known that almost two years after the start of the review of the Joint Venture Agreement (JVA) for the Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services (GIFTS) at Parola Wharf.

text: Ginpirmahan sang 2012 sa panahon sang administrasyon sadto ni Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog, ginhatagan ang Double Dragon Properties Corp sang eksklusibo nga 25 ka tuig nga kinamatarong sa pagdevelop kag pag-operate sang 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.
english: Signed in 2012 during the administration of then-Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog, Double Dragon Properties Corp was granted an exclusive 25-year right to develop and operate the 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.

text: Ang Joint Venture ang nagahatag sa Double Dragon sang 25 year exclusive rights sa pagkolekta sang terminal, berthing and cargo fees, kag ang pagparenta sang mga commercial spaces sa terminal complex.
english: The Joint Venture gives Double Dragon 25 year exclusive rights to collect terminal, berthing and cargo fees, and the leasing of commercial spaces in the terminal complex.

text: Sa idalom sang JVA, ang bahin sang syudad naglakip sang 1-5% sang kita sa gross terminal fee, 1% sang gross berthing fee revenues, 1% sang gross cargo fee revenues, kag 1% sang gross rental revenue (wala labot ang VAT).
english: Under the JVA, the city’s share included 1-5% of gross terminal fee revenue, 1% of gross berthing fee revenues, 1% of gross cargo fee revenues, and 1% of gross rental revenue (excluding VAT).

text: Ginapasabat sang Korte Suprema ang pila ka mga opisyal sang gobyerno kaangot sa mga petisyon para sa writ of habeas corpus nga gin-file sang mga mag-utod nga Duterte kasunod sang pag-aresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Supreme Court is holding several government officials accountable in connection with the petitions for writ of habeas corpus filed by the Duterte brothers following the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno sa Korte, nag-desisyon man ang en banc nga i-consolidate ang petitions for habeas corpus nga separado nga gin-file sang mga kabataan sang former president.
english: According to the Court, the en banc also decided to consolidate the petitions for habeas corpus filed separately by the children of the former president.

text: Ang nagpasaka sini sa Supreme Court amo sanday Davao City Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte, Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, kag Veronica “Kitty” Duterte.
english: The suit was filed in the Supreme Court by Davao City Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte, Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, and Veronica “Kitty” Duterte.

text: Ang pinaka-ulihi nga nagdugang sang iya petisyon amo si Pulong nga nag-file para sa habeas corpus, certiorari and prohibition, kag nagapangayo man sang temporary restraining order (TRO).
english: The latest to add to his petition is Pulong who has filed for habeas corpus, certiorari and prohibition, and is also seeking a temporary restraining order (TRO).

text: Naghingyo man ini sa Supreme Court nga manduan ang Pilipinas nga untaton ang pagkooperar sa International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol).
english: It also asked the Supreme Court to order the Philippines to stop cooperating with the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol).

text: Base sa kongresista, “unlawfully arrested and illegally detained” ang status sang iya amay.
english: According to the congressman, his father's status is “unlawfully arrested and illegally detained”.

text: Ang respondents naman nga ginhatagan sang 24 oras agud makasabat kun ngaa indi dapat pag-igrant ang hingyo sang petitioners amo sanday Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, Interior Secretary Juanito Victor Remulla, PNP chief Police General Rommel Marbil, kag Criminal Investigation and Detection Group chief Police Major General Nicolas Torre III.
english: The respondents who were given 24 hours to answer why the petitioners' request should not be granted are Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, Interior Secretary Juanito Victor Remulla, PNP chief Police General Rommel Marbil, and Criminal Investigation Group Chief Nico Torre. III.

text: Ginpasaka sang mga kabataan nga Duterte ang petisyon matapos nga gindakop ang ila amay sang Martes sang aga sa gahum sang arrest warrant nga gin-isyu sang ICC kag gindala sa The Hague.#
english: The Duterte children filed the petition after their father was arrested Tuesday morning by virtue of an arrest warrant issued by the ICC and brought to The Hague.

text: Nagdepensa si Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) chief Major General Nicolas Torre III matapos gin-alegar sang iban nga wala nahatagan sang iya kinahanglanon si former president Rodrigo Duterte sang ginkustodiya ini sa Villamor Air Base sang nagligad nga Martes.
english: Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) chief Major General Nicolas Torre III defended himself after some alleged that former president Rodrigo Duterte was not given his needs when he was detained at Villamor Air Base last Tuesday.

text: Suno kay Torre, wala gindalukan sang abogado, bulong, kag pagkaon ang former president.
english: According to Torre, the former president was not threatened with lawyer, medicine, or food.

text: “Wala pong deprivation at any moment ng kanilang right to food and water.
english: “There is no deprivation at any moment of their right to food and water.

text: In fact, dinedeliver pa nga namin e, and they are just the one declining na lang dahil sobra naman ang pagkain talaga e,” suno sa Major General.
english: In fact, we are still delivering them, and they are just the one declining because there is too much food,” said the Major General.

text: “Sobra namang dami; May delivery sila, may pabigay din kami so there’s really no problem, and hindi tama ang contention na dineprive namin ng food,” dugang sini.
english: "There are too many; they have delivery, we also have gifts so there's really no problem, and the contention that we are deprived of food is not right," he added.

text: Ini nga paathag ang kasunod sang ginsiling ni Veronica ”Kitty” Duterte sa iya na-expire na subong nga Instagram story nga wala gintugtan sang otoridad ang iya amay nga makakuha sang medical attention sang gin-aresto ini sa NAIA kag gindala sa Villamor Air Base.
english: This explanation follows what Veronica ”Kitty” Duterte said in her now expired Instagram story that the authorities did not allow her father to get medical attention when he was arrested at NAIA and taken to Villamor Air Base.

text: Ginsiling man sang bata sang former chief executive nga iligal sila nga gin-detain sa 250th Presidential Airlift Wing headquarters sa sulod sang base.
english: The former chief executive's son also said they were illegally detained at the 250th Presidential Airlift Wing headquarters inside the base.

text: Kaangot diri, nag-sorry pa si Torre sa publiko bangud naghatag sila sang “special treatment” kay Duterte bisan nga indi na ini presidente sang Pilipinas.
english: In this regard, Torre apologized to the public for giving “special treatment” to Duterte even though he is no longer president of the Philippines.

text: “Pasensya na po kayo, talagang napakalaking special treatment ang ibinigay natin sa former president Duterte.
english: “I'm sorry, we really gave a lot of special treatment to former president Duterte.

text: Para wala ng gulo at mapagbigyan ang lahat ng kaniyang kahilingan,” suno sa iya, nga nagmensyonar pa sang nangin pulungkuan ni Duterte nga presidential chair suno sa iya.
english: So that there will be no chaos and all his wishes will be granted,” he said, mentioning Duterte's seat as presidential chair.

text: “Kaya pagpasensyahan po ng kababayan nating Pilipino na might be agreed on that special treatment given to him.
english: “So please be patient with our fellow Filipinos who might be agreed on that special treatment given to him.

text: Pasensya na po kayo at ito ay kailangang gawin para ang ultimate objective ay magawa natin—which is to bring him to the International Criminal Court.”
english: I am sorry and this must be done so that we can achieve the ultimate objective—which is to bring him to the International Criminal Court.”

text: Daw ano ikaw ka-loyal sa imo nga trabaho?
english: How loyal are you to your job?

text: Madaog mo ayhan ang rekord sang isa ka Lolo nga masobra walo ka dekada nga nagtrabaho sa isa lang ka kumpaniya?
english: Can you beat the record of a Grandfather who worked for the same company for more than eight decades?
