text: Ini nga Lolo amo si Walter Orthmann, 100, residente sang Brusque, Brazil kag sang damlag lang nakasulod sa Guinness World Record bangud napamatud-an nga siya ang pinakamalawig nga nagtrabaho sa isa lang ka kumpaniya.
english: This Grandfather is Walter Orthmann, 100, resident of Brusque, Brazil and recently entered the Guinness World Record for being proven to be the longest employed by a single company.

text: Nakahibalo ka kun ano ka lawig?
english: Do you know how long?

text: 84 anyos!
english: 84 years old!

text: Nag-umpisa si Orthmann sa pag-trabaho sa factory floor sang isa ka company nga kilala subong nga RenauxView — kumpaniya nga nagahimo sang fabrics.
english: Orthmann started working on the factory floor of a company now known as RenauxView — a company that manufactures fabrics.

text: Sunod diri, nasaylo si Orthmann sa administration kag nangin sales manager.
english: Orthmann subsequently moved into administration and became sales manager.

text: Sekreto sini amo ang masami nga pag-stretch kag pag-maintain sa iya nga diet.
english: The secret is to stretch often and maintain his diet.

text: Pahayag sini, ginalikawan niya ang mga maasin kag matam-is nga mga pagkaon kag ang tanan nga makapalain sa iya nga intestines.Wala man ini naga-inom sang soda.
english: He said he avoids salty and sweet foods and everything that can upset his intestines. He doesn't drink soda either.

text: Bangud sa iya extraordinary accomplishment, yari ang simple nga panugyan si Orthmann sa mga tawo nga nagahandum man sang maayo kag fulfilling nga professional life: Una, ‘do what you love’, kag ikaduha, likawi ang junk food.
english: Because of his extraordinary accomplishment, here is Orthmann's simple advice to people who also want a good and fulfilling professional life: First, 'do what you love', and second, avoid junk food.

text: Ginaduso sang abogado nagikan sa isa ka human rights and public interest advocacy group nga dapat nga Pilipino man ang magatindog nga legal counsel para sa drug war victims kun mag-umpisa na ang trial sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: A lawyer from a human rights and public interest advocacy group is proposing that Filipinos should also stand as legal counsel for drug war victims when the trial begins at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gilbert Andres, executive director sang Center for International Law (CenterLaw) – Philippines nga yara subong sa The Hague, iya ginpahayag nga kun Pinoy ang abogado, may yara ini sang mabakod nga koneksyon sa mga biktima sang drug war.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gilbert Andres, executive director of the Center for International Law (CenterLaw) – Philippines who is currently in The Hague, said that if the lawyer is Filipino, he has a strong connection with the victims of the drug war.

text: Suno kay Andres, mas mahangpan man sang abogado nga Pinoy ang kultura sa Pilipinas, ang konteksto sang war on drugs, kag kun ano ang “trauma” kag mga eksperyensya sang mga biktima.
english: According to Andres, a Filipino lawyer will also better understand the culture in the Philippines, the context of the war on drugs, and the trauma and experiences of the victims.

text: Magluwas diri suno sa iya, indi pa mabudlayan sa lenggwahe sa pareho nga Pinoy bangud nga sa Netherlands himuon ang trial.
english: Besides, he said, there will be no language difficulties for the same Filipino because the trial will be held in the Netherlands.

text: Mas mahapos man suno sa iya nga ma-update gid ang mga Pilipino kun ano ang dalagan sang kaso, kun ano ang mga pagpanghangkat sa trial, kag iban pa nga ginahambalan sa The Hague.
english: He said it will also be easier for Filipinos to be updated on the progress of the case, the challenges in the trial, and other issues being discussed in The Hague.

text: Ginpahangop sini nga gina-appoint sang korte ang mangin legal representative sang mga biktima, kag may kondisyon nga ang abogado ang dapat nga yara sa listed counsel sang amo nga international tribunal.
english: He explained that the court appoints the legal representative of the victims, and there is a condition that the lawyer must be on the listed counsel of the international tribunal.

text: Sa Pilipinas, lima gid lamang ang abogado nga yara sa sini nga listahan.
english: In the Philippines, there are only five lawyers on this list.

text: Sa idalom sang CenterLaw Philippines, may yara sang duha ka accredited nga abogado sa ICC lakip na si Atty. Andres.
english: Under CenterLaw Philippines, there are two accredited lawyers in the ICC including Atty. Andrew.

text: Yara man sa lima si former Presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque nga matunog nga supporter ni former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.
english: Also among the five are former Presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque, a vocal supporter of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.

text: Sa nakaandan man suno kay Atty. Andres, posible nga isa tubtub tatlo lang ka drug war victims ang pasugtan nga makapungko bilang mga testigo sa korte.
english: As usual, according to Atty. Andres, it is possible that only one to three drug war victims will be allowed to sit as witnesses in court.

text: Yara na subong si Duterte sa detention facility sang ICC matapos ini naaresto sa Pilipinas sang Martes sang aga bangud sa gahum sang arrest warrant sang international tribunal bangud sa ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity nga iya nakomiter kadungan sang pag-implementar sang kontrobersyal nga war on drugs campaign.#
english: Duterte is now in the ICC detention facility after he was arrested in the Philippines on Tuesday morning on the strength of an arrest warrant issued by the international tribunal for alleged crimes against humanity he committed during the implementation of the controversial war on drugs campaign.

text: Naghimo sang position paper ang grupo sang mga manugpangisda sa Iloilo agud nga pamatukan ang pagsulod sang mga commercial fishing vessels sa Municipal waters sang probinsya.
english: A group of fishermen in Iloilo has prepared a position paper to oppose the entry of commercial fishing vessels into the municipal waters of the province.

text: Ini kasunod sang desisyon sang Supreme Court nga pasudlon ang mga commercial fising vessels sa municipal water.
english: This follows the Supreme Court's decision to allow commercial fishing vessels into municipal waters.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, head sang Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, ginatipon na sang provincial government ang position paper.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, head of the Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office, said the provincial government is currently compiling the position paper.

text: Suno kay Toledo, bisan siya ang nakibot sa nangin desisyon sang korte suprema.
english: Toledo said even he was surprised by the Supreme Court's decision.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga mangin dako ini nga epekto sa manugpangisda sang probinsya.
english: He also believes that this will have a big impact on the province's fishermen.

text: Sang ginpatigayon nga session sang nagligad sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan, gin-aprubahan unanimously ang resolusyon nga nagasuporta sa amo nga petisyon sang mga manugpangisda.
english: During the last session of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, a resolution supporting the petition of the fishermen was unanimously approved.

text: Ang matipon nga petisyon ang pagatipunon ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: The petition will be collected by Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: kag irepresentar sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR).
english: and represented to the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR).

text: Ginpabugal ni President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: nga naglab-ot na ang balor sang strategic investments sa masobra P4.6 trillion (as of February 2025).
english: that the value of strategic investments has reached more than P4.6 trillion (as of February 2025).

text: Suno sa presidente kadungan sang iya speech sa Gawad Bayanihan sa Pamumuhunan Milestone Event sa Malacañang, malapit sa 190 strategic investments ang naaprubahan sang gobyerno sa nagkalain-lain nga sektor.
english: The president said during his speech at the Gawad Bayanihan Investment Milestone Event in Malacañang that nearly 190 strategic investments have been approved by the government in various sectors.

text: Lakip diri suno sa iya ang renewable energy, digital infrastructure, food security, kag manufacturing.
english: These include renewable energy, digital infrastructure, food security, and manufacturing.

text: Ginmensyonar man sini nga target sang iya administrasyon nga makahimo sang business landscape kun sa diin mahimo mag-umwad pareho ang local kag foreign investors.
english: He also mentioned that his administration's target is to create a business landscape where both local and foreign investors can thrive.

text: ”Our journey towards progress will continue to be built on a strong and agile partnership between the government and the private sector,” pahayag sini.
english: ”Our journey towards progress will continue to be built on a strong and agile partnership between the government and the private sector,” it said.

text: ”Therefore, it is only fitting that we recognize the members of the Investments Facilitation Network, our national government agencies, and, of course, our LGUs, whose steadfast commitment to this cause has made the Philippines a more attractive investment destination,” dugang sang chief executive.
english: ”Therefore, it is only fitting that we recognize the members of the Investments Facilitation Network, our national government agencies, and, of course, our LGUs, whose steadfast commitment to this cause has made the Philippines a more attractive investment destination,” the chief executive added.

text: Suno pa sa presidente, paagi sa sini nga investments, may mahatag nga ginabanta 300,000 ka mga trabaho sa Pilipinas.
english: The president said that through these investments, an estimated 300,000 jobs will be created in the Philippines.

text: “What do these reforms truly mean for our people?
english: “What do these reforms truly mean for our people?

text: Jobs and service.
english: Jobs and service.

text: This investment is expected to generate nearly 300,000 jobs for our fellow citizens.
english: This investment is expected to generate nearly 300,000 jobs for our fellow citizens.

text: These are not just jobs but meaningful opportunities for a better and more comfortable life,” pahayag pa sini.
english: These are not just jobs but meaningful opportunities for a better and more comfortable life,” it said.

text: Ang gintambungan nga event ni Marcos amo man ang nagamarka sang una nga tuig sang implementasyon sang nationwide ease of doing business initiative.
english: The event, which Marcos attended, also marks the first year of the implementation of the nationwide ease of doing business initiative.

text: Ginalantaw ni former Department of Health (DOH) Sec.
english: Former Department of Health (DOH) Sec.

text: Janette Garin nga isa sa mga tikang agud nga mahagan-hagan ang epekto sang suspension sang foreign aid sang Estados Unidos amo ang pabaskugon ang pagpakig-angot sang Pilipinas sa ASEAN Countries.
english: Janette Garin said one of the steps to mitigate the impact of the suspension of US foreign aid is to strengthen the Philippines' relations with ASEAN countries.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Garin, iya ginpahayag nga dako ang epekto sang amo nga suspension, indi lamang ikaayong-lawas kundi lakip man ang edukasyon ilabi na nga wala sang window period nga ginhatag.
english: Garin said the suspension will have a huge impact, not only on health but also on education especially since there is no window period given.

text: Suno kay Garin, mangin mabudlay ini sa Pilipinas ilabi na sa pagpakigbato sa tuberculosis kon sa diin, dako nga kabahin ang foreign aid sang Estados Unidos.
english: According to Garin, this will be difficult for the Philippines especially in the fight against tuberculosis where foreign aid from the United States is a big part.

text: Nagalaum man si Garin nga temporaryo lamang ang suspension.
english: Garin also hopes that the suspension is temporary.

text: Nagapati man ang natungda nga tion na agud nga magbinuligay Association of Southeast Asian Nations agud indi na magsalig pa sa Estados Unidos.
english: He also believes that it is time for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to work together to stop relying on the United States.

text: Gin-ako man sa bahin sang Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office nga apektado man ang sektor sang agrikultura sa suspension sang foreign aid sang Estados Unidos.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office also acknowledged that the agricultural sector is also affected by the suspension of foreign aid by the United States.

text: Suno kay Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, head sang Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office, ang foreign aid ang nag-finance sang ila training agud maplastar ang climate field school nga flagship project sang talatapan.
english: According to Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, head of the Iloilo Provincial Agriculture Office, said foreign aid financed their training to set up the climate field school, the office's flagship project.

text: Nagpaguwa ang Australian government sang advisory sa ila nga mga residente kun magbyahe sa Pilipinas bangud sa isyu subong sang seguridad.
english: The Australian government has issued an advisory to its residents when traveling to the Philippines due to the current security issue.

text: Base sa abiso, ginapaandaman ang mga byahero nga maghalong gid bangud sa pamahog sang terorismo kag violent crime, amo man sang mga demonstrasyon kag civil unrest.
english: According to the notice, travelers are warned to exercise extreme caution due to the threat of terrorism and violent crime, as well as demonstrations and civil unrest.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini nga likawan ang protesta kag ang dalagku nga mga pagtilipon nga posible mangin bayolente.
english: It also called for avoiding protest and large gatherings that are likely to turn violent.

text: “We continue to advise exercise a high degree of caution in the Philippines.
english: “We continue to advise exercising a high degree of caution in the Philippines.

text: There’s an increased risk of demonstrations and civil unrest following recent events,” base sa nakabutang sa advisory.
english: There’s an increased risk of demonstrations and civil unrest following recent events,” according to the advisory.

text: Ginbutang man nga mahimo matabo ang terrorist attacks sa bisan diin nga parte sang Pilipinas, kag mahimo ma-target ang airports, public transportation, hotels, shopping malls, restaurants, major events, places of worship, kag tourist areas.
english: It also states that terrorist attacks can occur anywhere in the Philippines, and can target airports, public transportation, hotels, shopping malls, restaurants, major events, places of worship, and tourist areas.

text: “Do not travel to central and western Mindanao, including the Zamboanga Peninsula, Sulu Archipelago, and the southern Sulu Sea area due to the very high threat of terrorism and kidnapping,” dugang pa diri.
english: “Do not travel to central and western Mindanao, including the Zamboanga Peninsula, Sulu Archipelago, and the southern Sulu Sea area due to the very high threat of terrorism and kidnapping,” it added.

text: Ini nga abiso ang ginpaguwa matapos ang pagka-aresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sang Marso 11 nga subong yara na sa kustodiya sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: The notice was issued after the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte on March 11 who is now in the custody of the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Ginabantayan nga ipaidalom ini sa trial bangud sa alleged crimes against humanity kasunod sang war on drugs campaign.
english: He is expected to be tried for alleged crimes against humanity following the war on drugs campaign.

text: Sunod man nga ginpaidalom ang tanan nga units sang Philippine National Police sa heightened security alert status bangud sa possible protest actions.#
english: All units of the Philippine National Police were also placed under heightened security alert status due to possible protest actions.

text: Natalana nga bitayon sa Singapore sa masunod nga semana ang isa ka lalaki nga may problema sa paminsaron matapos nga wala ginpamatian sang korte ang iya final appeal.
english: A mentally ill man is set to be hanged in Singapore next week after a court refused to hear his final appeal.

text: Ini amo ang Malaysian nga si Nagaenthran K. Dharmalingam, 34, nga naaresto sang 2009 bangud nadakpan sa tuyo sini nga pagpasulod sang 43 grams (1.5 ounces) sang heroin sa Singapore.
english: This is Malaysian Nagaenthran K. Dharmalingam, 34, who was arrested in 2009 for trying to smuggle 43 grams (1.5 ounces) of heroin into Singapore.

text: Nobyembre pa sang nagligad nga tuig naka-schedule ang pagbitay kay Dharmalingam, kag madamo ang nagpakamalaot sa sini nga akto bangud mentally disabled ang lalaki.
english: Dharmalingam's execution was scheduled for November last year, and many condemned the act because the man was mentally disabled.

text: May yara ini sang IQ nga 69 – ang level nga ginakilala nga intellectual disability.
english: He has an IQ of 69 – the level recognized as an intellectual disability.

text: Matapos ang pila ka tuig nga pagpakibato sa amo nga kaso, napierde si Dharmalingam sa kaso bangud ginbasura sang huwes ang argumento nga ang pagpatay sa isa ka tawo nga may problema sa paminsaron ang naga-contravene sa international law.
english: After years of fighting the case, Dharmalingam lost the case because the judge rejected the argument that killing a mentally challenged person contravened international law.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang pamilya sini nga patigayunon ang execution sa Miyerkules sa masunod nga semana.
english: His family also confirmed that the execution will be held on Wednesday next week.

text: Magabyahe ang iya iloy kag tatlo ka utod sa Singapore agud nga makit-an siya antes ang schedule sang pagbitay.
english: His mother and three siblings will travel to Singapore to find him before the execution is scheduled.

text: Sa baylo nga kalipay, nabutang pa sa peligro ang kabuhi sang isa ka residente sang Pal-agon, Pavia, Iloilo matapos naigo sang bala sa tunga sang selebrasyon sang Paskwa.
english: Instead of happiness, the life of a resident of Pal-agon, Pavia, Iloilo was put in danger after being hit by a bullet in the middle of the Christmas celebration.

text: Ang biktima amo si AJ, 25, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as AJ, 25, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLtCol Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga base sa imbestigasyon, yara sa gwa sang ila balay ang biktima kaupod ang iban nga myembro sang iya pamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PLtCol Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said that based on the investigation, the victim was outside their house with other members of his family.

text: Sunod-sunod nga lupok ang ila nabatian kag gindumdom nila nga lunsay firecrackers lang ini apang hinali lang nga may nag-igo na sa tiil sang biktima kag nakit-an nga nagdugo.
english: They heard a series of gunshots and thought they were all firecrackers but suddenly something hit the victim's leg and he was found bleeding.

text: Gilayon ini nga gindala sa ospital.
english: He was immediately taken to the hospital.

text: Sang nagresponde naman ang otoridad, naabtan nila sa lugar ang ginatudlo nga suspek na si alyas Dayon, 37-anyos, nga nag-ako man nga siya ang nagpalupok sang pusil.
english: When the police responded, they found the suspect, alias Dayon, 37, who also admitted to firing the gun.

text: Suno pa sa impormasyon, sa kada may maglupok nga libentador, nagabalos ang suspek paagi sa pagpalupok sang pusil.
english: According to reports, every time a libentador exploded, the suspect retaliated by firing a gun.

text: Gilayon naman nga gin-aresto ang suspek kag mangatubang sang kaso nga Reckless imprudence resulting in physical injury kaangot sa RA 10591 ukon ang Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.
english: The suspect was immediately arrested and will face charges of Reckless imprudence resulting in physical injury under RA 10591 or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.

text: Magabalik na sa kumpetisyon ang Filipino superstar gymnast nga si Carlos Yulo.
english: Filipino superstar gymnast Carlos Yulo will return to competition.

text: Ang iya pagsabak sa 2025 Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships sa Jecheon, South Korea amo ang iya una nga contest halin sang nabulsa sini ang duha ka gold medals para sa Pilipinas sa 2024 Paris Olympics sa France.
english: Her appearance at the 2025 Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Jecheon, South Korea will be her first contest since pocketing two gold medals for the Philippines at the 2024 Paris Olympics in France.

text: Si Yulo ang manguna sa team sang Pilipinas sa men’s gymnastics kag paga-updan man nanday Jhon Romeo Santillan, Justin Ace de Leon, Juancho Miguel Besana, kag John Ivan Cruz.
english: Yulo will lead the Philippine team in men’s gymnastics and will also be joined by Jhon Romeo Santillan, Justin Ace de Leon, Juancho Miguel Besana, and John Ivan Cruz.

text: Lakip sa ila pasakupan amo ang team and all-around finals kag individual apparatus qualifications nga magasugod subong nga adlaw, Hunyo 5, kag magalawig tubtub sa Domingo, Hunyo 8.
english: The team and all-around finals and individual apparatus qualifications will start today, June 5, and run until Sunday, June 8.

text: Nagaserbe ang Asian championships nga qualifier sa 2025 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships sa Jakarta, Indonesia nga naka-schedule sa October 19 -25.
english: The Asian championships serve as a qualifier for the 2025 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Jakarta, Indonesia scheduled for October 19-25.

text: NAGAKABALAKA gid kita sa sining nagatabo nga diskriminasyon batok sa mga Asian Americans, nga nagalakip sang mga Filipino, sugod pa sadtong dinekada na nga tinuig nga nakaligad.
english: WE ARE deeply concerned about this discrimination against Asian Americans, which includes Filipinos, dating back decades.

text: In fact, ining diskriminasyon nagakadto pa kon kis-a sa racial violence.
english: In fact, this discrimination sometimes leads to racial violence.

text: For many reasons.
english: For many reasons.

text: Katulad sang pagpati sang madamo nga mga White Americans, kag pila pa ka mga puti, nga ang black people “are naturally violent and dangerous”, so balewala sa ila ang police brutality batok sa mga black people.
english: Like the belief of many White Americans, and some whites, that black people “are naturally violent and dangerous”, so they ignore police brutality against black people.

text: Nagakatabo na gani ini bisan sa mga Asian Americans, labi na gid sa panahon ni anay President Trump nga nagapati sa “White Supremacy”.
english: This is even happening to Asian Americans, especially during the time of former President Trump who believed in “White Supremacy”.

text: Of course, rason man ang naturalisa sang tawo – mga White Americans indi exception – sa maabtik nga paghusgar sang tawo sandig sa hitsura, panapot, kon paano sila magsugilanon, kag sa mga cultural nga binatasan.
english: Of course, there is also a reason why people naturalize – White Americans are no exception – to quickly judge people based on their appearance, dress, how they speak, and cultural customs.

text: Ang problema pa kay kon kanawong ka sang indi nila mauyunan nga pangayaw nga rasa – Intsik man, Indonesia, Filipino, etc.
english: The problem is that if you are the face of a foreign race they don't like – Chinese, Indonesian, Filipino, etc.

text: – ikaw na gid lang ang mamung-an sang ila diskriminasyon.
english: – you're the one who's going to be the victim of their discrimination.

text: Pasalamat kita kay ang masami nga panan-aw sa mga Filipino amo nga ini sila mga “smart and quiet”.
english: We are grateful that the most common perception of Filipinos is that they are “smart and quiet”.

text: Ugaling, pwede gihapon mahisaan sila, bisan pa daku ang nabulig sang mga Filipino sa mga Amerikano sa gyera kag sa ikasanyog sini sa madamo nga bagay.
english: However, they can still be jealous, even though the Filipinos helped the Americans a lot in the war and its development in many ways.

text: Isa sina ang ila pagtrabaho bilang mga professional nurses nga nagatrabaho para sa ikaayong lawas sang mga tumandok nga mga Amerikano.
english: One of those is their work as professional nurses working for the health of Native Americans.

text: Subong man ang  madamo nga imbensyon sang mga Filipino nga napuslan sang Estados Unidos.
english: As well as the many inventions of the Filipinos that the United States has benefited from.

text: Naglain pa gid kay ginduso ni anay President Trump ang pagpasanyog sang White Supremacy, nga nagpaisug pa gid sa White Americans agud itulod ang ila kuno bentaha sa mga pangayaw nga rasa, katulad sang mga Asyano.
english: To make matters worse, former President Trump pushed for the promotion of White Supremacy, which further emboldened White Americans to push their supposed advantages over foreign races, such as Asians.

text:
***

Sang sini lang nangamusta kita sa aton mga hinablos nga nagatrabaho sa Estados Unidos bilang mga nars kag mga American citizens na diri parti sa kon bala kon ano man ang ila experyensya sa ginabalita nga mga “hate crimes” sang pila ka White Americans batok sa mga Asyano.
english:
***

We recently asked our cousins who are working in the United States as nurses and American citizens here about their experiences with the reported “hate crimes” of some White Americans against Asians.

text: Ang akon mga hinablos nagakabalaka gid kag sa subong nagahalong gid sila sa ila paglagaw sa mga dalanon kag kon diin pwede sila makasumalang sang White Americans, ukon kasubong nga mga puti, nga may indi maayo nga panimuot sa mga Asyano.
english: My nephews are very worried and at the moment they are very careful about their roaming the streets and where they might encounter White Americans, or similar whites, who have a bad attitude towards Asians.

text: Wala pa man sing kasubong nga natabo sa ining akon mga himata.
english: Nothing like this has ever happened to these relatives of mine.

text: Apang ang balita nagasiling nga madamo na nga mga kaso sang hate crimes dira sa Estados Unidos.
english: But the news says there are already many cases of hate crimes in the United States.

text: Man, hingalagan lang nga may magtulod ukon magdis-ug sa ila, kon indi man nagapakita sang maaslom nga nawong sa ila kon masugata mo.
english: Also, don't let anyone push or shove them, if not show a sour face to them when you meet them.

text: May ara gani nga mga kaso sang pagpanakit sa ila, katulad sang pagpanapungol kag pagkutrab sang nawong sang isa ka Filipino.
english: There are even cases of torture, such as beating and slapping the face of a Filipino.

text: May yara man nga ginbuno kag gin-pagpangluthang nga grupo sang mga Asyano kon diin apat gid ang napatay.
english: There was also a group of Asians who were stabbed and shot, killing four.

text: In fact, wala ini sila pili kon tigulang man ini ukon indi!
english: In fact, they don't care if it's old or not!

text: Mapasensyahan mo pa seguro kon buang, pero daw hungod gid sa buot kag may malisya ang nagakatabo.
english: You can probably tolerate it if it's stupid, but it seems that what's happening is deliberate and malicious.

text:
***

Indi ini maayo nga nagakatabo sa Estados Unidos, labi na gid kay ginapabugal gid sini ang kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo sa civil rights, nga nagakilala sang kinamatarong sang tanan sa equality regardless of race, religion, belief, etc.
english:
***

This is not good happening in the United States, especially since it takes great pride in citizens' civil rights, which recognizes everyone's right to equality regardless of race, religion, belief, etc.

text: Indi dapat pabay-an sang Biden administration ang ining mga violation sang civil rights sang mga Asyano, nga napabayaan ni President Trump tungod man gani sang iya “White Supremacy” policy.
english: The Biden administration should not ignore these violations of the civil rights of Asians, which President Trump has neglected because of his “White Supremacy” policy.

text: Dapat may penalidad ang kada violation kag indi lang pasugtan nga himuon sang mga hambog kag abusado nga mga puti.
english: There should be a penalty for every violation and not just allowed to be committed by arrogant and abusive whites.

text: Kag tani indi man magpabaya ang mga Asyano agud madepensahan man nila ang ila mga komunidad batok sining violators sang ila civil rights nga indi lang para sa mga puti kundi lakip man ang mga Asyano./PN
english: And I hope the Asians will not neglect so that they can defend their communities against these violators of their civil rights that are not only for whites but also for Asians./PN

text: ILOILO CITY-Ano ang ginahimo mo kun kaagahon na nagapauli ang imo bana ukon nobyo?
english: ILOILO CITY-What do you do when your husband or boyfriend comes home in the morning?

text: Sa Estados Unidos, ginadayaw ang isa ka babaye bangud sa pinasahi sini nga pamaagi agud matapna ang bisyo sang iya nga nobyo nga nagakaagahan sa ilimnan.
english: In the United States, a woman is being praised for her unique way of breaking her boyfriend's drinking habit.

text: Ini amo si Steff nga napinsaran ang pag- set sang curfew sa iya nga nobyo nga kun ini ang maglampas sa las 3:00 sang aga nga indi pa makapuli, magabayad ini sang $50 ukon kapin P3,000.
english: This is Steff who thought of setting a curfew for her boyfriend that if he goes beyond 3:00 am and does not come home, he will pay $50 or more P3,000.

text: Bangud sa iya genius move, ginhatagan ini sang “Best Girlfriend Award” bangud sa makalilingaw kag pinasahi nga pinaagi agud matapna ang bisyo sang iya nga nobyo.
english: Because of her genius move, she was given the “Best Girlfriend Award” for her fun and unique way to stop her boyfriend's addiction.

text: Gin-athag sang General Services Office (GSO) nga ginhimo nga ‘urgent’ ang pag-aproba sang 10-year Solid Waste Management Plan agud nga indi mabudlayan ang syudad kon hinali nga magsirado ang sanitary land fill sang Iloilo City.
english: The General Services Office (GSO) explained that the approval of the 10-year Solid Waste Management Plan was made urgent so that the city would not suffer if the sanitary land fill of Iloilo City suddenly closes.

text: Ini kasunod kon matapos ang 10-year life span sang Sanitary Landfill sa Calajunan, Mandurriao sa 2026.
english: This follows the completion of the 10-year life span of the Sanitary Landfill in Calajunan, Mandurriao in 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, Head sang General Services Office (GSO), iya ginpahayag nga kon magsirado ang landfill, wala na sang iban nga pahamtangan sang mga basura ang syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, Head of the General Services Office (GSO), said that if the landfill closes, the city will have no other place to dispose of garbage.

text: Suno kay Ravena, kon mahuman ang bag-o nga landfill, magalab-ot sa 400 tons per day ang basura nga mahimo ma-generate sang planta sa Iloilo City.
english: According to Ravena, when the new landfill is completed, the plant in Iloilo City will generate 400 tons per day of waste.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga madamo pa sang mga rekisitos nga ipasa sang ila talatapan antes maaprubahan kon sa diin, may yara sila sang 18 ka bulan antes makumpleto ang bag-o nga sanitary landfill.
english: He also explained that there are still many requirements to be submitted by their office before being approved where, they have 18 months before the new sanitary landfill is completed.

text: Lakip na diri ang safe closure plan sang sanitary landfill, construction sang drainage system, kag soil cover agud matabonan ang existing landfill.
english: This includes a safe closure plan of the sanitary landfill, construction of a drainage system, and a soil cover to cover the existing landfill.

text: Ipahamtang naman ang bag-o nga landfill sa Brgy.
english: The new landfill will be located in Brgy.

text: Ingore, La Paz nga may Material Recovery Facility (MRF) agud nga maseparar ang mga madunot, indi madunot, kag recyclable nga basura.
english: Ingore, La Paz with a Material Recovery Facility (MRF) to separate perishable, non-perishable, and recyclable waste.

text: Ang Integrated Solid Saste Management Plant ang may sarang man nga makahimo sang supply sang kuryente kag maka-cover sang basura halin sa Pavia, Oton, kag San Miguel.
english: The Integrated Solid Saste Management Plant is also capable of generating electricity supply and covering waste from Pavia, Oton, and San Miguel.

text: Nakuha sang alumnus kag nagaserbe man nga part- time faculty member sang Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT U) ang titulo bilang kampeon sa TernoCon 2025, ang prestihiyoso nga national terno- making competition nga gin-organisa sang Cultural Center of the Philippines.
english: The alumnus and part- time faculty member of Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT U) won the title of champion at TernoCon 2025, the prestigious national terno- making competition organized by the Cultural Center of the Philippines.

text: Ini amo si Peter Gagula nga kilala bilang si Peach Garde.
english: This is Peter Gagula aka Peach Garde.

text: Si Garde ang nangibabaw gikan sa 12 tanan nga mga finalists sa culminating cultural show sang Enero 25, 2025.
english: Garde emerged out of 12 finalists in the culminating cultural show on January 25, 2025.

text: Ang iya collection ang nagapakita sang 20th-century Philippine visual arts paagi sa tatlo ka distinct pieces: isa ka formal terno nga may pañuelo, isa ka formal Balintawak nga may alampay kag tapis, kag isa ka formal Kimona nga naga-feature sang butterfly sleeves nga may alampay kag patadyong.
english: Her collection showcases 20th-century Philippine visual arts through three distinct pieces: a formal suit with a pañuelo, a formal Balintawak with alampay and tapis, and a formal Kimona featuring butterfly sleeves with alampay and patadyong.

text: Suno kay Dr. Gabriel M. Salistre Jr., ISAT U President, ini nga achievement wala lamang nagahatag dungog sa ISAT U apang sa abilidad sang mga Ilonggo sa pag-preserba kag pag-innovate sang Philippine traditional fashion.
english: According to Dr. Gabriel M. Salistre Jr., ISAT U President, this achievement not only honors ISAT U but also the ability of Ilonggos to preserve and innovate Philippine traditional fashion.

text: Dugang niya, ang kadalag-an ni Garde ang repleksyon man sang talento sang mga estudyante kag produkto sang unibersidad.
english: He added that Garde's success is also a reflection of the talent of the students and products of the university.

text: Lauman ang pagpaguwa sang red ukon yellow alerts sa summer months sa Pilipinas.
english: Red or yellow alerts are expected to be issued during the summer months in the Philippines.

text: Pahayag ini sang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) bangud sa mga indi planado nga outages sa mga planta nga nagaapekto gid sa power supply.
english: This is the statement of the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) due to unplanned outages in plants that severely affect power supply.

text: Suno kay NGCP spokesperson Cynthia Alabanza, indi madula ini nga “worst-case” scenario ilabi na kun madamo gid nga power plants ang maka-eksperyensya sang unexpected shutdowns.
english: According to NGCP spokesperson Cynthia Alabanza, this “worst-case” scenario will not go away especially if many power plants experience unexpected shutdowns.

text: Sa yellow alert, malab-ot pa man sang power supply ang demand, apang matabo gihapon ang brownouts bilang resulta kun mag-breakdown ang planta.
english: With a yellow alert, power supply will still meet demand, but brownouts will still occur as a result if the plant breaks down.

text: Kun sa red alert naman, indi na bastante ang suplay agud nga ma-meet ang demand, kag matabo gid ang brownout kun indi ma-manage ang demand.
english: As for the red alert, the supply is not enough to meet the demand, and brownouts will occur if the demand is not managed.

text: Indi man subong mahambal sang grid operator kun ano gid ang extend kag kalala ang alerts bangud lakip pa ini sa ginadiskusyunan kaupod sa Department of Enery.
english: The grid operator cannot say the extent and severity of the alerts as they are still under discussion with the Department of Energy.

text: Marso 5 sang gindeklarar sang NGCP ang yellow alert sa Luzon grid nga amo ang una nga alert nga napaguwa subong nga tuig.
english: On March 5, NGCP declared a yellow alert on the Luzon grid, the first alert issued this year.

text: Padayon subong ang pag-assess kag pag-adjust sa power outlook sang NGCP kag DOE matapos nakit-an ang surge sa demand.
english: NGCP and DOE are continuing to assess and adjust their power outlook after detecting a surge in demand.

text: Base sa data, ang power demand subong nga tuig ang mahimo magsaka sa 5.4 percent tubtub sa 14,769 megawatts (MW) sa Luzon; 16 percent tubtub sa 3,111 MW sa Visayas; kag 8.2 percent tubtub sa 2,789 MW sa Mindanao.
english: Based on the data, power demand this year is expected to increase by 5.4 percent to 14,769 megawatts (MW) in Luzon; 16 percent to 3,111 MW in the Visayas; and 8.2 percent to 2,789 MW in Mindanao.

text: Isa ka passenger jet kag isa ka military helicopter ang nagbungguanay samtang yara sa kahawaan malapit sa Reagan National Airport sa gwa sang Washington.
english: A passenger jet and a military helicopter collided while mid-air near Reagan National Airport outside Washington.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma sang US Federal Aviation Administration.
english: This was confirmed by the US Federal Aviation Administration.

text: Ang regional flight nga gina-operate sang PSA Airlines para sa American Airlines, ang naghalin sa Wichita, Kansas.
english: The regional flight, operated by PSA Airlines for American Airlines, originated in Wichita, Kansas.

text: Ang Bombardier CRJ700 kag US Army Sikorsky H-60 Black Hawk helicopter ang nagbunggo samtang nagapalapit sa airport ang jet.
english: A Bombardier CRJ700 and a US Army Sikorsky H-60 ​​Black Hawk helicopter collided as the jet approached the airport.

text: Suno sa Washingtos Metropolitan Police Department, nagapadayon subong ang multi-agency search and rescue operation sa Potomac River matapos ang aircraft crash.
english: According to the Washingtos Metropolitan Police Department, a multi-agency search and rescue operation is now underway in the Potomac River after the aircraft crash.

text: Ginkumpirma sang American Airlines nga isa ka American Eagle flight ang involved.
english: American Airlines confirmed that an American Eagle flight was involved.

text: Duda si Makabayan bloc member kag Gabriela Rep.
english: Makabayan bloc member and Gabriela Rep.

text: Arlene Brosas sa intensyon ni Vice President Sara Duterte sa pagpadulong sa Netherlands agud mag-apas sa iya amay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Arlene Brosas on Vice President Sara Duterte's intention to travel to the Netherlands to catch up with her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ini kasunod sang pag-aresto sang Interpol sa amay nga Duterte paagi sa arrest warrant kag gindala sa The Hague, Netherlands kun sa diin nahamtang ang International Criminal Court kun sa diin siya magaatubang bangud sa ginaalegar crimes against humanity nga nakumiter sini may kaangtanan sa iya drug war.
english: This follows the arrest of Duterte's father by Interpol through an arrest warrant and brought him to The Hague, Netherlands where the International Criminal Court is located where he will face alleged crimes against humanity committed in connection with his drug war.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Brosas, iya ginpahayag nga kwestyonable ang pagkadto ni VP Sara sa Netherlands bangud suno sa iya, may yara ini sang responsibilidad sa Pilipinas bilang ikaduha nga pinakamataas nga opisyal sang pungsod.
english: Brosas, he said that VP Sara's visit to the Netherlands is questionable because, according to him, he has a responsibility in the Philippines as the second highest official of the country.

text: Suno kay Brosas, ginalantaw niya ang posibilidad nga gamiton ini nga kahigayunan sang bise-presidente agud palagyuhan ang impeachment trial nga natalana nga magsugod sa Hulyo 30.
english: Brosas said he is looking at the possibility of the vice-president using this opportunity to evade the impeachment trial scheduled to begin on July 30.

text: Matandaan nga kahapon sang aga sang nagbyahe na padulong sa Amsterdam si VP Sara pila ka oras ang nakaligad sang naglupad man ang eroplano nga ginasakyan sang iya amay padulong sa Netherlands.
english: It can be recalled that yesterday morning when VP Sara left for Amsterdam a few hours later, the plane carrying her father also flew to the Netherlands.

text: Nagkalain lain ang mga ginapatigayon nga aktibidad sang magpamilya kag mag-abyan kadungan sang Easter sa Qatar.
english: Families and friends are engaged in various activities during Easter in Qatar.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Queny Gajete Parcon, direkta sa Qatar, ang Easter Festival ang ginaselebrar pinaagi sa nagkalain-lain nga events agud saulugon ang pagkabanhaw ni Hesus.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Queny Gajete Parcon, directly in Qatar, the Easter Festival is celebrated through various events to celebrate the resurrection of Jesus.

text: Sa mga magpamilya, kalabanan sa mga ini ang naga-day out kag nagapatigayon sang bunny brunch sa Doha.
english: For those with families, most of them are day out and having a bunny brunch in Doha.

text: Uso naman ang mga unlimited food sa diin may mga ginapatukar nga sonata samtang nagakaon.
english: Unlimited meals are popular where sonata are played while eating.

text: Nagahimo man ang mga ini sang Do It Yourself (DIY) crafts ukon nagapatigayon sang hinampang.
english: They also do Do It Yourself (DIY) crafts or play games.

text: Ang iban pa nga mga ginakabig ”Best Easter 2022 events” amo ang concerts, family cruises, Easter bunny bingos, kag virtual egg hunts.
english: Other top contenders for ”Best Easter 2022 events” include concerts, family cruises, Easter bunny bingos, and virtual egg hunts.

text: Nangin kabahin na ang Easter Bunny sa pagsaulog sang Easter Sunday sa Australia.
english: The Easter Bunny has become part of the celebration of Easter Sunday in Australia.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Genivive Taton, direkta sa Australia, ang Easter Sunday sa ila ang isa ka public holiday.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Genivive Taton, directly in Australia, Easter Sunday is a public holiday.

text: Sa tion sang Easter Sunday, ang mga Easter Bunny, ang nagabisita sa garden nga ginahampangan sang mga kabataan.
english: During Easter Sunday, the Easter Bunnies, visit the garden where the children play.

text: Diri kag nagabilin ang mga Easter Bunny sang chocolate eggs kag treats para sa mga kabataan nga maga-upod sa Easter Egg hunts.
english: This is where the Easter Bunnies leave chocolate eggs and treats for the children who will join the Easter Egg hunts.

text: Sa tion naman sang panyapon, nagakaon ang magpamilya sang karne sang karnero.
english: At dinner, the family eats mutton.

text: Ini ang nagasimbolo sang sakripisyo sa tion sang Jewish Passover kag nangin simbolo man para kay Hesus.
english: It symbolizes the sacrifice during the Jewish Passover and also became a symbol for Jesus.

text: Ginpa- Bombo sang isa ka turista ang ginaalegar pagbinastos sa ila sang isa ka staff sa Iloilo City Hall.
english: A tourist reported the alleged abuse of a staff member at Iloilo City Hall.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dave Billones Reyes, isa ka turista halin sa Tacurong, Sultan Kudarat, iya ginpahayag nga nagpadulong siya sa Iloilo City kaupod ang pila ka senior citizens agud maglantaw sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dave Billones Reyes, a tourist from Tacurong, Sultan Kudarat, said he went to Iloilo City with some senior citizens to watch the Dinagyang Festival.

text: Suno kay Reyes, nagkadto sila sa City Hall agud magbakal sang tickets apang may isa ka staff nga nagminaldita.
english: According to Reyes, they went to the City Hall to buy tickets but a staff member was rude.

text: Iya ini ginpangalanan nga si Matty Treñas nga ginapahayag nga staff mismo sang alkalde.
english: He named him Matty Treñas who is said to be the mayor's own staff.

text: Pahayag niya, dismayado gid siya sang nangin aktwasyon sang amo nga indibidwal nga ginlaragway ni Reyes nga tuman ka unprofessional.
english: He said he was disappointed with the actions of the individual whom Reyes described as very unprofessional.

text: Dugang niya, wala gid siya naglaum nga ila ini maeksperyensiyahan sa ginbansagan nga “City of Love” kag ginakabig man nga sister city sang Tacurong.
english: He added that he never expected that they would experience this in the so-called “City of Love” and also considered the sister city of Tacurong.

text: Samtang, nagsabat ang Iloilo City Government kasunod sang reklamo sang isa ka turista halin sa Tacurong City batok sa isa ka staff sang City Hall nga gin-alegar nagminaldita.
english: Meanwhile, the Iloilo City Government responded following a complaint by a tourist from Tacurong City against a City Hall staff who allegedly became naughty.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Miss Joy Facinal Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nagapangayo sila sang pasaylo kun indi man nangin maayo ang eksperyensiya sang tagreklamo nga si Dave Billones Reyes kaupod ang mga senior citizens.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Miss Joy Facinal Fantilaga, spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, said they apologize if the experience of complainant Dave Billones Reyes with the senior citizens was not good.

text: Apang suno kay Fantilaga, gintinguhaan gid nila nga maakomodar si Reyes sa ginhingyo sini nga tickets para sa Dinagyang tribes competition.
english: However, Fantilaga said they tried to accommodate Reyes in his request for tickets for the Dinagyang tribes competition.

text: Gin-ako naman niya nga apisar indi man tanan may maayo nga impresyon sa syudad, ginapasiguro nila nga mas mapanami pa ang ila pag-amuma sa mga bisita sa iban pa gid nga mga selebrasyon sa Iloilo City.
english: He acknowledged that although not everyone has a good impression of the city, they are ensuring that they will improve their care for the guests in other celebrations in Iloilo City.

text: Patay ang empleyado sang munisipyo sang Concepcion, Iloilo matapos makabunggo ang ginamaneho nga motorsiklo sa isa pa gid ka motorsiklo nga mahana kuntani nga matabok sa National Road sang Sitio Nangka, Barangay Calamigan, Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: An employee of the municipality of Concepcion, Iloilo was killed after his motorcycle collided with another motorcycle that was about to cross the National Road in Sitio Nangka, Barangay Calamigan, Concepcion, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Leonie Boy Dumali Artacho, 36, residente sang Barangay Macalbang, Iloilo, kag nagatrabaho bilang driver sang Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office sang amo nga banwa.
english: The victim was identified as Leonie Boy Dumali Artacho, 36, resident of Barangay Macalbang, Iloilo, and works as a driver of the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office of the said town.

text: Ang driver naman sang isa pa ka motorsiklo amo si Renz Gumaya Brito, 18-anyos, kag residente sang Sitio Luy- a, Barangay Jamul- awon, Concepcion.
english: The driver of the other motorcycle was identified as Renz Gumaya Brito, 18, resident of Sitio Luy-a, Barangay Jamulawon, Concepcion.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PSMS Mark Gregory Barbo, imbestigador sang Concepcion Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Poblacion, Concepcion si Artacho kag padulong kuntani sa banwa sang Sara, apang sang makalab-ot sa lugar sang aksidente, nakabunggo ini sa motorsiklo nga matabok kuntani sa wala nga bahin sang karsada.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PSMS Mark Gregory Barbo, investigator of the Concepcion Municipal Police Station, said Artacho was heading from Poblacion, Concepcion to Sara town when he reached the scene of the accident when he collided with a motorcycle that was about to cross the left side of the road.

text: Nakaagum sang menor nga kapilasan si Brito, samtang ginbawian naman sang kabuhi si Artacho bangud sa patal nga pilas sa iya nga ulo.
english: Brito sustained minor injuries, while Artacho died of fatal head injuries.

text: Sa subong, yara sa kustodiya sang Concepcion MPS si Brito, kag wala pa sang pinal nga desisyon ang pamilya sang biktima mapasaka sang kaso ukon may matabo nga aregluhanay.
english: Brito is currently in the custody of Concepcion MPS, and the victim's family has not yet made a final decision on whether to file a case or settle.

text: ILOILO CITY-Kun ikaw ang nagapalangga, dapat isa lang ang imo palanggaon.
english: ILOILO CITY-If you love, you should love only one.

text: Apang may iban gid ya nga indi makontento sa isa lang.
english: But there are others who are not satisfied with just one.

text: Kaangay sang lalaki sa China nga ginpakaslan sini sang sekreto ang tatlo tanan ka mga babayi kag ginpatiner sa lugar nga isa lang ka kilometro ang distansya sa isa kag isa para sa iya kaugalingon nga interes.
english: Like the man in China who secretly married all three women and kept them in a place only a kilometer away from each other for his own interests.

text: Ang 41- anyos nga lalaki nga ginkilala kay Zhang ang nagpangatubang sang duwa ka tuig nga pagkabilanggo bangud sa kaso nga polygamy matapos legal sini nga ginpakaslan ang tatlo ka mga babayi sa sulod sang tatlo ka tuig.
english: The 41-year-old man, identified as Zhang, faced two years in prison for polygamy after he legally married three women within three years.

text: Nagatrabaho siya bilang isa ka real estate agent rason nga indi problema sa iya ang magsagod sang tatlo ka pamilya.
english: She works as a real estate agent so it is not a problem for her to support three families.

text: Gin-ako ni Zhang nga ang magkadto sa tatlo ka balay 10 ka beses sa isa ka semana ang makapoy para sa iya.
english: Zhang admitted that going to three houses 10 times a week was exhausting for her.

text: Ginpakaslan sini ang una niya nga asawa nga si Ren sadtong 2015, ang ikaduwa nga asawa nga si Chen sang 2018 kag ang ikatatlo nga asawa nga si Wang sadtong tuig 2019.
english: He married his first wife Ren in 2015, his second wife Chen in 2018 and his third wife Wang in 2019.

text: May yara naman siya sang tag-isa ka anak sa tatlo ka mga babayi.
english: He has one child each from three women.

text: Nagpangabay si anay Kabataan Party-list representative Raoul Manuel nga matigayon na ang impeachment trials batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Former Kabataan Party-list representative Raoul Manuel has called for impeachment trials against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pag-anunsyar sang bise presidente nga mapadalagan sya sa pagkapresidente sa 2028.
english: This follows the vice president's announcement that he will run for president in 2028.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Manuel, iya ginpahayag nga kun indi masabat sang insakto ni Duterte ang mga pamangkut nahanungod sa budget sang iya opisina, mas dako ang posibilidad nga indi man sini maubra sang insakto ang iya obligasyon sa mas mataas nga posisyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Manuel said that if Duterte does not answer questions about the budget of his office, there is a greater possibility that he will not fulfill his obligations in a higher position.

text: Suno pa sa iya, imbes nga hatagan sini sang atensyon ang pagpangampanya kag pagpaguwa nga biktima sya sang political persecution, mas maayo kun magapangatubang anay ini sa grave constitutional charges.
english: He said that instead of paying attention to campaigning and claiming to be a victim of political persecution, it would be better if he faced serious constitutional charges.

text: Nagapati man ang anay kongresista nga dapat nga madayun na ang impeachment trial sini agud nga maguwa na ang mga ebidensya kontra sa iya nahanungod sa confidential funds.
english: The former congressman also believes that his impeachment trial should be held so that the evidence against him regarding confidential funds can come out.

text: Nagsaka pa sa tatlo ang napatay sa disgrasya sa Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City sang Enero 27, Lunes sang kaagahon.
english: Three more people were killed in an accident in Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City on January 27, Monday morning.

text: Ang nagdugang sa duha ka napatay amo ang isa ka 27-anyos nga lalaki nga sakay man sa Mitsubishi Mirage nga nakabunggo sa isa ka wing van truck.
english: Adding to the two fatalities was a 27-year-old man who was also in a Mitsubishi Mirage that collided with a wing van truck.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirmar ni Police Corporal Andy Pava sang Iloilo City Traffic Enforcement Unit.
english: This was confirmed by Police Corporal Andy Pava of the Iloilo City Traffic Enforcement Unit.

text: Una na nga ginbawian sang kabuhi sanday Rizalyn Anacan, 24-anyos, residente sang Brgy.
english: Earlier, Rizalyn Anacan, 24, resident of Brgy.

text: Cayos, Dumangas kag Kim Joseph Sumaguio, 22, residente sang Sta.
english: Cayos, Dumangas and Kim Joseph Sumaguio, 22, resident of Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Matandaan nga walo ang sakay sang kotse sang natabo ang insidente.
english: Eight people were in the car when the incident occurred.

text: Nakagwa na man sa ospital ang apat pa ka mga biktima samtang ang isa pa ka kaupod nila nga babaye ang padayon pa nga ginabulong.
english: Four other victims have also been discharged from the hospital while another female companion is still undergoing treatment.

text: Ginbyahe na padulong sa The Hague, Netherlands si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte has been flown to The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Naglupad ang ginasakyan sini nga Gulfstream G550 aircraft(RP-C5219) halin sa Manila kagab-i, kag magahugpa sa Dubai subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas antes magalupad liwat padulong na sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: The Gulfstream G550 aircraft (RP-C5219) he was carrying took off from Manila last night, and will land in Dubai this morning before flying back to The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Si Duterte ang gin-aresto kahapon sa NAIA Terminal 3 paagi sa warrant nga gin- issue sang International Criminal Court (ICC) bangud sa ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity.
english: Duterte was arrested yesterday at NAIA Terminal 3 through a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC) for alleged crimes against humanity.

text: Gindakop ang anay presidente matapos naghugpa sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) ang eroplano nga ginasakyan sini halin sa Hong Kong.
english: The former president was arrested after his plane from Hong Kong landed at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA).

text: Sa eroplano pa lang, ginpahayag na ni Duterte nga mas maayo pa nga mapatay na lang siya sa baylo nga magsungka.
english: Even on the plane, Duterte said he would rather die than surrender.

text: Ginpunggan pa kuntani ni Honeylet Avanceña ang iya bana nga mag-upod sa International Police kag sa Philippine National Police.
english: Honeylet Avanceña even tried to stop her husband from joining the International Police and the Philippine National Police.

text: Sa Instagram live video sang bata ni Duterte nga si Kitty, mabatian nga naghambal si Honeylet nga abusado ang mga nagapamalabag sa ila kag wala sang arrest warrant nga ginhatag.
english: In an Instagram live video of Duterte's daughter, Kitty, Honeylet can be heard saying that those who oppose them are abusive and no arrest warrant has been issued.

text: Makit-an man sa video nga ginapakalma sang anay presidente ang iya asawa kag ginpanugyanan nga magsunod nalang sa mga otoridad.
english: The video also shows the former president calming his wife and advising her to follow the authorities.

text: Mangin si Kitty kag ang iya magulang nga si Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte ang nagpakamalaot man sa ginhimo nga pag-aresto sa ila amay nga suno sa iya masakiton na.
english: Even Kitty and her brother, Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte, also condemned the arrest of their father, who he said was already ill.

text: Kahapon, ginbasahan sang pinuno sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) nga si Brigadier General Nicolas D. Torre III sang Miranda rights si Duterte.
english: Yesterday, Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) chief Brigadier General Nicolas D. Torre III read Duterte his Miranda rights.

text: Diri kag ginkwestyon ni Duterte kun ano ang basehan sa pag-aresto sa iya.
english: Duterte questioned the basis for his arrest.

text: Ginsabat naman ini ni Torre nga ang kaso ni Duterte ang may kaangtanan sa crime against humanity bangud sa war on drugs sa tion sang iya administrasyon.
english: Torre replied that Duterte's case is related to crimes against humanity due to the war on drugs during his administration.

text: Magalawig sang duha tubtob tatlo ka bulan ang pag-freeze sang US Agency for International Development (USAID) sa mga proyekto sa Iloilo City.
english: The US Agency for International Development (USAID) will freeze projects in Iloilo City for two to three months.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Niel Ravena, head sang Iloilo City Environment and Natural Resources Office kag General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga ini matapos nga nagmando ang United States Department of State nga i-freeze ang tanan nga mga assistance kag aid packages sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod.
english: Niel Ravena, head of the Iloilo City Environment and Natural Resources Office and General Services Office, said this after the United States Department of State ordered the freezing of all assistance and aid packages in various countries.

text: Ang pahayag ni Ravena ang kasunod man sang ginpagwa man nga internal memo ni US Secretary of State Marco Rubio nga kinahanglan pa anay sang Department nga tun-an kag aprubahan ang bag-o nga mga alokasyon ukon extensions sang existing aid packages sa iban nga pungsod.
english: Ravena's statement follows an internal memo issued by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that the Department needs to study and approve new allocations or extensions of existing aid packages in other countries.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga may mga proyekto sa syudad nga pat-od nga maapektuhan sang mando ni US President Donald Trump nga unahon anay nga buligan ang mga pumuluyo sang Amerika.
english: He said there are projects in the city that will certainly be affected by US President Donald Trump's order to give priority to the people of America.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang pat-od nga data kun pila ang ginalauman nga madula nga ayuda sa Pilipinas bangud sa nasambit nga polisa sang Trump administration.
english: At present, there is no definite data on how much aid is expected to be lost in the Philippines due to the Trump administration's policy.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang 2024, nagpain ang USAID sang $9.27 million ukon P542.4 million sa Pilipinas para sa disaster relief items, management sa emergency shelters, kag iban pa sa diin nalakip na diri ang Iloilo City.
english: In 2024, USAID will allocate $9.27 million or P542.4 million to the Philippines for disaster relief items, management of emergency shelters, and others, including Iloilo City.

text: ILOILO – Nadugangan pa sang 27 ka mga bag-o nga kaso sang Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease sa probinsya sang Iloilo sa sulod sang isa ka semana.
english: ILOILO – There were 27 new cases of Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease in Iloilo province in the past week.

text: Base sa data sang Iloilo Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit humalin sang Enero 1 tubtob Enero 18, 2025, may yara sang 48 ka mga kaso sang HFMD sa diin mas manubo ini kun ipaanggid sang 2024 nga may 92 cases sa kapareho nga period.
english: Based on the data of the Iloilo Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit from January 1 to January 18, 2025, there are 48 cases of HFMD which is lower compared to 2024 with 92 cases in the same period.

text: Ang Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease ang isa ka makalalaton nga balatian nga nagaapekto sa mga kabataan.
english: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease is an infectious disease that affects children.

text: Ang sintomas ang ginalakipan sang manubo nga hilanbat, mouth sores, kag rashes sa kamot kag tiil.
english: Symptoms include low-grade fever, mouth sores, and rashes on the hands and feet.

text: Mahimo nga maglaton ang balatian pinaagi sa pagpangatsi, pag-ubo kag pag-uyat sang mga gamit nga nauyatan sang tawo nga may HFMD.
english: The disease can be spread by sneezing, coughing and touching objects that have been touched by a person with HFMD.

text: 23 sa 43 ka mga local government units ang may recorded cases sang Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease sa diin ang Carles ang may walo ka kaso; ginasudan sang Cabatuan kag Lemery nga may tag apat; kag Alimodian, San Joaquin kag Barotac Nuevo nga may tag duha ka mga kaso.
english: 23 out of 43 local government units have recorded cases of Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease of which Carles has eight cases; followed by Cabatuan and Lemery with four each; and Alimodian, San Joaquin and Barotac Nuevo with two cases each.

text: Nagapanawagan ang Iloilo Provincial Health Office nga i-practice gid ang regular nga paghugas sang kamot, masami nga mag-disinfect kun nag-uyat sang ano man nga pagkabutang kag magkadto sa malapit nga rural health unit ukon health center kun nakabatyag na sang sintomas.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Health Office urged the public to practice regular hand washing, disinfect frequently when handling any objects and go to the nearest rural health unit or health center if they experience symptoms.

text: ILOILO – Dako ang posibilidad nga mapatuman man sa Western Visayas ang ginaduso sang pila ka mga transport groups sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board nga pasakaan ang plete sa Public Utility Jeepneys sang 1 peso tubtob 3 pesos.
english: ILOILO – The proposal of some transport groups to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board to increase the fare of Public Utility Jeepneys by 1 peso to 3 pesos is likely to be implemented in Western Visayas.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang ahensya nga gina-review na nila ang proposal sang transport groups nga mangin P15 ang minimum fare sa traditional jeepneys.
english: Earlier, the agency said it is reviewing the proposal of transport groups to increase the minimum fare to P15 for traditional jeepneys.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Raymundo Parcon, Presidente sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, iya ginpahayag nga wala sila naghimo sang petition bangud manageable pa ang presyo sang gatong sa rehiyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Raymundo Parcon, President of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, said they did not make a petition because the price of fuel in the region is still manageable.

text: Suno kay Parcon, may mga himata man sila nga pasahero sang jeep kag mini bus rason nga indi man nila luyag nga maapektuhan ang mga ini.
english: Parcon said they also have relatives who are passengers of the jeep and mini bus so they do not want to affect them.

text: Apang bangud national ang pag-file sang petition sang iban nga grupo pahayag niya, posible magataas man ang plete sa Western Visayas bangud bilog nga Pilipinas ang sakop sang fare hike.
english: However, since the petition was filed nationally by other groups, he said, it is possible that the fare in Western Visayas will also increase because the entire Philippines is covered by the fare hike.

text: Dugang sang natungdan, ang luyag gid kuntani sang mga transport groups amo nga mapanubo ukon makakas ang buwis sa gatong agud indi na kinahanglan pa nga magpataas sang plete bangud maganubo na ang presyo sang gatong.
english: He added that the transport groups would like to reduce or abolish the fuel tax so that there is no need to increase fares because the price of fuel will fall.

text: Ginasiguro naman sang LTFRB nga magapatigayon anay sila sang public hearings kag consultations agud mangin transparent kag malakip ang tanan nga sector sa decision-making process.
english: The LTFRB is ensuring that they will conduct public hearings and consultations to ensure transparency and inclusion of all sectors in the decision-making process.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang minimum fare sa traditional jeepneys ang yara sa P13 nga gin-implementar sang Oktubre 2023 samtang P15 naman ang minimum fare sa modern jeepneys.
english: The minimum fare for traditional jeepneys is P13 which was implemented in October 2023 while the minimum fare for modern jeepneys is P15.

text: Indi makapati si Senator Imee Marcos nga ang pag-abot ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa Pilipinas gikan sa Hong Kong nagresulta sa pagka-aresto sa iya.
english: Senator Imee Marcos cannot believe that former President Rodrigo Duterte's arrival in the Philippines from Hong Kong resulted in his arrest.

text: Una diri, ginkumpirmar sang Malacañang nga naaresto si Duterte base sa warrant for crimes against humanity sang International Criminal Court.
english: Earlier, Malacañang confirmed that Duterte was arrested based on a warrant for crimes against humanity of the International Criminal Court.

text: Suno kay Sen.
english: According to Sen.

text: Imee Marcos, nakibot siya kag naluoy sa anay presidente bangud tigulang na ini.
english: Imee Marcos, she was shocked and felt sorry for the former president because he was old.

text: Dugang pa sang senador nga wala na nadudla ang tanan kag nagatuga lamang sang gamo.
english: The senator added that everything is not lost and is only causing trouble.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala sang benepisyo ang mga pagbinaisay sa pulitika sa mga imol sa pungsod.
english: He also said that political disputes do not benefit the poor in the country.

text: Samtang, nagalaum naman si Senador Risa Hontiveros nga may mahambal ang Malacañang kag magasugot sa hingyo sang International Criminal Court, pinaagi sa Interpol, kag masiguro nga mahatag ang hustisya.
english: Meanwhile, Senator Risa Hontiveros hopes that Malacañang will say something and agree to the request of the International Criminal Court, through Interpol, and ensure that justice is served.

text: Nagapati man ni Hontiveros sa pahayag ni Duterte sa tion sang Senate hearing nga “under oath” kag dal-on niya ang kaso sa International Criminal Court kag bilang isa ka abogado, sundon niya ang proceedings.
english: Hontiveros also believes Duterte's statement during the Senate hearing that he is “under oath” and will take the case to the International Criminal Court and as a lawyer, he will follow the proceedings.

text: Nagapangamuyo naman subong si Senator JV Ejercito para sa Pilipinas matapos nadakpan si Duterte.
english: Senator JV Ejercito is now praying for the Philippines after Duterte's arrest.

text: Nagpabutyag man sang kasubo ang senador sa indi paghiliusa sa tanan nga suno sa iya nagapabudlay sa pag-uswag sang Pilipinas.
english: The senator also expressed regret over the lack of unity among all that he said makes it difficult for the Philippines to develop.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Senador Christopher “Bong” Go sa mga pumuluyo nga ipangamuyo ang sitwasyon ni Duterte subong.
english: Senator Christopher “Bong” Go called on the people to pray for Duterte's current situation.

text: Ginpangabay ni Go sa mga Pilipino nga ipangamuyo ang kaayuhan kag ikaayong lawas sang anay presidente.
english: Go urged Filipinos to pray for the former president's well-being and health.

text: ILOILO – Naglab-ot sa 200 ka mga pasyente ang ginhatagan sang medical care sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office kadungan sang selebrasyon sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: ILOILO – A total of 200 patients were given medical care by the Iloilo Provincial Health Office during the celebration of the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief sang Health Service Delivery Division, iya ginpahayag nga sa sulod sang duha ka adlaw, halin sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan tubtob sa Dinagyang Tribes Competition, nakarekord ang Iloilo Provincial Government sang 10,000 tubtob 15,000 ka tawo sa area lang sang Capitol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief of the Health Service Delivery Division, said that during the two days, from the Kasadyahan sa Babanwahanan to the Dinagyang Tribes Competition, the Iloilo Provincial Government recorded 10,000 to 15,000 people in the Capitol area alone.

text: Suno kay Labis, ang mga pasyente nga ginrespondehan sang medical teams ang kalabanan minor medical cases kaangay sang paglingin sang ulo, pagtaas sang blood pressure, pagbatyag sang sintomas sang heat exhaustion kag may isa ka pasyente nga gin-refer sa ospital.
english: According to Labis, the patients responded to by the medical teams were mostly minor medical cases such as dizziness, high blood pressure, feeling symptoms of heat exhaustion and one patient was referred to the hospital.

text: May mga ginhatag man ang Iloilo Provincial Health Office nga HIV Counseling and Screening Services sa 160 ka mga tawo kag masobra 10,000 condoms naman ang na-distribute.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Health Office also provided HIV Counseling and Screening Services to 160 people and more than 10,000 condoms were distributed.

text: Pahayag niya, wala sang may na-monitor nga food poisoning cases sa Food Festival sang Provincial Government.
english: He said no food poisoning cases were monitored during the Provincial Government's Food Festival.

text: Apang madamo sang nahatagan sang citation ticket bangud sa pagpanigarilyo kag pag-vape sa pampubliko nga lugar.
english: However, many have been issued citation tickets for smoking and vaping in public places.

text: Wala ginpasugtan ni Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.
english: Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.

text: Rommel Francisco Marbil si Sen.
english: Rommel Francisco Marbil and Sen.

text: Bong Go nga sugaton si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Bong Go to meet former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Si Go ang longtime aide ni Duterte.
english: Go is Duterte's longtime aide.

text: Ginkakasan man sang airport pass si Go kaupod sang personal doctor ni Duterte nga si Dr. Agnes Medina Del Rosario agud siguraduhon kuntani ang sitwasyon sang ikaayong lawas sang anay president.
english: Go was also stripped of his airport pass along with Duterte's personal doctor, Dr. Agnes Medina Del Rosario to ensure the health situation of the former president.

text: Para kay Go, importante ang ikaayong-lawas ni Duterte bangud 80 anyos na ini.
english: For Go, Duterte's health is important because he is 80 years old.

text: Nag- abot na sa siyudad sang Iloilo ang abogado sang apat ka mga indibidwal nga nagkaladakpan nga nagpangawat sang cellphones kag wallet sa tunga sang selebrasyon sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: The lawyer of four individuals who were caught stealing cellphones and wallets during the celebration of the Dinagyang Festival has arrived in Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga arestado amo ang maglive- in partner nga sanday alyas Maricar kag alyas Alog; ang ila financer nga si alyas Kevin; kag ang isa ka menor de edad nila nga upod nga yara sa paghinakop sang City Social Welfare Development Office (CSWDO).
english: The arrested were identified as Maricar and Alog; their financier alias Kevin; and a minor companion who is in the custody of the City Social Welfare Development Office (CSWDO).

text: Ang apat ang lunsay mga residente sang Tondo, Manila.
english: The four are all residents of Tondo, Manila.

text: Suno kay Inot, bangud posible organisado nga grupo ang mga arestado rason nga makasarang sila mag- hire sang abogado.
english: According to Inot, because the arrested may be an organized group, they can afford to hire a lawyer.

text: Apang bangud nga holiday subong, wala nakaproseso sang papeles ang ila nga abogado apang inisyal naman ini nga nakaistorya sa iya mga kliyente kag tuyo nga magpyansa sa mga kaso nga amo ang mga paglapas sa Presidential Decree 1612 ukon Anti-Fencing law; kag Section 11 sang Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 matapos makuhaan man sila sang illegal nga droga.
english: However, due to the holiday, their lawyer was not able to process the papers but he initially spoke to his clients and intends to post bail in cases of violation of Presidential Decree 1612 or Anti-Fencing law; and Section 11 of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 after they were also seized with illegal drugs.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang pagpangita sang mga kapulisan sa apat nila ka mga kaupdanan.
english: Police are still searching for their four companions.

text: NEW YORK – Natumod na sang New York Police Department ang “person of interest” sa mass shooting sa subway train sa Brooklyn, New York, USA.
english: NEW YORK – The New York Police Department has identified the person of interest in the mass shooting on a subway train in Brooklyn, New York, USA.

text: Ini amo si Frank R. James, 62, nga may address sa Philadelphia kag Wisconsin.
english: This is Frank R. James, 62, with addresses in Philadelphia and Wisconsin.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Ludovico Baqueriza, si James ang nagrenta sang U-Haul van sa Philadelphia.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Ludovico Baqueriza, James rented a U-Haul van in Philadelphia.

text: Ang yabi sa van ang nakit-an sa mga kagamitan sa train nga ginapatihan ginapanag-iyahan sang gunman.
english: The key to the van was found among the equipment on the train believed to belong to the gunman.

text: Ini ang ginalakipan sang Glock 9-millimeter handgun, tatlo ka ammunition magazines, isa ka hatchet, fireworks kag liquid nga ginapatihan gasolina.
english: They included a Glock 9-millimeter handgun, three ammunition magazines, a hatchet, fireworks and liquid believed to be gasoline.

text: Ang van ang gin-abandona, lima ka blocks ang kalayuon sa Kings Highway station, sa diin ginapatihan nga gin-agyan sang gunman sa subway kag lima ka milya ang kalayuon sa 36th Street station, sa diin nagluntad ang pagpangluthang.
english: The van was abandoned, five blocks from the Kings Highway station, where the gunman is believed to have taken the subway and five miles from the 36th Street station, where the shooting occurred.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin nga at large si James.
english: For now, James remains at large.

text: May nakit-an man nga videos sa iya Youtube sa diin ginapakamaot sini si New York City Mayor Eric Adams.
english: Videos were also found on his Youtube insulting New York City Mayor Eric Adams.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagdangat na sa 10 ang pilason sa nasambit nga pagpangluthang kag 13 naman ang nakasimhot sang aso, nagkalatumba kag nag-panic attack.
english: It was learned that 10 people were injured in the shooting and 13 others smelled smoke, fell and had a panic attack.

text: Natukiban sang Iloilo City Police Station 1 nga masami nagapadulong sa Iloilo City ang lalaki nga nasapwan nga nakasulod sa sa sako sa Parola Wharf sa tion sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: Iloilo City Police Station 1 discovered that the man who was found in a sack at Parola Wharf during the Dinagyang Festival 2025 often travels to Iloilo City.

text: Ang nasapwan amo si Angelo Brandon Salazar, may live-in partner, may duha ka mga kabataan kag residente sang Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique.
english: The victim was identified as Angelo Brandon Salazar, has a live-in partner, two children and resident of Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Romelo Tabuyoc, Chief of Police sang Iloilo City Police Station 1, iya ginpahayag nga nagpadulong ang ila imbestigador sa probinsya sang Antique agud magkoordinar sa pamilya sang biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Romelo Tabuyoc, chief of police of Iloilo City Police Station 1, said their investigator went to Antique province to coordinate with the victim's family.

text: Sa amo nga tion, gintumod sang himata ni Salazar nga masami ini nagapadulong sa Distrito sang Arevalo kag Mandurriao.
english: At that time, Salazar's relatives pointed out that he often went to Arevalo and Mandurriao districts.

text: Suno kay Tabuyoc, base sa pagpangusisa nila sa asawa sang biktima, wala namensyonar ni Salazar kon ano ang iya transakyom antes paman ini nagbiya sa Antique.
english: According to Tabuyoc, based on their questioning to the victim's wife, Salazar did not mention what his transaction was before he left Antique.

text: Ginalantaw man sang talatapan ang anggulo nga drug related case ang natabo kay Salazar bangud sa nangin anay kaso sini.
english: The office is also looking into the angle that Salazar was involved in a drug related case because of his previous case.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang San Jose de Buenavista, Antique Municipal Police Station nga nagsungka sa ila talatapan si Salazar sang Hulyo 14, 2016 sa tion man sang war on drugs ni Former Pres.
english: Earlier, the San Jose de Buenavista, Antique Municipal Police Station said Salazar surrendered to their office on July 14, 2016 during the war on drugs of former Pres.

text: Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Kon balikan, naghalin ang biktima sa ila nga puluy-an sang Enero 22, 2025 apang wala matul-id kun ano ang transaksyon sini.
english: The victim left their house on January 22, 2025 but the transaction is unknown.

text: Base sa inisyal na imbestigasyon, nakaagum ini sang pilas sa iya ulo, patimaan nga ginlampusan ini sang matig-a nga bagay.
english: Based on initial investigation, he sustained injuries to his head, indicating that he was hit with a hard object.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Salazar ang anak sang former Vice Mayor kag subong incumbent punong barangay sang Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique nga si Nestor Angel O. Salazar.
