english: Salazar is the son of former Vice Mayor and incumbent barangay captain of Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique, Nestor Angel O. Salazar.

text: Ginalauman ang moderate to heavy nga dalagan sang trapiko sa Byernes, Enero 31, 2025 kadungan sang selebrasyon sang Chinese New Year sa Iloilo City.
english: Moderate to heavy traffic flow is expected on Friday, January 31, 2025 during the Chinese New Year celebration in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCOL Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, iya ginpahayag nga may mga patigayunon nga road closure sa pila ka dalan sa downtown area sang syudad.
english: PCOL Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, said there will be road closures on some roads in the downtown area of ​​the city.

text: Ginaplano sang talatapan nga magsugod sirado sang dalan sa alas-12 sang udto agud makapreparar sa patigayunon nga Chinese New Year Parade sa alas-4 sang hapon sa Byernes.
english: The office plans to start closing the road at 12 noon to prepare for the Chinese New Year Parade to be held at 4 pm on Friday.

text: Nag-abiso man ang natungdan nga kon naghalin sa ila assembly area sa Aldeguer Street, J. De leon St., Fermin Caram Street, IZNART Street (Filipino-Chinese Friendship Arc) pakadto sa JM Basa Street, magliko sa wala pakadto sa M. Peralta Street, pakadto sa Freedom Grandstand kag magliko sa tuo pakadto sa Ortiz, padulong sa Calasanz pakadto sa ila dispersal area.
english: The concerned also advised that if you leave their assembly area at Aldeguer Street, J. De Leon St., Fermin Caram Street, IZNART Street (Filipino-Chinese Friendship Arc) to JM Basa Street, turn left to M. Peralta Street, to Freedom Grandstand and turn right to Orti Calz, towards their house. dispersal area.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, nagalaum siya nga magasunod ang motorista sa pagsulundan agud nga indi na makatuga sang huol sa iban nga motorista.
english: Garbanzos said he hopes motorists will follow the rules so as not to cause inconvenience to other motorists.

text: GINAKASUBO naton ang balita nga nagtaliwan na sadtong Domingo si Kapid Gabio sang lokal nga radyo.
english: We are saddened by the news that Kapid Gabio of the local radio passed away on Sunday.

text: Isa si Kapid  sa mga maukod nga reporter kag maisug nga komentarista sa radyo nga indi mapahog.
english: Kapid is one of the most diligent reporters and brave radio commentators who cannot be intimidated.

text: Indi man siya ugaling basta magpapatay lang.
english: He didn't just kill himself.

text: Nagapaniguro man siya.
english: He also makes sure.

text: Dala niya pirme ang iya ale-ale nga luthang agud madampigan ang kaugalingon.
english: He always carries his ale-ale gun to defend himself.

text: Kaupod ko si Kapid sa pagtukod sang Iloilo City Hall Press Corps (ICHPC) sadtong 1993.
english: I was with Kapid in founding the Iloilo City Hall Press Corps (ICHPC) in 1993.

text: Ginatapuan ini sang mga reporter sang tanan nga tri-media outlets nga na-assign sa city hall.
english: It is staffed by reporters from all tri-media outlets assigned to city hall.

text: Gina-representar ko sadto ang Panay News.
english: I used to represent Panay News.

text: Kaupod namon ni Kapid sa pagtukod sang ICHPC sanday Alex Vidal, Art Calsas, Roger Tamon, kag mga 10 pa.
english: Kapid and I founded the ICHPC with Alex Vidal, Art Calsas, Roger Tamon, and about 10 others.

text: Wala ako maghuna-huna nga mabotohan ako sang grupo bilang una nga presidente (charter president) sang ICHPC sadtong 1993, nga sadto man ginbalay ang Constitution & Bylaws sini.
english: I did not think that the group would vote me as the first president (charter president) of the ICHPC in 1993, when its Constitution & Bylaws were drafted.

text: Ginhisugtan namon ang isa ka “united front” agud bugtawon sa amon mga balita kag mga opinyon ang “public awareness” kag mag-“provoke action” para sa kawsa sang maka-pumuluyo nga gobyerno.
english: We agreed on a united front to awaken public awareness in our news and opinions and provoke action for the cause of pro-people government.

text: Gintawag namon ini nga “Operation Performance Audit”, nga nagabantay kag nagatugda sa hinimuan sang mga opisyales sa siyudad.
english: We called it the “Operation Performance Audit”, which monitors and recommends the performance of city officials.

text: Nangin madinalag-on naman ini, although nag-create ini sing madamo nga kaaway sa amon.
english: It was successful, although it created a lot of enemies among us.

text: Pero okey lang.
english: But it's okay.

text: Amo gid ina kon may kawsa ka.
english: That’s true when you have a cause.

text: Isa si Kapid sa masupog nga nagadala sang mga isyu sa iya programa sa radyo, kag sang matapos ang akon termino, si Kapid ang ginsaligan sang grupo agud magbulos sa akon kag magpadayon sang amon kawsa.
english: Kapid was one of the shy ones who brought up issues on his radio program, and when my term ended, Kapid was entrusted by the group to take my place and continue our cause.

text: Pid, indi kami malipat sang daku mo nga amot sa kawsa sang ICHPC sa pagduso sang kadalag-an sang “good government” sa panahon ko bilang presidente kag sang imo man panahon.
english: Pid, we will never forget your great contribution to the cause of ICHPC in promoting the victory of “good government” during my time as president and during your time.

text: Kabay nga upod mo na si God sa Iya Kaharian!
english: May God be with you in His Kingdom!

text:
***

Gin-agaw, ukon gin-coup d’ etat, sang Myanmar Army ang democratically-elected nga gobyerno sadtong Pebrero 1, 2021.
english:
***

The Myanmar Army seized, or coup d’etat, the democratically-elected government on February 1, 2021.

text: Tungod kuno sa “fraudulent” election nga nagpadaug sang National League for Democracy nga ginapangunahan ni Aung San Suu Kyi!
english: Because of the “fraudulent” election that won the National League for Democracy led by Aung San Suu Kyi!

text: Ginpilit sini nga isa pa ka eleksyon ang pagahiwaton pagkaligad sang isa ka tuig.
english: He insisted that another election be held a year later.

text: Gin-kwestyon ini sang mga pumuluyo nga nag-protesta gid sa dalanon sing halos kada adlaw agud ibalik sa poder ang nagdaug sa eleksyon nga grupo ni Suu Kyi.
english: This was questioned by the people who actually protested in the streets almost every day to return Suu Kyi’s election-winning team to power.

text: Ngaa kuno liwaton pa ang eleksyon samtang bisan isa ka ebidensya nga mabakud wala man ma-presentar ang kontra partido.
english: Why should the election be repeated when the opposing party has not presented a single strong evidence.

text: In fact, ang resulta sang eleksyon nagpakita sang daku nga abanse sang grupo ni Suu Kyi nga kon may dinayaay gid man sa ila bahin indi na ini malingkang kag basi magdaku pa ang abanse tungod sa dinayaay man sang kontra.
english: In fact, the election results showed a huge lead of Suu Kyi's group that if there is any corruption on their part, it will not be shaken and the lead may increase because of the corruption of the opponent.

text: Kag sin-o gid ang Military Junta agud mag-desidir kon bala may dinayaay ukon wala ang nagligad nga eleksyon?
english: And who exactly is the Military Junta to decide whether the last election was fraudulent or not?

text: Indi man ini election body ukon husgado nga may poder dira.
english: It is not an election body or a court that has power over it.

text: In other words, ilegal ang ginhimo nga coup sang Military Junta agud husgaran ang kuno dinayaay sa eleksyon kag hiwaton ang bag-o nga eleksyon.
english: In other words, the Military Junta's coup to judge the alleged election fraud and hold new elections is illegal.

text: Nahuy-an gid seguro ang nagapamulitika (nga indi tani bagay) nga Military Junta sa pagkapierde sang kontra partido nga kaalyado sini.
english: The political (which should not have been appropriate) Military Junta must have been embarrassed by the defeat of its opposing party ally.

text: Gani ini lang seguro ang ila medyos agud mabawi ang ila kahu-anan – ang i-lutong macao ang liwat nga eleksyon pabor sa ila grupo gamit ang pwersa sang militar.
english: So this is probably their only means to recover their losses – to cook the re-election in favor of their group using military force.

text: Apang wala nagpadaug sa kulba ang linibu nga naga-protesta bisan pa sa masunod na nga “Reign of Terror” sang Myanmar Army sa idalom sang Military Junta, samtang nagasinggit sing “Ibalik ang Demokrasya!” kag bisan 114 na sa ila ang ginpangluthang patay.
english: But thousands of protesters did not give in to fear despite the upcoming “Reign of Terror” by the Myanmar Army under the Military Junta, while shouting “Restore Democracy!” and even 114 of them were shot dead.

text: Na-“horrified” ang Estados Unidos kag iban nga pungsod sa ining kapintas sang Myanmar Army sa idalom sang Military Junta.
english: The United States and other countries are horrified by this brutality of the Myanmar Army under the Military Junta.

text: Pila sang Myanmar soldiers ang nagpalagyo gani agud indi masunod ang sugo nga pangluthangon ang mga naga-protesta.
english: Some of the Myanmar soldiers even fled to avoid following the order to shoot the protesters.

text: Gani, nagpirma sang joint statement ang mga defense chiefs sang 12 ka pungsod, nga nagalakip sang Estados Unidos, Germany, Denmark, Canada kag Australia kag 8 pa ka pungsod sa Uropa kag Asya, agud kondenaron ining “Reign of Terror” sa Myanmar.
english: Therefore, the defense chiefs of 12 countries, which include the United States, Germany, Denmark, Canada and Australia and 8 other countries in Europe and Asia, signed a joint statement to condemn this “Reign of Terror” in Myanmar.

text: Gin-remind nila ang Myanmar Army sang international standard of conduct “for protecting and not harming the people it serves”.
english: They reminded the Myanmar Army of the international standard of conduct “for protecting and not harming the people it serves”.

text: Contrary man sa international standard ang pagpatuman sang “unlawful orders” sa mga soldado, katulad sang pagpatay sa mga unarmed civilians nga nagapautas lang sang ila lehitimo nga reklamo.
english: It is also contrary to international standards to implement “unlawful orders” against soldiers, such as killing unarmed civilians who are just voicing their legitimate grievances.

text: Ang gwa sang Myanmar Army sini amo nga indi sila “protectors” kundi “murderers” sang mga pumuluyo.
english: The Myanmar Army's appearance is that they are not “protectors” but “murderers” of the people.

text: Nga dapat kondenahon sang tanan!/PN
english: That should be condemned by all!/PN

text: Gin-post sang two-time Filipino Olympian nga si EJ Obiena ang mga laragway sa iya madinalag-on nga pagdepensa sa iya titulo sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga 2025 Asian Athletics Championships sa Gumi, South Korea.
english: Two-time Filipino Olympian EJ Obiena posted pictures from his successful title defense at the recently concluded 2025 Asian Athletics Championships in Gumi, South Korea.

text: Ini ang ikatlo nga sunod-sunod nga gold medal ni Obiena sa amo nga tournament matapos ini nadag-an sang 2019 sa Dubai kag sang 2023 sa Bangkok.
english: This is Obiena's third consecutive gold medal in the tournament after winning it in 2019 in Dubai and in 2023 in Bangkok.

text:
Subong nga tuig, ginlaragway niya ini ang kadalag-an nga “title defended in the most thrilling way possible.”

Pareho sila sang iya abyan kag training partner nga Chinese pole vaulter nga si Huang Bokai nga naka-clear sang 5.72 meters sa isa lang ka attempt, pareho man nga nag-skip sa 5.77, kag pareho man nga napaslawan nga makalapaw sa 5.82 mark sa tatlo gid ka beses.
english:
This year, he described it the achievement as “title defended in the most thrilling way possible.”

Both he and his friend and training partner Chinese pole vaulter Huang Bokai cleared 5.72 meters in just one attempt, both skipped 5.77, and both failed to cross the 5.82 mark exactly three times.

text: Apang bangud si Obiena ang naka-clear sang 5.77-meter mark sa jump-off, siya ang kampyon kag si Huang ang silver medalist matapos ang masobra man lima ka oras nga kumpetisyon.
english: However, Obiena cleared the 5.77-meter mark in the jump-off, making him the champion and Huang the silver medalist after more than five hours of competition.

text: Nagpangatlo si Patsapong Amsamarng sang Thailand nga may clearance nga 5.67 meters.
english: Thailand's Patsapong Amsamarng came third with a clearance of 5.67 meters.

text: Kaupod sa iya nga legendary coach nga si Vitaly Petrov, magabalik si Obiena sa Europa para sa masako na naman nga schedule sa sini nga bulan.
english: Along with his legendary coach Vitaly Petrov, Obiena will return to Europe for another busy schedule this month.

text: Lakip sa namensyonar sini nga kumpetisyon amo ang sa Hengelo, Netherlands sa Hunyo 9; sa Oslo, Norway para sa Diamond League; kag sa Wanda Diamond League meeting sa Stockholm, Sweden sa Hunyo 15 kun sa diin yara ang world number one kag back-to-back record holder nga si Mondo Duplantis.
english: Among the mentioned of this competition are in Hengelo, Netherlands on June 9; in Oslo, Norway for the Diamond League; and the Wanda Diamond League meeting in Stockholm, Sweden on June 15 featuring world number one and back-to-back record holder Mondo Duplantis.

text: Antes sini, may training man ang Pinoy pride sa Italya.
english: Before that, the Filipino pride also had training in Italy.

text: Ang pinakadaku nga target ni Obiena subong nga tuig amo ang World Championships nga patigayunon sa Japan sa Septyembre.#
english: Obiena's biggest target this year is the World Championships to be held in Japan in September.#

text: Bahagyang tumaas ang takbo ng ekonomiya ng Pilipinas matapos maitala ang 5.5 percent na Gross Domestic Product o GDP growth sa ikalawang quarter ng taon, ayon sa pinakahuling datos ng Philippine Statistics Authority.
english: The Philippine economy picked up slightly after recording 5.5 percent Gross Domestic Product or GDP growth in the second quarter of the year, according to the latest data from the Philippine Statistics Authority.

text: Mas mataas ito kumpara sa 5.4% noong unang quarter, ngunit mababa sa 6.5% na naitala sa kaparehong panahon noong nakaraang taon at sa 5.6% na projection ng mga ekonomista.
english: This is higher than the 5.4% in the first quarter, but lower than the 6.5% recorded in the same period last year and the 5.6% projection of economists.

text: Ayon sa mga analyst, nakatulong sa bahagyang pagbilis ng ekonomiya ang easing inflation na posibleng nagpalakas sa consumer spending.
english: According to analysts, easing inflation has helped the economy slow down, which is likely to boost consumer spending.

text: Gayunpaman, naapektuhan ito ng election-related ban sa public disbursements na naglimita sa paggasta ng gobyerno.
english: However, it was affected by the election-related ban on public disbursements that limited government spending.

text: Pinakamalaking kontribusyon sa paglago ang wholesale at retail trade; repair ng motor vehicles and motorcycles na may 5.1%, public administration and defense; compulsory social security na pumalo sa 12.8%, at financial and insurance activities na may 5.6%.
english: The largest contributor to growth is wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles with 5.1%, public administration and defense; compulsory social security with 12.8%, and financial and insurance activities with 5.6%.

text: Ang GDP at ang 0.9% na six-year low inflation rate nitong Hulyo ay inaasahang magiging batayan sa susunod na policy meeting ng Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sa Agosto 28.
english: GDP and the 0.9% six-year low inflation rate in July are expected to be the basis for the next policy meeting of the Central Bank of the Philippines on August 28.

text: Nabudlayan makig-angot ang legal team sang anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa iya bangud sang impedements kabudlayan nga gina-atubang sang lawas kag panghuna-huna sang 80-anyos nga anay opisyal.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's legal team had difficulty communicating with him due to impedements facing the 80-year-old former official's physical and mental health.

text: Suno kay Nicholas Kaufman, legal counsel ni Duterte, nagahulat sila nga mag-guwa subong nga semana ang report sang medical experts nga nag-eksamin sa kapasidad sini nga mag-atubang sang kaso ni Duterte sa korte.
english: Nicholas Kaufman, Duterte's legal counsel, said they are waiting for the report of the medical experts who examined his capacity to face Duterte's case in court to come out this week.

text: Dugang pa ni Kaufman, nagalaom sila nga insakto ang evaluation sang medical experts nga ila gin-submit bangud nabudlayan sila sa mga impediments nga gina-atubang sang anay Presidente.
english: Kaufman added that they hope the evaluation of the medical experts they submitted is correct because they are struggling with the impediments facing the former President.

text: Mas gamay nga basura ang natipon sang Iloilo Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office (PGENRO sa ila ginpatigayon nga trash walk sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office (PGENRO) collected less garbage during their trash walk at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Ini ang ginpatigayon sa post Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: This was held in post Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mitzi Peñaflorida, senior environmental management specialist sang PGENRO, iya ginpahayag nga 5 ka sako nga basura ang ila natipon nga ginabug-usan sang 20 kilograms sang residual waste, 1.5 kilograms nga plastic bottles, kag 15 kilograms nga mga karton.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mitzi Peñaflorida, senior environmental management specialist of PGENRO, said they collected 5 sacks of garbage consisting of 20 kilograms of residual waste, 1.5 kilograms of plastic bottles, and 15 kilograms of cardboard.

text: Ini ang may kabug-usan nga 37 kilograms nga basura nga nakuha tanan sa sa palibot sang Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: This is a total of 37 kilograms of garbage collected all around the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Suno kay Peñaflorida, ang mga natipon nga basura ilabi na ang mga plastic bottles ang igabaligya sa mga junkshop kag ang matipon nga pondo ang igasulod sa passbook sang talatapan.
english: According to Peñaflorida, the collected garbage especially plastic bottles will be sold to junkshops and the collected funds will be deposited in the office's passbook.

text: Naghatag man ang natungdan sang positibo nga panan-awan sa mga Ilonggo kasunod sang magamay nga basura nga ila natipon.
english: He also gave a positive outlook to the Ilonggos following the small garbage they collected.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga amat-amat na nga nangin responsable ang mga Ilonggo sa ila pag-dispose sang mga basura.
english: He also believes that Ilonggos are gradually becoming responsible in their disposal of garbage.

text: Nagdinaguso ang mga Pinoy sa Bayanihan Kennedy Town Centre sa una nga adlaw sang overseas absentee voting sa Hong Kong.
english: Filipinos flocked to the Bayanihan Kennedy Town Center on the first day of overseas absentee voting in Hong Kong.

text: Duha ka oras pa lang nga nakaumpisa ang pagboto sang mga registered Filipino voters apang naghingyo na ang Philippine Consulate nga magbalik lang ang iban pagkasunod nga mga adlaw agud nga malikawan ang pagdis-uganay.
english: Registered Filipino voters have only started voting for two hours but the Philippine Consulate has already requested that others return in the following days to avoid conflict.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Jing Gabiazon direkta sa Hong Kong, mismo si Consul General Raly Tejada ang nag-apelar sa mga Pinoy nga magbalik lang matapos nga ginmuno sang Hong Kong Police Force ang kalabaon sang pila nga posible maangot sa paglapta sang Covid-19.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Jing Gabiazon directly in Hong Kong, Consul General Raly Tejada himself appealed to Filipinos to return after the Hong Kong Police Force increased the length of the queue that may be linked to the spread of Covid-19.

text: Tubtub pa sa Mayo 9 ang overseas absentee voting, kadungan sang local kag presidential elections diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Overseas absentee voting is until May 9, along with local and presidential elections in the Philippines.

text: Sa latest data nga gin-release, ginpahayag nga 3,285 ka registered voters ang nakatigayon nga makaboto kahapon nga adlaw sang Domingo.
english: According to the latest data released, 3,285 registered voters were able to vote yesterday Sunday.

text: Nag-apelar man ang Philippine Consulate in Hong Kong sa employers nga pahanugutan ang ila Filipino employees nga magboto sa weekdays.
english: The Philippine Consulate in Hong Kong also appealed to employers to allow their Filipino employees to vote on weekdays.

text: Mas istrikto subong ang pagpatuman sang protocols sa Hong Kong bangud ini na ang ika-lima nga Covid-19 surge sa amo nga lugar.
english: Hong Kong is now implementing stricter protocols as this is the fifth Covid-19 surge in the area.

text: Suportado sang grupo sang hog producers ang desisyon sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga magpatuman sang maximum suggested retail price (SRP) sa karne sang baboy epektibo buwas nga adlaw, Marso 10.
english: The group of hog producers supports the decision of the Department of Agriculture (DA) to implement the maximum suggested retail price (SRP) for pork effective tomorrow, March 10.

text: Ang tikang nga ini ang nagatuyo nga matapna ang nagapanglakaak nga presyo sang amo nga mga produkto.
english: The move aims to curb the rising prices of these products.

text: Suno kay Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines president Rolando Tambago, kinahanglan gid ang maximum SRP nga P350 sa pork shoulder kag P380 sa pork belly bangud tuman man ka taas ang retail price subong nga P480 per kilo.
english: According to Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines president Rolando Tambago, the maximum SRP of P350 for pork shoulder and P380 for pork belly is necessary because the retail price of P480 per kilo is very high.

text: Indi man rasonable ini nga presyo suno sa iya bisan isiling pa nga apektado sang African Swine Fever (ASF) ang produksyon sang baboy.
english: He said the price is not reasonable even if it is said that the African Swine Fever (ASF) affects the production of pigs.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginapanan-aw sini nga magnubo ang consumption sang karne kadungan sang pag-obserbar sang Lenten season.
english: On the other hand, he expects meat consumption to decrease during the observance of the Lenten season.

text: Nahibaluan nga santo sa nauna nga anunsyo sang DA, iimplementar ang MSRP sa karne sang baboy sa mga mercado sa National Capital Region (NCR).
english: It is known that according to the previous announcement of the DA, the MSRP on pork will be implemented in the markets in the National Capital Region (NCR).

text: Ginhimo ang desisyon kasunod sang mahinalungon nga konsultasyon sa industry stakeholders nga ginalakipan sang producers, wholesalers, traders, kag retailers.
english: The decision was taken following careful consultation with industry stakeholders including producers, wholesalers, traders, and retailers.

text: Iga-repaso ang MSRP pagkatapos sang isa ka bulan agud matumod kun kinahanglanon ang adjustments.
english: The MSRP will be reviewed after one month to determine if adjustments are needed.

text: Ginklaro nga indi ini pag-iimplementar sa supermarkets kag hypermarkets bangud natural nga mas mataas gid man ang ila nga operating costs.#
english: It was clarified that this will not be implemented in supermarkets and hypermarkets because they naturally have higher operating costs.

text: Handa na ang kaso nga igapasaka ni former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog batok kay Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon.
english: The case that former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog will file against Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon is ready.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pahayag ni Mabilog nga magapasaka ini sang kaso nga “libel” batok kay Ganzon sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This follows Mabilog's statement that he would file a libel case against Ganzon last year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay former Mayor Mabilog, iya ginpahayag nga ginapangamuyuan na niya ang kaso nga ipasaka sa bise-alkalde sang syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, former Mayor Mabilog said he is praying for the case to be filed against the city's vice-mayor.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, nagapati siya sa kasuguan sang Ginoo nga mangin mapinatawaron apang para sa iya, tuman gid ka sakit ang ginhimo ni Ganzon.
english: Mabilog said he believes in the Lord's law to be forgiving but for him, Ganzon's actions are very painful.

text: Sang ginpamangkot naman ang anay alkalde nga ipat-pat ang mga dugang nga kaso, wala ini nagkomento.
english: When asked to clarify the additional cases, the former mayor did not comment.

text: Nahibaluan nga una na nga ginpahayag ni Vice Mayor Ganzon nga wala siya sang may madumduman nga “libelous” nga komento nga ginbuy-an batok kay Mabilog.
english: It is known that Vice Mayor Ganzon earlier said that he does not remember any “libelous” comments released against Mabilog.

text: Ginarespeto man ni Ganzon ang pagpasaka sang kaso ni Mabilog kon nakabatyag ini sang ‘aggrieved’ ukon indi patas nga pagtratar.
english: Ganzon also respects Mabilog's right to file a case if he feels aggrieved or unfairly treated.

text: Samtang, nagpahayag naman si Mabilog nga basi nagka-Alzheimer lang si Ganzon rason nga wala sini madumduman ang iya ginhimo.
english: Meanwhile, Mabilog said Ganzon may have developed Alzheimer's disease and does not remember what he did.

text: ILOILO CITY-Untaton na sang Japan ang pag-import sang coal gikan sa Russia bilang pagpakita sang protesta sa lihok sang pungsod nga pag-atake kag pagpamatay sa mga inosente nga sibilyan sa Ukraine.
english: ILOILO CITY-Japan will stop importing coal from Russia in protest against the country's move to attack and kill innocent civilians in Ukraine.

text: Ini magluwas pa sa pag-expel sang Japan sa walo ka mga Russian diplomats.
english: This is in addition to Japan's expulsion of eight Russian diplomats.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma direkta sa Japan, iya ginpahayag nga nagapanindugan si Prime Minister Fumio Kishida nga nagadampig ang Japan sa Ukraine kag ginakondena sini ang giyera nga ginlunsar ni Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma directly in Japan, he said that Prime Minister Fumio Kishida insists that Japan is on Ukraine's side and condemns the war launched by Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Ginpahayag ni Palma nga sa subong, nagapangita na si trade minister Koichi Hagiuda sang alternatibo nga suppliers sang coal samtang amat-amat nga ginadula pag-import sini halin sa Russia.
english: Palma said trade minister Koichi Hagiuda is currently looking for alternative suppliers of coal while importing it from Russia is gradually being eliminated.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Russia ang nagabug-os sang 11% sang total coal imports sang Japan sang 2021 base sa government data.
english: Russia accounted for 11% of Japan’s total coal imports in 2021 based on government data.

text: Ang Russia amo ang fifth-biggest supplier sang Japan sang krudo kag liquefied natural gas (LNG) sang 2021.
english: Russia was Japan’s fifth-biggest supplier of crude oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) in 2021.

text: Ang Japan naga-import sang halos tanan nga coal nga ginakonsumo sini gani ini ang third-largest importer kasunod sang India kag China base naman sa U.S. Energy Information Administration data.
english: Japan imports almost all the coal it consumes, making it the third-largest importer after India and China, according to U.S. Energy Information Administration data.

text: Preparado ang gobyerno sa ano man nga eventuality sa tunga sang mga report sa pag-issue sang arrest warrant sang International Criminal Court (ICC) batok kay Former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The government is prepared for any eventuality amid reports of the issuance of an arrest warrant by the International Criminal Court (ICC) against Former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno kay Palace Spokesperson Undersecretary Claire Castro, wala pa sang kumpirmasyon gikan sa Malacañang angut sa pag-issue sang warrant of arrest sang International Tribunal.
english: According to Palace Spokesperson Undersecretary Claire Castro, there is no confirmation from Malacañang regarding the issuance of the warrant of arrest by the International Tribunal.

text: Apang, ang chief sang Presidential Communications Office nga si Jay Ruiz nagsiling man nga ang gobyerno nakahanda sa ano man nga hitabo.
english: However, Presidential Communications Office chief Jay Ruiz also said the government is prepared for any eventuality.

text: Suno sa Office of the Vice President (OVP), si Vice President Sara Duterte ang nag-upod sa iya amay nga sa Hong Kong para sa isa ka sortie sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino-Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban).
english: According to the Office of the Vice President (OVP), Vice President Sara Duterte accompanied her father who was in Hong Kong for a sortie of the Partido Demokratiko Pilipino-Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban).

text: Ang Bise Presidente ang natalana nga magtambong sa kahiwatan sang iya amay upod sa mga overseas Filipino workers sa Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
english: The Vice President is scheduled to attend his father's function with overseas Filipino workers in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

text: Nakita naman ang anay presidente sa Causeway Bay sang Marso 8, sa tunga sang nagalapta nga mga huring-huring nga ang International Criminal Court (ICC) nagpaguwa sang warrant of arrest batuk sa iya.
english: The former president was seen in Causeway Bay on March 8, amid rumors that the International Criminal Court (ICC) had issued a warrant of arrest against him.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Agosto sang nagligad nga tuig, ginpahayag ni Supreme Court Associate Justice Antonio Carpio nga mahimo nga magpaguwa sang warrant of arrest batuk sa anay presidente.
english: In August last year, Supreme Court Associate Justice Antonio Carpio said a warrant of arrest could be issued against the former president.

text: Gina-imbestigaran sang International Criminal Court ukon ICC si Duterte sa gina-alegar crimes against humanity bangud sa pagkapatay sang linibo ka tawo sa tion sang war on drugs nga ginpatuman sa iya pagpungko.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) is investigating Duterte for alleged crimes against humanity over the deaths of thousands of people during the war on drugs implemented during his tenure.

text: Ginabulubanta sang datos sang gobyerno nga 6,000 ka tawo ang napatay sa tion sang war on drugs.
english: Government data estimates that 6,000 people have been killed during the war on drugs.

text: Apang, ang local and international human rights groups nagpahayag sang kadamuon sang napatay sa tubtob 30,000.
english: However, local and international human rights groups put the death toll at up to 30,000.

text: Naka-secure ang Department of Justice sang indi magnubo sa pito ka mga conviction sa ila nagapadayon nga mga pagtinguha sa pagbato sa money laundering kag terrorism financing halin 2021 tubtob sa katapusan sang 2024.
english: The Department of Justice has secured at least seven convictions in its ongoing efforts to combat money laundering and terrorism financing from 2021 through the end of 2024.

text: Ini nga panahon kadungan sang paglakip sang Pilipinas sa gray list sang Financial Action Task Force (FATF), nga nagakilala sang mga hurisdiksyon nga yara sa idalom sang dugang nga monitoring para sa mga financial crimes.
english: This period coincides with the inclusion of the Philippines on the gray list of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), which identifies jurisdictions that are under increased monitoring for financial crimes.

text: Sa isa ka news forum sa Quezon City, gin-highlight ni DOJ Deputy State Prosecutor Deana Perez ang mga notable convictions, lakip na ang kaso nga anti-money laundering batok kay Janet Lim Napoles.
english: At a news forum in Quezon City, DOJ Deputy State Prosecutor Deana Perez highlighted notable convictions, including the anti-money laundering case against Janet Lim Napoles.

text: Ang Regional Trial Court sang Manila, Branch 24, nagtumod kay Napoles nga guilty beyond a reasonable doubt sang Hulyo 2024 sa paglapas sa Section 4(a) sang Republic Act No.
english: The Regional Trial Court of Manila, Branch 24, found Napoles guilty beyond a reasonable doubt in July 2024 of violating Section 4(a) of Republic Act No.

text: 9160, nga kilala man bilang Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2001, nga gin-amyendahan sang Republic Act No.
english: 9160, also known as the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2001, as amended by Republic Act No.

text: Ginsentensyahan ini sang indeterminate nga pagkapreso sang pito tubtub 14 ka tuig kag ginmultahan sang P16 million.
english: He was sentenced to indeterminate imprisonment of seven to 14 years and fined P16 million.

text: Sa kabilugan, natalupangdan niya nga ang DOJ madinalag-on nga nakakuha sang pito ka mga conviction para sa paglapas sa money laundering.
english: Overall, he noted that the DOJ successfully obtained seven convictions for money laundering violations.

text: Sang ulihi nga bahin sang nagligad nga bulan, gin-anunsyo sang Financial Action Task Force nga nakabase sa Paris ang pagpahalin sa Pilipinas sa ila gray list sang mga pungsod nga ginapaidalom sa heightened scrutiny para sa money laundering kag terrorism financing.
english: Late last month, the Paris-based Financial Action Task Force announced the removal of the Philippines from its gray list of countries under heightened scrutiny for money laundering and terrorism financing.

text: Nag-upod man ang Sweden sa tikang sang iban nga mga pungsod sa Europa nga pag-expel sa mga Russian diplomats bangud sa ginapahayag pag-spy sa ila nga mga hilikuton.
english: Sweden has also joined the move of other European countries to expel Russian diplomats for allegedly spying on their activities.

text: Suno sa foreign ministry sang Sweden, tatlo gid ka diplomats halin sa Russia ang gin-expel kasunod sang pagpatigayon sang mga ini sang illegal intelligence-gathering operations.
english: According to the Swedish foreign ministry, three diplomats from Russia have been expelled following their conduct of illegal intelligence-gathering operations.

text: Antes ang Sweden, nauna na ang Italy, Spain, France, Belgium kag the Netherlands have sa pagpahalin sang Russian diplomats bangud sa amo man nga alegasyon — ang spying activity.
english: Before Sweden, Italy, Spain, France, Belgium and the Netherlands have already expelled Russian diplomats over the same allegation — spying activity.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Fatima Sutinen direkta sa Sweden, vocal gid ang mga tawo sa amo nga European country sa pagpakita sang pagpamatok sa Russia kag pagpabutyag sang suporta sa Ukraine.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Fatima Sutinen directly in Sweden, people in the European country are very vocal in showing opposition to Russia and expressing support for Ukraine.

text: Nagabaton man ang Sweden sang Ukrainian refugees.
english: Sweden is also accepting Ukrainian refugees.

text: Ang tikang sang mga pungsod sa Europa ang gin-trigger pa gid sang reports nga may natukiban nga mga mass graves sa Ukraine kun sa diin nakit-an nga nahal-id lang ang bangkay sang mga sibilyan sa Bucha kasunod sang pag-isol sang iban nga Russian forces.
english: The move by European countries was further triggered by reports that mass graves were discovered in Ukraine where the bodies of civilians were found lying in Bucha following the withdrawal of other Russian forces.

text: Indi pa maathag kun san-o matapos ang total lockdown nga ginpatuman sa Shanghai, China nga amo ang rason kun ngaa suspendido ang overseas voting sa amo nga lugar para sa 2022 Philippine elections.
english: It is not clear when the total lockdown imposed in Shanghai, China, which is the reason why overseas voting in that area for the 2022 Philippine elections will be suspended, will end.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Donicia Habiling Moloney direkta sa Shanghai, China, nag-umpisa ang coronavirus outbreak bangud sa ginpatigayon nga city-wide testing.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Donicia Habiling Moloney directly in Shanghai, China, the coronavirus outbreak began due to city-wide testing.

text: Bangud apektado ang hulag sang mga residente, indi man mapatigayon ang absentee voting nga magaumpisa kuntani sa Abril 10.
english: Due to the affected movement of residents, the absentee voting that was supposed to start on April 10 will not be held.

text: Masobra 1,600 ka mga Pinoy ang yara sa amo nga lugar kag nagahulat-hulat pa sa masunod nga abiso sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC).
english: More than 1,600 Filipinos are in the area and are still waiting for the next notice of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC).

text: Sa subong suno kay Moloney, yara sa kapin 17,000 ka bag-o nga asymptomatic COVID-19 cases ang na-rekord kag masobra 300 ka bag-o nga symptomatic infections.
english: So far, Moloney said, more than 17,000 new asymptomatic COVID-19 cases have been recorded and more than 300 new symptomatic infections.

text: Kun ma-lift na ang lockdown, ipatigayon man ang pagboto suno sa COMELEC.
english: Once the lockdown is lifted, voting will also be held, according to the COMELEC.

text: Indi kaangay sa iban nga mga pungsod kun sa diin pwede makaboto ang mga Pinoy paagi sa mail, personal gid ang overseas absentee voting sa Shanghai kag manual man ang pag-isip sang balota kag indi automated.
english: Unlike other countries where Filipinos can vote by mail, overseas absentee voting in Shanghai is personal and the ballot counting is manual and not automated.

text: Nakuha sang Gilas Pilipinas Youth ang gold medal sa Fiba U16 Asia Cup Seaba Qualifiers kag nagtapos pa nga may undefeated record.
english: Gilas Pilipinas Youth won the gold medal in the Fiba U16 Asia Cup Seaba Qualifiers and finished with an undefeated record.

text: 6-0 ang Pilipinas matapos gintambakan ang Indonesia, 70-40, sa final round sa Bren Z. Guiao Convention Center sa Pampanga.
english: The Philippines won 6-0 after beating Indonesia, 70-40, in the final round at the Bren Z. Guiao Convention Center in Pampanga.

text: Sa imbukada pa lang nga period, 21-5 na ang skor, naglab-ot sa 41-20 ang lead sa halftime, kag nagdangat sa 59-25 nga amo ang pinakadaku nga abanse sang masobra uno minuto ang nabilin sa third period.
english: In the opening period, the score was 21-5, the lead reached 41-20 at halftime, and reached 59-25 which was the largest lead with more than a minute left in the third period.

text: Wala naman sang player ang Indonesia nga naka-double digits sa hampang.
english: Indonesia did not have a player in double digits in the game.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion nga nagkitaay ang Pilipinas kag Indonesia sa sini nga Seaba qualifiers, kun sa diin daog man ang Gilas sa una nga hampang, 77-68.
english: This is the second time that the Philippines and Indonesia have met in these Seaba qualifiers, where the Gilas also won the first game, 77-68.

text: Magluwas nga nakuha sang Philippine team ang gold, kuwalipikado na ini sa FIBA U16 Asia Cup nga patigayunon sa Mongolia.
english: Besides winning the gold, the Philippine team has qualified for the FIBA ​​U16 Asia Cup to be held in Mongolia.

text: Sulod man sa amo nga Asian tournament ang Indonesia nga silver medalist, kag ang Malaysia nga amo ang nagapangatlo.
english: Also in the Asian tournament are Indonesia, the silver medalist, and Malaysia, the third.

text: Pabor si Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office Head nga si Ret.
english: Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office Head Ret.

text: Pcol.
english: Pcol.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos nga dapat na nga i-remind ang mga driver sa siudad sa mga traffic regulations sa siudad sang Iloilo.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos said drivers in the city should be reminded of the traffic regulations in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Garbanzos, head sang nasambit nga opisina, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa dapat nga i-remind sang mga regulasyon amo ang mga pampubliko nga salakyan kag mga private car owners.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Garbanzos, head of the said office, said that among those who should be reminded of the regulations are public vehicles and private car owners.

text: Suno pa kay Garbanzos, ini amo ang isa sa mga tikang agud nga mas mangin mahilway ang dalagan sang trapiko sa siudad.
english: Garbanzos said this is one of the steps to make traffic flow more freely in the city.

text: Dala man sa ginpakigbahin sang ICTTMO head amo ang pito ka mga personnel sang Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) nga iga-endorso ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas sa Land Transportation Office 6 agud nga ma-deputize.
english: Also shared by the ICTTMO head were seven personnel of the Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) who will be endorsed by Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas to the Land Transportation Office 6 to be deputized.

text: Ini amo ang may tinutuyo nga mahatagan sang awtoridad ang pila ka mga traffic enforcers kag mismo nga si Garbanzos agud nga makaimplementar sang mga national traffic laws kun sa diin nalakip ang Anti-Sardinas Policy.
english: This is aimed at giving authority to some traffic enforcers and Garbanzos himself to implement national traffic laws including the Anti-Sardinas Policy.

text: Gin-welcome na sang aktor nga si JC de Vera kag non-showbiz wife nga si Rikkah Cruz ang ila ikatatlo nga baby.
english: Actor JC de Vera and non-showbiz wife Rikkah Cruz have welcomed their third baby.

text: Ini amo si baby boy Vittore.
english: This is baby boy Vittore.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang actor ang pagkabun-ag sang iya anak nga lalaki paagi sa Instagram post.
english: The actor announced the birth of his son through an Instagram post.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang ila kalipay para kay JC sanday Ogie Alcasid, John Prats, Vhong Navarro kag Dominic Roque.
english: Ogie Alcasid, John Prats, Vhong Navarro and Dominic Roque also expressed their happiness for JC.

text: Nahibaluan nga una nga ginbun-ag ang ila subang nga anak nga si Lana sang 2018 kag si Laura sang Hunyo 2023.
english: It is known that their younger daughter Lana was first born in 2018 and Laura in June 2023.

text: Sanday De Vera kag Cruz ang nagpakasal sang 2018 sa isa ka civil ceremony kag sa simbahan sang September 2021.
english: De Vera and Cruz tied the knot in 2018 in a civil ceremony and in the church in September 2021.

text: ILOILO CITY- Sa tanan nga prutas nga aton ginakaon, masami nga ginahaboy lang naton ang ila liso.
english: ILOILO CITY- Of all the fruits we eat, we often throw away their seeds.

text: Apang panumduma liwat kay may liso sang paborito mo nga prutas nga dapat hatagan mo sang tsansa nga buligan ang imo ikaayong lawas.
english: But remember again because there is a seed of your favorite fruit that you should give a chance to help your health.

text: Ini amo ang liso sang abukado nga suno sa National University of Singapore, nakit-an nga may yara sang 70% sang antioxidant content .
english: This is the avocado seed which according to the National University of Singapore, has been found to contain 70% of the antioxidant content .

text: Ang incredible fiber content nga may upod nga natural oils, vitamins kag minerals ang makabulig sa pag-improve sang digestion, reduced inflammation kag naangot man sa paglikaw sa development sang cancer cells.
english: The incredible fiber content combined with natural oils, vitamins and minerals can help improve digestion, reduced inflammation and is also linked to preventing the development of cancer cells.

text: Ang liso mahimo mo nga kihadon kag tuktukon kag isimpon sa imo nga pagkaon ukon ilimnon.
english: The seeds can be ground and crushed and mixed with your food or drink.

text: Suno kay Dr. Tom Wu, isa ka physician nga ginpasidunggan sang American Cancer Society kag United Nations, nakumpirma niya nga ang avocado seeds nagatanyag sang most intense amounts sang soluble fiber.
english: According to Dr. Tom Wu, a physician honored by the American Cancer Society and the United Nations, has confirmed that avocado seeds offer the most intense amounts of soluble fiber.

text: Ang soluble fiber nagabulig sa pagkakas sang kolesterol sa cardiovascular system gani makabulig ini sa paglikaw sa heart disease, heart failure kag stroke.
english: Soluble fiber helps remove cholesterol from the cardiovascular system so it can help prevent heart disease, heart failure and stroke.

text: Ang intense burst sang antioxidants sa abukado ang nagabulig sa pagpanubo sang oxidative stress nga tuga sang harmful UV rays sang adlaw kag amo man sang pollution kag chemicals.
english: The intense burst of antioxidants in avocado helps reduce oxidative stress caused by the sun’s harmful UV rays as well as pollution and chemicals.

text: Makabulig ini sa pag reduce sang visible signs sang aging, kag naga- rejuvenate sang tone kag condition sang skin tissue gani mas young- looking ang imo panit.
english: It helps reduce visible signs of aging, and rejuvenates the tone and condition of skin tissue so your skin looks younger.

text: SA Filipinas, naglab-ut pa lang ang nabakunahan batok sa COVID-19 ang 508,332 ka tawo tubtub sadtong Marso 23, 2021, sunu sa report sang Wikipedia.
english: In the Philippines, 508,332 people have been vaccinated against COVID-19 as of March 23, 2021, according to a Wikipedia report.

text: Kuha ini sila tanan sa health workers sector nga yara sa No.
english: They are all from the health workers sector which is in No.

text: 1 priority list sang Philippine vaccination program.
english: 1 priority list of the Philippine vaccination program.

text: May mga 110 ka milyon ang populasyon sang Filipinas.
english: The Philippines has a population of about 110 million.

text: Sa bug-os nga kalibutan, halin sadtong Disyembre 2020 tubtub Marso 14, 2021, mga 345 ka milyon na ka doses sang nagkalain-lain nga vaccine ang na-administer na sa sobra 100 ka pungsod.
english: Worldwide, from December 2020 to March 14, 2021, about 345 million doses of various vaccines have been administered in more than 100 countries.

text: Nagapanguna ang United States nga may 120 ka milyon (M) nga nabakunahan; 80M sa China; 50M sa India; kag 30M sa United Kingdom.
english: The United States leads with 120 million (M) vaccinated; 80M in China; 50M in India; and 30M in the United Kingdom.

text: Ang ining pagpangbakuna ginatanyag sang magalain-lain nga vaccine manufacturer.
english: This vaccination is offered by various vaccine manufacturers.

text: Sa Fiipinas tubtub Marso 19, apat na ka vaccine manufacturer ang natagaan sang Emergency Use Authorization (EUA).
english: In the Philippines as of March 19, four vaccine manufacturers have been granted Emergency Use Authorization (EUA).

text: Ini sila amo ang Pfizer/bioNTech sang US/German companies, ang Sinovac sang China, Oxford AstraZeneca sang European Union, kag Gamaleya Spunik V sang Rusya.
english: They are the US/German companies’ Pfizer/bioNTech, China’s Sinovac, the European Union’s Oxford AstraZeneca, and Russia’s Gamaleya Spunik V.

text: Duha sini – ang Sinovac kag AstraZeneca – nakapadala na sang ila supply sang vaccines kag nagapangbakuna na gani ang Department of Health sang mga pumuluyo diri.
english: Two of them – Sinovac and AstraZeneca – have already sent their supply of vaccines and the Department of Health is already vaccinating the residents here.

text: Ining duha ka vaccine pwede ma-store sa “regular fridge temperature”.
english: These two vaccines can be stored at “regular fridge temperature”.

text: Refrigertor temperature man ang kinahanglan sang Sputnik V, samtang ang Pfizer/BioNTech nagakinahanglan sang manubo nga  temperatura nga -70 degrees Celsius.
english: Sputnik V also requires refrigerator temperature, while Pfizer/BioNTech requires a low temperature of -70 degrees Celsius.

text: Ang Pfizer kag Sputnik V wala pa maka-finalize sang ila deal sa gobyerno sang Filipinas sa diin maagi ang tanan nga vaccines agud ipanagtag na sang DOH sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Pfizer and Sputnik V have not yet finalized their deal with the Philippine government where all vaccines will pass through for distribution by the DOH to the people.

text: Samtang, ang ginagamit sa karon nga vaccine sa United States amo ang pfizer/BioNTech, nga ginagamit man sang United Kingdom upod sa AstraZeneca.
english: Meanwhile, the vaccine currently being used in the United States is pfizer/BioNTech, which the United Kingdom is also using along with AstraZeneca.

text: Ga-expect ang US sa paggamit by June 2021 sang Moderna vaccine.
english: The US expects to use the Moderna vaccine by June 2021.

text:
***

Sa sining mga nabakunahan na, may importante nga panugyan ang mga health authorities, nga ayhan ang madamo wala pa makahibalo kag, tungod sini, ginadala naton diri ang ining ihibalo sa aton kolum.
english:
***

For those who have been vaccinated, the health authorities have an important advice, which perhaps many do not know and, therefore, we bring this knowledge here in our column.

text: Ang ila panugyan amo nga sigehon anay ang pagpatuman sang health protocols sang mga nabakunahan na, katulad sang paggamit sang face mask, pagpatigayon sang social (physical) distancing, panghugas sang kamot gamit ang habon, kag iban pa nga sanitizing practice.
english: Their advice is to continue implementing health protocols for those who have been vaccinated, such as wearing face masks, social (physical) distancing, hand washing with soap, and other sanitizing practices.

text: Isa ka virologist nagpahayag gani nga basi abtan pa sing duha ka tuig ang pagpatuman sining health protocols sa mga nabakunahan upod sa wala pa nabakunahan.
english: One virologist even said that it may take two years to implement these health protocols for those who have been vaccinated along with those who have not been vaccinated.

text: Ngaa amo gid sina ka dugay ang pagpatuman pa sang health protocols sa mga nabakunahan?
english: Why is it taking so long to implement health protocols for those who have been vaccinated?

text: Correct me if I am wrong, pero amo sini ang hangop kag pagtan-aw naton sa sining panugyan sang mga health authorities.
english: Correct me if I am wrong, but this is how we understand and view this advice of the health authorities.

text: Una, tungod indi pa lubos ang “effectiveness” sang vaccine sa idalom sang Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) agud “patyon” ang COVID-19 virus sa tanan nga nabakunahan.
english: First, because the vaccine is not yet fully effective under the Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) to kill the COVID-19 virus in all vaccinated people.

text: Ginapatihan  ugaling nga mapunggan na sini ang “severe”, ukon makamamatay, nga atake sining virus sa iban nga may mahina sing immune response kag mahina sa pag-produce sang antibodies.
english: However, it is believed that this can prevent severe, or fatal, attacks of the virus on others with weakened immune responses and weak antibody production.

text: Ikaduha, tungod kay ang mga nabakunahan pwede pa liwat ma-infect sunu sa experyensya sang pila ka nag-alayo, katulad ni Senador Sonny Angara.
english: Second, because those who have been vaccinated can still be infected again according to the experience of some who have recovered, such as Senator Sonny Angara.

text: Tungod seguro kay malip-ut lang ang immunity period nga nakuha sa vaccine.
english: Probably because the immunity period obtained from the vaccine is short.

text: Ang expersyensa sa COVID-19 immunization nagapakita nga, on average, tubtub lang sa mga apat ka bulan ang immunity nga hatag sang vaccine.
english: Experience with COVID-19 immunization shows that, on average, the immunity provided by the vaccine lasts only about four months.

text: Ikatatlo, ang nabakunahan mismo pwede maka-panglaton kay ang mga virus nga nabilin nga wala “mapatay” kag nagapabilin sa lawas, ukon makuha man, nila pwede isaylo nila ini sa iban.
english: Third, the vaccinated themselves can become infected because the viruses that remain undead and remain in the body, or get it, they can pass it on to others.

text: Pwede isaylo nila ini  sa kon sin-o sa ila direkta nga pagginhawa, pag-ubo ukon pangatsi, ukon madala sang mahigko nila nga mga kamot sa baba, ilong kag mata sa makuha nga COVID-19 virus sa mga makaptan nga mga bagay.
english: They can spread it to anyone by directly breathing, coughing or sneezing, or carrying their dirty hands to the mouth, nose and eyes to get the COVID-19 virus from touchable objects.

text: Ikaapat, indi pa malab-ut ang herd immunity sing dale-dale  nga nagabutang pa sang pungsod sa padayon nga pag-spread sang COVID-19.
english: Fourth, herd immunity has not been achieved gradually, which puts the country at risk of continuing the spread of COVID-19.

text: Ining herd immunity – mga 70-85% sa ulihi nga estimate – maga-shortcut sang siling sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga “No one is safe unless everyone is safe”./PN
english: This herd immunity – about 70-85% by late estimate – would shortcut the World Health Organization (WHO) saying “No one is safe unless everyone is safe”./PN

text: Nagsaka na sa tatlo ang numero sang Cabinet secretaries nga nagpanaog sa ila pwesto sa nauna nga tatlo ka bulan sang tuig 2025.
english: The number of Cabinet secretaries who stepped down in the first three months of 2025 has risen to three.

text: Ini matapos ginbaton ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This is after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. accepted.

text: ang resignation sang tiglikom sang Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) nga si Secretary Ivan Uy.
english: the resignation of Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) secretary Secretary Ivan Uy.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer kag communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, may yara sang officer-in-charge nga magabulos sa posisyon tubtub nga mag-appoint liwat ang punong ehekutibo sang bag-o nga tiglikom.
english: According to Palace Press Officer and communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, there is an officer-in-charge who will take over the position until the chief executive reappoints the new secretary.

text: Wala sini gindugangan ang detalye sa rason sang pagpanaog sa pwesto kag kun ano ang sunod nga direksyon ni Uy.
english: He did not add details on the reason for stepping down and what Uy's next direction is.

text: Natabo ini matapos nag-resign man sanday former transportation chief Jaime Bautista kag anay communications secretary Cesar Chavez.
english: This comes after former transportation chief Jaime Bautista and former communications secretary Cesar Chavez also resigned.

text: Ang tion ni Uy sa DICT ang napun-an sang reports sang pagpang-hack sa mga website sang government agencies kalakip na ang iya sang Kamara tubtub sa data breach sa Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth).
english: Uy's tenure at the DICT was filled with reports of hacking of websites of government agencies including that of the House of Representatives to a data breach at the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth).

text: Si Uy man ang nagpanguna sa implementasyon sang SIM Card Registration Act sa tuyo nga matapna kuntani ang spam calls and texts, apang bisan may yara sang mandatory nga rehistrasyon sang SIM Cards, gin-report nga may anum ka milyon gihapon nga scam texts kag 600,000 nga scam calls sang 2024.
english: Uy also led the implementation of the SIM Card Registration Act to curb spam calls and texts, but despite the mandatory registration of SIM cards, it was reported that there will still be six million scam texts and 600,000 scam calls in 2024.

text: Ang ginhalinan sini nga ahensya amo ang “primary policy, planning, coordinating, implementing, and administrative entity” sang ehekutibo sa pagplano, pagbalay, kag pag-promote sang national information and communication technology agenda.
english: The origin of this agency is the “primary policy, planning, coordinating, implementing, and administrative entity” of the executive in planning, framing, and promoting the national information and communication technology agenda.

text: Isa man ka IT expert si Uy kag na-appoint ni Marcos sa posisyon sang Mayo 2022 ukon duha ka bulan antes siya pormal nga nagpungko sa pwesto bilang president sang pungsod.
english: Uy is also an IT expert and was appointed by Marcos to the position in May 2022 or two months before he formally took office as president of the country.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, nauna na ginsiling sang Malacañang nga gina-assess ni President Marcos ang performance sang iya tanan nga Cabinet members agud mahibaluan kun may kinahanglan islan sa liderato sa kada department.
english: Last month, Malacañang earlier said that President Marcos is assessing the performance of all his Cabinet members to determine if there is a need to change the leadership in each department.

text: Gin-expel sang Italya, Denmark, Sweden kag Spain ang kabug-usan nga 73 Russian diplomats bilang pagkondina sa pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: Italy, Denmark, Sweden and Spain have expelled a total of 73 Russian diplomats in condemnation of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Spanish foreign minister Jose Manuel Albares, gin-expel sang ila pungsod ang 25 ka Russian diplomats kag embassy staff nga posible mangin pamahug sa security sang Espanya.
english: Spanish foreign minister Jose Manuel Albares said his country has expelled 25 Russian diplomats and embassy staff who could pose a threat to Spain's security.

text: Samtang, suno naman kay Sweden Foreign Minister Ann Linde, tatlo ka Russian diplomats ang ila iga-expel bangud sa ginpahayag nga spying.
english: Meanwhile, Swedish Foreign Minister Ann Linde said three Russian diplomats will be expelled for alleged spying.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Italy Foreign Minister Luigi Di Maio nga ginmandu sang ila pungsod ang expulsion sang 30 ka Russian envoys para sa national security.
english: Italian Foreign Minister Luigi Di Maio said his country ordered the expulsion of 30 Russian envoys for national security reasons.

text: Gin-expel naman sang Denmark ang 15 ka Russian “intelligence officers” kag ginhatagan sang 14 ka adlaw agud nga maghalin sa ila pungsod.
english: Denmark has expelled 15 Russian intelligence officers and given them 14 days to leave the country.

text: Ini ang pila sa mga dugang nga lihok sang European countries agud nga mas mapabaskog ang mga ginapataw nga sanctions sa batok Russia.
english: These are some of the additional moves by European countries to strengthen sanctions against Russia.

text: Nag-inspeksyon kag naghatag sang assessment si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., sa narumpag nga Cabagan-Santa Maria Bridge sa Isabela.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., inspected and gave an assessment of the collapsed Cabagan-Santa Maria Bridge in Isabela.

text: Suno sa presidente, ang desinyo mismo sang taytay ang may problema kag dapat nga manabat.
english: According to the president, the design of the bridge itself is problematic and should be held accountable.

text: ‘This is a design problem,” pahayag ni Marcos.
english: ‘This is a design problem,” Marcos stated.

text: Apang suno sa presidente, ang prayoridad sa subong amo nga mahatagan sang solusyon ang problema kag indi ang pagpangbasol.
english: But the president said the priority now is to find a solution to the problem and not to blame.

text: “Fix the problem, not the blame,” dugang pa sang presidente.
english: “Fix the problem, not the blame,” the president added.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga sa tion nga makaayo, mabalik sa daan sini nga structure ang taytay.
english: He also assured that once repaired, the bridge will be restored to its old structure.

text: Ang nasambit nga taytay ang may kabug-usan nga kalabaon nga 990-metros.
english: The bridge has a total length of 990 meters.

text: Nagsugod ang konstruksyon sini sang 2014 nga may budget nga masobra P1.2 billion.
english: Its construction began in 2014 with a budget of more than P1.2 billion.

text: Ang nasambit nga taytay ang wala pa nagamit sang publiko matapos nakumpleto ang konstruksyon sini.
english: The bridge has not been used by the public since its construction was completed.

text: Matandaan nga narumpag ang taytay sang Pebrero 27 matapos naglabay angdump truck nga nagresulta naman sa anom ka pilason.
english: The bridge collapsed on February 27 after a dump truck passed by, resulting in six injuries.

text: Suno sa Department of Public Works and Highways, ang taytay ang sarang lang nga makadala sang 44 ka tonelada nga salakyan, nga tuman kalayo sa kabug-aton sang truck nga nagadangat sa 100 ka tonelada.
english: According to the Department of Public Works and Highways, the bridge can only carry 44 tons of vehicles, which is a far cry from the weight of a truck of 100 tons.

text: Emosyonal nga nagpasalamat si Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda sa mga nagsuporta kag nagbuylog kay former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog agud makuha ang executive clemency.
english: Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-jam” Baronda emotionally thanked those who supported and joined former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog in getting executive clemency.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga sa pito ka tuig, nasaksihan niya ang naagyan nga sakripisyo sang anay alkalde.
english: Baronda, he said that in seven years, he witnessed the sacrifice of the former mayor.

text: Suno kay Baronda, ini ang pinakadasig nga paghatag sang executive clemency sa isa ka anay opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: According to Baronda, this is the fastest executive clemency grant to a former government official.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga nakit-an sang yara sa ibabaw nga mga opisyal ang nangin serbisyo ni Mabilog sa Iloilo City.
english: He also believes that the top officials have seen Mabilog's service to Iloilo City.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang natungdan kay House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag sa House Quad Committee bangud sila ang nangin balagan agud mabuksan ang kaso ni Mabilog.
english: He also thanked House Speaker Martin Romualdez and the House Quad Committee for being the barrier to opening Mabilog's case.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Mabilog ang may ginapangatubang nga kaso nga paglapas sa RA 3019 ukon ang Anti-graft and Corrupt Practices Act kag RA 6713 ukon Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials.
english: Mabilog is facing charges of violating RA 3019 or the Anti-graft and Corrupt Practices Act and RA 6713 or Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials.

text: Ini ang nag-ugat sa gin-alegar nga vehicle towing contract nga ginpirmahan sang anay alkalde sang 2015.
english: This is rooted in the alleged vehicle towing contract signed by the former mayor in 2015.

text: Madumduman nga sang nagligad nga Septyembre 2024 sang nagpauli si Mabilog sa Pilipinas halin sa Estados Unidos matapos ang pila ka tuig nga pagpanago para sa iya seguridad matapos nalakip ang iya pangalan sa narcolist ni former President Rodrigo Duterte sang 2017.
english: It can be recalled that last September 2024 when Mabilog returned to the Philippines from the United States after several years of hiding for his security after his name was included in the narcolist of former President Rodrigo Duterte in 2017.

text: Apisar ginpakamalaot anay si US President Joe Biden bangud sa pagtawag kay Russian President Vladimir Putin nga isa ka “manugpatay”, ginpanindugan gid sini liwat nga isa ka war criminal ang nasambit nga Russian leader kag dapat nga ipaidalom sa war crime trial.
english: Although US President Joe Biden was previously condemned for calling Russian President Vladimir Putin a “murderer”, he reiterated that the Russian leader is a war criminal and should be subjected to a war crime trial.

text: “You may remember I got criticized for calling Putin a war criminal.
english: “You may remember I got criticized for calling Putin a war criminal.

text: Well, the truth of the matter—you saw what happened in Bucha…He is a war criminal.
english: Well, the truth of the matter—you saw what happened in Bucha…He is a war criminal.

text: But we have to gather the information,” suno sa US president.
english: But we have to gather the information,” according to the US president.

text: Suno kay Biden, nagakomiter si Putin sang war crimes kasunod sang pahayag sang Ukraine nga may 410 ka bangkay nga nakit-an sa mga lugar nga nabawi sang Ukraine matapos nga nag-isol ang iban nga Russian forces.
english: Biden said Putin was committing war crimes following Ukraine’s claim that 410 bodies had been found in areas recaptured by Ukraine after other Russian forces retreated.

text: Lakip na diri ang 300 civilians sa Bucha.
english: This includes 300 civilians in Bucha.

text: Ang Russia ang una naman nga nagpanginwala nga sila ang may kahimuan sa pagpamatay sa mga sibilyan sa Bucha nga nahamtang sa northwest sang Kyiv.
english: Russia has previously denied involvement in the killing of civilians in Bucha, northwest of Kyiv.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Biden nga dugangan pa niya ang pagdagdag sang sanctions batok sa Russia.
english: Biden also said he would further increase sanctions against Russia.

text: Ginpangabay ni former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog si Mayor Jerry Treñas nga untaton na ang pagpamulitika sa Iloilo City Government.
english: Former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog has asked Mayor Jerry Treñas to stop politicizing the Iloilo City Government.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pagtamyaw ni Treñas kay Mabilog kasunod sang paghatag sa iya sang clemency ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: This follows Treñas' greeting to Mabilog following the granting of clemency to him by President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mabilog, iya ginpahayag nga dako ang iya pagpasalamat kay Mayor Treñas sa pag-upod sa iya sang siya ang nagaumpisa pa lamang bilang politiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mabilog said he is very grateful to Mayor Treñas for being with him when he was just starting out as a politician.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, may nakit-an lang siya nga mga deperensya nga dapat lang niya ihambal bangud nakaagi man siya alkalde sang syudad.
english: According to Mabilog, he only saw some defects that he should have said because he was also the mayor of the city.

text: Ginapauntat man sang anay alkalde ang pagpapromisa sa mga job hire nga maboto sang mga naluyagan ni Treñas nga kandidato.
english: The former mayor also stopped promising job hires to vote for Treñas' preferred candidates.

text: Nagpanindugan man ang natungdan nga ang iya pagpanawagan ang indi lang tungod sa iya kag sa alkalde ukon sa ambisyon sini.
english: He also insisted that his call is not just because of him and the mayor or his ambition.

text: Gin-athag man ni Mabilog nga ini ang tanan tungod sa mga pumuluyo sang syudad nga yara sa middle class kag pigado.
english: Mabilog also explained that this is all because of the city's residents who are in the middle class and poor.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala siya nagahimo-himo sang istorya agud nga pakalainon si Treñas bangud ini ang iya nakit-an kag nangin singgit man sang kadam-an.
english: He also said that he is not making up stories to criticize Treñas because he saw it and it became a shout of the crowd.

text: Duha na ang ginbawian sang kabuhi sa walo ka mga indibidwal nga sakay sang Mitsubishi Mirage nga nakabunggo sa isa ka wing van truck sa Barangay Tacas, Jaro kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Two of the eight individuals aboard a Mitsubishi Mirage that collided with a wing van truck in Barangay Tacas, Jaro this morning have died.

text: Ang mga napatay nga biktima amo sanday Rizalyn Anacan, 24-anyos, residente sang Brgy.
english: The dead victims were identified as Rizalyn Anacan, 24, resident of Brgy.

text: Cayos, Dumangas kag Kim Joseph Sumaguio, 22, residente sang Sta.
english: Cayos, Dumangas and Kim Joseph Sumaguio, 22, resident of Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Ang driver sang salakyan amo si Joseph Anacan Sumagyo samtang ang driver sang truck amo si Freddie Ceryos.
english: The driver of the vehicle was identified as Joseph Anacan Sumagyo while the driver of the truck was identified as Freddie Ceryos.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCol Andy Pava, traffic investigator, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Mandurriao ang salakyansamtang halin sa Buhang pakadto sa Tacas ang wing van truck.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PCol Andy Pava, traffic investigator, said the vehicle was heading from Mandurriao while the wing van truck was heading from Buhang to Tacas.

text: Suno kay Pava, base sa nakakita, madasig ang dalagan sang Mitsubishi Mirage kag sang nag-overtake ini sa isa ka puck-up truck, wala ini nakabalik gilayon sa lane kag nakabunggo sa nagasugata nga truck.
english: According to Pava, based on witnesses, the Mitsubishi Mirage was traveling at a high speed and when it overtook a puck-up truck, it did not immediately return to the lane and collided with the oncoming truck.

text: Padayon naman nga ginabulong sa ospital ang iban nga sakay sang Mitsubishi Mirage matapos nag-angkon sang kapilasan.
english: Other passengers of the Mitsubishi Mirage are still being treated at the hospital after sustaining injuries.

text: Nahibaluan nga bangud sa impact, wasak gid ang kotse nga ginasakyan sang mga biktima.
english: It was learned that due to the impact, the car was completely destroyed.

text: Desidido si Senate Committee on Public Order and Dangerous Drugs Chairman Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa nga i-re-file ang hagna nga ipatuman ang death penalty para sa high-level drug traffickers sa tunga sang liwat nga paglutaw sang makangilidlis nga mga krimen sa pungsod.
english: Senate Committee on Public Order and Dangerous Drugs Chairman Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa is determined to re-file the bill to implement the death penalty for high-level drug traffickers amid the resurgence of heinous crimes in the country.

text: Gin-ako ni Dela Rosa nga mabudlayan ang pagpasar sang iya hagna bangud kontrobersyal ini, apang kumbinsido ini nga sa tion nga mapasar ini mangin solusyon ini sa mga problema nga ginapangatubang sang pungsod.
english: Dela Rosa acknowledged that it will be difficult to pass his bill because it is controversial, but he is convinced that once passed it will be a solution to the problems facing the country.

text: Ginmensyonar man sang senador ang damlag lang ang pagpangidnap sa isa ka 14-anyos nga Chinese student sa Taguig City kun sa diin gin-utdan ini sang tudlo sang suspek.
english: The senator also mentioned the recent kidnapping of a 14-year-old Chinese student in Taguig City where the suspect cut off his finger.

text: Gintumod man sang senador ang kaso sa Cebu sa diin isa ka lalaki, sa impluwensya sang iligal nga droga, ginpatay ang iya asawa kag duha ka kabataan; kag ang mga kaso sang isa ka tatlo ka tuig kag isa ka 80-anyos nga lunsay ginhimuslan kag ginpatay.
english: The senator also referred to the case in Cebu where a man, under the influence of illegal drugs, killed his wife and two children; and the cases of a three-year-old and an 80-year-old who were both raped and murdered.

text: Ginpanindugan ni Dela Rosa nga indi mapierde ang kampanya kontra iligal nga droga paagi sa disente nga approach.
english: Dela Rosa insisted that the campaign against illegal drugs cannot be defeated through a decent approach.

text: Suno sa iya, kinahanglan gid ang iron fist agud madula ang amo nga krimen.
english: He said an iron fist is needed to eradicate such crime.

text: Nagapanalaytay sa dugo sang ginbansagan nga ‘sprint king’ sang National Capital Region ang kadasigon sa pagdalagan.
english: The sprint king of the National Capital Region is running with speed.

text: Si Pi Durden Wangkay ang nakakuha sang gold medal sa secondary boys’ 100m kag sa 200m events sa Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: Pi Durden Wangkay won gold medals in the secondary boys’ 100m and 200m events at the Palarong Pambansa 2025.

text: Ang 16-anyos nga solterito halin sa De La Salle Zobel ang nagsiling nga nakuha niya sa iya iloy ang amo nga abilidad.
english: The 16-year-old from De La Salle Zobel said he got the skill from his mother.

text: Sang 1990s, ang iya iloy nga si Jonah Genilza ang nagdominar man sa Palaro paagi sa pagpangibabaw sa secondary girls’ sprint events kag nakahimo man sang record sa 400m nga naglawig sang masobra isa ka dekada antes ini na-break.
english: In the 1990s, her mother Jonah Genilza also dominated the Palaro by dominating the secondary girls’ sprint events and also set a record in the 400m that stood for more than a decade before it was broken.

text: Si Jonah ang nangin kabahin sang team La Salle sa UAAP kag nakatiglawas man sang Pilipinas sa international meets bilang parte sang national team.
english: Jonah was part of the La Salle team in the UAAP and also represented the Philippines in international meets as part of the national team.

text: Siya subong ang coach sang iya anak nga nagahandom man nga maka-compete sa international nga lebel kaangay sang iya iloy.
english: He is now the coach of his son who also dreams of competing at the international level like his mother.

text: MANG-GO gid ining pila ka Amerikano, sandig sa pila ka kaso sang “hate gestures” sang sini lang sa United States batok sa mga Asians – Filipino, Vietnamese, immigrants halin sa India, etc.
english: These Americans will GO, based on some cases of “hate gestures” recently in the United States against Asians – Filipinos, Vietnamese, immigrants from India, etc.

text: May nagtapungol gani sang tigulang nga Filipino.
english: Someone even stabbed an old Filipino.

text: Kontra nila ang mga Asian immigrants.
english: They are against Asian immigrants.

text: Aba, nalipat sila nga sila gid gani ang una kag pinakasabad nga immigrants sa Amerika, kon diin una nagapuyo ang mga American Indians.
english: Alas, they forget that they were the first and most notorious immigrants to America, where the American Indians first lived.

text: In fact, nangagaw lang gani sila sing mapuy-an sa Amerika.
english: In fact, they even took over America.

text: Mga gago!
english: Fools!

text:
***

Tungod seguro bag-o nga balatian ining COVID-19, wala kita nakita sa aton reseach parti sa kon ano nga mga factors ang pwede maka-influence sang immune response ang pagpabakuna sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english:
***

Because COVID-19 is probably a new disease, we did not find in our research about what factors can influence the immune response to the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Labi na gid kon bala makapabaskug ukon makapahina sang immune response ang COVID-19 vaccination.
english: Especially whether COVID-19 vaccination can strengthen or weaken the immune response.

text: Notwithstanding, pwede man seguro makabulig sa pagpabaskug sang immune (antibody) response ang pila ka buluhaton bag-o magpabakuna sa COVID-19, katulad sang experyensya sa pila ka vaccine batok sa iban nga balatian.
english: Notwithstanding, some activities before getting vaccinated against COVID-19, such as experience with some vaccines against other diseases, may also help strengthen the immune (antibody) response.

text: Por ejemplo, sunu sa report sang Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) sang United States, may mga pagtuon nga nagasiling nga may influence sa immune response sang tawo ang pagpanigarilyo (smoking) bag-o ini magpabakuna.
english: For example, according to a report by the Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the United States, there are studies that say that smoking before vaccination has an influence on a person's immune response.

text: Makapanubo ini sang immune response sa tion sang HepB vaccination, although wala sing impluwensya diri ang HPV vaccination.
english: This can reduce the immune response during HepB vaccination, although HPV vaccination has no influence here.

text: On the other hand, mataas ang immune response sa Tetanus vaccination pagkatapos sang pagdalagan sang isa ka runner sangsa non-runner control group.
english: On the other hand, immune response to Tetanus vaccination was high after running by a runner than non-runner control group.

text: Isa man ka pagtuon nagasiling nga ang pag-exercise sang butkon bag-o magpa-TIV (isa ka personality disorder) vaccination nagapataas sang antibody production sang mga babaye.
english: Another study says that arm exercise before TIV (a personality disorder) vaccination increases antibody production in women.

text: Ang positive mood sa bahin sang mga tigulang (elderly) nagapataas man sang ila antibody response sa TIV vaccination.
english: Positive mood on the part of the elderly also increases their antibody response to TIV vaccination.

text: Ang kulang sing tulog bag-o magpabakuna nagapanubo  sang antibody response sa tion sang HepB vaccination.
english: Lack of sleep before vaccination reduces the antibody response during HepB vaccination.

text: Madamo nga mga vaccine ang wala naga-influence sa Malnourishment, apang manubo ang immune response nila sa pila man ka vaccine katulad sang batok sa HepB kag tetanus vaccination.
english: Many vaccines do not influence malnourishment, but they have a low immune response to some vaccines such as those against HepB and tetanus vaccination.

text: Maka-influence man gali kon diin ka nagapuyo – rural (countryside) ukon urban (city).
english: It can also influence where you live – rural (countryside) or urban (city).

text: Ang nagapuyo sa rural, sunu sa isa ka pagtuon, may mas mataas nga antibody response sa tetanus kag experimental malaria vaccine.
english: Those who live in rural areas, according to one study, have a higher antibody response to tetanus and experimental malaria vaccine.

text: Nahibal-an man nga maka-influence gali ang geographical location.
english: It is also known that geographical location can influence.

text: Ang mga African infants sa “wet season” mas may mabaskug nga immune response sa CD254 vaccine kontra BCG sangsa sa mga infants sa “dry season”.
english: African infants in the “wet season” had a stronger immune response to the CD254 vaccine against BCG than infants in the “dry season”.

text: Nahibal-an man nga delikado magpabakuna ang mga tawo nga may mga serious allergic reaction sa vaccine component, ukon ingrediente sini, kag ang mga may pondo nga balatian  ukon kahimtangan nga, sa pag-check sang doktor, indi dapat bakunahan.
