english: It is also known that it is dangerous for people who have serious allergic reactions to vaccine components, or ingredients, and those who have underlying illnesses or conditions that, according to a doctor, should not be vaccinated.

text: On the other hand, indi man makapanubo ang vaccine sang immune response sang mga “sickly”, ukon ang mahina ang ikaayong lawas.
english: On the other hand, the vaccine does not reduce the immune response of the “sick”, or those with weak health.

text: In fact, makabulig pa ini sa pagpabakud sa isa nga tuyu magpabakuna.
english: In fact, it can even help strengthen one's intention to get vaccinated.

text: Of course, madamo pa nga factors ang maka-influence sang pagpabakuna sa pila ka balatian, nga nagalakip sa klase sang bakuna, nutritional factors,  kag pati na ang klase sang pag-administrar sang vaccine kon diin makahatag sing bagay nga panugyan ang isa ka doktor ukon health expert.
english: Of course, many other factors can influence vaccination for certain diseases, including the type of vaccine, nutritional factors, and even the type of vaccine administration where a doctor or health expert can give appropriate advice.

text: Tungod sini, wala man kita seguro pierdihon kon sundon ang pila ka bagay nga nakabulig ang pagpabakuna sa pagpataas sang immune (antibody) response sa pagpabakuna sa iban nga balatian.
english: Therefore, we probably do not lose if we follow some of the things that helped vaccination to increase the immune (antibody) response to vaccination against other diseases.

text: Katulad sang paglikaw sa pagpanigarilyo (smoking), exercise lakip na sang butkon bag-o magpa-tuslok, positive mood, indi gutom samtang nagapabakuna, kag maglikaw sa kulang nga tulog kag stress bag-o magpabakuna.
english: Such as avoiding smoking, exercise including the arm before injection, positive mood, not hungry while vaccinating, and avoiding lack of sleep and stress before vaccination.

text:
***

Samtang, importante man mahibaluan naton kon may weakened immune system, ukon immune deficiency, kita.
english:
***

Meanwhile, it is also important to know if we have a weakened immune system, or immune deficiency.

text: Nagalakip ini sang mataas nga stress level; pirme nga pag-“catch colds” katulad sang masami pag-sip-on kag pag-ubo-ubo; masami nga pagtae-tae (diarrhea);  madugay nga pagpali sang pilas; kinahanglan sing antibiotics sing mga duha ka beses sa isa ka tuig; kag pirme lang maluya ang kalawasan.
english: These include a high stress level; frequent catching colds such as frequent sneezing and coughing; frequent bowel movements (diarrhea);  prolonged wound healing; need antibiotics about twice a year; and always weak in body.

text: Tungod sini, kinahanglan naton ang magpabakud (boost) sang aton  immune system katulad sang balanced diet, bastante nga tulog, pag-exercise, masami nga pagpanghugas gamit ang habon sang kamot, pagpabilin sang healthy nga timbang, indi pagpanigarilyo, kag paglikaw sa stress physical kag mental./PN
english: Therefore, we need to boost our immune system such as a balanced diet, sufficient sleep, exercise, frequent hand washing with soap, maintaining a healthy weight, not smoking, and avoiding physical and mental stress.

text: Indi kumbinsido ang pamilya sang isa ka Person Deprived of Liberty (PDL) sa sulod sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology- Male Dormitory sa Nanga, Pototan, Iloilo nga nagpanginmatay ini.
english: The family of a Person Deprived of Liberty (PDL) inside the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology-Male Dormitory in Nanga, Pototan, Iloilo is not convinced that he committed suicide.

text: Ang PDL amo si alyas “Christian”, 33 anyos, nga napreso sang nagligad lang nga Nobyembre angot sa kaso nga may kahilabtanan sa illegal drugs.
english: The PDL is alias “Christian”, 33 years old, who was arrested last November in connection with a case related to illegal drugs.

text: Base sa impormasyon, isa ka nurse sa isolation facility ang nakakita sa amo nga PDL nga nagatindog apang nagapiyong ang mata.
english: According to reports, a nurse at the isolation facility saw the PDL standing with his eyes closed.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa isolation facility ginbutang ang amo nga PDL bangud may indi kinaandan sa iya hulag kag aktwasyon.
english: It was learned that the PDL was placed in the isolation facility because of something unusual in his movements and actions.

text: Matapos makit-an sang nurse, madasig man ini nga gindala sa ospital sa Barotac Nuevo apang ginbawian gid ini sang kabuhi.
english: After being found by a nurse, he was rushed to the hospital in Barotac Nuevo but died on the spot.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alyas “Pau”, pakaisa sang PDL, iya ginpahayag nga kwestyonable para sa ila ang pahayag sang pamunuan sang BJMP.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, alias “Pau”, cousin of the PDL, said that the statement of the BJMP leadership is questionable for them.

text: Ini bangud nga wala man sang napakita nga mga ebidensya ukon mga letrato sang ila himata antes ini gindala sa ospital.
english: This is because no evidence or photographs of their relatives were shown before they were taken to the hospital.

text: Suno kay Pau, may nakit-an man nga mga lagob sa iya lawas partikular sa kamot kag dulunggan.
english: According to Pau, there were also bruises on his body particularly on his hands and ears.

text: Dugang ni Pau, nakasugid man sa ila si Christian nga ginapabudlayan siya sa sulod sang pasilidad.
english: Pau said Christian also told them that he was being harassed inside the facility.

text: Pahayag pa niya, may yara man sang gusto pa gid isugid si Christian apang kaangay nga nahadlok ini.
english: He said Christian had something else to tell him but he seemed afraid.

text: Apisar nga napaidalom na sa autopsy ang lawas kag naggwa nga positibo nga nagpanginmatay gid man ini, padayon gihapon nga nagapangita sang kaathagan ang mga himata.
english: Although the body has been subjected to an autopsy and it turned out positive that he committed suicide, the relatives are still looking for clarification.

text: Apang gintuad niya nga nakaagi naman sadto nga gintuyo sang iya pakaisa nga utason ang iya kabuhi.
english: But he admitted that his cousin had tried to take his life.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay alyas “Fatima” nga utod ni Christian, ginkumpirma man niya nga asset ini sang pulis sadto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Christian's sister, alias “Fatima”, confirmed that he was an asset of the policeman.

text: Suno sa iya, ikaduha na ini nga tion nga nadakpan bangud man sa iligal nga druga apang nakagwa paagi sa plea bargaining agreement.
english: He said this is the second time he was arrested for illegal drugs but was released through a plea bargaining agreement.

text: Idineklara ng pamahalaan ng Sri Lanka ang state of emergency matapos ang malawakang pagbaha at pagguho ng lupa na dulot ng Cyclone Ditwah, na ngayo’y itinuturing bilang isa sa pinakamapaminsalang bagyo na tumama sa bansa sa mga nagdaang taon.
english: The Sri Lankan government has declared a state of emergency after widespread flooding and landslides caused by Cyclone Ditwah, which is now considered one of the most destructive typhoons to hit the country in recent years.

text: Mahigit 330 katao na ang naitalang nasawi.
english: More than 330 people have been recorded missing.

text: Ayon sa mga opisyal, higit 200 pa ang nananatiling nawawala, habang 200,000 kabahayan ang nawasak at nagresulta sa paglikas ng mahigit 108,000 indibidwal patungo sa mga pansamantalang evacuation center na pinapatakbo ng estado.
english: According to officials, more than 200 people remain missing, while 200,000 homes were destroyed and resulted in the evacuation of more than 108,000 individuals to temporary evacuation centers run by the state.

text: Tinatayang isang-katlo ng bansa ang walang suplay ng kuryente at tubig, bagay na lalo pang nagpapahirap sa operasyon ng mga otoridad at sa kalagayan ng mga residente.
english: An estimated one-third of the country is without electricity and water supply, which further complicates the operation of the authorities and the plight of the residents.

text: Inilarawan naman ni Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake ang pananalasa ng bagyo bilang ang “pinaka-malaking hamon na kalamidad” na tumama sa kanilang bansa, at iginiit na napakalawak ng pinsalang iniwan nito.
english: Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake described the typhoon's devastation as the "most challenging disaster" to hit their country, and stressed that the damage it left behind was widespread.

text: Patuloy naman ang mga evacuation sa iba’t ibang lugar, lalo na sa mga komunidad na binaha matapos umapaw ang tubig mula sa Kelani River.
english: Evacuations continue in various areas, especially in communities that were flooded after the water from the Kelani River overflowed.

text: Sa ulat ng isang residente mula sa gitnang bahagi ng Sri Lanka, 15 kabahayan sa kanilang lugar ang tuluyang natabunan ng malalaking bato at makakapal na putik, at wala ni isa mang nakaligtas.
english: According to a resident from central Sri Lanka, 15 houses in their area were completely covered by large rocks and thick mud, and no one survived.

text: Pinakamaraming nasawi ang naitala sa Kandy at Badulla, kung saan marami pang lugar ang hindi nararating ng mga rescue team dahil sa pagkasira ng mga kalsada at patuloy na pagguho ng lupa.
english: The highest number of victims was recorded in Kandy and Badulla, where many areas are still inaccessible to rescue teams due to damaged roads and continuous landslides.

text: Dahil sa lawak ng pinsala, umapela na ang pamahalaan ng Sri Lanka para sa international aid at hinihikayat ang mga Sri Lankan na nasa ibang bansa na magbigay ng donasyon upang matulungan ang mga apektadong komunidad.
english: Due to the extent of the damage, the Sri Lankan government has appealed for international aid and urged Sri Lankans abroad to donate to help the affected communities.

text: Ginmultahan ang isa ka judge sa Sweden bangud sa ginapahayag tuyo nga pagpangawat sang Christmas ham kag meatballs.
english: A judge in Sweden has been fined for allegedly deliberately stealing Christmas ham and meatballs.

text: Suno sa prosecutor sa amo nga kaso, nadakpan sang staff sang grocery store sa central Stockholm ang 67-anyos nga Supreme Court justice isa ka semana antes ang Paskuwa.
english: According to the prosecutor in the case, staff at a grocery store in central Stockholm arrested the 67-year-old Supreme Court justice a week before Easter.

text: Suno kay chief public prosecutor Per Nichols, ginpabayad ang amo nga judge bangud sa krimen nga petty theft ukon shoplifting.
english: According to chief public prosecutor Per Nichols, the judge was fined for the crime of petty theft or shoplifting.

text: Sang Pebrero, nag-resign na ini sa iya nga posisyon sang naglapta ang reports nga ginaimbestigaran siya.
english: In February, he resigned from his position when reports spread that he was under investigation.

text: Duha ka dekada man ini nga nagatrabaho bilang judge.
english: He has also been working as a judge for two decades.

text: Sandig sa reports, antes ang Christmas, samtang yara sa grocery store, gintago sini ang Christmas ham, meatballs, sausages kag cheese sa bag paagi sa pagtabon sang isa pa ka bag.
english: According to reports, before Christmas, while at the grocery store, he hid the Christmas ham, meatballs, sausages and cheese in the bag by covering another bag.

text: Gin-ako sini ang facts sa amo nga kaso apang ginpanginwala ang intensyon nga magpangawat sang groceries.
english: He admitted the facts in the case but denied the intention to steal groceries.

text: Nagdangat sa 50,000 Swedish kronor ukon P276,400 ang gindagdag nga multa.
english: The additional fine amounted to 50,000 Swedish kronor or P276,400.

text: Nagsabat si Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro kay former presidential spokesman Harry Roque matapos gintawag siya nga “salesman” sang Marcos administration.
english: Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro to former presidential spokesman Harry Roque after he was called a “salesman” of the Marcos administration.

text: Suno kay Castro, indi siya salesman, kundi isa ka “messenger” sang administrasyon ni President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: According to Castro, he is not a salesman, but a “messenger” of the administration of President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: Sa statement ni Roque sang nagligad, ginsiling sini nga “good luck” na lang sa mga bag-o nga opisyal sang Presidential Communications Office (PCO) nga sanday Castro kag Jay Ruiz.
english: In a statement earlier, Roque said he wished “good luck” to the new Presidential Communications Office (PCO) officials, Castro and Jay Ruiz.

text: Daw kaangay suno kay Roque nga nagapungko sila bilang salesman, pero suno sa iya, bisan ano pa ka maalam ang salesman kun indi man maayo ang produkto, mabudlayan man gihapon ini nga ibaligya.
english: Roque said it is like sitting as a salesman, but he said that no matter how smart the salesman is, if the product is not good, it will still be difficult to sell.

text: Naga-guwa nga palagtik ini kay President Marcos halin kay Roque nga nagpungko anay nga spokesman sang tion ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: This appears to be a threat to President Marcos from Roque who served as spokesman during the time of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: ”Para kang salesman eh, kinakailangang ibenta mo ang Presidente mo… pero alam ng lahat ng salesman, kahit gaano ka kagaling na salesman, kung hindi magandang produkto, mahihirapan kang ibenta.
english: "For a salesman, you have to sell your President... but every salesman knows that no matter how good a salesman you are, if you don't have a good product, you will have difficulty selling.

text: So all I can say is goodluck sa bagong PCO officials na si Jay Ruiz at Claire Castro,” suno anay kay Roque.
english: So all I can say is goodluck to the new PCO officials Jay Ruiz and Claire Castro,” Roque said.

text: Nagsabat man sang palagtik si Castro.
english: Castro responded with a smile.

text: Ginsiling sini nga mabudlay gid man ibaligya ang produkto ilabi na kun kinahanglan pa limpyuhan ang mga ginahambal sang tawo.
english: He said it is very difficult to sell the product especially if you have to clean up what people say.

text: Ginpabati-batian man sini ang masami pahayag sang spokesperson anay ni Duterte nga naga-joke lang ang former president ilabi na kun kontrobersyal ang iya mga pahayag.
english: He also echoed the frequent statements of Duterte's former spokesperson that the former president is just joking especially when his statements are controversial.

text: ”Naniniwala po talaga kami na mahirap ibenta ang bulok o masamang produkto.
english: "We really believe that it is difficult to sell rotten or bad products.

text: Mahirap po talagang ibenta kapag ang ibinibenta mo ay kailangan mo pang linisin ang mga sinasabi.
english: It's really hard to sell when you're selling and you have to clean up the words.

text: Mahirap ibenta ang mga tao na ang laging nababanggit ay joke lamang iyan,” suno kay Castro sa press briefing, Marso 3.
english: It's hard to sell people that what's always mentioned is just a joke,” Castro said at a press briefing on March 3.

text: ”Hindi po kami salesman dito.
english: "We're not salespeople here.

text: Kami po ay messenger.
english: We are messengers.

text: Ang salesman po kasi ay kailangan na maganda ang bokadura mo; kailangan na ibenta kahit na minsan ay hindi totoo iyong mga sinasabi mo para lang mabenta ang isang tao o isang produkto.
english: The salesman has to have good vocabulary; you have to sell even if sometimes what you say is not true just to sell a person or a product.

text: Okay, sa amin po, messenger kami; hindi po kami nagbebenta ng Pangulo o ng gobyerno,” dugang sang undersecretary.
english: Okay, we're messengers; we are not selling the President or the government,” the undersecretary added.

text: Nahibaluan nga umpisa sang nagligad nga semana, nangin popular si Castro sa iya mga buwelta ilabi na kun may mga isyu nga ginahaboy batok sa Marcos administration.
english: It is known that since last week, Castro has become popular in his rounds especially when there are issues thrown against the Marcos administration.

text: Ginsabat man sini mangin si former President Duterte.
english: He also responded to former President Duterte.

text: Nagpahanumdom naman si Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero nga ang mga opisyal sang PCO indi amo ang spokesperson ni President Marcos.
english: Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero reminded that PCO officials are not the spokesperson of President Marcos.

text: “Everyone at that office serves at the pleasure of the President, but I don’t think she is the spokesperson of the President,” suno kay Escudero.
english: “Everyone at that office serves at the pleasure of the President, but I don’t think she is the spokesperson of the President,” according to Escudero.

text: “If I remember it correctly, the President said he will not have a spokesperson and that has maintained kaya title pa rin niya ay press officer… ‘Yan siguro ang dapat maisip din at maalala ng ating mga opisyal sa PCO na ang Pangulo pa rin ang nananatiling magsasalita para sa sarili niya,” dugang sini.
english: “If I remember it correctly, the President said he will not have a spokesperson and that has maintained so his title is still press officer... 'That's probably what our officials in the PCO should think and remember that the President still remains to speak for himself,” he added.

text: Tun-an sang Malacañang ang report nga naka-donar pa sang mga motorsiklo sa Philippine National Police (PNP) kag sa Local Government Unit (LGU) ang pila sa ginaalegar mga espiya sang China nga nadakpan sang otoridad.
english: Malacañang will study reports that some of the alleged Chinese spies arrested by the authorities have donated motorcycles to the Philippine National Police (PNP) and the Local Government Unit (LGU).

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Claire Castro, imbestigaran kun may lain pa gid nga motibo sa amo nga donasyon, bangud sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, wala man sang malain nga magbaton sang donasyon kun ginhatag ini sa maayo nga tinutuyo.
english: Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Claire Castro said they will investigate whether there is another motive behind the donation, because in fact, there is nothing wrong with receiving a donation if it is given with good intentions.

text: Base sa nauna nagguwa nga report, sanday Wang Yongyi, Wu Junren, Cai Shaohuang, kag Chen Haitao ang naghatag sang donasyon sa Tarlac City kag sa pulis paagi sa grupo nga suportado sang China sadtong 2022.
english: Based on previous reports, Wang Yongyi, Wu Junren, Cai Shaohuang, and Chen Haitao donated to Tarlac City and the police through a Chinese-backed group in 2022.

text: Ginsiling sa report nga sanday Wang, Wu, kag Cai ang nakahatag sang 10 Chinese-made motorcycles nga nagabalor sang $2,500 ukon P144,800 kada isa sa Manila police.
english: The report said Wang, Wu, and Cai donated 10 Chinese-made motorcycles worth $2,500 or P144,800 each to the Manila police.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang Manila Local Government Unit nga nabaton gid man sang pulis sa ila hurisdiksyon ang amo nga mga motorsiklo, apang ginklaro nga wala sang inter-aksyon si Manila Mayor Honey Lacuna sa donor magluwas lamang sa adlaw nga ginpatigayon ang turnover ceremony.
english: The Manila Local Government Unit also confirmed that the police in their jurisdiction received the motorcycles, but clarified that Manila Mayor Honey Lacuna had no interaction with the donor except on the day of the turnover ceremony.

text: Una naman nga ginsiling ni PNP-Crime Investigation and Detection Group chief Brig.
english: Earlier, PNP-Crime Investigation and Detection Group chief Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III nga nagmandu na ang chief sang Philippine National Police nga imbestigaran ini nga report.
english: Nicolas Torre III said the chief of the Philippine National Police has ordered an investigation into the report.

text: Natukiban nga mga pugante sa China ang 13 sa Chinese nationals nga naaresto sang gin-raid sang otoridad ang ginaalegar nga Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) scam hub sa Pasay City.
english: Thirteen Chinese nationals arrested during a raid on an alleged Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) scam hub in Pasay City were discovered to be fugitives from China.

text: Ginpasa sang Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) ang ila nga mga pangalan sa Chinese embassy kag ang embahada sa Manila ang nagkumpirma nga guilty sila sa pila ka mga krimen sa ila ginhalinan nga pungsod.
english: The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) forwarded their names to the Chinese embassy and the embassy in Manila confirmed that they were guilty of several crimes in their country of origin.

text: Suno kay PAOCC executive director Gilbert Cruz, nadiskubrehan ini sang ginkuhaan sila sang biometric kag didto na kag nagsunod-sunod na sa pagguwa ang ila matuod nga mga pangalan kag ang ila ginkaulamiran nga criminal activities.
english: According to PAOCC executive director Gilbert Cruz, this was discovered when they were taken biometric and there and one after another came out their real names and their known criminal activities.

text: Wanted sila sa cryptocurrency and investment scam kag nagagamit man sang ginadumilian nga messaging app agud nga mapatigayon ang ila nga negosyo.
english: They are wanted for cryptocurrency and investment scam and also use illegal messaging app to conduct their business.

text: Ang ginakabalak-an sang PAOCC suno kay Cruz amo kun ngaa nakasulod pa gihapon ini nga Chinese nationals bisan nga banned naman ang Pogo diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Cruz said the PAOCC is concerned about why these Chinese nationals are still able to enter the country even though Pogo is banned in the Philippines.

text: “Especially those with red notice or may blue notice or wanted ng Interpol, automatic pagpasok dito niyan nagre-red alert na agad eh.
english: “Especially those with red notice or may blue notice or wanted by Interpol, automatic entry here now nagre-red alert immediately eh.

text: Since wala silang dokumento nung pumasok dito, malamang puwedeng nag-back door sila or they used other means to get in our country,” pahayag sang natungdan.
english: Since they did not have documents when they entered here, it is likely that they used a back door or they used other means to get into our country,” he said.

text: Nagapakig-angot man sila sa Bureau of Immigration para sa backtrack investigation.
english: They are also working with the Bureau of Immigration for a backtrack investigation.

text: Lakip man sa natukiban sang awtoridad amo nga pila sa foreign workers ang nakapalagyo anay sang gin-raid ang POGO hubs sa Bamban, Tarlac, kag sa Porac, Pampanga kag nagsaylo anay sa mas gamay nga POGO operations sa Pasay.
english: Among the findings of the authorities is that some of the foreign workers escaped when the POGO hubs in Bamban, Tarlac, and Porac, Pampanga were raided and moved to smaller POGO operations in Pasay.

text: Magasapol sanday Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kag Chinese President Xi Jinping sa Abril 8.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte and Chinese President Xi Jinping will meet on April 8.

text: Ginbuyagyag ini sang presidente samtang ginahambalan ang tensyon sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: The president revealed this while discussing tensions between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Ginpanindugan ni Duterte nga magapabilin nga neutral ukon wala sang ginadampigan ang Pilipinas sa amo nga away.
english: Duterte insisted that the Philippines will remain neutral in the fight.

text: Suno sa presidente, kun hinali nga madayon gid ang gyera, kun iguon sang nuclear weapon ang Russia ukon ang Russia man ang mag-una, sigurado nga indi man mapaghimunong ang China bangud kuhaon man sini ang teritoryo sang Taiwan.
english: According to the president, if the war suddenly continues, if Russia is hit with a nuclear weapon or Russia takes the lead, China will certainly not be satisfied because it will also take the territory of Taiwan.

text: Sigurado suno sa presidente nga iguon man sini ang Pilipinas kun may yara na sang full-scale war bangud may mga Amerikano nga nagatinir sa pungsod.
english: The president said he is sure that it will also hit the Philippines if there is a full-scale war because there are Americans staying in the country.

text: Ginhatag na ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang Executive Clemency kay former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.
english: the Executive Clemency to former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.

text: Mismo ang kampo sang anay alcalde ang nag-anunsyo sang amo nga development.
english: The former mayor's camp itself announced the development.

text: Madumduman nga sang nagligad nga Septyembre 2024 sang nagpauli si Mabilog sa Pilipinas halin sa Estados Unidos matapos ang pila ka tuig nga pagpanago para sa iya seguridad matapos nalakip ang iya pangalan sa narcolist ni former President Rodrigo Duterte sang 2017.
english: It can be recalled that last September 2024 when Mabilog returned to the Philippines from the United States after several years of hiding for his security after his name was included in the narcolist of former President Rodrigo Duterte in 2017.

text: May kaangtanan sa amo nga clemency, isa ka Thanksgiving Mass ang pagahiwaton sa las-10:00 subong nga aga sa Mabilog compound.
english: In connection with the clemency, a Thanksgiving Mass will be held at 10:00 this morning at the Mabilog compound.

text: Nangin biktima sang pagpang-atake ang duha ka mga Pinoy sa duha ka separado nga insidente sa Midtown Manhattan sa New York City.
english: Two Filipinos were attacked in two separate incidents in Midtown Manhattan in New York City.

text: Ang una nga biktima amo ang 73 anyos nga Pilipino nga gin-sakit sa 8th Avenue, New York.
english: The first victim was a 73-year-old Filipino who was assaulted on 8th Avenue, New York.

text: Base sa video nga ginpagwa sang New York Police Department Crime Stopper, gintiklod sang suspek ang biktima tubtob nga natumba ini.
english: According to video released by the New York Police Department Crime Stopper, the suspect pushed the victim until she fell.

text: Nakaagum sang mga pilas sa guya ang pinoy kag padayon nga ginabulong.
english: The Filipino sustained injuries to his face and is undergoing treatment.

text: Ang ikaduha nga biktima amo ang 53 anyos nga Pillipino nga gin-atake sa isa ka food chain sa Midtown, New York.
english: The second victim was a 53-year-old Pillipino who was attacked at a food chain in Midtown, New York.

text: Sa video sang NYPD Crime Stopper makita nga samtang naga-order sang pagkaon ang bitima gilayon lang ini nga ginpalapitan sang suspek ka ginpahog.
english: The NYPD Crime Stopper video shows that while the victim was ordering food, the suspect immediately approached her and threatened her.

text: Gintapungol kag ginsipa pa gid tubtob nga nakuha ang iya kwarta kag cellphne.
english: He was beaten and kicked until his money and cellphone were taken.

text: Nakaagum ini sang pilas sa iya lawas ka gilayon nga gindala sa ospital.
english: He sustained injuries to his body and was immediately taken to the hospital.

text: Ini na ang ika 34 nga Pilipino nga gin-atake suno sa Consulate General sa New York.
english: This is the 34th Filipino to be attacked, according to the Consulate General in New York.

text: Ginakahangaw-an naman sang pila pa ka mga Pilipino ang magsakay sa subway bangud sa kakulba nga mangin biktima sang hate crimes sa New York City.
english: Some Filipinos are still worried about taking the subway because they are afraid of becoming victims of hate crimes in New York City.

text: Ang mga Pilipino kag Asian community ang magapatigayon man sang rally sa Manhattan agud nga kundinahon ang nagakatabo nga pagang-atake.
english: The Filipino and Asian communities will also hold a rally in Manhattan to condemn the attacks.

text: Ginpromisa sang Russia nga ila buhinan ang military operations sa Kyiv kag Chernihiv sa Ukraine matapos nga pagsinapul kaupod ang mga opisyal sang Ukraine sa Istanbul, Turkey.
english: Russia has promised to reduce military operations in Kyiv and Chernihiv in Ukraine after a meeting with Ukrainian officials in Istanbul, Turkey.

text: Ginpropose naman sang Ukraine nga ila adoptaron ang neutral status sa mga international guarantees sa baylo nga maprotektahan sila sa anuman nga pagpang-atake.
english: Ukraine has proposed that they adopt neutral status under international guarantees instead of being protected from any attack.

text: Ang buot silingon sini, indi na makigbahin ang Ukraine sa anuman nga alyansa kag mag-host sang bases sa mga froreign troops apang dapat nga magaranteya ang seguridad sa ila pungsod.
english: What this means is that Ukraine will not participate in any alliance and host bases to froreign troops but that security in their country must be guaranteed.

text: Gintumod man ang Israel kag ang mga NATO members sa Canada, Poland kag Turkey nga amo ang magabulig nga makahatag sang amo nga garantiya.
english: Israel and NATO members Canada, Poland and Turkey were also identified as helping to provide such guarantees.

text: Dugang pa sang mga Ukrainian negotiators, may bastante nga mga materyales ang ila proposal agud nga mapatigayon ang meeting sa tunga nanday Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky kag Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: The Ukrainian negotiators added that their proposal has enough materials to facilitate a meeting between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Ginhiluan ang isa Russian billionaire kag ang kaupod sini nga Ukrainians kasunod sang ginapahayag pag-negosyar sini agud tapuson na ang away sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: A Russian billionaire and his fellow Ukrainians have been poisoned following their alleged negotiations to end the conflict between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Sandig sa US reports, ang gin-target sang poisoning attack amo ang oligarch nga si Roman Abramovich, ang longtime owner sang Chelsea Football Club sa London.
english: According to US reports, the target of the poisoning attack was oligarch Roman Abramovich, the longtime owner of Chelsea Football Club in London.

text: Ang amo nga billionaire businessman ang nalakip sa gindagdagan sang sanctions halin sa Western nations agud pwersahon si Russian President Vladimir Putin nga untaton na ang iya invasion.
english: The billionaire businessman is among those who have increased sanctions from Western nations to force Russian President Vladimir Putin to stop his invasion.

text: Antes ang poisoining attack, ginapahayag nga nakit-an si Abramovich nga nagaguwa sulod sa Kyiv, Moscow kag iban pa nga negotiation sites.
english: Before the poisoining attack, Abramovich was reportedly seen appearing inside Kyiv, Moscow and other negotiation sites.

text: Matapos ang meeting sa Kyiv, ginapahayag nga si Abramovich kag ang duha ka senior Ukrainian negotiators ang nag-develop sang mga sintomas kaangay sang pula nga mata nga nagasakit kag nagatubig-tubig kag nagapanit-panit man ang ila nawong kag kamot.
english: After the meeting in Kyiv, Abramovich and the two senior Ukrainian negotiators reportedly developed symptoms such as red painful and watery eyes and peeling of their faces and hands.

text: Indi maathag kun sin-o ang may kahimuan apang ginapahayag nga ang ginabasol amo ang pila ka tawo sa Russia nga nagatuyo nga i-sabotahe ang negosasyon.
english: It is not clear who is responsible but it is said that some people in Russia are trying to sabotage the negotiations.

text: Sa subong, luwas na sa katalagman sanday Abramovich kag ang Ukranian negotiators.
english: For now, Abramovich and the Ukrainian negotiators are safe.

text: Ginapatihan man nga indi intensyon sang suspek nga patyon ang bilyonaryo kundi magpalab-ot lang sang warning.
english: It is also believed that the suspect did not intend to kill the billionaire but to convey a warning.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky nga nakabaton siya sang suporta halin sa mga Russian businessmen lakip na si Abramovich kag isa ini sa nagpasugot sa negosasyon.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky also confirmed that he had received support from Russian businessmen including Abramovich and that he was one of those who agreed to the negotiations.

text: Bisan ang mga lider sa Estados Unidos ang nagpabutyag man sang kahangawa kasunod sang wala hawid-hawid nga pahayag ni US President Joe Biden nga manugpatay kag indi na mahimo makatinir sa pagginahum si Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: Even leaders in the United States have expressed concern following US President Joe Biden's unrestrained statement that Russian President Vladimir Putin is a murderer and can no longer remain in power.

text: Lakip ini sa ginpanghambal ni Biden pagkatapos sang iya nga speech sa Poland kun sa diin ginbisita man sini ang iban nga Ukrainian refugees.
english: Biden said this after his speech in Poland where he also visited other Ukrainian refugees.

text: Suno kay Russia spokesperson Dmitry Peskov, makakilibot ang nangin pahayag ni Biden.
english: According to Russia spokesperson Dmitry Peskov, Biden's statement was surprising.

text: Wala nakahangop si Biden suno sa iya nga indi lang limitado ang kalibutan sa Estados Unidos kag sa Europa.
english: Biden does not understand, he said, that the world is not limited to the United States and Europe.

text: Kasunod sini, talalupangdon man ang maabtik nga pagdepensa sang US.
english: Subsequently, the agile US defense was also noteworthy.

text: Suno kay US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, ang buot silingon ni Biden, indi pwede nga maggahum si Putin sa kaiping nga mga pungsod sang Russia kag sa bilog nga rehiyon.
english: According to US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Biden meant that Putin cannot rule over Russia’s neighbors and the entire region.

text: Nagdepensa ang Estados Unidos nga wala ginatumod ni Biden ang pagginahum ni Putin sa Russia, ukon ang pag-ilis sang rehimen.
english: The United States defended that Biden was not referring to Putin’s rule in Russia, or regime change.

text: Gintumod man sang pila ka mga tawo nga bisan sang tiempo sang Cold War, nakahibalo na ang Americans kag Soviets nga lain ang kahulugan sa pagkondenar sa isa ka lider ipaanggid kun ginapanawan na ang pagkakas sa iya sa posisyon ukon ang regime change.
english: Some people also pointed out that even during the Cold War, the Americans and Soviets knew that it was different to condemn a leader than to remove him from office or regime change.

text: Talalupangdon man nga pila sa kaalyado sang US ang nagreact.
english: It is also noteworthy that several of the US allies have reacted.

text: Suno kay French President Emmanuel Macron, ginabutang ni Biden sa alang-alang ang ceasefire negotiations sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine bangud sang iya nga ginapanghambal.
english: According to French President Emmanuel Macron, Biden is putting the ceasefire negotiations between Russia and Ukraine at risk because of his remarks.

text: Ginakabig sang City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), nga isa ka dako nga pagpanghakat sa ila nga buy bust operations ang panibag-o nga stratehiya sang mga durugista.
english: The City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) considers the new strategy of drug pushers as a major challenge in their buy bust operations.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCapt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCapt.

text: Roque Gimeno III, Hepe sang CDEU, iya ginpahayag nga ila natukiban nga madamo na sa mga nagabakal kag nagabaligya sang droga ang ginapaagi na sa mga delivey rider kag ginaputos ang mga droga kaangay sang parcel.
english: Roque Gimeno III, Chief of CDEU, said they have discovered that many of the drug buyers and sellers are already being sent through delivey riders and packaged drugs like parcels.

text: Suno pa kay Gimeno, wala na sang madamo nga naga-engage sa face-to-face transaction, bangud nga nagahalong naman ang mga ini agud indi sila madali nga madakpan sang mga awtoridad.
english: According to Gimeno, there are not many people who engage in face-to-face transactions, because they are careful not to be easily caught by the authorities.

text: Natukiban sang mga kapulisan ang panibag-o nga tikang sang mga durugista matapos nila nga nadakpan ang isa ka subject nga madamo sang tinago nga mga karton nga amo ang ginaputsan sang mga droga kag ginapadeliver sa mga rider.
english: Police discovered the new move of drug pushers after they arrested a subject who had many hidden cartons that were used to package drugs and deliver them to riders.

text: Balantayan ang isa na naman ka hugnat sang pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo sa masunod nga emana.
english: Another round of petroleum product price increases is expected in the coming months.

text:
Suno sa Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau, sandig sa apat ka adlaw nga trading, yari ang posible nga hulag sa presyo:

Gasoline – increase of more or less P1.50 per literDiesel – increase of more or less P1.00 per literKerosene – increase of more or less P0.80 per liter

Gina-angot sang ahensya ang nagapamintana nga fuel price hike sa mga latest nga development sa oil market subong nga semana.
english:
According to the Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau, based on four days of trading, here is the likely price movement:

Gasoline – increase of more or less P1.50 per literDiesel – increase of more or less P1.00 per literKerosene – increase of more or less P0.80 per liter

The agency linked the pending fuel price hike to the latest developments in the oil market this week.

text: Lakip diri ang nabuhi nga mga kahangawa sa supply disruptions kasunod sang sanction ni US President Donald Trump sa Russia kag sa Iranian oil.
english: This includes revived concerns about supply disruptions following US President Donald Trump's sanctions on Russia and Iranian oil.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, yara man ang paglaom sa mas maayo nga economic activity matapos ang US – EU trade deal.
english: On the other hand, there is also hope for better economic activity after the US – EU trade deal.

text: Sa Lunes kinaandan nga gina-anunsyo sang fuel retailers ang opisyal nga price adjustments kag ginapatuman ini sa kada Martes sang aga.#
english: Fuel retailers usually announce official price adjustments on Monday and implement them every Tuesday morning.

text: Humalin sa paborito naton nga taho kag sa subong nagbantog naman ang milktea, indi gid madula diri ang panakot nga sago.
english: From our favorite taho and now milktea is famous, the spice of sago will never disappear.

text: Ang sago ang isa ka sahi sang starch nga naghalin sa tropical palm stems sa diin mabilog-bilog ini kag makalilingaw man nga usapon.
english: Sago is a type of starch that comes from tropical palm stems and is round and fun to chew.

text: Ang sago ang nangin kabahin man sang staple starch sa iban nga mga pungsod kaangay sang Indonesia, Malaysia, kag Papua New Guinea.
english: Sago has also become a staple starch in other countries such as Indonesia, Malaysia, and Papua New Guinea.

text: Natukiban man sa mga pagtuon nga ang sago ang indi basta-basta lang nga sago bangud dako ang mahatag sini nga benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas ilabi na sa mga naga-ehersisyo.
english: Studies have also shown that sago is not just a sago because it can provide great health benefits especially to those who exercise.

text: Suno kay Ryan Raman, registered dietitian sa Auckland, New Zealand, manggaranon sa antioxidants kag resistant starch ang sago sa diin nagabulig ini pasangkad sang exercise performance.
english: According to Ryan Raman, registered dietitian in Auckland, New Zealand, sago is rich in antioxidants and resistant starch which helps enhance exercise performance.

text: Pahayag ni Raman, ang high carbohydrate content sang sago ang nagabulig prolong sang endurance activity kag nagapaboost sang energy sang isa ka indibidwal nga naga-ehersisyo.
english: Raman said the high carbohydrate content of sago helps prolong endurance activity and boosts the energy of an individual who exercises.

text: Ang pagkaon sang sago pagkatapos sang ehersiyo ang makabulig man sa lawas nga makarecover sa kakapoy.
english: Eating sago after exercise can also help the body recover from fatigue.

text: Ang antioxidants kag resistant starch sa sago ang makabuhin naman sang risgo sa pag-angkon sang heart disease.
english: The antioxidants and resistant starch in sago can reduce the risk of heart disease.

text: Magluwas diri, ang resistant starch sa sago ang nagabulig man panubo sang blood sugar levels kag appetite, kag nagapa-improve sang digestion.
english: In addition, the resistant starch in sago also helps lower blood sugar levels and appetite, and improves digestion.

text: Dugang pa sang dietician, recommended man ang lemon sago pudding para sa mas healthy nga recipe kag pagkaon sang sago.
english: The dietician added that lemon sago pudding is also recommended for a healthier sago recipe and diet.

text: Diri kag ginapabukalan lamang ang sago sa tubig, lemon juice kag honey sa diin ini ang masami nga ginaserbe sa New Zealand.
english: Here the sago is simply boiled in water, lemon juice and honey where it is usually served in New Zealand.

text: Ginpamatbatan sang reclusion perpetua ukon 20 tubtob 40 ka tuig nga pagkapreso sa kada count sang ‘rape’ ang isa ka pari bangud sa paghimulos sa isa ka 16-anyos nga estudyante.
english: A priest was sentenced to reclusion perpetua or 20 to 40 years in prison for each count of rape for raping a 16-year-old student.

text: Ang pari amo si Father Mark E. Batolne, nga gindagdagan sang sentensiya ni Presiding Judge Modesto D. Bahul Jr.
english: The priest was Father Mark E. Batolne, whose sentence was increased by Presiding Judge Modesto D. Bahul Jr.

text: sang Regional Trial Court Branch 2.
english: of Regional Trial Court Branch 2.

text: Natabo ang paghimulos sa kwarto nga ginatiniran sang dalagita sa sulod sang compound sang Diocese sang Baguio sang Marso 2023.
english: The rape took place in the room where the girl was staying within the compound of the Diocese of Baguio in March 2023.

text: Sang amo nga tion, si Batolne ang finance administrator sang Diocese sang Baguio.
english: At the time, Batolne was the finance administrator of the Diocese of Baguio.

text: Napamatud-an nga guilty ang pari sa idalom sang Articles 266-A kag 266-B sang Revised Penal Code kun sa diin napamatud-an nga naggamit ini sang kutsilyo agud pahugon ang dalagita.
english: The priest was found guilty under Articles 266-A and 266-B of the Revised Penal Code where he was found guilty of using a knife to threaten the girl.

text: Anom ka beses nga natabo ang pagpanghimulos sang Marso 2023.
english: Exploitation occurred six times in March 2023.

text: Sa kada kaso, 20 ka tuig ang katumbas nga pagkapreso gani magalawig sang kabilugan nga 120 ka tuig ang iya sentensya.
english: In each case, 20 years is the equivalent of imprisonment so his sentence will last a total of 120 years.

text: Magluwas sa pagkapreso, pabaydon man ini sang ₱225,000 bilang danyos sa biktima.
english: Besides imprisonment, he will also be ordered to pay ₱225,000 in damages to the victim.

text: GINAKILALA sang international community ang neutral position sang mga pari agud magsabat sa kalagnon nga kinahanglan sang tawo, kaugyon man ukon kaaway sa gyera.
english: THE international community recognizes the neutral position of priests in responding to the spiritual needs of the people, whether allies or enemies in war.

text: Subong man sang mga doktor sa ila misyon “to save lives” sang kon sin-o man, kag sang mga abogado sa pagpatuman sang kinamatarong sang suspetsado nga mahatagan sing “day in court” bisan kaaway pa ini.
english: Likewise, doctors in their mission “to save lives” of anyone, and lawyers in enforcing the right of the suspect to be given a “day in court” even if he is an enemy.

text: Bisan gani ang Simbahan Catolica may ginahatag nga “devil’s advocate” agud baison ang pagka-santo sang isa ka kandidato sa sainthood.
english: Even the Catholic Church provides a “devil’s advocate” to challenge the sainthood of a candidate for sainthood.

text: Gani ginakabalak-an gid naton ang suspetso nga kahimuan sang pila ka pulis kag mga vigilante ining mga pamahog kag pagpatay sa mga abogado.
english: We are therefore deeply concerned about the suspicious behavior of some police and vigilantes in these threats and killings of lawyers.

text: Labi na gid  ang nagapangapin sang mga kaso sa ilegal nga droga, sang mga kaso sang mga rebelde kag sa pag-violar sang human rights.
english: Especially those who defend illegal drug cases, rebel cases and human rights violations.

text: Sang sini lang, ginhandom nga patyon si Atty. Guillen nga masami ginakuha sa pagpangapin sang mga kaso sa human rights violations kag sang mga rebelde batok sa gobyerno.
english: Recently, an attempt was made to kill Atty. Guillen who is often hired to defend cases of human rights violations and those of rebels against the government.

text: Madumduman ta man ang pagpatay sadtong nagligad nga tuig kay Atty. Romero nga masami kuhaon sang mga suspetsado sa ila mga kaso sa ilegal nga droga.
english: We also remember the murder last year of Atty. Romero said suspects often take him in their illegal drug cases.

text: In fact, madamo pa ang kasubong nga mga kaso sang pagpamahog kag pagpatay sa mga abogado nga natabo sa panahon sining karon nga administrasyon.
english: In fact, there are many other similar cases of intimidation and killing of lawyers that have occurred during the current administration.

text: Ano na lang abe kon wala na sing mangisug nga abogado sa pagtindug sa kasubong nga kaso, sa diin, sa matuod, ang akusado inosente gali sa akusasyon?
english: What if no lawyer dares to stand up in such a case, where, in fact, the accused is innocent of the charges?

text: Ano na lang ang ila kinamatarong sa idalom sang Universal Human Rights nga ginatindugan sang United Nations kon diin myembro ang Filipinas?
english: What are their rights under the Universal Human Rights of the United Nations of which the Philippines is a member?

text: Bale wala na lang?
english: So nothing?

text: Kag patyon na gid lang sila paagi sa extrajudicial killing (EJK)?
english: And just kill them by extrajudicial killing (EJK)?

text: Tutal wala naman sila kinahanglan sing tagpangapin nga abogado kay nahusgaran na sila nga “guilty” sang estado nga nagaakto bilang bogus nga hwes kag berdugo katulad ni James Bond nga “licensed to kill”?
english: After all, they don't need a defense lawyer because they have been judged “guilty” by the state acting as a bogus judge and executioner like James Bond who is “licensed to kill”?

text:
***

Diyos gid lang ang makahatag sing sentensya nga wala na sing binaisay sa husgado.
english:
***

Only God can give a sentence without a dispute in court.

text: Ina tungod wala kita sing pwede malikom sa Diyos nga All-Knowing, nga tal mismo pwede siya makahusgar.
english: That's because we can't hide anything from the All-Knowing God, who can judge.

text: Indi pareho sa tawo nga kinahanglan palutawon pa ang kamatuoran paagi sa pahayag kag pag-presenta sang ebidensya halin sa duha ka bahin, ukon sa isa ka case trial sa atubangan sang hwes.
english: Unlike a person who needs to prove the truth through statements and presentation of evidence from both sides, or in a case trial before a judge.

text: Nga kon indi mapatuman, katulad sa kaso sang EJK, daku nga kasal-anan ini sa ngalan sang Hustisya.
english: That if not implemented, as in the case of EJK, it is a serious crime in the name of Justice.

text: By the way, may isa ka kasal-anan nga indi mapatawad sang Kalangitan diri pa lang sa kalibutan.
english: By the way, there is one sin that Heaven cannot forgive right here on earth.

text: Ano ini?
english: What is this?

text: Ini ang “Sin against the Holy Spirit”, ukon ang kasal-anan sa Diyos Espiritu Santo.
english: This is “Sin against the Holy Spirit”, or the sin against God the Holy Spirit.

text: Sunu sa Bibliya sa Matt.12:31:“Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven people, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven”.
english: According to the Bible in Matt.12:31: “Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven”.

text:
Sunu sa Merriam Webster Dictionary, ang tinaga nga blasphemy means “the act of insulting or showing contempt or lack of reverence for God; the act of claiming the attributes of deity; irreverence toward something considered sacred.”

Sunu ugaling sa isa ka Biblical scholar ining “Sin against the Holy Spirit” may kapatawaran man sa ngalan sang Diyos nga All-forgiving.
english:
According to the Merriam Webster Dictionary, the word blasphemy means “the act of insulting or showing contempt or lack of reverence for God; the act of claiming the attributes of deity; irreverence toward something considered sacred.”

However, according to one Biblical scholar, this “Sin against the Holy Spirit” also has forgiveness in the name of God who is All-forgiving.

text: Wala lang ini kapatawaran kon padayon, ukon persistent, nga ginahimo ini nga kasal-anan sang isa ka tawo nga wala sing pagbag-o nga daw gina-enjoy pa niya himuon pirme.
english: It is only unforgivable if a person continues to, or persistently, commits this sin without changing the way he seems to enjoy doing it all the time.

text: katulad sang pagpamatay sang 6 ka milyon nga Jews sadto sa Germany.
english: such as the murder of 6 million Jews in Germany.

text: In other words, pwede man siya gihapon mapatawad sang iya “Sin against the Hoy Spirit” paagi sa sincero kag lubos nga paghinulsol.
english: In other words, he can still be forgiven of his “Sin against the Hoy Spirit” through sincere and complete repentance.

text: Ugaling lang kay malawig gid seguro ang pagka-“quarantine” niya sa Purgatoryo bag-o makasulod sa Langit.
english: However, he must have been quarantined in Purgatory for a long time before entering Heaven.

text: Isa sa sining “Sin against the Holy Spirit”, sa aton pagpati, amo ang “deliberate” nga pagpatay sang kapareho mo nga tawo nga wala sing “due process” katulad sang nagakatabo sa EJK, nga indi man ma-justify sa self-defense, defense of the defenseless, ukon just war.
english: One of these “Sins against the Holy Spirit”, in our belief, is the “deliberate” killing of your fellow man without “due process” as happens in EJK, which cannot be justified in self-defense, defense of the defenseless, or just war.

text: Gani, kamo nga may handom nga makasulod sa Langit, likawan gid ang mga kasal-anan nga nagatampalas kag nagabulag sa aton sa Diyos, nga nagalakip sang pagkadula sing paglaum sa grasya sang Diyos kag ang pagsikway sang Diyos sa aton pangabuhi.
english: Therefore, you who desire to enter Heaven, avoid the sins that dishonor and separate us from God, which includes losing hope in God's grace and rejecting God in our lives.

text: Indi magsalig nga mapatawad ka man sa imo “Sin against the Holy Spirit” kay sobra-sobra gid seguro ang balayran nga utang sang imo kalag sa Purgatoryo./PN
english: Don't expect to be forgiven for your “Sin against the Holy Spirit” because the debt of your soul in Purgatory is probably too much./PN

text: Nagdeklarar na ang gobyerno sang Sri Lanka sang state of emergency matapos ang lapnagon nga mga pagbaha kag mudslide tuga sang Cyclone Ditwah nga nagpatay na sang masobra 330 ka tawo.
english: The Sri Lankan government has declared a state of emergency after widespread flooding and mudslides caused by Cyclone Ditwah have killed more than 330 people.

text: Ini ang ginakabig nga isa sa pinaka-delikado nga bagyo nga naglaslas sa mga nagliligad nga tuig sa amo nga pungsod.
english: It is considered one of the most dangerous typhoons to hit the country in recent years.

text: Masobra 200 ka mga tawo ang padayon nga missing samtang 200,000 ka mga kabalayan ang nagkalagguba nga na nagpa-displace sa 108,000 ka mga indibidwal padulong sa state-run temporary shelters.
english: More than 200 people remain missing while 200,000 homes were destroyed displacing 108,000 individuals to state-run temporary shelters.

text: Suno sa mga opisyal, yara sa one-third sang pungsod ang wala sang suplay sang kuryente kag tubig.
english: Officials say about one-third of the country is without power and water supplies.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake nga ini n ang pinaka-challenging nga kalamidad nga nag-igo sa maragtason sang ila pungsod kag lala ang halit nga ginbilin sini.
english: Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said it was the most challenging disaster in the history of the country and the damage it left behind was devastating.

text: Nagpatigayon naman sang mga evacuation sa pila ka mga lugar kadungan sang madasig nga pag-lapaw sang tubig halin sa Kelani River.
english: Evacuations were conducted in several areas amid the rapid overflow of water from the Kelani River.

text: base sa isa ka residente halin sa central Sri Lanka, yara sa 15 ka mga kabalayan sa ila lugar ang nalubong sa idaloom sang dalagkuan nga mga bato kag lutak kag wala sa mga residente ang nakaluwas.
english: According to a resident from central Sri Lanka, about 15 houses in their area were buried under large rocks and cracks and none of the residents survived.

text: Pinakadako nga numero sang mga napatay ang na-report sa Kandy kag Badulla, kun sa diin madamo sang mga lugar ang wala pa makadtuan.
english: The highest number of deaths was reported in Kandy and Badulla, where many areas have not yet been visited.

text: Kaangot diri, nag-apelar na ang Sri Lankan government para sa international aid kag gin-engganyo ang mga Sri Lankans nga yara sa abroad nga mag-donate sang kwarta para suportahan ang mga apektado nga komunidad.
english: In this regard, the Sri Lankan government has appealed for international aid and urged Sri Lankans abroad to donate money to support the affected communities.

text: Liwat nga nakuha sang Tultugan Festival sang Maasin ang kampyonato sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan 2025 nga isa sa highlights sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The Tultugan Festival of Maasin once again won the championship in Kasadyahan sa Babanwahanan 2025 which is one of the highlights of the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Napauli sang Maasin ang P1.2 million cash prize lakip na ang BEST IN MUSIC, BEST IN PERFORMANCE, BEST IN CHOREOGRAPHY, kag BEST IN PRODUCTION DESIGN.
english: Maasin took home the P1.2 million cash prize including BEST IN MUSIC, BEST IN PERFORMANCE, BEST IN CHOREOGRAPHY, and BEST IN PRODUCTION DESIGN.

text: Gindeklarar naman nga 1st runner up ang Tribu Jalaud sang Hirinugyaw-Suguidanonay sang Calinog nga may cash prize nga P700,000.
english: Tribu Jalaud was declared the 1st runner up of Hirinugyaw-Suguidanonay of Calinog with a cash prize of P700,000.

text: Nakuha man sang Tribu Jalaud ang BEST IN STREET DANCING, BEST IN DISCIPLINE, kag BEST IN COSTUME.
english: Tribu Jalaud also won BEST IN STREET DANCING, BEST IN DISCIPLINE, and BEST IN COSTUME.

text: Ang Kaing Festival sang Leon ang gindeklarar man nga 2nd runner up sa amo nga paindis-indis kag nagpauli sang cash prize nga P500,000.
english: The Kaing Festival of Leon was also declared 2nd runner up in the competition and took home a cash prize of P500,000.

text: Banwa man sang Leon ang nakabaton sang PEOPLES CHOICE AWARDS sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan 2025.
english: The town of Leon also received the PEOPLES CHOICE AWARDS in Kasadyahan sa Babanwatahan 2025.

text: Kun gugma na gani ang pagahambalan, daw halos wala sang imposible bangud tanan masarangan himuon sang tawo.
english: When it comes to love, it seems that almost nothing is impossible because everything can be done by man.

text: Kaangay sang Vietnamese nga lalaki nga daw maano na gid bangud duha ka tuig niya nga wala makit-an ang iya asawa nga nagatrabaho sa India.
english: Like the Vietnamese man who seems to be in danger because he has not seen his wife who works in India for two years.

text: Ang lalaki amo si Ho Hoang Hung, nagaedad sang 37 anyos.
english: The man is Ho Hoang Hung, aged 37 years.

text: Halin sa Ho Chi Minh City sa Vietnam, nagbyahe si Hung padulong sa Bangkok, Thailand agud kuntani nga makasakay sa eroplano kag makalab-ot sa Mumbai, India.
english: From Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam, Hung traveled to Bangkok, Thailand to hopefully catch a plane and reach Mumbai, India.

text: Sa malain nga palad, bangud wala nakakuha sang visa kag wala nag-ugyon ang panahon, nagpadulong na lang si Ho sa Pattaya, isa man ka syudad sa Thailand.
english: Unfortunately, not getting a visa and the weather not cooperating, Ho headed to Pattaya, also a city in Thailand.

text: Bangud desperado siya sa iya misyon nga makit-an ang iya asawa, nagdesisyon ini nga magsakay sa isa ka gamay nga rafting boat.
english: Desperate for his mission to find his wife, he decided to take a small rafting boat.

text: Ang plano ni Ho amo nga magtabok sa dagat paagi sa pag-paddle, apang nakahibalo ka kun daw ano kalayo ang iya kinahanglan i-paddle agud makalab-ot sa India?
english: Ho’s plan was to paddle across the sea, but do you know how far he had to paddle to reach India?

text: 2,000 kilometros!
english: 2,000 kilometers!

text: Sang ginabanta 80 kilometros na ang kalayuon sang na-paddle ni Ho halin sa mainland sang Thailand, may isa ka fishing boat nga nagtawag sa maritime security agud ma-rescue si Ho bangud nahadlok sila kun ano ang matabo sa iya.
english: When Ho was about 80 kilometers away from the mainland of Thailand, a fishing boat called the maritime security to rescue Ho because they were afraid of what would happen to him.

text: Sang ginpadulungan sang otoridad si Ho, nakit-an ang dala sini nga suitcase, may botelya sang tubig apang wala na halos sang unod, may 10 ka pakete sang noodles — apang ang masadya — wala man lang ini sang mapa, compass, GPS, ukon ekstra nga panapton.
english: When the authorities approached Ho, they found him carrying a suitcase, a bottle of water but almost empty, 10 packets of noodles — but the funny thing was — he didn't even have a map, compass, GPS, or spare clothes.

text: 18 ka gab-i man ang gintinir ni Ho sa tunga sang dagat, apang wala na siya ginpasugtan nga magpadayon sa lawod kag gindala siya liwat sa Thailand.
english: Ho also spent 18 nights in the middle of the sea, but was not allowed to continue at sea and was taken back to Thailand.

text: Kun basehan lang ang iya nga kadasigon, ginabanta 625 ka adlaw pa ini antes nga makalab-ot sa India — apang ina kun wala sang malain nga matabo sa iya, bangud sang amo nga tion, may yara sang bagyo nga gina-forecast sa Bay of Bengal.
english: Based on its speed alone, it is estimated to be 625 days before it reaches India — but that is if nothing bad happens to it, because at that time, there is a typhoon forecast in the Bay of Bengal.

text: Ginbuligan si Ho nga mabutang anay sa isa ka temporaryo nga puluy-an kag gilayon man nga ginpakig-angutan ang Vietnamese embassy kag ang Indian embassy agud nga makita na sini ang iya nga asawa.##
english: Ho was helped to find a temporary home and the Vietnamese embassy and the Indian embassy were immediately contacted so that he could see his wife.

text: Ginmanduan ni President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. ordered

text: ang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga padasigon ang livestock consolidation kag pabaskugon ang biosecurity measures agud dalayon nga matapna ang African swine fever (ASF).
english: the Department of Agriculture (DA) to accelerate livestock consolidation and strengthen biosecurity measures to continuously prevent African swine fever (ASF).

text: Suno sa presidente, importante ang biosecurity magluwas pa gid sa ginahimo subong nga pagpangbakuna batok sa ASF.
english: According to the president, biosecurity is important in addition to the ongoing vaccination against ASF.

text: Ginsiling naman ni DA Undersecretary Designate for Livestock Constante Palabrica nga naga-implementar na ang ahensya sang biosecurity kag ginpahibalo na ang mga manguguma kun paano ini himuon.
english: DA Undersecretary Designate for Livestock Constante Palabrica said the agency is already implementing biosecurity and farmers have been informed on how to do so.

text: Ginsiguro man sa presidente nga 80% sang mga baboy ang protektado gid kun makabaton na sang bakuna.
english: The president also assured that 80% of the pigs will be fully protected once they receive the vaccine.

text: Base sa timeline sang DA, ginalauman nga makakuha na sang approval para sa commercial vaccination batok sa ASF sa Abril.
english: Based on the DA's timeline, it is expected to get approval for commercial vaccination against ASF in April.

text: Ini nga commercial vaccination ang nagatuyo nga mapadasig ang pagbangon sang local hog industry sa epekto sang ASF ilabi na ang nag-igu sa third kag last quarter sang 2024.
english: This commercial vaccination aims to accelerate the recovery of the local hog industry from the impact of ASF especially those that hit in the third and last quarter of 2024.

text: Nahibaluan nga at least 490,000 doses sang ASF AVAC live vaccines ang gina-target nga matublok sa idalom sang government-controlled vaccination.
english: At least 490,000 doses of ASF AVAC live vaccines are targeted to be administered under government-controlled vaccination.

text: Maga-umpisa buwas, Marso 2, ang Holy Month of Ramadan sa Pilipinas.
english: The Holy Month of Ramadan in the Philippines will begin tomorrow, March 2.

text: Ginhimo ni Bangsamoro Grand Mufti kag Executive Director of the Bangsamoro Darul-Ifta’ Sheikh Abdulrauf Guialani ang anunsyo kagab-i matapos nga nagpatigayon sang moon sighting sa pungsod.
english: Bangsamoro Grand Mufti and Executive Director of the Bangsamoro Darul-Ifta’ Sheikh Abdulrauf Guialani made the announcement last night after conducting moon sighting in the country.

text: Wala nakit-an ang crescent moon suno sa iya, gani nga opisyal nga maga-umpisa sang Ramadan Fasting 2025 buwas.
english: The crescent moon was not seen, he said, so Ramadan Fasting 2025 will officially begin tomorrow.

text: “By the authority vested in me as the Bangsamoro Mufti, I, Abdulrauf A. Guialani, hereby announce that the crescent moon was not sighted today.
english: “By the authority vested in me as the Bangsamoro Mufti, I, Abdulrauf A. Guialani, hereby announce that the crescent moon was not sighted today.

text: Therefore, Ramadan fasting 2025 will officially commence on Sunday, March 2, 2025, In Shaa Allah,” suno sa Grand Mufti.
english: Therefore, Ramadan fasting 2025 will officially commence on Sunday, March 2, 2025, In Shaa Allah,” according to the Grand Mufti.

text:
“Happy Ramadhan 1446, and may Allah shower His blessings and mercy upon all of us.”

Base sa tradisyon sang Islam, kun indi kit-anon ang bulan, dapat nga makumpleto ang current lunar month sa sulod sang 30 ka adlaw.
english:
“Happy Ramadhan 1446, and may Allah shower His blessings and mercy upon all of us.”

According to Islamic tradition, if the moon is not visible, the current lunar month must be completed within 30 days.

text: Nagalain-lain man ang pag-umpisa sang Ramadan sa nanuhay-tuhay nga mga pungsod depende sa lunar sighting.
english: The start of Ramadan also varies in different countries depending on lunar sighting.

text: Ang moon sighting nga kilala man nga hilal sighting amo ang nagatumod sa pagsugod sang bag-o nga lunar month bangud ginasunod sang Islamic calendar ang cycle sang bulan.
english: Moon sighting also known as hilal sighting marks the beginning of a new lunar month as the Islamic calendar follows the cycle of the moon.

text: Ang Ramadan amo ang ika-siyam nga bulan sa kalendaryo sang Islam kag isa sa pinaka-balaan nga tinion para sa mga Muslim.
english: Ramadan is the ninth month in the Islamic calendar and one of the holiest times for Muslims.

text: Tion ini sa pag-puasa kag pagpangamuyo, gani ginalikawan sang mga Muslim ang pagkaon kag pag-inom halin sa pagbutlak sang adlaw tubtub sa pagtunod sini.
english: It is a time for fasting and prayer, so Muslims abstain from eating and drinking from sunrise to sunset.

text: May exemptions man ini kaangay sang may sakit sa lawas kag panghuna, mga nagabusong kag nagapasuso, kag mga tigulang nga nagakinahanglan sang pagkaon para sa kusog.
english: It also has exemptions such as the physically and mentally ill, pregnant and breastfeeding women, and the elderly who need food for strength.

text: Sa sini nga mga tion, wala man nagapanigarilyo kag nagapakighilawas ang mga Muslim.
english: During these times, Muslims also abstain from smoking and having sex.

text: Eid al-Fitr naman ang tawag kun magtakop ang Ramadan kag ginaselebrar sa una nga tatlo ka adlaw sang Shawwal nga amo ang pang-10 nga bulan sa Islamic calendar.
english: Eid al-Fitr is the end of Ramadan and is celebrated on the first three days of Shawwal, the 10th month of the Islamic calendar.

text: Patigayunon na 1:00 karon sa hapon ang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan nga isa sa ginabantayan nga highlights sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The Kasadyahan sa Babanwahana, one of the highlights of the Dinagyang Festival 2025, will be held at 1:00 pm today.

text:
Pasakupan ini sang masunod nga mga tribu:

Banaag Festival sang AnilaoKaing Festival sang LeonTawili Festival sang San RafaelHirinugyaw Suguidadonay Festival sang CalinogTinuom Festival sang CabatuanCry of Jelicuon Festival sang New LucenaTangyan Festival sang IgbarasHaw-as Festival sang Dumangaskag Tultugan Festival sang Maasin nga amo ang defending champions

Sa sini nga kumpetisyon, may yara man sang walo ka special award categories nga ang kada magadaog makabaton sang 10,000 cash prize.
english:
It will include the following tribes:

Banaag Festival of AnilaoKaing Festival of LeonTawili Festival of San RafaelHirinugyaw Suguidadonay Festival of CalinogTinuom Festival of CabatuanCry of Jelicuon Festival of New LucenaTangyan Festival of IgbarasHaw-as Festival of Dumangaskag Tultugan Masing is the defending champion of the Festival

In this competition, there will also be eight special award categories with each winner receiving a 10,000 cash prize.

text:
Lakip diri ang:

Best in PerformanceBest in ChoreographyBest in MusicBest in Costume DesignBest in Production DesignBest in DisciplineBest in Street Dancingkag People’s Choice Award

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Gilbert Marin, head sang Provincial Culture, Arts, History, and Tourism Office (PCAHTO), iya ginpahayag nga magluwas diri, may P1.2-million nga nagahulat sa champion, P700,000 para sa first runner up, kag P500,000 para sa second runner-up.
english:
These include:

Best in PerformanceBest in ChoreographyBest in MusicBest in Costume DesignBest in Production DesignBest in DisciplineBest in Street Dancingkag People’s Choice Award

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Gilbert Marin, head of the Provincial Culture, Arts, History, and Tourism Office (PCAHTO), said that besides this, there is P1.2-million waiting for the champion, P700,000 for the first runner up, and P500,000 for the second runner-up.

text: Ang anum nga non-winning groups ang makabaton naman sang tag-P200,000.
english: The six non-winning groups will receive P200,000 each.

text: Ini nga Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan ang gamiton bilang plataporma nga mapabugal ang reputasyon sang Iloilo bilang manggaranon sa kultura, kustombre, tradisyon, pagkaon, nga kun sumahon nagalinya sa tourism slogan sang Iloilo nga: “Fun, Foodie, Friendly Iloilo”.
english: This Town Festival will be used as a platform to boast of Iloilo's reputation as rich in culture, customs, traditions, food, which is in line with Iloilo's tourism slogan: “Fun, Foodie, Friendly Iloilo”.

text: Antes ini nga big day, nakahatag na nga daan ang provincial government sang pondo sa participating municipalities.
english: Before this big day, the provincial government has already provided funds to the participating municipalities.

text: Kada performance ang limitado lamang sa 8-10 minutes kag 29 seconds.
english: Each performance is limited to only 8-10 minutes and 29 seconds.

text: Magapanguna sa distinguished panel si Madam Shirley Halili-Cruz, former chair sang National Commission for Culture and the Arts – Committee on Dance kag artistic director sang Halili-Cruz School of Dance.
english: The distinguished panel will be led by Madam Shirley Halili-Cruz, former chair of the National Commission for Culture and the Arts – Committee on Dance and artistic director of the Halili-Cruz School of Dance.

text: Nag-upod si United States Ambassador MaryKay Carlson sa mga opisyal sang Pilipinas nga nagpatigayon sang tour sa West Philippine Sea samtang sakay sa American maritime patrol aircraft.
english: United States Ambassador MaryKay Carlson joined Philippine officials who conducted a tour of the West Philippine Sea while aboard an American maritime patrol aircraft.

text: Lakip sa mga opisyal nga yara sa tour amo sanday Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, Presidential Assistant on Maritime Concerns Andres Centino kag Philippine Coast Guard Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan.
english: Among the officials on the tour were Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, Presidential Assistant on Maritime Concerns Andres Centino and Philippine Coast Guard Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan.

text: Sa iya post sa X, gingamit ni Carlson ang hashtags nga #FriendsPartnersAllies for a #FreeAndOpenIndoPacific nga masami ginagamit sa mga diskusyon kag statements nga naangot sa relasyon sang Estados Unidos kag Pilipinas amo man sa padayon nga pag-claim sang China pati sa West Philippine Sea.
english: In his post on X, Carlson used the hashtags #FriendsPartnersAllies for a #FreeAndOpenIndoPacific which is often used in discussions and statements related to US-Philippine relations as well as China's continued claims to the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno sa US Embassy, ini nga aerial tour ang kabahin sang regular engagement sa senior Philippine leaders sa isyu nga pareho nga involved ang duha ka pungsod lakip na ang international maritime law.
english: According to the US Embassy, ​​this aerial tour is part of regular engagement with senior Philippine leaders on issues that both countries are involved in including international maritime law.

text: Ang ila ginsakyan nga P-8 Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft isa ka multi-mission maritime patrol aircraft nga kilala sa anti-submarine warfare; anti-surface warfare; intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance kag mangin sa search and rescue.
english: Their P-8 Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft was a multi-mission maritime patrol aircraft known for anti-submarine warfare; anti-surface warfare; intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance and be in search and rescue.

text: Bisan nga ang impeachment kay Vice President Sara Duterte ang pinakamainit nga isyu subong sa Pilipinas, nagguwa sa isa ka Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey nga indi ini isa sa nagapanguna nga konsiderasyon sang mga Pilipino kun sin-o ang ila botohon sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: Although the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte is the hottest issue in the Philippines right now, a Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey found that it is not one of the top considerations of Filipinos for whom to vote for in the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Base sa survey nga gin-komisyon sang Stratbase Group kag ginpatigayon sang nagligad nga Pebrero 15-19, 53% lamang sa respondents ang nagsiling nga magaboto sila sa kandidato nga maga-advocate sa patas nga trial kay Duterte sa impeachment court ukon sa Senado.
english: Based on a survey commissioned by the Stratbase Group and conducted last February 15-19, only 53% of respondents said they would vote for a candidate who would advocate a fair trial for Duterte in the impeachment court or in the Senate.

text: Ini ang pinakamanubo sa 15 ka mga isyu nga ginhatag sa survey respondents.
english: This was the lowest of the 15 issues given to the survey respondents.

text: Base sa nasambit nga latest poll, ang nagapanguna kag pinaka-importante nga konsiderasyon para sa mga Pinoy amo ang agriculture, health care, employment kag education.
english: Based on the latest poll, the top and most important considerations for Filipinos are agriculture, health care, employment and education.

text: 90% sa respondents ang nagsiling nga suportahan nila ang mga kandidato nga may kawsa sa pagtib-ong sang agrikultura kag magasiguro sang food security kag amo man ang magapabaskog sang health care system sang pungsod.
english: 90% of respondents said they would support candidates who have a cause to boost agriculture and ensure food security as well as strengthen the country's health care system.

text: Ginasundan ini sang mga kandidato nga may kawsa sa pagpadamo pa sang job opportunities (89 percent), equal access to education (89 percent), workers’ rights and welfare (88 percent), pagtapna sa kapigaduhon kag gutom (83 percent) kag pag-address sa inflation (81 percent).
english: This is followed by candidates with causes of increasing job opportunities (89 percent), equal access to education (89 percent), workers’ rights and welfare (88 percent), preventing poverty and hunger (83 percent) and addressing inflation (81 percent).

text: Ang iban pa nga nagapanguna nga konsiderasyon amo ang climate change (79 percent), national security kag sovereignty sa West Philippine Sea (77 percent), illegal drugs (77 percent) kag energy security kag paggamit sang renewable energy (75 percent).
english: Other top considerations were climate change (79 percent), national security and sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea (77 percent), illegal drugs (77 percent) and energy security and use of renewable energy (75 percent).

text: Sa statement sang Stratbase, ginsiling nga ini nga resulta sang survey ang nagapakita kun ano subong ang mga prayoridad sang mga Pilipino.
english: In a statement, Stratbase said the results of the survey reflect the current priorities of Filipinos.

text: Ini nga latest SWS survey ang may yara sang 1,800 respondents kag may margin of error nga plus/minus 2.31 percent.
english: This latest SWS survey has 1,800 respondents and has a margin of error of plus/minus 2.31 percent.

text: May pinakadamo nga Ukrainian refugees ang pungsod Poland kun ipaanggid sa iban pa nga neighboring countries sang Ukraine.
english: Poland has the largest number of Ukrainian refugees compared to other neighboring countries of Ukraine.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Poland ang pinakauna nga pungsod nga nagbaton sang refugees sang nagsugud ang Russian invasion.
english: Poland was the first country to receive refugees when the Russian invasion began.

text: Kadam-an sa mga refugees ang ginhatagan sang trabaho sang Polish government agud nga indi mabudlay nga ipadayon ang ila pagpangabuhi nga likaw sa kinagamo sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: Most of the refugees were given jobs by the Polish government so that it would not be difficult to continue their lives away from the conflict between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Grace Juntado Guion,– direkta sa Poland, ang polish government ang naga-provide man sang libre nga ilistaran, allowances kag libre nga transportasyon kun ila ipresentar ang ila passports.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Grace Juntado Guion,– directly in Poland, the Polish government also provides free accommodation, allowances and free transportation if they present their passports.

text: Suno kay Guion, kadam-an man sa mga polish ang nagahatag sang ila bulig pinaagi sa donations kag paghatag sang pagkaon.
english: According to Guion, most of the polish also give their help through donations and food.

text: Ang cash allowances naman ang ginahatag sang polish government.
english: Cash allowances are provided by the Polish government.

text: Nagapangayo naman sang dugang nga global support ang Polish government agud nga masuportahan sang pungsod ang accommodation, edukasyon, basic needs, tubig kag sanitation, child protection kag gender-based violence para sa mga nadugang nga populasyon sang Poland.
english: The Polish government is seeking additional global support so that the country can support accommodation, education, basic needs, water and sanitation, child protection and gender-based violence for Poland's growing population.

text: Dugang pa ni Guion, posible nga batunon sa gihapon sang mga polish ang dugang pa nga Ukrainian refugees nga magpangayo sang bulig sa ila.
english: Guion added that it is possible that the Poles will still accept more Ukrainian refugees who seek their help.

text: Nangin madinuagon kag napuno sang kasanag kag kasadya ang ILOmiNATION Philippine Light Festival sang Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The ILOmiNATION Philippine Light Festival of Iloilo Dinagyang Festival 2025 was colorful and full of light and joy.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang nagpakita sang pagtililipon sang mga nagapanguna nga light festivals sang pungsod bilang kabahin sang tuigan nga selebrasyon sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said it showed the gathering of the country's leading light festivals as part of the annual celebration of the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Suno kay Treñas, ang magadaog subong nga tuig ang magabaton sang grand prize nga P500,000.
english: According to Treñas, this year's winner will receive a grand prize of P500,000.

text: Nagpaindis-indis ang mga grupo sang Pandang Gitab, ang opisyal nga kapiestahan sang Oriental Mindoro; Pavvurulun Afi Festival sang Tuguegarao City, Cagayan; Tanglawan Festival sang San Jose del Monte, Bulacan; Hermosa Festival sang Zamboanga City; kag Bailes de Luces Festival sang La Castellana, Negros Occidental.
english: Pandang Gitab teams, the official festival of Oriental Mindoro, competed; Pavvurulun Afi Festival of Tuguegarao City, Cagayan; Tanglawan Festival of San Jose del Monte, Bulacan; Hermosa Festival of Zamboanga City; and Bailes de Luces Festival of La Castellana, Negros Occidental.

text: Ang ILOmination champion sang nagligad nga tuig nga Tribu Sidlangan ang nagpasundayag bilang bisita, kaupod ang Iloilo’s Banaag Festival gikan sa Anilao, ang nagaisahanon nga light festival sang probinsya.
english: Last year’s ILOmination champion Tribu Sidlangan performed as a guest, along with Iloilo’s Banaag Festival from Anilao, the province’s only light festival.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang ika-duha nga tion sang nagsugod ang amo nga kompetisyon sang 2023 pagkatapos sang pandemya, nga nagasimbulo sang kasanag pagkatapos sang kadulom.
