english: It is known that this is the second time that such a competition started in 2023 after the pandemic, symbolizing light after darkness.

text: Nagtukod sang impeachment Secretariat ang Kamara nga magahatag sang technical kag administrative support sa 11-man House prosecution team sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The House of Representatives has established an impeachment Secretariat to provide technical and administrative support to the 11-man House prosecution team in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ini ang base sa Memorandum Order 19-1006 nga ginpagwa ni House Secretary General Reginald Velasco.
english: This is based on Memorandum Order 19-1006 issued by House Secretary General Reginald Velasco.

text: Suno kay Velasco, may importante nga papel ang impeachment Secretariat sa paghatag sang kinahanglanon nga logistical, research kag documentation support sa House prosecution team.
english: Velasco said the impeachment Secretariat plays an important role in providing the necessary logistical, research and documentation support to the House prosecution team.

text: Ang impeachment Secretariat ginabug-usan sang mga tiglawas halin sa Office of the Secretary General, Office of the Sergeant at Arms, Legislative Operations Department, Legal Affairs Department kag iban pa nga may kaangtanan nga yunit sang Kamara.
english: The impeachment Secretariat consists of representatives from the Office of the Secretary General, Office of the Sergeant at Arms, Legislative Operations Department, Legal Affairs Department and other related units of the House.

text: Suno kay Velasco, ang ila papel amo ang paghatag sang plenary support, legal research, records management, stenographic transcription, information technology, security kag administrative coordination.
english: Velasco said their role is to provide plenary support, legal research, records management, stenographic transcription, information technology, security and administrative coordination.

text: Ang mga assigned officers kag employees ang magasunod sa istrikto nga pagsulundan kag ethical guidelines sang Kamara.
english: The assigned officers and employees will follow the strict rules and ethical guidelines of the House.

text: Nagapati naman si Manila 3rd District Rep.
english: Manila 3rd District Rep.

text: Joel Chua, katapo sang 11-man House Prosecution Team, ang pagtukod sang House Secretariat, ang bilang suporta sa ila sa impeachment trial batok kay VP Duterte.
english: Joel Chua, a member of the 11-man House Prosecution Team, the establishment of the House Secretariat, the as support for them in the impeachment trial against VP Duterte.

text: Ginpasalig naman ni Chua nga handa na ang prosecution team sa impeachment proceedings.
english: Chua assured that the prosecution team is ready for the impeachment proceedings.

text: Natalana nga magsapol sa masunod nga mga inadlaw ang 11-man House Prosecution Team upod sa mga katapo ukon staff sang bag-o natukod nga House Secretariat agud ma-iron out ang mga bagay may kaangtanan sa pagsugod sang impeachment trial batok kay VP Sara Duterte.
english: The 11-man House Prosecution Team is scheduled to meet in the coming days with members or staff of the newly formed House Secretariat to iron out matters related to the start of the impeachment trial against VP Sara Duterte.

text: Nalubong na sa tuman ka pigado nga sitwasyon ang mga residente sa pungsod Lebanon.
english: The residents of Lebanon are already buried in a very poor situation.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Maricel Tayo,– direkta sa Lebanon, ang kapigaduhon sa amo nga pungsod ang tuga sang korupsyon kag indi maayo nga pagdumala sang gobyerno.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Maricel Tayo, – directly in Lebanon, the poverty in that country is caused by corruption and poor governance.

text: Gina-antos subong sang mga Lebanese ang tuman kamahal nga presyo sang mga nagapanguna nga balaklon, kakulang sang suplay sang wheat, halos adlaw-adlaw nga brown out, wala sang magamit nga generator fuel para batuan ang lamig, kag ini ang ginpalala pa sang padayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong tuga man sang Russia-Ukraine crisis.
english: Lebanese are currently suffering from high prices of basic commodities, shortages of wheat supplies, almost daily brown outs, no available generator fuel to fight the cold, and this is exacerbated by the continuous rise in fuel prices also caused by the Russia-Ukraine crisis.

text: Apektado man suno sa iya ang mahatag nga serbisyo sang mga ospital kag wala na sang mabakal nga bulong sa mga pharmacy.
english: He said the services provided by hospitals are also affected and there are no medicines available in pharmacies.

text: Suno kay Tayo, madamo naman sa mga tawo sa Lebanon ang nadulaan sang trabaho.
english: According to Tayo, many people in Lebanon have lost their jobs.

text: Maayo man para sa natungdan nga wala ini nadulaan sang trabahao bangud padayon nga naga-operate ang mga salons sa Lebanon.
english: Fortunately for her, she did not lose her job because salons continue to operate in Lebanon.

text: Ginkakas sang Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) ang signage sang pangalan sang isa food kiosk sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) has removed the signage of the name of a food kiosk during the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Ini matapos natukiban nga may mga tinaga nga indi nagakaigo para sa publiko.
english: This was after it was discovered that there were words that were not suitable for the public.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Nestor Canong, head sang Local Economic Enterprise Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang tinaga sa amo nga kiosk ang nagahatag sang malain nga panan-awan sa Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Nestor Canong, head of the Local Economic Enterprise Office, said the wording on the kiosk gives a bad impression of Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Canong, nagahatag ini sang indi manami nga imahe sa syudad bangud ang tinaga ang isa ka pamuyayaw.
english: According to Canong, it gives a bad image to the city because the word is a joke.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sini nga ang tuyo lang kontani sang nagapanag-iya sang kiosk amo ang maka-attract sang madamo nga customer.
english: He also revealed that the only intention of the kiosk owner was to attract more customers.

text: Nahibaluan nga gilayon nagmandu si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sa talatapan nga islan ang pangalan sang kiosk bangud kon indi, ipasirado ini sang alkalde.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas immediately ordered the office to change the name of the kiosk because otherwise, the mayor will close it.

text: Ginsabat sang Palasyo ang Malacañang ang latest statement ni Vice President Sara Duterte sang ginpahayag sini nga may kinamatarong ang mga Pilipino nga magpangakig sa gobyerno.
english: The Palace responded to Malacañang's latest statement by Vice President Sara Duterte when she said Filipinos have the right to be angry with the government.

text: ”Unang-una nakakalungkot po na mula sa pangalawang pinakamataas na lider ng bansa ay mukha pang nag-eencourage siya sa mga tao na magalit sa gobyerno,” suno kay Presidential Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro.
english: "First of all, it is sad that the second highest leader of the country seems to be encouraging people to be angry with the government," said Presidential Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro.

text: “Noong nalaman po ito ng Pangulo ay wala po siyang naging reaksyon dito dahil hindi nga po ito dapat nanggagaling sa pangalawang pinakamataas na lider ng bansa,” dugang sini.
english: “When the President learned of this, he did not react to it because it should not be coming from the second highest leader of the country,” he added.

text: Diri na kag ginkwestyon ni Castro si Sara kun amo man bala sini ang panindugan niya sang ang nagapamuno sa pungsod amo ang iya amay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Castro questioned Sara whether she had the same position when her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, was in charge of the country.

text: Ginbalikan ni Castro ang “award” ni Duterte bilang “Most Corrupt” sang 2017 nga nagatumod sang designation sang anay punong ehekutibo sa Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP).
english: Castro recalled Duterte's “award” as “Most Corrupt” in 2017 referring to the designation of the former chief executive to the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP).

text: Ang OCCRP amo ang naga-identify sa mga indibidwal nga may daku nga kontribusyon sa organized crime and corruption sa kalibutan.
english: OCCRP identifies individuals who have made significant contributions to organized crime and corruption in the world.

text: Na-highlight diri ang ginaalegar nga involvement ni Duterte sa extrajudicial killings, human rights violations, kag sa suppression sa rule of law.
english: It highlights Duterte's alleged involvement in extrajudicial killings, human rights violations, and the suppression of the rule of law.

text: Suno pa kay Castro, sang 2016, runner up pa lang si Duterte, apang nakuha gid ang “most corrupt award” pagkasunod nga tuig.
english: According to Castro, in 2016, Duterte was only runner up, but won the “most corrupt award” the following year.

text: Ginbalikan ni Castro ini nga hitabo kag ginkwestyon si Sara kun nagpanindugan man ini sang amo nga tion nga may kinamatarong ang mga tawo nga magpangakig.
english: Castro looked back on this incident and questioned Sara if she had insisted at the time that people had the right to be angry.

text: “Bakit naman ngayon lang?
english: “Why only now?

text: Mas marami rin naman pong nangyari sa panahon ng kaniyang ama,” dugang niya.
english: Mas marami rin naman pong nangyari sa panahon ng kaniyang ama,” dugang niya.

text: “Noong 2016 ay runner-up lang si Pangulo bilang most corrupt, siya ay kinilala ng Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project.
english: “Noong 2016 ay runner-up lang si Pangulo bilang most corrupt, siya ay kinilala ng Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project.

text:
Pero noong 2017 ay nag-level up si dating Pangulong Duterte at siya na po yung naging awardee at kinilala ng People of the Year being the most corrupt.”

“At inamin din naman po niya, sa statement ni Pangulong Duterte, na siya ay corrupt at siya ay nagnakaw pero naubos na nga lang.
english:
But in 2017, former President Duterte leveled up and he became the awardee and recognized by People of the Year being the most corrupt.”

“And he also admitted, in President Duterte's statement, that he was corrupt and he stole but he ran out.

text: Natatandaan n’yo po ba yun?
english: Do you remember that?

text:
Because mayroon pa po ako dito na statement niya.”

“Yun ba ay hindi niya (VP Sara) man lang nasabi na dapat na merong karapatan ang taong magalit?”

Nagpanugyan man ang Palasyo kay Sara nga dapat hayluhon sini ang publiko nga magbulig sa gobyerno sa baylo nga engganyuhon ang kaakig paagi sa iya nga mga statement.
english:
Because I still have his statement here.”

"Didn't he (VP Sara) say that people should have the right to be angry?"

The Palace also advised Sara that she should persuade the public to help the government instead of inciting anger through her statements.

text: “Mas maganda po sana kung siya ay mag-eencourage sa mga tao na makipagtulungan lang instead of having this feeling of hatred against the government,” dugang sang undersecretary.#
english: “It would be better if he encouraged people to cooperate instead of having this feeling of hatred against the government,” the undersecretary added.

text: Pabaskugon pa sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) ang ila depensa batok sa pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) will strengthen its defenses against Russia's aggression in Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Ramil Isogon,– direkta sa United Kingdom, magapadala ang UK sang dugang nga 6,000 ka missiles nga igatugyan sa Ukrainian forces bilang dugang sa 4,000 NLAWs kag Javeline nga nauna na napadala nga bulig sa Ukraine.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Ramil Isogon,– directly to the United Kingdom, the UK will send an additional 6,000 missiles to be handed over to Ukrainian forces in addition to the 4,000 NLAWs and Javeline already sent to Ukraine.

text: Nagpa-in man sang dugang nga £25 million ukon masobra sa P1 billion bilang financial support sa Ukrainian military.
english: It also allocated an additional £25 million or more than P1 billion as financial support to the Ukrainian military.

text: Nauna na nga naghatag ang UK sang £400 million ukon masobara sa P27 billion nga financial support sa Ukraine.
english: The UK has already provided £400 million or more than P27 billion in financial support to Ukraine.

text: Samtang, ginkabig naman sang NATO nga isa ka dako nga sala ang lihok ni Russian President Vladimir Putin nga pagsakop sa Ukraine.
english: Meanwhile, NATO considered Russian President Vladimir Putin's move to invade Ukraine a serious mistake.

text: Sa subong, apektado na ang ekonomiya sang Russia kag nagnubo man ang value sang Russian Rubles.
english: Currently, the Russian economy is already affected and the value of the Russian Ruble has also fallen.

text: Suno kay Isogon, ginalantaw man nga magkulang sa military equipments ang Russia bangud indi na sini sarang nga mag-import sang mga armas halin sa iban nga pungsod.
english: According to Isogon, Russia is also expected to run out of military equipments because it can no longer afford to import weapons from other countries.

text: Dugang pa niya, base sa press briefing ni UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson, ginpahayag sini nga ginahandaan na sang NATO ang ila depensa ukon mangin akto sa posible pagbuya sang mass destruction– chemical, biological ukon nuclear weapon sang Russia.
english: He added that based on a press briefing by UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson, he said that NATO is already preparing its defense or will act in the possible destruction of mass destruction - chemical, biological or nuclear weapons of Russia.

text: Gin-ako sang 33-anyos nga Filipina singer nga si Klarisse de Guzman nga myembro siya sang LGBT+ community.
english: 33-year-old Filipina singer Klarisse de Guzman has admitted that she is a member of the LGBT+ community.

text:
Sa latest episode sang “Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab Edition”, magluwas sa pagbuyagyag sang iya matuod nga sexual orientation, gin-share man sang singer nga apat ka tuig na ang iya same-sex relationship sa partner sini nga si “Trina.”

Gina-identify ni Klarisse ang iya kaugalingon bilang bisexual.
english:
In the latest episode of “Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab Edition”, besides revealing his true sexual orientation, the singer also shared that he has been in a same-sex relationship with his partner “Trina” for four years.

Klarisse identifies herself as bisexual.

text: Dugang sini, ang iya girlfriend amo ang nagatatap sa iya nga iloy.
english: He added that his girlfriend is taking care of his mother.

text: “I’m am bi.
english: “I’m am bi.

text: ‘Yung kinukwento ko sa inyo na may four years akong partner.
english: I'm telling you that I have a partner for four years.

text: Yes, I have a partner of four years (and) her name is Trina.
english: Yes, I have a partner of four years (and) her name is Trina.

text: Hindi ko in-expect na masasabi ko ito ngayon,” suno kay de Guzman.
english: I didn't expect to say that now,” de Guzman said.

text: “Ang lakas ng loob ko para sabihin and hindi alam ng parents ko, bago mawala Papa ko, alam ng Mama ko, and kasama ngayon ng Mama ko is her,” dugang sini.
english: "I had the courage to tell and my parents didn't know, before my dad died, my mom knew, and now my mom is with her," he added.

text: Gin-share man sang singer nga ginabaton sang iya pamilya kun ano man ang iya sexual orientation.
english: The singer also shared that her family accepts her sexual orientation.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga kumportable man siya nga na-share ini kaupod sa iban nga yara sa reality show ilabi na bangud ang nag-facilitate sang confession amo ang beauty-queen kag model-actress nga si Michelle Dee nga una naman nag-ako nga isa siya ka bisexual.
english: She said she was comfortable sharing it with others on the reality show especially since the confession was facilitated by beauty-queen and model-actress Michelle Dee who previously admitted that she is bisexual.

text: “I guess komportable ako sabihin sa inyong lahat with Michelle Dee pa.
english: “I guess I’m comfortable telling you all with Michelle Dee yet.

text: Hindi ko mahintay na ma-meet n’yo siya and I miss her.
english: I can't wait to meet her and I miss her.

text: Sobrang suwerte ko lang talaga kasi tanggap ako ng parents ko,” suno sa iya.
english: I'm just really lucky because my parents accept me,” she said.

text: “Hindi ako nahirapan sa phase na ‘yun.
english: “I didn't have a hard time in that phase.

text:
Even some of my relatives alam pero hindi ko pa nga nasasabi sa work ko, so I am proud, love wins.”

Nahibaluan nga antes kay Klarisse, madamo na nga queer stories ang nagsugod sa sini nga television reality competition; umpisa kay BB Gandanghari nga subong isa ka transwoman.
english:
Even some of my relatives know but I haven't said it in my work, so I'm proud, love wins.”

It is known that before Klarisse, many queer stories have started in this television reality competition; starting with BB Gandanghari who is now a transwoman.

text: Yara man si Fifth Solomon sa “All In” edition kag ang trans woman nga si Raf Juane sa “Kumunity Season 10.” Na-feature man diri ang gay couple nga sanday Dingdong Bahan kag Patrick Ramirez bilang duo sang nagligad nga last season.
english: There’s also Fifth Solomon in the “All In” edition and trans woman Raf Juane in “Kumunity Season 10.” It also featured gay couple Dingdong Bahan and Patrick Ramirez as a duo from last season.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nay, nay nagadigamo ka bala subong?
english: ILOILO CITY- Nay, nay are you making trouble now?

text: Basi magatanok ikaw sang mais.
english: Maybe you'll plant corn.

text: Nagsulod man ayhan sa pinsar mo kon may pulos man bala ang buhok sang mais?
english: Have you ever wondered if corn hair is useful?

text: Siling sang Chinese physician nga si Lan Mao, ang corn silk naga- contain sang mga plant compounds nga mahimo mangin responsable para sa pila ka health effects.
english: According to Chinese physician Lan Mao, corn silk contains plant compounds that may be responsible for some health effects.

text: Sa traditional Chinese kag Native American medicine, ginagamit ini sa pagbulong sang balatian kaangay sang prostate problems, malaria, urinary tract infections (UTIs), kag heart disease .
english: In traditional Chinese and Native American medicine, it is used to treat diseases such as prostate problems, malaria, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and heart disease .

text: Sa mga pagtuon, nakit an man nagabulig ini sa pagpanubo sang blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar, kag inflammation.
english: In studies, it has also been found to help lower blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar, and inflammation.

text: Ang Corn silk natural nga manggaranon sa flavonoid antioxidants.
english: Corn silk is naturally rich in flavonoid antioxidants.

text: Ang Antioxidants amo ang plant compounds nga nagaprotect your cells batok sa free radical damage kag oxidative stress.
english: Antioxidants are plant compounds that protect your cells against free radical damage and oxidative stress.

text: Ang Oxidative stress ang isa sa nagapanguna nga kabangdanan sangchronic conditions kaangay sang diabetes, heart disease, cancer, kag inflammation.
english: Oxidative stress is one of the leading causes of chronic conditions such as diabetes, heart disease, cancer, and inflammation.

text: Ang Corn silk mahimo nga mangin natural alternative sa prescribed diuretics, nga masami nagareduce sang blood pressure.
english: Corn silk can be a natural alternative to prescribed diuretics, which often reduce blood pressure.

text: Gapamangkot kamo kon ano himuon ninyo sa buhok sang mais?
english: Are you wondering what to do with corn hair?

text: Mahimo ini magamit nga fresh apang masami ini ginapamala bag-o kunsumohon bilang tea ukon extract.
english: It can be used fresh but is often dried before being consumed as a tea or extract.

text: Nagpahayag ng suporta ang MORE Power sa mga bagong hakbang ng administrasyong Marcos, lalo na sa renewable energy push ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr., kabilang ang pagpapalawak ng Lifeline Rate coverage at pagpapabilis ng Net Metering program upang tugunan ang lumalaking pangangailangan sa kuryente at epekto ng climate change.
english: MORE Power expressed its support for the new steps of the Marcos administration, especially the renewable energy push of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., including the expansion of Lifeline Rate coverage and acceleration of the Net Metering program to address the growing demand for electricity and the impact of climate change.

text: Sa kanyang ika-apat na State of the Nation Address (SONA), inilahad ni Pangulong Marcos ang layunin na makabitan ng solar home systems ang isang milyong kabahayan bago matapos ang taong 2028.
english: In his fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA), President Marcos laid out the goal of installing solar home systems in one million households by the end of 2028.

text: Kasabay nito, ipinahayag niya na paiigtingin ng Department of Energy (DOE) ang pagpapatupad ng Net Metering program upang mas mapakinabangan ng mga benepisyaryo ang sobrang enerhiya na kanilang nalilikha.
english: At the same time, he said the Department of Energy (DOE) will intensify the implementation of the Net Metering program so that beneficiaries can better benefit from the surplus energy they generate.

text: Ipinahayag din ng Pangulo na palalawakin ang saklaw ng Lifeline Rate.
english: The President also announced that the scope of the Lifeline Rate will be expanded.

text: Bukod sa mga kasalukuyang miyembro ng 4Ps, isasama na rin sa mga makikinabang ang mga pamilyang may mababang kita at may buwanang konsumo na hindi lalampas sa itinakdang threshold.
english: In addition to current 4Ps members, low-income families with monthly consumption that does not exceed the set threshold will also be included among the beneficiaries.

text: Sa Iloilo City, isa sa mga unang nagpatupad ng Net Metering system ay ang Iloilo City Hall, na may 60-kilowatt system application noong 2024.
english: In Iloilo City, one of the first to implement the Net Metering system is the Iloilo City Hall, which will have a 60-kilowatt system application by 2024.

text: Ayon sa MORE Power, kasalukuyan itong may 491 net metering consumers at 34 aplikasyon pa ang nasa proseso.
english: According to MORE Power, it currently has 491 net metering consumers and 34 applications are still in the process.

text: Noong Hunyo 2025 lamang, umabot sa 237,780 kWh ang enerhiyang nalikha sa ilalim ng Net Metering program.
english: By June 2025 alone, 237,780 kWh of energy will be generated under the Net Metering program.

text: Nagpahayag si MORE Power President at CEO Roel Castro ng buong suporta sa direksyong itinatakda ng Pangulo para sa energy sector.
english: MORE Power President and CEO Roel Castro expressed his full support for the direction set by the President for the energy sector.

text: Aniya, tumutugma ang adbokasiya ng kumpanya sa mga layunin ng administrasyon, partikular sa pagbibigay ng abot-kayang kuryente at pagsuporta sa marginalized sector.
english: He said the company's advocacy is in line with the administration's goals, particularly in providing affordable electricity and supporting the marginalized sector.

text: Ibinahagi rin ng kumpanya na mayroon itong 5,610 kasalukuyang lifeline beneficiaries at inaasahang tataas pa ang bilang sa pagpapalawak ng coverage.
english: The company also shared that it has 5,610 current lifeline beneficiaries and the number is expected to increase with the expansion of coverage.

text: Ayon kay Castro, ang implementasyon ng Net Metering at Lifeline Rate ay isang kongkretong hakbang upang matamo ang makatarungan at sustenableng access sa enerhiya, at hinihikayat nito ang aktibong partisipasyon ng mga konsyumer.
english: According to Castro, the implementation of Net Metering and Lifeline Rate is a concrete step to ensure fair and sustainable access to energy, and it encourages the active participation of consumers.

text: Dagdag pa niya, patuloy ang MORE Power sa pamumuhunan sa makabago at advanced na teknolohiya upang mapabuti ang serbisyo, palakasin ang efficiency, at masigurong maaasahan ang power distribution sa mga komunidad.
english: He added that MORE Power continues to invest in innovative and advanced technologies to improve service, increase efficiency, and ensure reliable power distribution in the communities.

text: GINADALA naton sa sini nga kolum ang isa ka panugyan sang isa ka London-based nurse kon paano malikawan ang peligro sa “serious allergic reaction” sa pagpabakuna batok sa COVID-19.
english: WE carry in this column a London-based nurse’s advice on how to avoid the risk of a “serious allergic reaction” to getting vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Ini nga panugyan iya sang isa ka Filipino nurse nga naga-ubra sa London, United Kingdom nga nakatapos na sang duha ka dose sang Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine.
english: This advice comes from a Filipino nurse working in London, United Kingdom who has completed two doses of the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine.

text: Ining London-based nurse amo si Raymond Padilla, nga sadto isa ka reporter sang Panay News nga nagpa-abenturar sang ulihi sa pagtrabaho sa London.
english: This London-based nurse was Raymond Padilla, formerly a Panay News reporter who later ventured to work in London.

text: Una siya nag-ubra diri sa isa ka publishing company nga naggamit sang iya ihibalo sa reporting kag copywriting tubtub nga nagdesidir siya sa pagtuon kag magtapos sang pagka-nurse dira mismo sa London.
english: She first worked for a publishing company that used her knowledge of reporting and copywriting until she decided to study and complete her nursing degree in London.

text: Sa karon nagapuyo si Nurse Padilla upod sang iya Filipina nga asawa kag dalagita nga anak sa London kon diin nagatrabaho siya sa isa ka ospital diri.
english: Nurse Padilla currently lives with his Filipina wife and young daughter in London where he works at a hospital here.

text:
***

“Safe!” ang matigda niya nga sabat paagi sa messenger sa aton pamangkot sa iya sadtong Marso 4, 2021 parti sa kon ano man ang iya experyensya sa pagpabakuna.
english:
***

“Safe!” he replied over messenger to our question on March 4, 2021 about his experience with vaccination.

text: Kon may problema man, dugang niya, amo man lang ang pagpanakit sang butkon niya sa bahin nga gin-iniksyunan nga nadula man pagkatapos sang duha ka adlaw.
english: If there is a problem, he added, it is the same pain in his arm in the part that was injected that also disappeared after two days.

text: “And that’s it,” ang pamat-ud gani niya.
english: “And that’s it,” he concluded.

text:
Ari ang lubos nga pahayag ni Nurse Raymond sa iya sabat (unedited) sa aton pamangkot sa iya via messenger sadtong Marso 4, 2021:

“Safe.
english:
Here is Nurse Raymond's full statement in her answer (unedited) to our question to her via messenger on March 4, 2021:

“Safe.

text: Had a sore upper arm for like two days but that’s it.
english: Had a sore upper arm for like two days but that’s it.

text: Some have headache, others down with flu-like symptoms but these symptoms were all gone after two days.
english: Some have headache, others down with flu-like symptoms but these symptoms were all gone after two days.

text: But then I had Pfizer and most of my friends.
english: But then I had Pfizer and most of my friends.

text: Astra Zeneca is also good, also the same symptoms, efficacy though was not as good as Pfizer.
english: Astra Zeneca is also good, also the same symptoms, efficacy though was not as good as Pfizer.

text: Sinovac?
english: Sinovac?

text: I can’t say anything about it as it has not reached the UK yet.
english: I can’t say anything about it as it has not reached the UK yet.

text:
Go for Astra Zeneca.”

***

Sunu kay Nurse Raymond, ang tanan nga vaccine may mga adverse effects nga ma-experyensyahan ang nabakunahan.
english:
Go for Astra Zeneca.”

***

According to Nurse Raymond, all vaccines have adverse effects that can be experienced by the vaccinated.

text: Ang ining mga adverse effects nagakatabo gid man.
english: These adverse effects do occur.

text: Nagapahibalo ini sa lawas sang nabakunahan nga nagasugod na sa pagtrabaho ang vaccine agud bugtawon ang immune system sa paghimo sang mga antibodies agud awayon ang nakasulod nga COVID-19 virus.
english: This signals to the body of the vaccinated person that the vaccine is starting to work to awaken the immune system to produce antibodies to fight the invading COVID-19 virus.

text: Ang iban nga adverse effects, katulad sang hilanat kag palanakit sa bahin sang butkon nga na-indyeksyunan, normal lang ini nga indi dapat hadlukan, siling ni Nurse Padilla.
english: Other adverse effects, such as fever and pain in the injected arm, are normal and should not be feared, Nurse Padilla said.

text: Ang iban ugaling pwede magdala sing peligro sa nabakunahan, katulad sang “serious allergic reaction” sa pila ka ingrediente sang bakuna.
english: Others, however, can pose a risk to the vaccinated, such as a serious allergic reaction to some vaccine ingredients.

text: Angot diri, ginapanugyan niya sa mga may pangduha-duha sa ila ikaayong lawas kon magpabakuna nga makigkita gid sa clinician ukon doktor agud maseguro kon bala pwede sila magpabakuna ukon indi.
english: In this regard, he advised those who have doubts about their health to get vaccinated to consult a clinician or doctor to make sure whether they can get vaccinated or not.

text:
***

Nagsugod ang pangbakuna sa Unitd Kingdom sadtong Disyembre 3, 2020 kon san-o natagaan na sing emergency authorization (Emergency Use Authorization) ang Pfizer/bioNTech.
english:
***

Vaccination in the United Kingdom began on December 3, 2020 when Pfizer/bioNTech was granted emergency use authorization.

text: Ang Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine natagaan sang EUA sadtong Disyembre 30, 2020, samtang ang Moderna natagaan sing otorisasyon sadtong Enero 8, 2021 nga nagsugod man dayon sa pag-administer sang ila vaccine diri sa United Kingdom.
english: The Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine was granted an EUA on December 30, 2020, while Moderna was granted authorization on January 8, 2021, which immediately began administering its vaccine here in the United Kingdom.

text: As of February 28, 2021, mga 20,089,551 na ang naka-first dose kag 796,000 ang naka-second dose sang either Oxford – AstraZeneca or sang Pfizer – BioNTech vaccine sa kabug-usan sang UK.
english: As of February 28, 2021, approximately 20,089,551 have received the first dose and 796,000 have received the second dose of either the Oxford – AstraZeneca or the Pfizer – BioNTech vaccine across the UK.

text: Gina-expect sang gobyerno nga mabakunahan ang mga 32 ka milyon ka mga pumuluyo sa UK sa pag-abot sang Abril 15, 2021.
english: The government expects to have vaccinated around 32 million UK citizens by April 15, 2021.

text: Ang United Kingdom may populasyon nga 68,131,084, sunu sa latest United Nations data sadtong Marso 10, 2021.
english: The United Kingdom has a population of 68,131,084, according to the latest United Nations data as of March 10, 2021.

text: Ginaamat-amat naman gani seguro nga ginahikot na sa UK ang blood testing (serology) agud ma-confirm kon ano ka damu ang aktwal nga na-immunize sa mga nabakunahan kag kon tubtub ano kalawig ang ila immunity nga naangkon halin sa ila pagpabakuna.
english: Blood testing (serology) is probably being done in the UK to confirm how many of the vaccinated have actually been immunized and how long their immunity has been acquired since their vaccination.

text: Tungod wala man sing 100 % nga “effectiveness” ang bakuna, indi lang kita matingala nga may na-infect sang COVID-19 bisan tapos nabakunahan na.
english: Since the vaccine does not have 100% effectiveness, we should not be surprised that someone is infected with COVID-19 even after being vaccinated.

text: Sa ulihi nga report sa Israel, ang Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine ginsiling nga may “effectiveness”  nga 46% sa una nga dose, kag 92% sa ikaduha kag final nga dose.
english: In a later report in Israel, the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine was said to have an “effectiveness”  of 46% with the first dose, and 92% with the second and final doses.

text: May 95% efficacy ini sa pagtuon sa laboratoryo./PN
english: It has 95% efficacy in laboratory studies./PN

text: Luyag sang mga otoridad sang Pilipinas nga padasigon ang repatriation sang bangkay ni Maryan Pascual Esteban, isa ka Filipina nga napatay sa sunog sa isa ka high-rise building sa Hong Kong.
english: Philippine authorities want to expedite the repatriation of the body of Maryan Pascual Esteban, a Filipina who died in a fire at a high-rise building in Hong Kong.

text: Suno kay Consul General Romulo Victor Israel, umpisahan na nila ang kinahanglan nga paperwork para mapadasig ang pagpauli sa bangkay sang biktima.
english: Consul General Romulo Victor Israel said they will start the necessary paperwork to expedite the return of the victim's body.

text: Lauman nga magalab-ot sang duha ka semana ang proseso, apang ginasiguro ni Israel nga tinguhaan nila nga padasigon ini.
english: The process is expected to take a couple of weeks, but Israel assures that they will try to speed it up.

text: Nahibaluan nga nabilin ni Esteban ang iya 10 anyos nga anak sa Cainta, kun sa diin personal nga nagbisita ang Department of Migrant Workers sa pamilya.
english: Esteban left his 10-year-old son in Cainta, where the Department of Migrant Workers personally visited the family.

text: Samtang, kadam-an sang mga Pilipino sa nasambit nga lugar nakumpirma na, apang duha ka mga indibidwal sa gihapon ang ginatinguhaan nga pangitaon bangud sa daan nga data sang contact numbers.
english: Meanwhile, most of the Filipinos in the area have been confirmed, but two individuals are still being sought due to old data of contact numbers.

text: Magakitaay liwat sanday Presidente Ferdinand Marcos kag anay Bise Presidente kag subong Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos and former Vice President and current Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo will meet again.

text: Ini bangud natalana nga magbisita sa Naga City si Presidente Marcos para mag-inspeksiyon sang proyekto nga Oplan Kontra Baha sa lugar.
english: This is because President Marcos is scheduled to visit Naga City to inspect the Oplan Kontra Baha project in the area.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Palace Press Officer Usec.
english: Palace Press Officer Usec.

text: Claire Castro ang natalana nga pagkitaay liwat sang duha.
english: Claire Castro the two are scheduled to meet again.

text: Sang ginpamangkot naman si Castro kun posible nga may iban pa nga istoryahan sanday Marcos kag Robredo, nagsiling si Castro nga ini ang dapat bantayan sang publiko.
english: When asked if it is possible that Marcos and Robredo have other things to talk about, Castro said that this is what the public should watch out for.

text: Ginpalupad sang North Korea ang ginapatihan pinakadaku nga intercontinental ballistic missile samtang nagatutok si US President Joe Biden kag ang iban pa nga Western leaders sa problema sa Ukraine.
english: North Korea has launched what is believed to be the largest intercontinental ballistic missile as US President Joe Biden and other Western leaders focus on the problem in Ukraine.

text: Sang amo nga tion, yara ang mga lider sang West sa Belgium para sa isa ka security summit.
english: At the time, there were West leaders in Belgium for a security summit.

text: Ang ginasuspetsahan nga missile ang naglupad sa kataason nga 6,000 kilometros kag sa kalayuon nga 1,080 kilometros kag ang kalawigon sang paglupad sini ang ginabanta yara sa 71 minutos antes nagtupa sa sulod sang exclusive economic zone (EEZ) sang Japan.
english: The suspected missile flew at an altitude of 6,000 kilometers and a distance of 1,080 kilometers and its flight duration is estimated at 71 minutes before landing within the exclusive economic zone (EEZ) of Japan.

text: Sandig sa pahayag sang mga analysts, ini ang longest-range missile nga ginbuy-an sang North Korea kag nalapawan pa sini ang kalayuon sang ginlupad sang ila ginbuy-an nga missile sang Nobyembre 2017.
english: According to analysts, this is the longest-range missile launched by North Korea and has surpassed the distance of the missile launched in November 2017.

text: Nakit-an man sang Japan Defense Ministry base sa kataason sang lupad sini nga bag-o nga klase sang intercontinental ballistic missile ang gingamit kag posible indikasyon nga malapit na lang nga makahimo ang North Korea sang weapons nga maga-target sa Estados Unidos.
english: The Japan Defense Ministry also found based on its altitude that a new type of intercontinental ballistic missile was used and a possible indication that North Korea is about to develop weapons that will target the United States.

text: Dungan naman ang US kag ang mga kaalyado sini nga South Korea kag Japan sa pagkondenar sang ginhimo sang North Korea.
english: The US and its allies South Korea and Japan jointly condemned North Korea's actions.

text: Pabaskugon pa ang security protocols sa Malacañang matapos nadakpan ang duha ka Chinese nationals kag tatlo ka mga kahimbon nga mga Pilipino nga ginaalegar nagapang-espiya malapit sa palasyo.
english: Security protocols in Malacañang will be tightened after two Chinese nationals and three Filipino accomplices were arrested for allegedly spying near the palace.

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary kag Malacañang Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, makaalarma ini nga ginaalegar espionage activities nga nakalab-ot na subong sa compound sang Malacañang.
english: According to Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary and Malacañang Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, it is alarming that alleged espionage activities have now reached the compound of Malacañang.

text: Magluwas sa seguridad sa Palasyo, mas hugton man ang pagbantay kay President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Besides security at the Palace, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. will also be tightened.

text: Base sa anunsyo sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), nadakpan ang lima ka ginasuspetsahan nga espiya sang nagligad nga Pebrero 20.
english: According to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), the five suspected spies were arrested on February 20.

text: Naaresto sila matapos gin-alerto ang awtoridad sang makaduluda nga mga salakyan nga may international mobile subscriber identity (Imsi) catchers malapit sa Malacañang, sa headquarters sang Armed Forces of the Philippines kag Philippine National Police sa Quezon City, kag mangin sa US Embassy sa Manila.
english: They were arrested after authorities were alerted to suspicious vehicles with international mobile subscriber identity (Imsi) catchers near Malacañang, the headquarters of the Armed Forces of the Philippines and Philippine National Police in Quezon City, and even the US Embassy in Manila.

text: Ang IMSI catchers amo ang nagaserbe nga peke nga cell towers sa tunga sang mobile phones kag tower sang original network provider gani nga ma-intercept ang mga mensahe para sa unauthorized surveillance, pagpamati-bati, data theft, kag network disruption.
english: IMSI catchers act as fake cell towers between mobile phones and the tower of the original network provider so that messages can be intercepted for unauthorized surveillance, eavesdropping, data theft, and network disruption.

text: Una nga nadakpan amo ang mga Pinoy nga ginpangkilala nga sanday Omar Khan Joveres, Leo Panti kag Mark Angelo Binza.
english: The first arrested were Filipinos identified as Omar Khan Joveres, Leo Panti and Mark Angelo Binza.

text: Ginbulgar nila ang ginsugo lang sila sang Chinese national nga si Ni Qinhui kag ginswelduhan sang P2,500 tubtub sa P3,000 kada adlaw.
english: They revealed that they were ordered by Chinese national Ni Qinhui and paid P2,500 to P3,000 a day.

text: Suno sa tatlo, ginsugo sila nga i-maneho ang salakyan nga may Imsi catchers malapit sa amo nga government installations sa Metro Manila.
english: According to the three, they were ordered to drive the vehicle with Imsi catchers near the said government installations in Metro Manila.

text: Sa ginpatigayon naman nga follow-up operation, nadakpan si Ni kag ang isa pa ka Chinese national nga si Zheng Wei sa condominium unit sa Malate, Manila.
english: In a follow-up operation, Ni and another Chinese national, Zheng Wei, were arrested at a condominium unit in Malate, Manila.

text: Matandaan nga sang Enero, nadakpan man sang NBI ang lima ka suspected Chinese spies nga naga-monitor man sang aktibidad sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) kag Philippine Navy sa Palawan lakip na ang resupply sang tropa sa West Philippine Sea.
english: In January, the NBI also arrested five suspected Chinese spies who were also monitoring the activities of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and the Philippine Navy in Palawan including the resupply of troops in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Nakabalik na gid man sa Pilipinas nga hilway sa katalagman ang 17 ka Pinoy crew members sang MV Galaxy Leader nga amo ang barko nga gin-hijack sa Red Sea sadtong Nobyembre 2023.
english: The 17 Filipino crew members of the MV Galaxy Leader, the ship that was hijacked in the Red Sea in November 2023, have finally returned safely to the Philippines.

text: Lakip sa ila amo ang isa ka Ilonggo nga si Leonardo Junjun Flores sang Barangay Pagsangaan, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Among them is an Ilonggo named Leonardo Junjun Flores of Barangay Pagsangaan, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Suno sa Department of Migrant Workers, naghugpa ang eroplano sakay ang seafarers sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 1 via Oman Air Flight No.
english: According to the Department of Migrant Workers, the plane carrying the seafarers landed at Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 1 via Oman Air Flight No.

text: 843 sang 9:31 kagab-i, Enero 23.
english: 843 at 9:31 last night, January 23rd.

text: Lakip sa nag-abi-abi sa ila pag-abot amo ang ila pamilya, sanday Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, Foreign Affairs Secretary Enrique Manalo, Transportation Secretary Jaime Bautista, kag iban pa nga government officials.
english: Among those who welcomed them on their arrival were their families, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, Foreign Affairs Secretary Enrique Manalo, Transportation Secretary Jaime Bautista, and other government officials.

text: Suno kay Cacdac, tugutan anay ang crew members nga makatinir kaupod sa ila pamilya sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw, magpaidalom sa tests, kag siguruhon gid nga maayo ang kondisyon sang ila nga lawas.
english: According to Cacdac, crew members will be allowed to stay with their families for a few days, undergo tests, and make sure that their bodies are in good condition.

text: Suno naman sa Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), may ihatag nga financial aid, counseling kag stress debriefing halin sa ahensya para sa tanan nga seafarers.
english: According to the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), financial aid, counseling and stress debriefing will be provided by the agency for all seafarers.

text: Iga-monitor man sila sa ila nga recovery period kag kun handa na nga magbalik sa programa, maka-avail sila sa nagkalain-lain nga programa nga ginatanyag sang ahensya.
english: They will also be monitored during their recovery period and when they are ready to return to the program, they will be able to avail of the various programs offered by the agency.

text: Nahibaluan nga 428 ka adlaw nga gin-hostage ini nga mga Pinoy.
english: The Filipinos were held hostage for 428 days.

text: Lakip sila sa crew members sang Israeli-owned MV Galaxy Leader nga ginbanggaan sang Houthi rebels sa Red Sea kag gindala sa Yemen sadtong Nobyembre 2023 nga isa ka bulan gid lamang matapos nag-ibwal ang giyera sa Gaza.
english: They were among the crew members of the Israeli-owned MV Galaxy Leader that was rammed by Houthi rebels in the Red Sea and taken to Yemen in November 2023, just a month after the war in Gaza broke out.

text: Base sa report sang Al Masirah TV nga ginapanag-iyahan sang Houthis, ang ila paghilway sa mga seafarers ang kasunod sang ila “koordinasyon” nga ginhimo kaangot sa ceasefire sa Gaza war sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas.
english: According to a report by the Houthis-owned Al Masirah TV, their release of the seafarers follows their “coordination” made in connection with the ceasefire in the Gaza war between Israel and Hamas.

text: Available na sa merkado ang imported nga pula nga sibuyas.
english: Imported red onions are now available in the market.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: This was announced by Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: matapos nag-abot na sa Pilipinas ang at least 500 metric tons sang amo nga produkto nga ginbakal halin sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: after at least 500 metric tons of the product purchased from abroad arrived in the Philippines.

text: Kabahin ini sang 4,000 MT sang imported onions nga aprubado sang Department of Agriculture nga ginalakipan sang 3,000 MT nga pula kag 1,000 MT nga puti nga bombay.
english: This is part of the 4,000 MT of imported onions approved by the Department of Agriculture which includes 3,000 MT of red and 1,000 MT of white bombay.

text: Bangud sa pag-abot sini, ginalauman sang ahensya nga maga-us-os sa P80 tubtub sa P100 per kilo ang baligyaanay sang red onions sa mga merkado.
english: Due to its arrival, the agency expects the price of red onions to drop to P80 to P100 per kilo in the markets.

text: “PHP80 to PHP100, masaya tayo diyan, compared doon sa nakikita nating PHP180 to PHP200.
english: “PHP80 to PHP100, we are happy with that, compared to what we see PHP180 to PHP200.

text: So, makita natin na these prices talaga, okay,” suno kay DA spokesperson Assistant Secretary Arnel De Mesa.
english: So, we can see that these prices are really, okay,” said DA spokesperson Assistant Secretary Arnel De Mesa.

text: Matandaan nga may mga grupo nga nagreklamo sa tikang sang DA, apang nagdepensa ang ahensya nga kinahanglanon gid ang importasyon para mapunggan nga magsaka pa ang retail prices.
english: It can be recalled that some groups complained about the DA's move, but the agency defended that imports are essential to prevent retail prices from rising further.

text: Ang ginakahangaw-an naman sang farmers’ groups amo nga magnubo ang farmgate prices sang onions sa tunga sang harvest season.
english: Farmers' groups are concerned that farmgate prices of onions will drop in the middle of the harvest season.

text: Nagpahamtang sang dugang nga mga basurahan ang General Services Office sa palibot sang City Proper Area kadungan sang pagsugod na sang mga aktibidad sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The General Services Office has installed additional garbage bins around the City Proper Area as the Dinagyang Festival 2025 activities begin.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Niel Ravena, head sang General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga ginapaabot na nila ang pagdoble sang volume sang basura ilabi na sa mga judging areas bangud sa paglantaw sang mga tawo sa blocking sang mga tribu kun sa diin may yara man sang mga mobile kiosk nga nagabaligya sang pagkaon nga kalabanan nga source sang basura.
english: Niel Ravena, head of the General Services Office, said they are expecting a doubling of the volume of garbage especially in the judging areas due to the people's view of the blocking of the tribes where there are also mobile kiosks selling food which is the main source of garbage.

text: Suno kay Ravena, mas magadamo pa gin ang volume sang basura bangud sa pagsugod naman sang food festival.
english: According to Ravena, the volume of garbage will increase due to the start of the food festival.

text: Nagpangabay man ini sa mga merchants nga mag-provide sang kaugalingon nga garbage bags agud may yara sang mahabuyan sang basura ang mga tawo.
english: He also urged merchants to provide their own garbage bags so that people have something to throw their garbage.

text: Ginakabalak-an sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) nga suportahan sang China ang nagapadayon nga pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) is concerned that China will support Russia’s ongoing invasion of Ukraine.

text: Pagadiskusyunan naman sang 30 member nations ang mangin role sang Beijing sa nagapadayon nga kinagamo sa duha ka pungsod.
english: The 30 member nations will discuss Beijing's role in the ongoing conflict between the two countries.

text: Suno kay NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg, posible maghatag sang ‘material support’ ang China sa Russia.
english: According to NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg, China is likely to provide 'material support' to Russia.

text: Ila man ginpanawagan sa bahin sang China nga ila kondenahon ang nagapadayon nga Russian invasion.
english: They also called on the Chinese side to condemn the ongoing Russian invasion.

text: Suportado ni Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa ang mga tikang ni Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero kaangot sa impeachment trial para kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa supports the steps of Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero regarding the impeachment trial for Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno sa senador nga kaalyado sang mga Duterte, nakahibalo ang senate president kun ano ang iya ginahimo kag ginatindugan sini kun ano ang iya ginapatihan nga husto.
english: According to the senator, who is an ally of the Dutertes, the senate president knows what he is doing and stands for what he believes is right.

text: “I’m following the lead of our Senate President.
english: “I’m following the lead of our Senate President.

text: I presume alam na alam niya yung ginagawa niya… I’m supporting his effort dahil nga, kung baga, pinanindigan niya yung kanyang pinaniwalaang tama at saka yung sinabi niya pine-preserve niya yung integridada ng Senado,” pahayag ni Bato.
english: I presume he knows what he's doing... I'm supporting his effort because, if anything, he stood up for what he believed was right and then he said he preserved the integrity of the Senate,” Bato said.

text: Subong nga adlaw sang gin-release ni Escudero ang proposed timetable para sa impeachment trial.
english: Today, Escudero released the proposed timetable for the impeachment trial.

text: Ini nga proposed calendar ang naka-attach sa sulat nga napetsahan sang Pebrero 24 nga nagalakip man sang Special Order nga amo ang naga-assign sa nagkalain-lain nga Senate offices bilang administrative support sa impeachment court.
english: The proposed calendar is attached to a letter dated February 24 that also includes a Special Order assigning various Senate offices as administrative support to the impeachment court.

text: Ginpadala ang sulat sa mga senador, kay Duterte, kag kay Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.
english: The letter was sent to senators, Duterte, and Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.

text:
Yari ang ginaproponer nga timetable:

June 2, 2025 – resumption sang session; presentasyon sang prosecutors sang articles of Impeachment; approval sang revised rules of procedure sa impeachment trials (3 pm)June 3, 2025 – pag-convene sang impeachment court kag oath-taking sang incumbent senator-judges (9 am)June 4, 2025 – reception sang pleadingsJune 24 to July 25, 2025 – pre-trialJuly 28, 2025 – inaugural session sang 20th Congress (10 am); joint session sang Congress para sa State of the Nation Address ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english:
Here is the proposed timetable:

June 2, 2025 – resumption of session; presentation by prosecutors of articles of Impeachment; approval of revised rules of procedure in impeachment trials (3 pm)June 3, 2025 – convening of impeachment court and oath-taking of incumbent senator-judges (9 am)June 4, 2025 – reception of pleadingsJune 24 to July 25, 2025, pre-trial – July 25, 2025 2025 – inaugural session of the 20th Congress (10 am); joint session of Congress for the State of the Nation Address by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text:
(4 pm)July 29, 2025 – oath-taking sang newly elected senator-judges sa Senate nga amo ang impeachment court (9 am); plenary session sang Senate (3 pm)July 30, 2025 – pag-umpisa sang trial (9 am to 2 pm)

Pebrero 5 sang gin-impeach sang Kamara ang bise-presidente.
english:
(4 pm)July 29, 2025 – oath-taking of newly elected senator-judges in the Senate which is the impeachment court (9 am); plenary session of the Senate (3 pm)July 30, 2025 – start of trial (9 am to 2 pm)

The House of Representatives impeached the vice-president on February 5.

text: Sang amo man nga adlaw, ginpasa ang Articles of Impeachment sa Senate apang nag-adjourn ang upper chamber nga wala na-istoryahan ang amo nga isyu.
english: On the same day, the Articles of Impeachment were passed in the Senate but the upper chamber adjourned without discussing the issue.

text: May pending man nga petisyon si Sara sa Korte Suprema nga nagahangkat sa validity sang nasambit nga impeachment complaint.
english: Sara also has a pending petition in the Supreme Court challenging the validity of the said impeachment complaint.

text: Ginsuportahan ni Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros ang pahayag ni Senate Minority Leader Aquilino Pimentel III nga dapat indi na maglaminday ang Senado kag aktuhan na gilayon ang impeachment case batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros supported Senate Minority Leader Aquilino Pimentel III's statement that the Senate should not be silent and immediately act on the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Hontiveros, bisan nga may gin-cite si Senate President Francis Escudero nga procedural concerns kaangot sa session break ukon recess sang Senado, wala sang legal impediment ukon nagapugong sa ila nga mag-proceed sa trial ukon diskusyunan na ang articles of impeachment kag magtingob bilang impeachment court.
english: According to Hontiveros, although Senate President Francis Escudero cited procedural concerns regarding the session break or recess of the Senate, there is no legal impediment or prevents them from proceeding with the trial or discussing the articles of impeachment and coming together as an impeachment court.

text: “Walang pumipigil sa amin na i-tackle yung articles of impeachment at mag-constitute bilang impeachment court,” suno sa senadora.
english: “There is nothing stopping us from tackling the articles of impeachment and constituting as an impeachment court,” the senator said.

text: Kun basehan ang statement sang senate president, mahimo nga magsugod ang proceedings sa Hunyo pagkatapos sang legislative break bangud sa Hunyo 2 pa magabalik ang sesyon.
english: Based on the statement of the senate president, the proceedings could begin in June after the legislative break as the session will resume on June 2.

text: Apang suno naman kay Hontiveros, indi na kinahanglan nga maghulat sang apat ka bulan bangud may risgo ini nga i-atrasar man ang hustisya.
english: However, Hontiveros said there is no need to wait four months because there is a risk that justice will be delayed.

text: Gina-abi-abi man ni Hontiveros ang plano nga magpatigayon sang caucus ang mga senador para nga mahambalan ang impeachment trial.
english: Hontiveros also welcomed the plan to hold a caucus of senators to discuss the impeachment trial.

text: “Sana dun sa caucus na yun, mapakinggan ng aming mga kasama ang mga argumento ni Senator Koko (Pimentel) kung bakit di lamang pwede kundi dapat mag-convene na kami bilang impeachment court para i-treat, i-tackle yung articles of impeachment,” dugang sini.
english: “Hopefully in that caucus, our colleagues will hear the arguments of Senator Koko (Pimentel) why we can not only but should convene as an impeachment court to treat, tackle the articles of impeachment,” he added.

text: Nahibaluan nga samtang palapit ang midterm elections, nagatunog ang mga espekulasyon nga naga-alang-alang ang re-electionist senators nga umpisahan ang impeachment trial bangud sa kahadkok sa political repercussions.
english: As the midterm elections approach, speculation is rife that re-electionist senators are hesitant to initiate an impeachment trial for fear of political repercussions.

text: Kun madayon ang impeachment trial sa senado, mahimo ini mag-resulta sa pagkakas sa bise-presidente sa opisina kag sa iya nga perpetual disqualification from office.
english: If the impeachment trial in the Senate proceeds, it could result in the vice president's removal from office and his perpetual disqualification from office.

text: Pebrero 5 sang gin-impeach sang Kamara ang vice president nga amo man ang adlaw nga nagtakop ang session sa Kongreso para sa eleksyon.#
english: The House of Representatives impeached the vice president on February 5, the same day the Congress session ended for the election.

text: Panubuon pa gid sang Department of Agriculture (DA) sa P48 kada kilo ang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) para sa imported rice umpisa sa Sabado, Marso 1.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will further lower the maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) for imported rice to P48 per kilo starting Saturday, March 1.

text: Ini ang una nga bes nga mas manubo ini sa P50 kada kilo.
english: This is the first time it is below P50 per kilo.

text: Apang suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., indi ini pag-iimplementar sa bilog nga Pilipinas kundi sa Metro Manila lamang sa kag pili nga urban centers.
english: However, according to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., it will not be implemented throughout the Philippines but only in Metro Manila and selected urban centers.

text: Ini bangud suno sa tiglikom, nakitaan na sang pagnubo sa presyo sa pila ka mga probinsya kag wala na nagakinahanglan sang MSRP.
english: This is because, according to the secretary, the price has already been reduced in some provinces and no longer requires MSRP.

text: “The maximum suggested retail price for imported rice will be lowered to P49 per kilo starting Saturday, March 1, marking the first time since the MSRP was introduced six weeks ago that it will slip below the P50 mark,” kabahin sang statement sang tiglikom.
english: “The maximum suggested retail price for imported rice will be lowered to P49 per kilo starting Saturday, March 1, marking the first time since the MSRP was introduced six weeks ago that it will slip below the P50 mark,” the secretary said in a statement.

text: “In many provincial areas, we’ve seen prices of imported rice already lower than the MSRP.
english: “In many provincial areas, we’ve seen prices of imported rice already lower than the MSRP.

text: So we will apply it more selectively,” dugang ni Tiu Laurel.
english: So we will apply it more selectively,” Tiu Laurel added.

text: Matandaan nga sa una nga implementasyon, ginhimo nga P58 per kilo ang MSRP sang Enero 20; P55 per kilo umpisa sang Pebrero 5; kag P52 per kilo sang Pebrero 15.
english: In the first implementation, the MSRP was set at P58 per kilo on January 20; P55 per kilo starting February 5; and P52 per kilo on February 15.

text: Magapadayon sa pag-review ang DA sa presyo sa masunod nga mga inadlaw agud nga matumod kun kinahanglan pa gid nga panubuon ang presyo.
english: The DA will continue to review the price in the coming days to determine if the price needs to be further reduced.

text: Gin-abi-abi naman sang agricultural group nga SINAG ang tikang sang DA ilabi na bangud ang target nga makit-an sang grupo nga ideal price amo ang P40-45/kilo.
english: The agricultural group SINAG welcomed the DA's move especially since the group's target price is P40-45/kilo.

text: Magabisita si US President Joe Biden sa Poland agud makigsapol kay President Andrzej Duda kag dikusyunan ang Ukraine-Russia crisis kag ang international response kasunod sang gamo.
english: US President Joe Biden will visit Poland to meet with President Andrzej Duda and discuss the Ukraine-Russia crisis and the international response following the conflict.

text: Sa statement sang White House, magapadulong si Biden sa Poland kun matapos na sini ang pagbisita sa Belgium kun sa diin tabuon niya ang mga lider sang NATO, G7 kag European Union.
english: According to a statement from the White House, Biden will travel to Poland after his visit to Belgium where he will meet with the leaders of NATO, G7 and the European Union.

text: Ginapahayag nga maga sentro ang istoryahanay sa suporta sang US sa Ukraine kag pagpamatok kay Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: The talks will reportedly focus on US support for Ukraine and opposition to Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Sa latest record sang Polish border guard, yara sa duha ka milyon nga refugees ang naghalin sa Ukraine kag nagsulod sa Poland umpisa sang ginpatigayon ang Russian invasion sang Pebrero 24.
english: According to the latest record of the Polish border guard, about two million refugees have left Ukraine and entered Poland since the Russian invasion on February 24.

text: Gin-athag man sang White house nga wala sang plano si Biden nga bisitahon ang Ukraine kadungan man sang iya byahe sa Europa.
english: The White House also clarified that Biden has no plans to visit Ukraine during his trip to Europe.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sini, nagpadulong na sa Kyiv, Ukraine ang mga prime ministers sang Poland, Czech Republic kag Slovenia.
english: Earlier, the prime ministers of Poland, the Czech Republic and Slovenia had already left for Kyiv, Ukraine.

text: Ginsiling ini sang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) apisar sang nauna nga pasalig sang Department of Energy (DOE) nga sandig sa forecast, wala sang yellow ukon red alert sa masunod nga mga binulan.
english: The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) said this despite the earlier assurance of the Department of Energy (DOE) that based on the forecast, there will be no yellow or red alert in the coming months.

text: Suno kay Engineer Vincent Harvey Bernabe, ang operations manager sang NGCP central grid, kun basehan ang natabo sang nagligad nga tuig, madamo sang beses nga may unscheduled kag unannounced shutdowns sa mga planta rason nga may yellow kag red alerts.
english: According to Engineer Vincent Harvey Bernabe, the operations manager of NGCP central grid, based on what happened last year, there were many times there were unscheduled and unannounced shutdowns in the plants causing yellow and red alerts.

text: Base sa una nga statement sang DOE, may masobra sa 4,000 megawatts sang new generation nga maga-boost sang supply antes ang summer season.
english: Based on the DOE's initial statement, there are more than 4,000 megawatts of new generation that will boost supply before the summer season.

text: Suno naman sang power grid operator, wala sang makapakot kun maka-eksperyensya ang mga planta sang emergency shutdowns kaangay sang natabo sang naglinigad nga mga tinuig.
english: According to the power grid operator, no one can predict if the plants will experience emergency shutdowns as happened in previous years.

text: “Meron tayong mga unplanned forced outages, so ineexpect natin na during summer nandyan sya, pero come summer di na sya available,” suno kay Bernabe.
english: “We have unplanned forced outages, so we expect that during summer he will be there, but come summer he will not be available,” Bernabe said.

text: Para naman sa May 2025 national and local elections, nagapreparar naman ang NGCP sang contingency measures para sa ila nga power transmission operations.
english: For the May 2025 national and local elections, NGCP is preparing contingency measures for its power transmission operations.

text: Gintukod ang Energy Task Force Election (ETFE) nga ginapangunahan sang Department of Energy (DOE) nga amo ang nagapatigayon sang regular meetings para maistoryahan ang updates sa energy sector kaangot sa eleksyon.
english: The Energy Task Force Election (ETFE) led by the Department of Energy (DOE) was established to hold regular meetings to discuss updates on the energy sector in connection with the election.

text: Nagpa-ticket na ang driver sang convoy nga ginapahayag nga sakay si Philippine National Police (PNP ) chief General Rommel Marbel matapos nga naglabay sa EDSA Bus way.
english: The driver of the convoy allegedly carrying Philippine National Police (PNP) chief General Rommel Marbel has already booked a ticket after it passed the EDSA Bus way.

text: Ginkumpirma ni PNP spokesperson Brig.
english: PNP spokesperson Brig.

text: General Jean Fajardo nga mga matag-as nga opisyal sang kapulisan ang sakay sang convoy.
english: General Jean Fajardo said senior police officials were on board the convoy.

text: Wala na lamang sini ginmitlang ang pangalan sang mga opisyal.
english: He did not name the officers.

text: Padulong sa Camp Crame ang convoy bangud nga may yara sang closed-door meeting nga patigayunon kun sa diin kinahanglan ang presensiya sang mga opisyal.
english: The convoy is heading to Camp Crame because there is a closed-door meeting to be held where the presence of officials is required.

text: Dugang sini,matapos nga madul-ong ang mga opisyal sang PNP, nagbalik ang driver sang convoy kag sila ang nagpaticket sa Department of Transportation-Special Action and Intelligence Committee for Transportation (DOTr-SAICT).
english: He added that after the PNP officers were taken away, the driver of the convoy returned and they issued a ticket to the Department of Transportation-Special Action and Intelligence Committee for Transportation (DOTr-SAICT).

text: Nagpabilin man ang mga escort nila nga naka-motorsiklo bilang pagpasiguro nga mabalik ang mga drivers sang convoy.
english: Their escorts on motorcycles also remained to ensure that the drivers of the convoy returned.

text: Handa man ang mga ini magpaathag tuhoy sa natabo.
english: They are also ready to explain what happened.

text: Nahibaluan nga hugot nga ginadumili ang paglabay sa EDSA Busway kun sa diin limitado lamang ini sa mga matag-as nga opisyal sang gobyerno kaangay sang Presidente sang Pilipinas,Vice President of the Philippines, Senate President, Speaker of the House of Representatives, kag Chief Justice of the Supreme Court.
english: It is known that the passage of the EDSA Busway is strictly prohibited and is limited to senior government officials such as the President of the Philippines, Vice President of the Philippines, Senate President, Speaker of the House of Representatives, and Chief Justice of the Supreme Court.

text: Napatay ang magkahagugma nga kalaslon na kuntani sang maaksidente ang truck nga ila nga sinasakyan sa San Emilio, Ilocos Sur.
english: A couple who were about to get married were killed when their truck crashed in San Emilio, Ilocos Sur.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Ibrahim Cardenas, 26-anyos, kag Fatima Claire Pis-oy, 25-anyos, pareho nga residente sang Barangay Cabaroan sa San Emilio.
english: The victims were identified as Ibrahim Cardenas, 26, and Fatima Claire Pis-oy, 25, both residents of Barangay Cabaroan in San Emilio.

text: Nagasakay sa truck nga ginamaneho ni Cardenas ang duha sang nagluntad ang insidente samtang nagabyahe sila sa Barangay Paltoc.
english: The two were riding in a truck driven by Cardenas when the incident occurred while they were traveling in Barangay Paltoc.

text: Ginpahayag nga nadulaan sang kontrol si Cardenas sa salakyan kag wala naghawid ang preno sang truck tubtob nga nagbaliskad ang truck.
english: Cardenas reportedly lost control of the vehicle and did not apply the brakes until the truck overturned.

text: Nag-angkon sang mga pilas ang duha kag gindeklarar nga dead on arrival sa ospital.
english: The two sustained injuries and were declared dead on arrival at the hospital.

text: Magahatag ang Maharlika Investment Corp sang $76.4 million ukon P4.425 billion nga loan sa isa ka gold and copper mining project sa probinsya sang Kalinga.
english: Maharlika Investment Corp will provide a $76.4 million or P4.425 billion loan for a gold and copper mining project in Kalinga province.

text: Suno sa sovereign wealth fund sang Pilipinas nga Maharlika, nagpirma na sila sang binding term sheet para sa isa ka loan sa Makilala Mining Company, Inc.
english: According to the Philippines' sovereign wealth fund Maharlika, they have already signed a binding term sheet for a loan to Makilala Mining Company, Inc.

text: (Makilala Mining) agud umpisahan ang temprano nga development works para sa Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog Copper-Gold Project (MCB Project) sa probinsya sang Cordillera.
english: (Makila Mining) to start the early development works for the Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog Copper-Gold Project (MCB Project) in the province of Cordillera.

text: Ang loan magapondo sang isa ka feasibility study, pagtukod sang dalan, kag paghanas para sa mga katapo sang Balatoc Indigenous Cultural Community.
english: The loan will fund a feasibility study, road construction, and training for members of the Balatoc Indigenous Cultural Community.

text: Ang kwarta magatugot man sa Makilala Mining nga malab-ot ang mga kinahanglanon sa pinansyal nga ikasarang sa idalum sang Mineral Production Sharing Agreement sa Gobyerno sang Pilipinas,.
english: The money will also allow Makilala Mining to meet financial viability requirements under the Mineral Production Sharing Agreement with the Government of the Philippines,.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Maharlika Investment Corp (MIC) nga ang ila suporta sa proyekto nag-agi sa isa ka due diligence review sang iya teknikal, pinansyal, legal, environmental, kag socioeconomic nga aspeto.
english: Maharlika Investment Corp (MIC) also said that its support for the project has undergone a due diligence review of its technical, financial, legal, environmental, and socioeconomic aspects.

text: Ang Presidente kag CEO sang MIC nga si Rafael D. Consing, Jr.
english: MIC President and CEO Rafael D. Consing, Jr.

text: nagsiling nga ang proyekto sa pagmina nagasanto sa ila mandato sa pagduso sang pag-uswag sang ekonomiya.
english: said the mining project is in line with their mandate to drive economic growth.

text: Ang MIC nagsiling nga ang loan iga-disburse, nga may una nga $10 million nga gintigana para sa gilayon nga pagsugod sang proyekto.
english: MIC said the loan will be disbursed, with the first $10 million set aside for immediate project start-up.

text: Ang kasugtanan nagalakip man sang mga probisyon nga nagapasiguro sang pagbantay kag partisipasyon sang MIC sa mga key project management decisions, suno sa sovereign wealth fund.
english: The agreement also includes provisions ensuring MIC oversight and participation in key project management decisions, the sovereign wealth fund said.

text: Nagapadayon man ang mga paghambalanay nahanungod sa dugang nga pondo para sa MCB Project.
english: Discussions are also underway regarding additional funding for the MCB Project.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang MIC nga naga-invest man ini sa power grid operator sang pungsod.
english: Earlier, MIC said it is also investing in the country’s power grid operator.

text: Ang sovereign wealth fund nakakuha sang una nga pondo gikan sa duha ka pinakadaku nga ginapanag-iyahan sang estado nga mga bangko sang pungsod, nga suno sa International Monetary Fund kinahanglan na karon nga i-recapitalize.
english: The sovereign wealth fund has secured initial funding from the country’s two largest state-owned banks, which the International Monetary Fund says will now need to be recapitalized.

text: [WARNING: The following report contains violent content and hostage-taking.
english: [WARNING: The following report contains violent content and hostage-taking.

text:
Reader discretion is advised.]

Nangin makahalawat-hawat ang eksena sa Barangay Sabala Manao Proper, Marawi City, Lanao del Sur matapos gin-hostage sang isa ka adik ang bata nga babaye.
english:
Reader discretion is advised.]

The scene in Barangay Sabala Manao Proper, Marawi City, Lanao del Sur became shocking after an addict took a girl hostage.

text: Base sa impormasyon, nagalakat lamang ang bata nga babaye sang hinali lang nga ginbutong ini sang suspek.
english: According to reports, the girl was walking when the suspect suddenly grabbed her.

text: Ginpahayag nga nakit-an sang hostage-taker ang dala nga ₱500 paper bill sang bata gani iya ini gintuyo nga agawon.
english: The hostage-taker reportedly saw the child's ₱500 paper bill and tried to snatch it.

text: Hinali niya nga ginkup-an ang bata kag gintayaan niya sang kutsilyo sa liog.
english: He suddenly grabbed the child and stabbed him in the neck.

text: Sa dalayon nga pagnegosyar, isa ka pulis ang nagdesisyon nga tiruhon ang suspek sang hana na kuntani sini nga gulgulan sa liog ang bata.
english: After a long negotiation, a policeman decided to shoot the suspect when he tried to stab the child in the neck.

text: Gilayon naman nga gindala sa ospital ang bata nga nakaangkon sang mga pilas.
english: The child was rushed to the hospital with injuries.

text: Gindeklarar naman nga patay ang suspek bangud sa naangkon nga igo sang bala sa iya guya kag butkon.
english: The suspect was declared dead due to gunshot wounds to his face and arm.

text: NATURAL lang nga mamangkot ang mausisa (curious) kon paano gina-deteminar sang mga siyentipiko ang “efficacy” sang mga vaccine.
english: IT IS only natural for the curious to ask how scientists determine the “efficacy” of vaccines.

text: More specifically sa kaso sang mga COVID-19 vaccine, paano bala nalab-ut ang 50.4% nga efficacy sang Sinovac (coronavac) vaccine, ang 70% nga efficacy sang AstraZeneca, ukon ang 95% efficacy sang Pfizer/bioNTech?
english: More specifically in the case of COVID-19 vaccines, how was the 50.4% efficacy of the Sinovac (coronavac) vaccine, the 70% efficacy of AstraZeneca, or the 95% efficacy of Pfizer/bioNTech achieved?

text: Ang pagtuon sa COVID-19 vaccine nagatutok mayor sa kon bala “effective and safe” ini kon gamiton sang tawo.
english: Studies on the COVID-19 vaccine focus mainly on whether it is “effective and safe” when used in humans.

text: Indi lang sa laboratoryo, kundi labi na gid sa “real world” sa gwa sang controlled environment sang laboratoryo kon diin diri na mahibal-an sing lubos ang epekto sini sa padayon nga pagpangbakuna sa mga tawo.
english: Not only in the laboratory, but especially in the “real world” outside the controlled environment of the laboratory where the impact of this on the continued vaccination of people can be fully determined.

text: But first, ano bala ang buot silingon sang vaccine efficacy, ukon ang ikasarang, sini sa pag-away sa COVID-19 sunu sa pagtuon sa laboratoryo?
english: But first, what does vaccine efficacy mean, or its ability to fight COVID-19 according to laboratory studies?

text: Sunu kay Yella Hewins-Martin, Ph.
english: According to Yella Hewins-Martin, Ph.

text:
D sa iya artikulo sa Medical News Today sadtong Enero 4, 2021, “Vaccine efficacy is the percentage reduction in a disease in a group of people who received a vaccination in a clinical trial.”

Lain man ini, sunu pa gid kay Martin, sa “vaccine effectiveness” nga nagatakos sang ikasarang sang vaccine batok sa balatian kon i-administer na sa mga tawo sa komunidad sa gwa sang clinical trials sa nagakalain-lain nga sitwasyon.
english:
D in his article in Medical News Today on January 4, 2021, “Vaccine efficacy is the percentage reduction in a disease in a group of people who received a vaccination in a clinical trial.”

This is also different, Martin said, from “vaccine effectiveness” which measures the ability of a vaccine against the disease when administered to people in the community outside of clinical trials in different situations.

text:
***

Balik kita kon paano gina-determinar sang aton mga siyentipiko ang efficacy sang isa ka vaccine.
english:
***

Let’s go back to how our scientists determine the efficacy of a vaccine.

text: Ang aton research wala nangin mabungahon sa kaso sang Sinovac kag iban pa nga vaccine.
english: Our research has not been fruitful in the case of Sinovac and other vaccines.

text: Sa kaso sang Sinovac, ang aton nakuha amo lang ang mga generalization kag, kon may detalye man, indi ini sapat agud mahimo naton ang pag-calculate sang efficacy sini.
english: In the case of Sinovac, all we have got are generalizations and, if there is any detail, it is not enough to enable us to calculate its efficacy.

text: Kon may nakahibalo man sa sini nga mga detalye, ina lang seguro sa study report nga nabaton sang mga FDA nga tungod sa right to confidentiality sa tunga sang manufacturer kag sang kliyente indi mahatag sa publiko.
english: If anyone knows these details, it is probably only in the study report received by the FDA which due to the right to confidentiality between the manufacturer and the client cannot be made public.

text: Salamat ugaling nga indi gid man lubos nga confidential ang study report halin sa Pfizer/bioNTech angot sa pag-deterrminar sang 95% efficacy sini, nga nakuha naton sa report ni Martin sa Medical News Today.
english: Thankfully, however, the study report from Pfizer/bioNTech regarding the determination of its 95% efficacy is not completely confidential, which we obtained from Martin's report in Medical News Today.

text: Sunu sa report nga ini ni Martin, naglab-ut sa 43,661 ang mga study volunteer sa pagtuon sa vaccine efficacy sang Pfizer/bioNTech.
english: According to Martin's report, there were 43,661 study volunteers in the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine efficacy study.

text: Gintunga ini sa duha ka grupo (21,830 ang isa ka grupo) sang vaccine group kag sang placebo (fake vaccine) group.
english: They were divided into two groups (21,830 each) of the vaccine group and the placebo (fake vaccine) group.

text: Paagi sa “random” ang pagpili kon diin matupa sa duha ka study group ang mga volunteer.
english: The selection of volunteers into the two study groups was done at random.

text: Bala sa grupo nga ginhatagan sing candidate vaccine ukon sang placebo katulad sang sugar pill?
english: In the group that was given the candidate vaccine or a placebo such as a sugar pill?

text: Resulta sang pagtuon nagpakita nga 162 sa placebo group ang na-infect sang COVID-19 sa ginpakita nila nga sintoma.
english: The results of the study showed that 162 in the placebo group were infected with COVID-19 when they showed symptoms.

text: Walo (8) lang ang na-infect halin sa grupo nga ginhatagan sing candidate vaccine.
english: Only eight (8) were infected from the group that was given the candidate vaccine.

text: Ang infection rate sang infected sa placebo group amo ang 162 divided by 21,830 (162/21,830) ukon 0.74%.
