english: The infection rate of infected in the placebo group was 162 divided by 21,830 (162/21,830) or 0.74%.

text: Ang infection rate sang vaccine group amo ang 8/21,830 ukon 0.04%.
english: The infection rate of the vaccine group was 8/21,830 or 0.04%.

text: Halin diri sa infection rate sang duha ka grupo ma-calcuate ta na ang efficacy.
english: From this infection rate of the two groups we can calculate the efficacy.

text: Una, sa pagbuhin sang infection rate sang vaccine infection rate (0.04%) halin sa placebo infection rate (0.74%) nga maga-resulta sa 0.7%.
english: First, to subtract the infection rate of the vaccine infection rate (0.04%) from the placebo infection rate (0.74%) which would result in 0.7%.

text: Dayon 0.7% divided by 0.74% multiplied by 100, nga “almost equal to” 95% efficacy, ukon 0.7%/0.74% ≈ 95% sa mathematical symbolism sang mga scientist.
english: Then 0.7% divided by 0.74% multiplied by 100, which is “almost equal to” 95% efficacy, or 0.7%/0.74% ≈ 95% in scientists’ mathematical symbolism.

text: Kon natabuan nga ang pagtuon nagpakita sang vaccine infection rate sing 0.14% kag ang placebo infection rate 0.74% gihapon, ang efficacy rate mangin 81% lang.
english: If by chance the study showed a vaccine infection rate of 0.14% and the placebo infection rate was still 0.74%, the efficacy rate would be only 81%.

text: This also means, sa pagnubo sang efficacy sa 81%, nga magadamo man ang maisip nga infected halin mismo sa nabakunahan (vaccine group).
english: This also means, with the decrease in efficacy to 81%, that more people will be counted infected from the vaccinated group.

text: In other words, magataas man ang infected diri halin sa walo (8) sang 95% efficacy.
english: In other words, the number of infected will also increase from eight (8) to 95% efficacy.

text: Of course, maganubo ang infection sa kabug-usan tungod sa mas madamo na ang ma-proteksyunan (95%) for at least tatlo ka bulan nga immunity, samtang ang infection sa placebo group (wala nabakunahan) yara lang sa kubos 1% (0.74%), dugang nga paathag ni Dr. Piero Olliero, myembro sang Academie de Medicine, France nga may Ph.D. sa infectious disease sa University of Pavia, Italy.
english: Of course, the overall infection will decrease because more people will be protected (95%) for at least three months of immunity, while the infection in the placebo group (unvaccinated) is only less than 1% (0.74%), Dr. Piero Olliero, member of the Academie de Medicine, France with Ph.D. in infectious disease at the University of Pavia, Italy.

text: Ang pagtuon sa laboratoryo sa Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine nagpakita nga makasabat lang ini sa problema sang symptomatic Covid-19 (gapakita sintoma) kag wala nagalakip sang asymptomatic COVID-19 (wala gapakita sintoma).
english: Laboratory studies on the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine have shown that it can only address the problem of symptomatic Covid-19 (showing symptoms) and does not include asymptomatic COVID-19 (not showing symptoms).

text: Ang real-world “effectiveness” review ugaling sang Israeli health records nagpakita nga maka-prevent man ini sang asymptomatic COVID-19, sunu sa sinulatan ni Molly Walker Associate Editor, sa MedPage Today sadtong Pebrero 24, 2021./PN
english: A real-world “effectiveness” review of Israeli health records showed that it can also prevent asymptomatic COVID-19, according to Molly Walker Associate Editor, in MedPage Today on February 24, 2021./PN

text: Ginpadayaw ni Miss Universe 1969 Gloria Diaz nga may yara ini sang love life.
english: Miss Universe 1969 Gloria Diaz flaunted that she has a love life.

text: Suno sa 74- anyos nga si Diaz, ang iya nobyo nga si Mike de Jesus nga presidente sang isa ka bangko, ang mas bataon sang sa iya.
english: According to 74-year-old Diaz, her boyfriend, Mike de Jesus, who is president of a bank, is younger than her.

text: Pahayag ni Gloria, 28 anyos na sila nga magkarelasyon.
english: Gloria said they have been in a relationship for 28 years.

text: Apang suno sa iya, indi na ini bukas para nga magpakasal liwat.
english: But he said it was no longer open to remarriage.

text: Ginpakigbahin man niya nga apisar nagapabilin sila nga nga friends sang iya ex-husband.
english: She also shared that although they remain friends with her ex-husband.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, nagaupdanay pa gani sila sang nga tatlo sang iya partner kag ex-husband nga naga-bond kag naga-hang out.
english: In fact, they were even together when the three of her partner and ex-husband bonded and hung out.

text: Ipinatupad na sa Iloilo City ang 10 araw na gun ban bilang bahagi ng security measures para sa high-level Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) meetings na nakatakda sa Pebrero 25 hanggang 27.
english: A 10-day gun ban has been implemented in Iloilo City as part of security measures for the high-level Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) meetings scheduled for February 25 to 27.

text: Ayon sa Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6), epektibo ang temporary suspension ng Permit to Carry Firearms Outside of Residence (PTCFOR) simula noong Biyernes at tatagal hanggang Marso 1.
english: According to the Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6), the temporary suspension of the Permit to Carry Firearms Outside of Residence (PTCFOR) will be effective from Friday and will last until March 1.

text: Sa ilalim ng direktiba, ang mga uniformed at on-duty personnel lamang mula sa otorisadong law enforcement agencies ang papayagang magdala ng armas.
english: Under the directive, only uniformed and on-duty personnel from authorized law enforcement agencies will be allowed to carry firearms.

text: Sa panayam naman ng Bombo Radyo kay PCol Wilbert Parilla, OIC Director ng Iloilo City Police Office, sinabi nito na nag-deploy na rin ng mahigit 1,900 na mga police personnel.
english: When contacted by Bombo Radyo, PCol Wilbert Parilla, OIC Director of the Iloilo City Police Office, said that more than 1,900 police personnel have already been deployed.

text: Ito ay para magbigay seguridad sa mga delegado sa loob ng tatlong araw na meeting.
english: This is to provide security to the delegates during the three-day meeting.

text: Ang mga delegado ay mula sa mga bansang kasapi ng Association of Southeast Asian Nations o ASEAN, kabilang ang Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Pilipinas, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste at Vietnam.
english: The delegates are from Association of Southeast Asian Nations or ASEAN member countries, including Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste and Vietnam.

text: Handa nga magbulig ang National Food Authority (NFA) para lagson ang mga nagapamintaha nga rice traders sa punsod, suno kay NFA Administrator Larry Lacson.
english: The National Food Authority (NFA) is ready to help crack down on predatory rice traders in the country, according to NFA Administrator Larry Lacson.

text: Sa ika-apat nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr., ginpasigurado sini sa Department of Agriculture (DA) nga mabantayan ang mga trader halin sa posible nga pagpamintaha sa mga mangunguma kag pagmanipula sa presyo sang bugas kag humay.
english: In his fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA), President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. assured the Department of Agriculture (DA) to monitor traders from possible exploitation of farmers and manipulation of rice and rice prices.

text: Suno kay Lacson, ang matigdas nga pahayag ni Presidente Marcos batok sa mga trader ang pamatuod nga ginapamatian sang gobyernmo ang mga ginasinggitan sang mga mangunguma.
english: According to Lacson, President Marcos' harsh statement against the traders is proof that the government is listening to the cries of the farmers.

text: Nakahanda man suno sa iya ang NFA nga magbulig sa DA kag iban pa nga ahensiya sang gobyerno para isulong ang mga kampaniya kontra sa mga mapamintaha nga mga trader kag dalayon nga mapasabat ang mga ini agud proteheran ang mga mangunguma.
english: He said the NFA is also ready to assist the DA and other government agencies to advance campaigns against corrupt traders and immediately hold them accountable to protect farmers.

text: Ginsiling sang opisyal nga ang nagapanguna nga katuyuan sang NFA amo agud proteheran ang kinamatarong sang mga mangunguma.
english: The official said the main purpose of the NFA is to protect the rights of farmers.

text: Suno sa iya, ang mga ini ang matuod nga haligi sang seguridad sa pagkaon sa pungsod, kasubong sang ginahatagan igtalupangod ni Presidente Marcos sa iya nga nangin speech.
english: He said these are the true pillars of food security in the country, as President Marcos emphasized in his speech.

text: Samtang, nagapanindugan si Lacson nga indi man sang insigida ang solusyon nga ginahimo sang NFA kag DA, lauman sa gihapon sang mga mangunguma nga tinguhaan sang ahensya ang pag-ayos kag pagbag-o sa sektor sang pagpanguma kalakip na ang pagpasabat sa mga nagapangmanipula nga trader.
english: Meanwhile, Lacson insisted that even if the solution being developed by the NFA and DA is not immediate, farmers can still expect the agency to try to improve and change the agricultural sector including holding manipulative traders accountable.

text: Kun magkaon kita sang prutas sang saging, ginahaboy mo man bala gilayon ang panit sini?
english: When we eat a banana, do you immediately throw away the skin?

text: Samtang pamilyar ang kadam-an sa matam-is kag fruity nga unod sang saging, gamay lamang ang nagventure agud testingan ang panit sini.
english: While most are familiar with the sweet and fruity flesh of the banana, few have ventured to test its peel.

text: Suno kay Adda Bjarnadottir, isa ka registered nutritionist sa Iceland, magluwas nga malikawan ang food waste, indi pa mauyang ang vitamins kag minerals nga mahatag sang banana peel ukon ang panit sang saging sa diin epektibo ini nga panglakip sa diet.
english: According to Adda Bjarnadottir, a registered nutritionist in Iceland, besides avoiding food waste, the vitamins and minerals that banana peel or banana peel can provide are not wasted.

text: Manggaranon man ang panit sang saging sang pila ka key nutrients kalakip na ang potassium, dietary fiber, polyunsaturated fats, kag essential amino acids.
english: Banana peels are also rich in several key nutrients including potassium, dietary fiber, polyunsaturated fats, and essential amino acids.

text: Ang fiber nga yara sa panit sang saging amo ang nagabalanse sang blood sugar levels kag nagapaboost sang heart health.
english: The fiber present in banana peels balances blood sugar levels and boosts heart health.

text: Samtang ang potassium naman nga yara man sa banana peel ang nagabulig sa pagregulate sang blood pressure levels kag nagapabuhin sang risgo sa pag-angkon sang kidney stones.
english: Meanwhile, potassium, which is also found in banana peel, helps regulate blood pressure levels and reduces the risk of kidney stones.

text: Pahayag sang nutritionist, manggaranon man ang panit sang saging sa antioxidants nga nagapabuhin sang inflammation kag nagaproteher sa lawas sang tawo batok sa nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian kaangay sang heart disease, cancer kag diabetes.
english: According to the nutritionist, banana peel is also rich in antioxidants that reduce inflammation and protect the human body against various diseases such as heart disease, cancer and diabetes.

text: Ang banana peel ukon ang panit sang saging ang mahimo nga i-bake, pabukalan, ukon prituhon kag mahimo man lutuon sa nagkalain-lain nga recipe
english: Banana peel or banana peel can be baked, boiled, or fried and can also be cooked in a variety of recipes

text: Nagpadulong sa Lebanon si Pope Leo XIV bilang ikaduha kag ulihi nga bahin sang iya una nga pagbisita sa iban nga pungsod bilang lider sang Simbahang Katolika.
english: Pope Leo XIV traveled to Lebanon as the second and final leg of his first foreign visit as leader of the Catholic Church.

text: Ginalauman nga magahatag siya sang panawagan para sa kahilwayan sang pungsod nga padayon nga gina-target sang mga air strike sang Israel.
english: He is expected to deliver a call for the independence of the country, which continues to be targeted by Israeli air strikes.

text: Naghalin sa Turkey ang pinakauna nga US pope, nga nagbisita sang apat ka adlaw kag nagpa-andam nga mabutang sa risgo ang bwas damlag sang katawhan bangud sang indi kina-andan nga numero sang madinugu-on nga inaway sa kalibutan.
english: The first US pope left Turkey, visiting for four days and warning that the future of mankind is at risk because of the unusual number of bloody wars in the world.

text: Sa Beirut, makigkita siya sa presidente kag prime minister kag makig-istorya sa mga lider sang pungsod.
english: In Beirut, he will meet with the president and prime minister and hold talks with the country’s leaders.

text: Nagalaum naman ang Hezbollah leader nga si Naim Qassem nga ang pagbisita sang Santo Papa ang magatapos na sang pagpang-atake sang Israel.
english: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem hopes that the Pope's visit will end Israel's attacks.

text: Isa ang graduation day sa mga adlaw nga aton gid ginahandaan bangud diri naton mapasalamatan ang mga tawo nga nangin parte sang aton kadalag-an kag diri man naton ulihi makit-an ang pila sa aton mga abyan kag classmates.
english: Graduation day is one of the days that we prepare for because it is where we can thank the people who have been part of our success and where we can finally see some of our friends and classmates.

text: Talagsa lang sa malaka nga may gamo nga nagakatabo diri, gani matandaan gid kun may ginhimo nga eskandalo kaangay sining isa ka estudyante sa China.
english: It's rare for there to be trouble here, so it's easy to remember when there's a scandal like this one student in China.

text: Natabo ini sa graduation rites sa Fudan University sa Zhengda Stadium, Shanghai kun sa diin masobra 10,000 ka mga estudyante ang nagtapos sa ila pag-eskwela.
english: This took place at the graduation rites at Fudan University at Zhengda Stadium, Shanghai where more than 10,000 students graduated.

text: Sang nakaabot na sa degree conferment segment, naglinya ang mga propesor sa entablado suksok ang ila pula nga toga kag diri na kuntani nga parte nga isa-isa mag-atubang ang mga estudyante sa propesor para masaylo ang ila tassels.
english: When they reached the degree confirmation segment, the professors lined up on stage wearing their red togas and this is where the students were supposed to face the professor one by one to transfer their tassels.

text: Madamo gid ang nakibot sang natumba ang isa ka professor bangud nga gintapungol ini sang estudyante sa iya atubangan.
english: Many were shocked when a professor fell because a student stabbed him in front of him.

text: Dali-dali man nga nagpanaog sa stage ang estudyante samtang nabuka naman ang antipara sang teacher kag gindapatan gid sang pagbulong bangud sa minor injuries.
english: The student quickly got off the stage while the teacher's glasses were broken and he was treated for minor injuries.

text: Daku ang pagpati nga isa ka mistaken identity ang natabo sa amo nga seremonya kag ang dean gid kuntani ang target sang estudyante.
english: It is widely believed that a mistaken identity occurred at the ceremony and the dean was the target of the student.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang estudyante ang yara sa shortlist para sa Peking Univeristy Health Schience Center master’s degree program sang Abril, pero wala ginpasugtan sang unibersidad bangud ginapaidalom pa siya sa ideological and moral assessment.
english: The student was on the shortlist for the Peking University Health Science Center master's degree program in April, but the university did not allow him because he was still undergoing an ideological and moral assessment.

text: Ginalantaw nga tuman ang paglain sang buot sini rason nga nasumbagan sini ang professor.
english: It is believed that he was so angry that he stabbed the professor.

text: Gina-imbestigaran sang Student Affairs Office kag Law School staff sang unibersidad ang hitabo, ginahulat pa ang mangin statement sang estudyante, kag ginabantayan man kun ano nga disciplinary action ang idagdag batok sa iya.
english: The Student Affairs Office and Law School staff of the university are investigating the incident, are still waiting for the student's statement, and are also monitoring what disciplinary action will be added against him.

text: Gin-ordinahan kag gin-install bilang pinakauna nga Filipino Bishop sa Japan si bishop-elect Edgar Gacutan, CICM.
english: Bishop-elect Edgar Gacutan, CICM, was ordained and installed as the first Filipino Bishop in Japan.

text: Si bishop Gacutan ang ginbata sa Cagayan Province, Northeastern, Luzon sang Septyembre 1964 kag 1986 ang iya first pledge sa Junshinkai, Japan.
english: Bishop Gacutan was born in Cagayan Province, Northeastern, Luzon in September 1964 and 1986 was his first pledge in Junshinkai, Japan.

text: Sang 1990, nagtransfer ini sa Japan bilang isa ka seminary student.
english: In 1990, he transferred to Japan as a seminary student.

text: Pagkatapos sang iya tatlo ka tuig nga internship sa Japan, nagpauli ini sa Pilipinas agud nga padayunon ang iya pag eskwela sa iya ideolohiya.
english: After his three-year internship in Japan, he returned to the Philippines to continue his studies in his ideology.

text: Si Gacutan ang gin-ordinahan sa pagkapari sang Abril 23,1994 sa Pilipinas.
english: Gacutan was ordained a priest on April 23, 1994 in the Philippines.

text: Nangin assistant professor man ini sa Kongo Church sang 1994 tubtob1997.
english: He was also an assistant professor at the Kongo Church from 1994 to 1997.

text: Si bishop Gacutan ang nangin appointed Bishop sa Sendai Parish sang Disyembre 8, 2021.
english: Bishop Gacutan became the appointed Bishop in Sendai Parish on December 8, 2021.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma,– direkta sa Japan, pila man ka mga pinoy kag Japanese catholics ang nagtambung sa seremonya nga pag-ordina kay bishop Gacutan sa Sendai, Japan.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma,– directly in Japan, several Filipinos and Japanese Catholics also attended the ceremony of ordination of Bishop Gacutan in Sendai, Japan.

text: Suno kay Palma, dako nga pagpanghangkat kay bishop Gacutan kun paano niya maserbehan ang Filipino Community sa Sendai nga amo masami matabuan sang mga kalamidad.
english: According to Palma, it is a big challenge for Bishop Gacutan how he can serve the Filipino community in Sendai which is often affected by disasters.

text: Ginkilala nga happiest country in the world ang Finland sa sulod na sang lima ka tuig base sa World Happiness Report rankings kag sa evaluation naghalin sa Gallup World Poll.
english: Finland has been recognized as the happiest country in the world for the past five years based on the World Happiness Report rankings and the evaluation from the Gallup World Poll.

text: Ang world happiness report ang base sa kaugalingon nga assessment sang ila happiness lakip na ang economic kag social data sang isa ka pungsod.
english: The world happiness report is based on their own assessment of their happiness including economic and social data of a country.

text: Ang happiness score ang nakadepende man sa Gross Domestic Product (GDP), social support, personal freedom kag level sang corruption sa isa ka lugar.
english: The happiness score also depends on the Gross Domestic Product (GDP), social support, personal freedom and level of corruption in an area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Denise Anne Rivera, Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) sa Finland, iya ginpahayag nga halos tanan nga butang sa sa amo nga pungsod ang libre nga posible amo ang rason nga masadya ang mga finnish sa ila nga pagpangabuhi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Denise Anne Rivera, Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) in Finland, said that almost everything in the country is free which is probably the reason why the Finns are happy in their lives.

text: Suno kay Rivera, libre ang education (free tuition kag may allowance monthly ang mga estudyante, free ang hospitalization, free nga balay para sa mga single parent kag apisar nga absent ukon naka-sick leave makabaton sa gihapon sang sweldo.
english: According to Rivera, education is free (free tuition and monthly allowance for students, free hospitalization, free housing for single parents and even if they are absent or on sick leave, they will still receive a salary.

text: Apang, apisar sang halos libre tanan, tuman naman kataas ang tax sa amo nga pungsod.
english: However, despite almost everything being free, taxes in the country are very high.

text: Magasugod na karon sa gab-i ang food festival and bazaar sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol may kaangtanan sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The food festival and bazaar at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol in connection with the Dinagyang Festival 2025 will start tonight.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Aulynn Yue Sin, officer sang Local Economic Development and Investment Promotion sang probinsya, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang 50 ka mga kiosko nga magabaligya sang mga pagkaon sa food festival area sa Muelle Loney.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Aulynn Yue Sin, officer of the province's Local Economic Development and Investment Promotion, said there are 50 kiosks that will sell food in the food festival area at Muelle Loney.

text: Suno sa LEDIP Officer, may yara man sang 23 ka mga merchants sa bazaars nga ipahamtang sa Capitol Park kun sa diin nanuhay-tuhay nga mga produkto ukon non-food items ang sarang mabakal sang mga tawo.
english: According to the LEDIP Officer, there will also be 23 merchants in the bazaars that will be set up in Capitol Park where various products or non-food items can be purchased by the people.

text: May yara man sang live entertainment para sa mga bisita.
english: There will also be live entertainment for guests.

text: Si Goverrnor Arthur Defensor mismo ang magabukas sang food festival and bazaar nga magalawig tubtob sa Enero 26.
english: Governor Arthur Defensor himself will open the food festival and bazaar which will last until January 26.

text: Nagapati ang mga mamalidha nga bisan indi man perpekto ang Ayuda Para sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP), isa ini ka importante nga programa sang gobyerno bangud wala lamang sini ginabuligan ang mga tawo sa tunga sang nagasaka nga presyo, kundi nagabulig man sa pag-stimulate sang ekonomiya.
english: Lawmakers believe that while the Ayuda Para sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP) is not perfect, it is an important government program because it not only helps people amid rising prices, but also helps stimulate the economy.

text: Kasunod ini sang survey sang polling firm nga OCTA Research kun sa diin nagapakita nga 69 percent sang respondents (seven out of 10) ang gusto nga mapalawig ang programa samtang 31 percent naman ang nagapamatok.
english: This follows a survey by polling firm OCTA Research which showed that 69 percent of respondents (seven out of 10) want the program to be extended while 31 percent are against it.

text: Suno kay Lanao del Sur Rep.
english: According to Lanao del Sur Rep.

text: Zia Alonto Adiong, kinahanglan gid man ang adjustments nga himuon sa AKAP, apang dugang sini, ang paghatag sang financial aid direkta sa mga tawo ang nagapabaskog sang ila nga purchasing power kag bilang resulta, mabuligan man sini ang mga negosyo.
english: Zia Alonto Adiong, there is a need for adjustments to be made in AKAP, but he added that the provision of financial aid directly to the people strengthens their purchasing power and as a result, it will also help businesses.

text: “This aid has been done for a long time by the government, we’re just trying to improve that.
english: “This aid has been done for a long time by the government, we’re just trying to improve that.

text: We’re not saying that the AKAP is perfect, there will always a room for adjustment.
english: We’re not saying that the AKAP is perfect, there will always a room for adjustment.

text: That’s why we are really trying to really improve the services to the people so that they can feel that the government is working for them,” suno kay Adiong sa press briefing sa Batasang Pambansa complex.
english: That’s why we are really trying to really improve the services to the people so that they can feel that the government is working for them,” Adiong said in a press briefing at the Batasang Pambansa complex.

text: “What they are saying about the ayuda being necessary is because it goes directly to the pocket of the people, and then it will strengthen the purchasing power of these individuals, these people, as part the consumer, that in effect it will contribute positively to the local economy, which in effect is good,” dugang sini.
english: “What they are saying about the aid being necessary is because it goes directly to the pocket of the people, and then it will strengthen the purchasing power of these individuals, these people, as part the consumer, that in effect it will contribute positively to the local economy, which in effect is good,” it added.

text: Ginsiling man ni Adiong nga bangud mataas ang numero sang mga tawo nga nagasugot sa AKAP, buot silingon, pamatuod ini nga epektibo gid man ang programa.
english: Adiong also said that because the number of people who agree with AKAP is high, it means that this is proof that the program is effective.

text: “Actually, we’re making true to our promise, this administration said it will bring government services closer to the people.
english: “Actually, we’re making true to our promise, this administration said it will bring government services closer to the people.

text: Gintawag sang Malacañang nga “one-man fake-news factory” si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte matapos ang iya pahayag nga pakadto na sa diktadurya si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Malacañang called former President Rodrigo Duterte a “one-man fake-news factory” after his statement that President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. is heading for dictatorship.

text: Sa statement nga ginpaguwa ni Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Pebrero 23, ginlaragway sini ang pahayag ni Duterte nga isa na naman ka “budol”.
english: In a statement issued by Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin on February 23, he described Duterte's statement as another “budol”.

text: Suno pa sa natungdan, ginakabig nila nga “baseless and ridiculous” ang amo nga pahayag.
english: He said they consider the statement “baseless and ridiculous”.

text: “This hoax is another budol emerging from a one-man fake-news factory,” suno kay Bersamin.
english: “This hoax is another budol emerging from a one-man fake-news factory,” according to Bersamin.

text: “We treat the former president’s baseless and ridiculous statements in the same way that Filipinos are dismissive of them: a tall tale from a man prone to lying and to inventing hoaxes,” kabahin pa sang statement.
english: “We treat the former president’s baseless and ridiculous statements in the same way that Filipinos are dismissive of them: a tall tale from a man prone to lying and to inventing hoaxes,” the statement added.

text: Dugang pa ni Bersamin, nagapadayon gid ang Marcos administration sa pag-demonstar nga magapabilin ini sa pagtib-ong sa Konstitusyon sa pagsunod sa rule of law kag sa pagtahod sang kinamatarong sang mga tawo.
english: Bersamin added that the Marcos administration continues to demonstrate that it will remain committed to upholding the Constitution in compliance with the rule of law and respect for the rights of the people.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga indi sila magbalik sa mga pamaagi sang anay Duterte administration kun sa diin ginpangpreso ang mga kritiko kag ginpasakaan sang kaso, kag ginpaguwa pa ang “kill orders” nga daw nasadyahan pa.
english: He also said that they will not return to the methods of the former Duterte administration where critics were imprisoned and prosecuted, and kill orders were issued as if they were still happy.

text:
“We will not backslide into the oppressive ways of the previous administration, when critics were jailed upon trumped-up charges and when kill orders were publicly issued with glee and obeyed blindly… It is the leader of that troubled past who is depicting us as veering toward a system where anyone can be deprived of life, liberty, and property without due process of law, as many had been on his mere say-so as a tyrant who did not respect the rights of the people.”

Ini nga mga statement sang Malacañang ang kasunod sa ginhambal ni Duterte sang rally sa Cebu sang Sabado kun sa diin ginpahayag sini nga nagaplano si Marcos nga ilugon ang iya amay kag magadeklarar man ini sang martial law para nga indi matabo ang 2028 presidential elections kag indi ini makapanaog sa pwesto.#
english:
“We will not backslide into the oppressive ways of the previous administration, when critics were jailed upon trumped-up charges and when kill orders were publicly issued with glee and obeyed blindly… It is the leader of that troubled past who is depicting us as veering toward a system where anyone can be deprived of life, due process and liberty without property law, as many had been on his mere say-so as a tyrant who did not respect the rights of the people.”

Malacañang's statements follow Duterte's remarks at a rally in Cebu on Saturday where he said Marcos plans to imitate his father and will declare martial law to prevent the 2028 presidential elections from taking place.

text: Nag-apelar sang dugang nga bulig si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky pinaagi sa iya historic speech sa US Congress.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky appealed for more help through his historic speech to the US Congress.

text: Nagpanawagan si Zelensky sa Biden administration nga hatagan sang dugang pa nga financial support, dugang nga weaponry kag no-fly zone ang Ukraine agud nga makabulig sa ila pakigbato sa nagapadayon nga Russian invasion.
english: Zelensky called on the Biden administration to provide Ukraine with more financial support, more weaponry and a no-fly zone to help it fight the ongoing Russian invasion.

text: Makaligad ang pila ka oras matapos ang speech ni Zelensky, gin-anunsyo man sang White House nga sila ang liwat nga magapadala sang bag-o nga package sang military supplies.
english: Hours after Zelensky's speech, the White House also announced that it would again send a new package of military supplies.

text: Sa una nga virtual address ni Zelensky, nagpangayo ini sang air defense system, kag bag-o nga sanctions sa tagsa ka politicin sang Russian federaton.
english: In Zelensky's first virtual address, he demanded an air defense system, and new sanctions on every politician in the Russian federaton.

text: Pormal man nga gin-anunsyo ni Bidn nga maga-deliiver sang $800 million nga dugang sa security aid sa Ukraine, lakip diri ang 800 nga bag-o ka antiaircraft systems, 9,000 shoulder mounted missiles kag 7,000 small arms, kaangay sang machine guns.
english: Bidn also formally announced the delivery of $800 million more in security aid to Ukraine, including 800 new antiaircraft systems, 9,000 shoulder mounted missiles and 7,000 small arms, such as machine guns.

text: Ang package ang may kalakip man nga drones.
english: The package also includes drones.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginmanduan naman sang International Court of Justice ang Russia nga gilayon untaton ang ila pagpang-atake sa Ukraine bangud wala ini sang ebidensiya nga nagasuporta sa pagjustify sang kinagamo.
english: Meanwhile, the International Court of Justice has ordered Russia to immediately stop its attacks on Ukraine because it has no evidence to support the justification of the conflict.

text: Nagdesisyon ang korte nga wala sang ebidensya ang Russia sa ila ginapatihan ginkomiter nga genocide sang Ukraine sa bahin sang Luhansk kag Donesk region.
english: Nagdesisyon ang korte nga wala sang ebidensya ang Russia sa ila ginapatihan ginkomiter nga genocide sang Ukraine sa bahin sang Luhansk kag Donesk region.

text: Samtang, ginahibalo man subong sang mga otoridad sa Ukraine ang sitwasyon sang linibo ka mga residente matapos nga ginbombahan sang Russia ang ila ginatiniran nga drama Theater sa Mariupol.
english: Meanwhile, Ukrainian authorities are also assessing the situation of thousands of residents after Russia bombed their drama theater in Mariupol.

text: Wasak ang theater kag wala pa nahibaluan kun pila ang posible napatay sa amo nga pagpang atake sang Russia.
english: The theater was destroyed and it is not known how many people may have been killed in the Russian attack.

text: Handa ang pinuno sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) nga magtestigo batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte pananglitan ipatawag siya sang impeachment court.
english: The head of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) is ready to testify against Vice President Sara Duterte if he is summoned by the impeachment court.

text: Suno kay CIDG Director MGen.
english: According to CIDG Director MGen.

text: Nicolas Torre III, magadepende pa gihapon ini sa opinyon sang Department of Justice (DOJ) kag prosecution panel kun kinahanglan ukon indi ang testimoniya halin sa ila nga opisina.
english: Nicolas Torre III, it will still depend on the opinion of the Department of Justice (DOJ) and prosecution panel whether or not testimony from their office is required.

text: “Sa ngayon, let me not put the cart before the horse because ang mga investigation against kay VP Sara ay joint palagi na ginagawa ng NBI at saka ng PNP CIDG under the offices of the DOJ.
english: “For now, let me not put the cart before the horse because the investigations against VP Sara are always jointly done by the NBI and the PNP CIDG under the offices of the DOJ.

text: Depende sa kung ano ang magiging pananaw ng DOJ at saka ng mga prosecution panel kung kailangan nila ang testimony namin,” kabahin sang pahayag ni Torre.
english: It depends on what the view of the DOJ and the prosecution panel will be if they need our testimony,” Torre said.

text: Matandaan nga sang Nobyembre, gin-track sang CIDG ang statement ni Sara nga ginaalegar may gin-kontrata ini nga patyon si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., First Lady Liza Marcos, kag House Speaker Martin Romualdez pananglitan may magpatay man sa iya.
english: In November, the CIDG tracked Sara's statement that she allegedly contracted to kill President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., First Lady Liza Marcos, and House Speaker Martin Romualdez if someone killed her.

text: Apang suno kay Torre, indi lang sini anay pag-unahan ang mga statement bangud ang imbestigasyon kay Sara ang joint efforts sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) kag CIDG sa idalom sang DOJ.
english: However, Torre said he will not prioritize the statements because the investigation into Sara is a joint effort of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and CIDG under the DOJ.

text: Nobyembre sang gin-subpoena man sang NBI si Duterte kaangot sa “kill threat” batok sa chief executive, apang wala si Sara nagpakita.
english: In November, the NBI also subpoenaed Duterte in connection with the “kill threat” against the chief executive, but Sara did not appear.

english: Sara was impeached by the House of Representatives on February 5 on grounds of violation of the constitution, betrayal of public trust, graft and corruption, and other high crimes.

english: Some Russian soldiers captured in Ukraine have said they fear facing a firing squad when they return to Russia.

english: According to a Kremlin soldier from the 2nd Motor Rifle Division who surrendered to Ukrainian forces, he has not yet died, his funeral has been “arranged” in Russia.

text: “In Russia, we are already considered dead,” suno sa soldado.
english: “In Russia, we are already considered dead,” the soldier said.

text: “I was given the opportunity to call my parents and they told me that a funeral for me had already been arranged.
english: “I was given the opportunity to call my parents and they told me that a funeral for me had already been arranged.

If we are exchanged, then we will be shot by our own people.”

english:
If we are exchanged, then we will be shot by our own people.”

english: One of his fellow lieutenants from the Russian troops was killed when he rescued the woman and her mother.

english: On February 24, Russian soldiers were ordered to shoot civilians in Kharkiv. According to the captured soldier, he was shot in the leg.

english: His fellow lieutenant was actually killed by their comrades when they noticed that they were not targeting civilians.

text: May yara man sang mga na-intercept nga radio messages kun sa diin nabatian nga nagapamalabag ang mga Russian soldiers nga magpati sa central command orders agud nga pangapinan ang Ukrainian towns.

text: Jude A. Acidre nga nakasaad sa Konstitusyon ang mandu nga gilayon aktohan ang impeachment case nga ginpadala sang Kamara.
english: Jude A. Acidre said the Constitution provides for immediate action on the impeachment case sent by the House of Representatives.

text: Suno kay Acidre, mahimo nga mag-convene ang Senado bisan pa wala sang special session kon paga-aprubahan ang deklarasyon sang martial law, santo sa nakasaad sa Konstitusyon.
english: Acidre said the Senate can convene even if there is no special session to approve the declaration of martial law, as provided for in the Constitution.

text: Pamatuod man ini suno sa iya nga may yara sang mandato ang Kongreso nga wala nasakop sang legislative calendar kag makahulag gilayon sa mga non-legislative matters kaangay sang impeachment.
english: He said this is also proof that Congress has a mandate that is not covered by the legislative calendar and can act immediately on non-legislative matters such as impeachment.

text: Ini ang ginsegundahan ni House Assistant Majority Leader kag Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.
english: It was seconded by House Assistant Majority Leader and Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.

text: Jil D. Bongalon kag ginhatagan punto nga ang lenguahe sang 1987 Constitution maathag nga ang impeachment trial dapat sugodan.
english: Jil D. Bongalon and pointed out that the language of the 1987 Constitution is clear that an impeachment trial must be commenced.

text: Ginpanindugan ni Bongalon nga ang probisyon sang Konstitusyon ang indi bukas sa interpretasyon ukon pagpaatrasar sini.
english: Bongalon insisted that the provision of the Constitution is not open to interpretation or delay.

text: Ginklaro sini nga mahimo mag-convene ang Senado bilang impeachment court bisan pa nga yara sa recess ang Kongreso kon magpasugot ang mga katapo sini.
english: He clarified that the Senate can convene as an impeachment court even when Congress is in recess if its members agree.

text: Nangin mabugnaw man si Bongalon sa ideya nga maghulat pa sang tatlo tubtob apat ka bulan antes magsugod ang pagbista.
