text: na plano ng pamahalaan na makapagbenta ng bente pesos na bigas sa 15 milyong households o 60 milyong Pilipino kabilang ang mga pamilya na nasa middle-income class.
english: that the government plans to sell 20 pesos of rice to 15 million households or 60 million Filipinos including families in the middle-income class.

text: Magtatakda din ang ahensiya ng buwanang limit na 10 kilong bigas na maaaring bilhin ng middle-class households, bagamat maaari aniya itong mapataas pa kalaunan.
english: The agency will also set a monthly limit of 10 kilos of rice that middle-class households can afford, although it can afford to raise it.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, tanging mga nasa vulnerable sectors gaya ng mga mahihirap o miyembro ng Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Progam (4Ps), senior citizen, persons with disability (PWDs), solo parents, at minimum wage earners ang maaaring bumili ng murang bigas.
english: Currently, only those in vulnerable sectors such as the poor or members of the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps), senior citizens, persons with disabilities (PWDs), solo parents, and minimum wage earners can afford to buy cheap rice.

text: Kung saan limitado sa 30 kilo ng bigas kada buwan ang maaaring bilhin ng mga benepisyaryo ng programa.
english: Where limited to 30 kilos of rice per month can be purchased by the beneficiaries of the program.

text: Paghigugma, paghimakas kag determinasyon ang nangin sentro sang prestihiyoso nga Mister and Miss University of San Agustin (USA) 2025.
english: Love, struggle and determination were the focus of the prestigious Mister and Miss University of San Agustin (USA) 2025.

text: Ini matapos ginkoronahan ang real-life couple nga sanday Matt Andrew Daniel Sy Española kag Vjan Ylsaia Gallinero sa diin wala lang sila naghimo sang pangalan sa maragtas sang unibersidad, kundi mas ginpapag-on pa nila ang ila love story.
english: This was after the crowning of real-life couple Matt Andrew Daniel Sy Española and Vjan Ylsaia Gallinero where they not only made a name in the history of the university, but they strengthened their love story.

text: Si Española, nga Medical Technology student sa College of Pharmacy and Medical Technology, tumandok sang General Santos City ang indi na bag-o sa mga pageant, bangud nakapasakop na siya sa kaangay nga kompetisyon sang high school.
english: Española, a Medical Technology student at the College of Pharmacy and Medical Technology, a native of General Santos City, is no stranger to pageants, having participated in similar competitions in high school.

text: Samtang, si Gallinero, nga Nursing student sa College of Nursing, Nutrition, and Dietetics, ang ginkoronahan na bilang Miss 46th Carabao Carroza Festival Queen sang 2018, sa edad nga 16.
english: Meanwhile, Gallinero, who is a Nursing student in the College of Nursing, Nutrition, and Dietetics, was already crowned Miss 46th Carabao Carroza Festival Queen in 2018, at the age of 16.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Gallinero, iya ginpahayag nga wala nangin mahapos ang iya pagkuha sang korona.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Gallinero said it was not easy for him to win the crown.

text: Sang 2022, nagpasakop na siya sa Mister at Miss USA, apang nagtapos lang bilang 1st runner-up.
english: In 2022, she had already participated in Mister at Miss USA, but only finished as 1st runner-up.

text: Sa pihak sang kahangawa, nagdesisyon siya nga magpasakop sa liwat kag matapos ang tatlo ka tuig, nagbunga ang iya pagtinguha.
english: Despite the anxiety, he decided to apply again and after three years, his efforts paid off.

text: Subong, bilang Miss USA 2025, katuyuan niya nga mangin inspirasyon sa iban samtang padayon nga ginatuman ang iya handom nga mangin isa ka registered nurse.
english: Now, as Miss USA 2025, she aims to inspire others while continuing to fulfill her dream of becoming a registered nurse.

text: Para naman kay Española, mas nangin espesyal ang iya kadalag-an bangud kaupod niya ang iya girlfriend nga nagdaog.
english: For Española, his victory was even more special because he was with his girlfriend who won.

text: Subong nga Mister USA 2025 na si Española, ginatutukan niya nga makatapos sa pagtuon agud mangin Medical Technologist kag sa ulihi, mangin isa ka doctor.
english: Now that Española is Mister USA 2025, he is focused on graduating to become a Medical Technologist and eventually, a doctor.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga magahatag sila nga power couple sang inspirasyon sa sulod kag gwa sang unibersidad.
english: He also assured that they will provide inspiration as a power couple inside and outside the university.

text: Gintal-usan ni Senator Robin Padilla si Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa bilang myembro sang Senate Committee on Accountability of Public Officers and Investigation.
english: Senator Robin Padilla replaced Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa as a member of the Senate Committee on Accountability of Public Officers and Investigation.

text: Ini bangud sa pagkakas kay Dela Rosa bangud sa wala sini pagtambong sa sesyon sa Senado halin pa sang Nobyembre sang nagligad tuig.
english: This is due to the dismissal of Dela Rosa for not attending the Senate session since November last year.

text: Ginpangunahan naman ni Senate Deputy Majority Leader JV Ejercito ang pagduso nga iboto si Padilla bilang committee nga parte sang isa ka Senate minority bloc.
english: Senate Deputy Majority Leader JV Ejercito led the push to vote for Padilla as a committee member of a Senate minority bloc.

text: Wala sang bisan sin o nga nag-object sa mga senador gani gilayon ini nga gin-aprubahan ni Senate President Vicente Sotto III.
english: No one objected to the senators so it was immediately approved by Senate President Vicente Sotto III.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala na nagatambong si Dela Rosa sa mga sesyon sa senado bangud sa pagpagwa sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sang arrest warrant batok sa iya.
english: Dela Rosa is no longer attending senate sessions due to the issuance of an arrest warrant against him by the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Nagapangatubang man ini sang kaso nga crimes against humanity kaangot sa iya papel sang tyempo ni anay President Rodrigo Duterte sa ila wala nagakaigo nga pagpatuman sang war on drugs.
english: He is also facing charges of crimes against humanity in connection with his role during the time of former President Rodrigo Duterte in their improper implementation of the war on drugs.

text: MAABTIK mag-una sa pagpabakuna sang Sinovac vaccine ang Philipine General Hospital (PGH) director sadtong nagligad nga inadlaw.
english: The Philippine General Hospital (PGH) director was quick to take the lead in vaccinating the Sinovac vaccine yesterday.

text: Indi lang seguro agud mapasalig niya ang iya mga tinawo nga wala sila dapat kakulbaan diri.
english: Not just to reassure his men that they had nothing to worry about.

text: Kundi tungod man seguro sa  pagpasugot sang 94 ka porsyento sang iya mga tinawo sa pre-registration sang pagpabakuna.
english: But also probably because of the consent of 94 percent of his staff to the pre-registration of vaccination.

text: Ugaling kay nagpasugot lang gali sila tungod sa pagpati nga ang ihatag sa ila nga bakuna amo ang may mataas nga kalidad nga makapaseguro sa ila sing lubos nga pagpakigbatu sa COVID-19 virus samtang ginaatubang ang risgo nila sa sining makalalaton nga balatian.
english: However, they agreed because they believed that the vaccine they would be given would be of high quality that would ensure them a full fight against the COVID-19 virus while facing their risk of this infectious disease.

text: Sang mahibal-an ugaling nila nga Sinovac vaccine ang ihatag sa ila nga may 50 ka porsyento lang nga “efficacy”, nagreklamo sila kag nagpahayag ang mga 95 percent sa ila sang indi na pagpasugot.
english: When they learned that the Sinovac vaccine would be given to them with only 50 percent efficacy, they complained and about 95 percent of them expressed their disapproval.

text: Diri sa Iloilo City, sunu sa aton palangga nga senador nga si Franklin Drilon, 15 percent lang gani ang luyag magpabakuna sa Sinovac vaccine.
english: Here in Iloilo City, according to our beloved senator Franklin Drilon, only 15 percent want to be vaccinated with the Sinovac vaccine.

text: Tuod man, kon may yara man lang nga mas masaligan nga bakuna, nga abe didto ka gid sa mahina ang epekto?
english: Indeed, if there were a more reliable vaccine, would you be there for the weaker effect?

text: Ano ka lipong nga bangros!
english: What a dizzy bangros!

text: Okey man lang seguro ina nga medyo mahina ang epekto basta indi ka madisgrasya.
english: I guess that's okay with a little weak effect as long as you don't get hurt.

text: Tutal may Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) man ang Sinovac vaccine, bisan mahina ini, sang World Health Organization (WHO) kag sang Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
english: After all, the Sinovac vaccine has Emergency Use Authorization (EUA), albeit weak, by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

text: Pero sin-o sina ugaling ang makapasalig kay pang-emergency lang gani ining una nga mga bakuna?
english: But who can guarantee that these first vaccines are only for emergencies?

text: Problema pa gid kay indi masaligan ang China sa ginasugid sini.
english: The problem is that China cannot be trusted in what it says.

text: Kilala ini sa kalibutan sa pagtagu sang kamatuoran sa madamo nga bagay.
english: It is known in the world for hiding the truth in many things.

text: Mahuyog ini sa cover-up nga daw wais nga isda nga indi luyag mahulik sang taga sa baba!
english: It tends to cover-up like a fish that doesn't want to be caught by the mouthpiece!

text: Samtang ang iban nga bakuna – katulad sang Pfizer, Moderna kag Astra Zeneca nga mataas ang “efficacy” – hayag sa publiko ang resulta sang ila pangbakuna, nga ginahimo na sa karon sa minilyon nga pumuluyo sa United States kag Uropa.
english: While other vaccines – such as the highly efficacious Pfizer, Moderna and Astra Zeneca – are publicly available, the results of their vaccinations are now being administered to millions of people in the United States and Europe.

text: Tungod sini, nahibal-an dayon sa nag-boluntad sa pagpabakuna kon ano ang kondisyon sang tawo nga hilway ukon indi sa peligro sang pagbakuna.
english: Because of this, the person who volunteered to be vaccinated knows immediately what the condition of the person is free or not from the risk of vaccination.

text: Kag, kon may malain nga matabo, mahibal-an man dayon kag matudlo kon ano ang rason nga dapat likawan sa masunod nga pagbakuna kag kon ano ang mahimo dayon nga remedyo.
english: And, if something bad happens, it will be immediately known and taught what the reason should be avoided in the next vaccination and what can be immediately remedied.

text: Bentaha ini sa aton diri sa Filipinas kay ulihi kita nga nakabaton sang bakuna, kon diin dapat ipaathag gid sing maayo sang aton mga health authorities kon sin-o ang pwede kag indi magpabakuna.
english: This is an advantage for us here in the Philippines because we are the last to receive the vaccine, where our health authorities should explain very well who can and cannot be vaccinated.

text: Kon luyag ta pa ma-testingan ang posible nga epekto sang bakuna sa mga Filipino diri mismo sa pungsod, kita sa ining aton kolum nag-rekomendar na gani sa isa ka edisyon sang aton kolum sang nagligad nga unahon bakuna ang pila ka soldado kag pulis – sa nagakaigu nga kadamuon – para mahibal-an kon sin-o ang dapat bakunahan ukon indi.
english: If we want to test the possible effect of the vaccine on Filipinos here in the country, we in this column have already recommended in a previous edition of our column to vaccinate some soldiers and police – in appropriate numbers – to determine who should be vaccinated or not.

text: Tutal pwede man sila mag-boluntad sa ngalan sang ila obligasyon sa pag-risgo sang ila kabuhi para sa mga pumuluyo.
english: After all, they can volunteer in the name of their obligation to risk their lives for the people.

text: May ara pa gani sila sing suicide commando, indi bala?/PN
english: They even have a suicide commando, right?/PN

text: Nagbalos si former President Rodrigo Duterte matapos ang sunod-sunod nga mga pagpalagtik nga ginhimo ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte retaliated after a series of attacks by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa mga campaign rally para sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: at campaign rallies for the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa indignation rally sa Mandaue City, Cebu, Pebrero 22, kun sa diin personal nga nagtambong ang anay punong ehekutibo kaupod ang iya mga gina-endorso nga mga kandidato sa pagka-senador, ginsiling sini nga antes magtakop ang termino ni Marcos sa 2028, magapatuman ini sang martial law.
english: At an indignation rally in Mandaue City, Cebu, February 22, where the former chief executive personally attended along with his endorsed senatorial candidates, he said that before Marcos' term ends in 2028, he will implement martial law.

text: Suno kay Duterte, ilugon ni President Marcos ang ginhimo ni former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english: According to Duterte, President Marcos will imitate the example of former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: para magarantiya nga wala sang eleksyon kag mapalawig pa ang iya pagtinir sa Malacañang.
english: to guarantee that there will be no elections and to extend his stay in Malacañang.

text: ”Si Mr. Marcos is veering towards a dictatorship.
english: ”See Mr. Marcos is veering towards a dictatorship.

text: Mo pusta ko sa inyo, dili na manaog pagkahuman sa iyang termino.
english: I bet you, he won't step down after his term.

text: Pareha na sa iyang tatay, magkagubot na pud ta because ang iyang buhaton mag-declare na pud ug martial law pareho sa iyang papa.
english: Like his father, we'll be in trouble because what he'll do is declare martial law like his father.

text: ‘Pag martial law, walay eleksyon,” suno kay Duterte.
english: 'If martial law, no elections,' Duterte said.

text: Madumduman nga sang Septyembre 1972 sang nagdeklarar ang amay nga Marcos sang martial law kag nagpabilin sa opisina bilang presidentE sang pungsod tubtub nga napahalin ini paagi sa EDSA People Power Revolution sang Pebrero 1986.
english: It can be recalled that in September 1972, Marcos declared martial law and remained in office as president of the country until he was ousted through the EDSA People Power Revolution in February 1986.

text: Sa iya speech, naghingyo man ang former president sa militar kag pulis nga maghimo sang moral decisions kag indi pagsakyan ang ambisyon sang isa ka tawo.
english: In his speech, the former president also urged the military and police to make moral decisions and not ride on the ambition of one person.

text: Duha lamang ang pilian sang soldado kag pulis suno kay Duterte nga amo ang sayop kag ang matarong.
english: Duterte said the soldier and police have only two choices, the wrong and the right.

text: ”Kamong mga sundalo ug pulis paminaw mo, kanang ambition sa usa ka tao ayaw mo ug pagsakay kay madugay o madali matapos man gyud na, unya illegal mana.
english: "You soldiers and police listen, that ambition of a person do not ride because sooner or later it will end, then it is illegal.

text: Pamili mo, duha ra mana, naay sayop, naay tama,” dugang sini sa iya nga speech.
english: Choose, there are only two, there is wrong, there is right,” he added in his speech.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, gintawag man ni Duterte si Marcos nga bangag kag nagagamit sang iligal nga droga.
english: Last week, Duterte also called Marcos a bastard and a drug user.

text: Nagbalos man si President Marcos kag nagsiling nga ang iya mga kandidato ang wala naga-apin kag nagahugyaw para sa China, wala naga-akto bilang sakristan sa sala nga propeta nga may kaso sa pagpang-abuso, wala nagpangbulsa sang kuwarta sang gobyerno sang may pandemya, kag wala sang mantsa sang dugo ang ila mga kamot sa war on drugs.#
english: President Marcos also retaliated and said that his candidates do not defend and cheer for China, do not act as priests in the wrong prophet with a case of abuse, did not pocket government money during the pandemic, and have no blood stain on their hands in the war on drugs.

text: Nagtukod ang Commission on Elections (Comelec) sang isa ka task force sa pag-regulate sang mga survey firms sa tion sang eleksyon para sa 2025 midterm polls.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has set up a task force to regulate survey firms during the election period for the 2025 midterm polls.

text: Antes sini, ang poll body nag-anunsyo sang Huwebes nga ang tanan nga mga survey firms dapat na nga marehistro sa poll body.
english: Earlier, the poll body had announced on Thursday that all survey firms must now be registered with the poll body.

text: Gin-aprubahan sang poll body ang Resolution No.
english: The poll body approved Resolution No.

text: 11117 sa ila regular nga en banc session sang Pebrero 19 para sa sini nga katuyuan.
english: 11117 at their regular en banc session on February 19 for this purpose.

text: Karon, sa isa ka memorandum nga napetsahan Pebrero 21, gintukod ni Comelec Chairman George Garcia ang Task Force Regulation and Enforcement of Survey Practices for Election Credibility and Transparency (Task Force RESPECT).
english: Now, in a memorandum dated February 21, Comelec Chairman George Garcia established the Task Force Regulation and Enforcement of Survey Practices for Election Credibility and Transparency (Task Force RESPECT).

text: Ang task force ang gin-assign nga mag-facilitate sang reporting mechanism sang mga survey firms sa Comelec kag i-publish ang ila findings sa Comelec website.
english: The task force is assigned to facilitate the reporting mechanism of survey firms to the Comelec and publish their findings on the Comelec website.

text: Gintugyanan man ini sa pag-orient sa mga survey firms, individual pollsters kag sa publiko nahanungod sa Comelec Resolution No.
english: It was also tasked with orienting survey firms, individual pollsters and the public regarding Comelec Resolution No.

text: 11117 kag Republic Act No.
english: 11117 and Republic Act No.

text: 9006 ukon ang Fair Election Act.
english: 9006 or the Fair Election Act.

text:
Dugang pa, ang grupo maga-uyat kag maga-imbestigar sang mga reklamo may kaangtanan sa “improper or inappropriate publication of election-related surveys.”

Nahibaluan nga si Director Efraim Bag-id, pinuno sang Comelec Political Finance and Affairs Department ang maga-chair sang task force.
english:
In addition, the group will handle and investigate complaints related to “improper or inappropriate publication of election-related surveys.”

Director Efraim Bag-id, head of the Comelec Political Finance and Affairs Department, will chair the task force.

text: Ginatinghuwaan sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Region 6 nga lab-oton ang vlogger nga nagreklamo sa taxi driver bangud sa ginapahayag wala sang metro kag nagsukot sang P600 nga plete.
english: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Region 6 is trying to reach the vlogger who complained to the taxi driver because he allegedly did not have a meter and charged P600 fare.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Salvador Altura, Director sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga lain ang statement nga nagaguwa sa bahin sang vlogger kasunod man sang ginpaguwa nga statement sang moderator sang taxi driver.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Salvador Altura, Director of the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board Region 6, said that the statement issued by the vlogger follows the statement issued by the moderator of the taxi driver.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, gin-require niya nga magpasa sang narration of evidence ang operator sang taxi agud nga matumod kon magapatuman full pledge investigation.
english: Garbanzos said he required the taxi operator to submit a narration of evidence to determine whether to conduct a full pledge investigation.

text: Kon matigayon naman nga mag-progress ang imbestigasyon, i-require man ang vlogger nga magpasa sang iya nga pormal nga reklamo.
english: If the investigation progresses, the vlogger will be required to file a formal complaint.

text: Sa karon, nagakoordinar na sila sa vlogger agud nga mabutang sa legal ang ginareklamo sini sa iya man nga video.
english: They are now coordinating with the vlogger to legalize his complaint in his video.

text: Sa amo nga vlog ni Mamita Lakwatsera, ginsiling sini nga makahuluya ang ginhimo sang taxi driver nga ginsukot siya sang P600 halin sa Iloilo City padulong sa airport sa Cabatuan kag wala naggamit sang taxi meter.
english: In her vlog, Mamita Lakwatsera said it was shameful that the taxi driver charged her P600 from Iloilo City to the airport in Cabatuan and did not use a taxi meter.

text: Ginpatay sang tropa sang Russia ang isa ka American journalist nga yara sa Irpin, Kyiv region sa Ukraine.
english: Russian troops killed an American journalist who was in the Irpin, Kyiv region in Ukraine.

text: Ginkilala ang biktima nga si Brent Renaud, 50, nga nagtrabaho anay sa New York Times.
english: The victim was identified as Brent Renaud, 50, who formerly worked for the New York Times.

text: Suno sa statement sang The Times, isa ka talented photographer kag filmmaker ang lalaki nga naka-contribute sa The New York Times sa sulod sang malawig nga mga tinuig.
english: According to a statement from The Times, the man is a talented photographer and filmmaker who has contributed to The New York Times for many years.

text: Apang suno sa The Times, wala ini gin-assign sang amo nga media company para sa coverage sa Ukraine apisar nga nakasuksok ang biktima sang Times press badge sang adlaw nga ginpatay ini.
english: But according to The Times, he was not assigned by that media company for coverage in Ukraine despite the fact that the victim was wearing a Times press badge on the day he was killed.

text: Sandig naman sa anunsyo sang police department sang Kyiv, ginpatay ang amo nga American freelance filmmaker samtang nagahanda nga mag-film sa mga refugees nga nagatabok sa border sa amo nga pungsod.
english: According to the Kyiv police department, the American freelance filmmaker was killed while preparing to film refugees crossing the border into the country.

text: Suno sa pulis, nagasakay si Renaud sa salakyan kaupod ang iban pa nga journalists sang nagpalupok ang Russian troops.
english: Police said Renaud was riding in a car with other journalists when Russian troops opened fire.

text: May yara pa sang isa ka napilasan nga journalist nga wala man ginhingadlan.
english: There was another injured journalist who was also not named.

text: Magaserbi bilang salog ukon flooring sang extension stages sang Dinagyang Festival 2025 ang board ukon plywood nga human sa recycled plastics.
english: The board or plywood made of recycled plastics will serve as the flooring of the extension stages of the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, head sang Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO), iya ginpahayag nga ang gingamit nga plastic sa amo nga plywood ang naghalin gid sa mga basura.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, head of the Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO), said the plastic used in the plywood came from garbage.

text: Suno kay Ravena, low density waste nga plastic ang ginhimo nga plywood kon sa diin, ginpaidalom sa ‘upcycle’ rason nga gintawag man nga eco board.
english: According to Ravena, low density waste plastic was made into plywood which was subjected to upcycle and was also called eco board.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga ginakonsiderar man sang ila talatapan nga ang tanan nga matipon nga plastic sa Dinagyang Festival ang ipadala sa nagahimo sang eco board agud magamit.
english: He also said that their office is also considering that all the plastic collected during the Dinagyang Festival will be sent to the eco board manufacturer for use.

text: Nagapati man si Ravena nga mas durable ang amo nga plywood kon ikumparar sa typical nga plywood nga madasig maggabok.
english: Ravena also believes that the plywood is more durable compared to typical plywood that rots quickly.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapadala pa sa Manila ang makolekta nga mga plastic agud nga iproseso antes mangin isa ka eco board.
english: The collected plastics are still being sent to Manila to be processed before becoming an eco board.

text: Ginaplano naman sang GSO nga magkuha sang mga low density plastic halin sa Calajunan Landfill agud nga ipadala man sa Manila kag iproseso.
english: The GSO plans to collect low density plastics from the Calajunan Landfill to be sent to Manila for processing.

text: Umpisahan sang Department of Health (DOH) ang “Alas Kwatro, Kontra Mosquito!” campaign sa Lunes, Pebrero 24, bilang parte sang mas masangkad nga kampanya kaupod ang government agencies kontra sa dengue sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) will launch the “Four O'clock, Against Mosquitoes!” campaign on Monday, February 24, as part of a broader campaign with government agencies against dengue throughout the Philippines.

text: Suno sa ahensya, magasugod ang “Nationwide Search and Destroy Mosquito Breeding Sites Campaign” alas kuwatro sang hapon.
english: According to the agency, the “Nationwide Search and Destroy Mosquito Breeding Sites Campaign” will begin at 4 pm.

text: Gina-engganyo ang mga komunidad nga manglimpyo sa mga gina-istaran sang lamok agud makalikaw sa pagdugang sang kaso.
english: Communities are encouraged to clean mosquito breeding grounds to avoid an increase in cases.

text: Sa Iloilo, partikular nga na-mensyonar ang Barangay Bolong Oeste, Sta.
english: In Iloilo, Barangay Bolong Oeste, Sta.

text: Barbara kag ang banwa sang San Dionisio nga nagakinahanglan sang partisipasyon sang publiko.
english: Barbara and the town of San Dionisio which requires public participation.

text: Sa latest data sang ahensya, may 28,234 dengue cases sa pungsod halin sang January 1 tubtub sang February 1 nga may 40% increase ipaanggid sa amo man nga period sang 2024.
english: According to the agency's latest data, there were 28,234 dengue cases in the country from January 1 to February 1, a 40% increase compared to the same period in 2024.

text: Base naman sa latest record sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO), nalapawan na ang alert kag epidemic thresholds sa dengue nga buot silingon nagakinahanglan sang madasig nga intervention.
english: Based on the latest record of the Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO), the alert and epidemic thresholds for dengue have been exceeded which means it requires immediate intervention.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Socorro Colmenares-Quiñon, head sang IPHO, iya ginpahayag nga halin sang Enero 1-Pebrero 15, naka-rekord ang probinsya sang 592 dengue cases kun sa diin lima ang patay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Maria Socorro Colmenares-Quiñon, head of the IPHO, said that from January 1 to February 15, the province recorded 592 dengue cases with five deaths.

text: May 77% ini nga pagsaka ipaanggid sa record sang 2024 nga may 335 cases kag isa ka patay sang amo man nga period.
english: This is a 77% increase compared to the 2024 record of 335 cases and one death in the same period.

text: Ang mga banwa nga may nagapanguna nga numero sang kaso amo ang Leon (33), Oton (32, isa ang patay), San Joaquin (32), Dumangas (31), Cabatuan (28), Lambunao (24), San Dionisio (23), Banate (20), Janiuay (19), kag Tigbauan (19, isa ang patay).
english: The towns with the highest number of cases are Leon (33), Oton (32, one death), San Joaquin (32), Dumangas (31), Cabatuan (28), Lambunao (24), San Dionisio (23), Banate (20), Janiuay (19), and Tigbauan (19, one death).

text: Nagapamintana na sa North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) ang pagpang-atake nga ginhimo sang Russia sa isa ka daku nga military base sang Ukraine nga nahamtang malapit sa border sang Poland, isa ka pungsod nga myembro sang amo nga Western defense alliance.
english: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) is already concerned about Russia's attack on a large Ukrainian military base located near the border with Poland, a member of the Western defense alliance.

text: Sandig sa statement sang local officials, ang missile attack nga ginpatigayon sang Russia sa Yavoriv International Center for Peacekeeping and Security ang nagpatay sa 35 ka mga tawo.
english: According to a statement by local officials, the missile attack carried out by Russia on the Yavoriv International Center for Peacekeeping and Security killed 35 people.

text: Pilason naman ang 134 ka iban pa nga indibidwal.
english: 134 other individuals were injured.

text: Kun basehan naman ang statement sang defense ministry sang Russia, ginpahayag nga ginguba sang air strike ang dalagku nga weapons nga ginasuplay sang iban nga mga pungsod.
english: According to a statement from the Russian defense ministry, the air strike destroyed heavy weapons supplied by other countries.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Russia nga ila napatay ang 180 ka foreign soldiers.
english: Russia also said it had killed 180 foreign soldiers.

text: Ang amo nga military base ang nahamtang may kalayuon nga 25 kilometros lang halin sa border sang Poland.
english: The military base is located just 25 kilometers from the Polish border.

text: Diri nga base ginpatigayon sang Ukraine ang ila nga drills kaupod ang mga pungsod sang Western defense alliance antes pa man natabo ang Russian invasion.
english: It was here that Ukraine conducted its drills with Western defense alliance countries before the Russian invasion.

text: Una naman nga nagpaandam ang Russia nga ang convoy sang Western countries nga nagakarga sang mga armas kag shipments sa Ukraine amo ang posible ma-konsiderar nga lehitimo nga mga target.
english: Russia earlier warned that convoys of Western countries carrying weapons and shipments to Ukraine could be considered legitimate targets.

text: Nag-react diri ang iban nga mga pungsod.
english: Other countries reacted to this.

text: Suno sa Britanya, ang amo nga insidente ang posible suguran sang isa ka “significant escalation” sang gamo batok sa Russia.
english: According to Britain, the incident could trigger a "significant escalation" of violence against Russia.

text: Suno naman sa Estados Unidos paagi kay White House national security adviser Jake Sullivan, kun atakehon ang bisan isa lang ka teritoryo sang NATO, magabato kag magabalos ang bilog nga alyansa sang NATO.
english: According to the United States through White House national security adviser Jake Sullivan, if even one NATO territory is attacked, the entire NATO alliance will fight back.

text: Nadala na pauli sa Pilipinas ang bangkay sang isa ka overseas Filipino worker (OFW) sa Kuwait matapos nasapwan ini nga nalubong sa ugsaran sang nagligad nga Disyembre 2024.
english: The body of an overseas Filipino worker (OFW) in Kuwait has been brought back to the Philippines after it was found buried in the yard last December 2024.

text: Suno sa Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), dal-on ang bangkay ni Dafnie Nacalaban sa balay sang iya pamilya sa ila probinsya para nga makaupod man sini ang iya mga himata sa ulihi nga tion.
english: According to the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), Dafnie Nacalaban's body will be taken to her family's home in their province so that she can be with her relatives at a later time.

text: Ang 35-anyos nga Pinay ang tumandok sang Cagayan de Oro apang naga-istar na sa Zamboanga del Sur kaupod ang iya partner kag 14-anyos nga bata.
english: The 35-year-old Filipina is a native of Cagayan de Oro but now lives in Zamboanga del Sur with her partner and 14-year-old child.

text: Nag-trabaho si Nacalaban bilang household service worker sa Kuwait halin sang Disyembre 2019, apang gin-report sang iya ikaduha nga employer nga na-missing sadtong Oktubre 2024.
english: Nacalaban worked as a household service worker in Kuwait since December 2019, but was reported missing by her second employer in October 2024.

text: Disyembre 31 sang amo man nga tuig sang nakit-an ang lawas sini nga yara sa advanced state of decomposition sa balay sang isa pa ka Kuwaiti national sa Saad Al-Abdullah, Jahra.
english: On December 31 of the same year, his body was found in an advanced state of decomposition at the house of another Kuwaiti national in Saad Al-Abdullah, Jahra.

text: Padayon ang pagpakig-angot sang Department of Foreign Affairs, Department of Migrant Workers, Overseas Workers Welfare Administration, kag Embahada sang Pilipinas sa Kuwait sa mga awtoridad para masiguro nga mahatagan sang hustisya ang kamatayon sini.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs, Department of Migrant Workers, Overseas Workers Welfare Administration, and the Philippine Embassy in Kuwait are continuing to liaise with the authorities to ensure that justice is done to his death.

text: Nahibaluan nga madamo na nga OFWs ang napatay sa Kuwait lakip sanday Jullebee Ranara nga ginsunog kag nasapwan sa disyerto sang 2023; Joanna Demafelis nga ginpatay kag ginsulod sa freezer sang iya employers sang 2018; Constancia Lago Dayag nga ginpatay man sang iya employer sang May 2019; kag Jeanelyn Villavende nga ginpatay man sang iya ama sang Disyembre 2019 bangud sa pagpangimon.
english: It is known that many OFWs have died in Kuwait including Jullebee Ranara who was burned and found in the desert in 2023; Joanna Demafelis who was murdered and stuffed into a freezer by her employers in 2018; Constancia Lago Dayag who was also killed by her employer in May 2019; and Jeanelyn Villavende who was also killed by her father in December 2019 out of jealousy.

text: Ini nga mga insidente ang nagtulod sa deployment ban, apang bangud sa mga negosasyon, na-lift ang ban sang 2020 kag gintugutan liwat ang mga Pinoy nga mag-trabaho sa amo nga pungsod sa Middle East.
english: These incidents prompted the deployment ban, but due to negotiations, the ban was lifted in 2020 and Filipinos were again allowed to work in the Middle Eastern country.

text: Bangud sa pinakaulihi nga mga insidente, ginsiling sang DMW nga ginakonsiderar liwat ang pagbalik sang deployment ban sa amo nga nasyon.
english: In light of the latest incidents, the DMW said it is reconsidering the reinstatement of the deployment ban in that country.

text: Nag-updanay ang Pilipinas kag France sa military drills sa West Philippine Sea, Pebrero 21.
english: The Philippines and France joined military drills in the West Philippine Sea, February 21.

text: Nag-upod sa maritime cooperation activity ang aircraft carrier sang French Navy nga Charles De Gaulle, Fregate Europeenne Multi-Mission Destroyer Provence, Force Supply Vessel Jacques Chevallier, Air Defense Destroyer Forbin, kag Aquitaine-class frigate Alsace.
english: Joining the maritime cooperation activity were French Navy aircraft carrier Charles De Gaulle, Fregate Europeenne Multi-Mission Destroyer Provence, Force Supply Vessel Jacques Chevallier, Air Defense Destroyer Forbin, and Aquitaine-class frigate Alsace.

text: Sa bahin sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), ginpadala ang BRP Jose Rizal, BRP Gregorio del Pilar, C90 aircraft kag duha ka FA50s.
english: On the part of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), BRP Jose Rizal, BRP Gregorio del Pilar, C90 aircraft and two FA50s were sent.

text: Suno kay AFP Chief General Romeo Brawner, Jr., tuyo sini nga drill nga mapapag-on ang depensa sang militar kag makapreparar nga masabat ang nagkalain-lain nga pagpanghangkat sa seguridad sang pungsod sa modern nga panahon.
english: AFP Chief General Romeo Brawner, Jr. said the drill aims to strengthen the military's defenses and prepare it to meet the various security challenges of the country in modern times.

text: “Through joint maritime cooperative activities and collaborative efforts, the AFP seeks to build a stronger, more resilient defense system that is prepared to address the challenges of the modern security landscape,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “Through joint maritime cooperative activities and collaborative efforts, the AFP seeks to build a stronger, more resilient defense system that is prepared to address the challenges of the modern security landscape,” part of the statement.

text: Ginhimo ini nga bilateral activity samtang ginapadayon pa ang negosasyon sa visiting forces agreement (VFA) sa tunga sang Manila kag Paris.
english: This was done as a bilateral activity while negotiations on the visiting forces agreement (VFA) between Manila and Paris are still ongoing.

text: Paagi sa sini nga kasugtanan, matugutan ang military training kag operasyon kag mas daku nga joint exercises sa tunga sang duha ka nasyon.
english: Through this agreement, military training and operations and larger joint exercises between the two countries will be allowed.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2024, sa labing-una nga tion, nagpasakop ang France sa four-day joint patrol sa West Philippine Sea kadungan sang tuigan nga Balikatan exercises sang Pilipinas kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: In 2024, for the first time, France will participate in a four-day joint patrol in the West Philippine Sea in conjunction with the annual Balikatan exercises of the Philippines and the United States of America.

text: Going strong ang relasyon nanday Andi Eigenmann kag partner sini nga si Philmar Alipayo matapos ang drama nga natabo sini lang nga bulan.
english: The relationship between Andi Eigenmann and her partner Philmar Alipayo is going strong after the drama that happened this month.

text: Sa reel nga gin-share sang Island Tattoo Piercing Studio, nakit-an sanday Andi kag Philmar nga Dungan nga nagpa-tattoo.
english: In the reel shared by Island Tattoo Piercing Studio, Andi and Philmar were seen getting tattoos together.

text: “What an absolute honor to turn @andieigengirl stories into lasting art.
english: “What an absolute honor to turn @andieigengirl stories into lasting art.

text: Another tattoo sessions with the power couple @andieigengirl & @chepoxz we couldn’t be more stoked to have them back together with Lilo & Koa,” kabahin sang post.
english: Another tattoo sessions with the power couple @andieigengirl & @chepoxz we couldn’t be more stoked to have them back together with Lilo & Koa,” the post read.

text: Antes ang Valentine’s Day, matandaan nga nangin kontrobersyal ang relasyon sang duha bangud sa sunod-sunod nga cryptic stories sang aktres kag pag-unfollow nila sa isa kag isa sa social media.
english: Before Valentine's Day, the relationship between the two became controversial due to the actress' cryptic stories and unfollowing each other on social media.

text:
Sang ulihi, ginklaro ni Andi nga wala nag-cheat si Philmar apang naglain ang iya buot bangud nagpabutang ini sang couple tattoo kaupod sa iya long-time friend nga si Pernilla Sjoo.Ang tattoo design nanday Philmar kag Pernilla amo ang “224” nga buot silingon “Today, Tomorrow, and Forever.”

Pagkatapos sadto, nag-update ang champion surfer nga “okay” na sila sang aktres.
english:
Later, Andi clarified that Philmar did not cheat but was upset because he had a couple tattoo with his long-time friend Pernilla Sjoo. The tattoo design of Philmar and Pernilla is “224” which means “Today, Tomorrow, and Forever.”

After that, the champion surfer updated that he and the actress are “okay”.

text: Magkaupod man sila nga nagselebrar sang Valentine’s Day kun sa diin ginsorpresa pa ni Philmar si Andi sang improvised bouquet of flowers nga may puso sang saging.
english: They also celebrated Valentine's Day together where Philmar even surprised Andi with an improvised bouquet of flowers with a banana heart.

text: Indi na magpasaka sang kaso ang nagapanag-iya sang balay nga gin-arado sang isa ka van sa Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The owner of a house that was plowed by a van in Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City will not file a case.

text: Ang driver sang van amo si Jerry Tolentino Gonzales, 53-anyos, kag residente sang Ledesma St.
english: The driver of the van was identified as Jerry Tolentino Gonzales, 53, and resident of Ledesma St.

text: Pototan, Iloilo.
english: Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Liezel Turba, tag-iya sang balay, iya ginpahayag nga naghumok ang iya tagipusuon kasunod sang paghayo sang driver sa iya nga P70,000 na lang iya ibayad bangud sa ginapangatubang man sini nga problema.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Liezel Turba, the owner of the house, said her heart softened after the driver asked her to pay only P70,000 because of the problem she was facing.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang driver sang van kag ang nagbunggo-patay sa duha ka mga babaye sa Tubigan, Zarraga ang isa lang.
english: It was learned that the driver of the van and the one who hit and killed the two women in Tubigan, Zarraga are the same.

text: Suno kay Turba, una nga ginsukot nila sang P80,000 ang driver apang nag-hayo ini nga P70,000 lamang ang iya masarangan nga mabayaran.
english: According to Turba, they initially charged the driver P80,000 but he pleaded that he could only afford to pay P70,000.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga tuman ang pagpakitluoy sang pamilya sang driver nga mag-areglo na lang kasunod man sang mga kaso nga ginapangatubang sini kasunod sang pagkapatay sang duha ka mga babaye sa Zarraga.
english: He also said that the family of the driver is pleading with him to settle following the cases he is facing following the death of two women in Zarraga.

text: Kon balikan, ginpahayag sang Zarraga Municipal Police Station nga nag-panic ang driver matapos nga na-arado ang balay rason nga nadalasa sini ang duha ka babaye nga nagasakay sa motorsiklo.
english: The Zarraga Municipal Police Station said the driver panicked after the house was plowed and hit two women on a motorcycle.

text: Matapos magluntad ang insidente, gilayon nga nanaog sa van ang driver kag nagsakay sa tricycle agud magpadulong sa Leganes Municipal Police Station kag didto magsungka.
english: After the incident, the driver immediately got out of the van and boarded a tricycle to go to the Leganes Municipal Police Station and surrender there.

text: Gilayon naman nga gin-turnover naman sang Leganes MPS sa Zarraga MPS ang driver sang van.
english: Leganes MPS immediately turned over the driver of the van to Zarraga MPS.

text: Ginhabulan sang madamol nga abo ang mga malapit nga pamalay sa Mount Merapi volcano nga nahamtang sa Java Island sa Indonesia nga amo ang naglupok sang Marso 10.
english: Heavy ash covered nearby homes in the Mount Merapi volcano on Indonesia's Java Island that erupted on March 10.

text: Masobra sa 250 ka mga indibidwal ang gin-evacuate kasunod sang volcanic eruption kag subong temporaryo nga nagatinir sa split type villages control nga kaangay sang Glagaharjo kag Umbulharjo sa Yogyakarta province kag Central Java’s Klaten district.
english: More than 250 individuals were evacuated following the volcanic eruption and are now temporarily staying in split type villages control similar to Glagaharjo and Umbulharjo in Yogyakarta province and Central Java’s Klaten district.

text: Ang Mount Merapi ang pinakaaktibo sa masobra 300 ka mga bulkan sa Indonesia.
english: Mount Merapi is the most active of more than 300 volcanoes in Indonesia.

text: Nagadangat naman sa 76-100 sa 300 ka mga bulkan ang makabig nga aktibo.
english: About 76-100 of the 300 volcanoes are considered active.

text: Ang Mt.
english: The Mt.

text:
Merapi ang kilala man sa tawag nga “Mountain of Fire” nga naghalin sa Javanese combined words nga “Meru,” nga nagakahulugan sang “mountain,” kag “api,” nga ang meaning “fire.”

Wala naman sang narekord nga napatay ukon nasamaran sa amo nga paglupok sang bulkan.
english:
Merapi is also known as the “Mountain of Fire” which comes from the Javanese combined words “Meru,” which means “mountain,” and “api,” which means “fire.”

No casualties were reported in the eruption.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Ginavella Limpin Cumla,– direkta sa Indonesia, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa paglupok sang bulkan, ila nahibaluan kun ano ka kadasig ang pagresponde sang Indonesian government sa amo nga kalamidad.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Ginavella Limpin Cumla, – directly in Indonesia, she said that because of the volcanic eruption, they know how quickly the Indonesian government responded to the disaster.

text: May yara na na suno sa iya sang plano ang gobyerno kag mahapos man nga mapasunod ang mga residente.
english: He said the government already has a plan and it is easy for the residents to follow it.

text: Suno kay Cumla, indi man mapahalin ang mga residente sa lugar nga malapit sa bulkan bangud tuman ini ka tahom kag makabig nga tourist attraction.
english: According to Cumla, residents cannot be evacuated from the area near the volcano because it is very beautiful and considered a tourist attraction.

text: Apang suno kay Cumla, kun may yara sang alert status ang bulkan, pila man sa mga residente ang nagadesisyon nga una na nga mag-evacuate bangud sa kahangawa nga maglala ukon mangin mabaskog ang volcanic eruption.
english: However, Cumla said that if the volcano has an alert status, some residents decide to evacuate earlier because of fears that the volcanic eruption will worsen or become stronger.

text: Kun maobserba sang mga otoridad nga posible magdako ang paglupok sang bulkan, ginasirado na ang access sa lugar sa kalayuon nga 8km-12 km.
english: If the authorities observe that the volcano is likely to erupt, access to the area is closed at a distance of 8km-12 km.

text: Sa nauna na nga mga volcanic eruptions, nagalab-ot sa kapin 12 km ang pag-ilig sang lava halin sa bulkan.
english: In previous volcanic eruptions, lava has flowed more than 12 km from the volcano.

text: May yara man suno kay Cumla sang ginapatigayon nga volcanic observatory malapit sa bulkan agud nga ma-obserbahan ang movement ukon kondisyon sini sa tagsa ka adlaw.
english: Cumla said there is also a volcanic observatory being conducted near the volcano to observe its movement or condition every day.

text: Ang ulihi nga pinakadako nga paglupok sang Mt.
english: The last largest eruption of Mt.

text: Merapi ang natabo sang 2010 nga nagpatay sang 347 ka mga indibidwal kag nagtuga sang evacuation sa 20,000 ka mga residente sang lugar.
english: Merapi occurred in 2010 which killed 347 individuals and caused the evacuation of 20,000 residents of the area.

text: Mangin carousel type ang performance sang mga kabanwahanan sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The performance of the municipalities in the Dinagyang Festival 2025 will be carousel type.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alfonso Baldonado, Program Director sang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan, iya ginpahayag nga kapareho sa gihapon ang dalagan sang kompetisyon sa nagligad nga tuig kon sa diin, magadungan sila perform sa pagbukas sang kompetisyon sa Freedom Grandstand.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alfonso Baldonado, Program Director of Kasadyahan sa Babanwahan, said the competition will be the same as last year where they will perform together at the opening of the competition at the Freedom Grandstand.

text: Suno kay Baldonado, magasugod sa nasambit nga judging area ang una nga tatlo ka mga tribu nga amo ang tribe number 1 nga Banaag Festival sang Anilao, tribe number 2 nga Kaing Festial sang Leon, kag tribe number 3 nga Tawili Festival sang San Rafael .
english: According to Baldonado, the first three tribes will start in the judging area, namely tribe number 1, Banaag Festival of Anilao, tribe number 2, Kaing Festival of Leon, and tribe number 3, Tawili Festival of San Rafael.

text: Maga-perform naman sa judging area number 2 sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol ang Haw-as Festival sang Dumangas kag Tultugan Festival sang Maasin.
english: Haw-as Festival of Dumangas and Tultugan Festival of Maasin will perform in judging area number 2 at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Samtang magapasundayag naman sa judging area number 3 ang Cry of Jelicuon Festival sang New Lucena kag Tangyan Festival sang Igbaras.
english: Meanwhile, Cry of Jelicuon Festival of New Lucena and Tangyan Festival of Igbaras will perform in judging area number 3.

text: Sa judging area number 4, magapaindis-indis ang Hirinugyaw-Suguidanonay Festival sang Calinog kag ang Tinuom Festival sang Cabatuan.
english: In judging area number 4, the Hirinugyaw-Suguidanonay Festival of Calinog and the Tinuom Festival of Cabatuan will compete.

text: Nagdepensa ang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Region 6 may kaangtanan sa pagtukod sang Aquaculture Feed Mill Plant sa Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Region 6 has defended the construction of the Aquaculture Feed Mill Plant in Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagpangakig ni Senate Committee on Agriculture, Food, and Agrarian Reform Chairman Senator Cynthia Villar sa pagpatukod sang Aquaculture Feed Mill Plant sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: This follows the anger of Senate Committee on Agriculture, Food, and Agrarian Reform Chairman Senator Cynthia Villar over the construction of the Aquaculture Feed Mill Plant in the said town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay BFAR Region 6 Director Remia Aparri, iya ginpahayag nga ang tuyo sang Aquaculture Feed Mill Plant sa Tigbauan amo ang mabuligan ang fishpond operators sa Western Visayas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, BFAR Region 6 Director Remia Aparri said the purpose of the Aquaculture Feed Mill Plant in Tigbauan is to assist fishpond operators in Western Visayas.

text: Suno kay Aparri, ang planta ang makahatag sang produkto nga nagahalin sa mga isda bangud ang rehiyon ang isa ka fish producing region nga mahimo man makabulig sa aqua culture industry sang pungsod.
english: According to Aparri, the plant will provide fish products as the region is a fish producing region that can also help the country's aqua culture industry.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga makabulig ini sa pagpataas sang produksyon sang isda sa rehiyon.
english: He also believes that this will help increase fish production in the region.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga may mga components pa sa planta ang indi pa hitso nga maka-produce apang, ginalantaw nga mangin handa sa operasyon ang planta sa 2nd quarter sang 2025.
english: Ginpahayag man sini nga may mga components pa sa planta ang indi pa hitso nga maka-produce apang, ginalantaw nga mangin handa sa operasyon ang planta sa 2nd quarter sang 2025.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa 90% completion ang planta.
english: Currently, the plant is at 90% completion.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang proyekto ang isa ka kolaborasyon kaupod ang Southeast Asian Fisheries Development Center (SEAFDEC).
english: Nahibaluan nga ang proyekto ang isa ka kolaborasyon kaupod ang Southeast Asian Fisheries Development Center (SEAFDEC).

text: Nagpanindugan man si Aparri nga mas kabisado sang SEAFDEC ang amo nga operasyon rason nga nag-collaborate sila.
english: Aparri also insisted that SEAFDEC is more familiar with the operation and that is why they collaborated.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang concern ni Sen.
english: He also explained that the concern of Sen.

text: Villar amo ang legislation nga dapat i-turnover sa Local Government Unit ang planta pagkatapos sang iya nga termino bilang director sang BFAR 6.
english: Villar is the legislation that the plant should be turned over to the Local Government Unit after his term as director of BFAR 6.

text: Kumbinsido si Former Presidential Legal Counsel Atty. Salvador Panelo nga magadalagan sa pagka-presidente si Vice President Sara Duterte sa 2028 Elections.
english: Former Presidential Legal Counsel Atty. Salvador Panelo that Vice President Sara Duterte will run for president in the 2028 Elections.

text: Suno kay Panelo, sigurado nga magadalagan ang bise presidente sa masunod nga Presidential Elections.
english: Panelo said the vice president is sure to run in the next Presidential Elections.

text: Ginpanindugan sang anay Duterte appointee nga indi kuntani matabo ang conflict nanday Duterte kag Marcos kun una na nga nagdesisyon si VP Sara nga magpadalagan sa pagka-presidente sa 2022 elections.
english: The former Duterte appointee insisted that the conflict between Duterte and Marcos would not have happened if VP Sara had already decided to run for president in the 2022 elections.

text: Talalupangdon nga si VP Sara nagsiling na sang una nga ‘seryoso nga ginakonsidera’ niya ang pagpadalagan sa pagkapresidente sa 2028.
english: Notably, VP Sara has previously said that she is ‘seriously considering’ running for president in 2028.

text: Una nga gin-impeach si VP Sara sa Kamara sang Pebrero 5, samtang ginalauman nga magapadayon ang impeachment trial sa masunod nga mga binulan.
english: VP Sara was first impeached in the House of Representatives on February 5, while the impeachment trial is expected to continue in the coming months.

text: Kon lubos siya nga mapahalin sa pwesto paagi sa impeachment, ma-disqualify siya sa pag-uyat sang anuman nga public office, base sa probisyon sang kasuguan.
english: If he is completely removed from office through impeachment, he will be disqualified from holding any public office, based on the provisions of the law.

text: Una na nga nag-file sang petisyon sa Korte Suprema ang isa ka abogado nga nagahingyo sang pag-issue sang court order nga naga-require sa Senado nga gilayon nga aksyonan ang kaso nga impeachment batuk kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Earlier, a lawyer filed a petition in the Supreme Court seeking the issuance of a court order requiring the Senate to immediately act on the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa petisyon nga gipasaka ni Atty. Catalino Generillo Jr., iya ginhingyo sa korte nga mag-issue sang writ of mandamus agud gilayon nga ipatawag ang mga Senador bilang impeachment court kag gilayon nga magpatigayon sang public trial kasunod sang pag-file sang impeachment case sang Kamara.
english: In a petition filed by Atty. Catalino Generillo Jr., he asked the court to issue a writ of mandamus to immediately summon the senators as an impeachment court and immediately conduct a public trial following the filing of the impeachment case by the House.

text: MAKAULUGOT gid man ang masami nga pag-brownout diri sa amon barangay – kag bisan pa sa iban nga lugar sa siyudad – labi na gid kon inoras ang kalawig.
english: It is annoying to have frequent brownouts here in our barangay – and even in other parts of the city – especially if they last for hours.

text: Imagine ang brownout nga isa ka oras, duha, tatlo kag tubtub pa gani sa anom ka oras!
english: Imagine a brownout of one hour, two, three and even six hours!

text: Luas pa sa kulba mo nga maguba ang mga appliances mo sa hinali nga pagpatay sang suga, guba man ang online mo nga trabaho sa imo desktop (electricity-powered) computer.
english: In addition to the fear of losing your appliances to a sudden power outage, your online work on your desktop (electricity-powered) computer is also ruined.

text: Gani pa-MORE gid ang pag-ugtas mo!
english: So make MORE of your cuts!

text: Well, ano abe ang himuon kundi mangita na gid lang medyos nga mawili mo ang imo kaugalingon sa pwede mahimo sa balay ukon ano man nga mautihan mo sa mga tanom sa gamay n’yo nga lagwerta.
english: Well, what can you do but find a way to entertain yourself with what you can do at home or whatever you can do with the plants in your small yard.

text: Kag kon indi man, ang magpahunay-hunay kag maglingaw sang kaugalingon sa musika kag interesante nga talan-awon sa TV ukon sa na-save mo halin sa online.
english: And if not, to relax and entertain yourself with music and interesting TV shows or what you have saved from online.

text: Katulad sang mga soul-soothing nga mga ambahanon, pili nga mga instansya halin sa sports, ang luyag mo dumdumon nga mga hitabo katulad sang tsunami sa Japan kag Indonesia, mga tumalagsahon nga mga abilidad,  kag iban pa.
english: Like soul-soothing songs, selected instances from sports, memorable events like the tsunami in Japan and Indonesia, extraordinary abilities, and so on.

text: Lakip na ang pagsid-ing dira sa makawiwili nga competition sa America Got Talent (AGT) sang NBC kag kasubong nga competition shows sa iban nga network.
english: This includes watching the interesting competition on NBC's America Got Talent (AGT) and similar competition shows on other networks.

text: Isa sa sining competition amo ang paindis-indis nanday Darci Lynne Farmer, nga isa ka ventriloquist (nagapa-“hambal” kag nagapa-“kanta” sang puppet) kag Angelica Hale, nga ginkitaan sang unique kag powerful nga singing voice sadtong Season 12 sang AGT 2017.
english: One of these competitions is the contest of Darci Lynne Farmer, who is a ventriloquist (making a puppet “talk” and “sing”) and Angelica Hale, who won her unique and powerful singing voice during Season 12 of AGT 2017.

text: Mabudlay ini husgaran tungod ang competition indi sa pareho nga abilidad kundi sa nagalain-lain nga abilidad nga mapakita sang mga contestant – sa kanta man, saot, acrobatics, magic, pakita sang abilidad sang mga hayop, kag iban pa.
english: It is difficult to judge because the competition is not based on the same skills but on the different skills that the contestants can show – whether in song, dance, acrobatics, magic, animal shows, etc.

text: Ang padaug diri sandig na gid lang seguro sa audience impact ukon sa ginapakita nga pagdayaw sang publiko.
english: The winner here probably depends on the audience impact or the praise shown by the public.

text: Nagdaug diri ang 13 anyos nga si Darci Lynne sang Oklahoma City,  samtang nagpangaduha si Angelica, ang 10 anyos nga Fil-Am nga taga Atlanta, Georgia.
english: The winner was 13-year-old Darci Lynne of Oklahoma City, while Angelica, a 10-year-old Fil-Am from Atlanta, Georgia, came in second.

text: Sa akon lang, wala sing itulak-butongon sa ila nga duha kon abilidad ang pagahambalan.
english: I don't think there's anything to compare between the two of them when it comes to ability.

text: Kon nagdaug si Darci Lynne tungod lang ina seguro sa mabudlay nga abilidad niya bilang ventriloquist – imagine “mapahambal” kag “mapakanta” mo ang puppet!
english: If Darci Lynne won, it was probably because of her difficult skills as a ventriloquist – imagine you can make the puppet “talk” and “sing”!

text: – nga gamit ang tatlo ka puppet.
english: – that is using three puppets.

text: Si Angelica may tumalagsahon nga boses – mature kag powerful voice – nga unique makita sa isa ka bata.
english: Angelica has an extraordinary voice – mature and powerful voice – which is unique to find in a child.

text: Pwede siya seguro ma-feature sa mga children stage shows kag bisan sa pelikula sa isa ka dramatic role tungod sang iya mahumok nga pang-guyahon.
english: She could probably be featured in children's stage shows and even in a movie in a dramatic role because of her soft face.

text:
***

Nadumduman ko gali ang siling ni Darci sang pamangkuton siya parti sa iya experyensya sa pag-compete sa AGT 2017.
english:
***

I actually remember what Darci said when asked about her experience competing on AGT 2017.

text: “I will always love good competition!” siling niya.
english: “I will always love good competition!” he said.

text: Ako man, “I love good competition”, nga nagapahanumdum sa akon sang sadto masadya nga paindisanay sang GMA kag ABS-CBN TV.
english: I also, “I love good competition”, which reminds me of the fun competition between GMA and ABS-CBN TV.

text: Akig ugaling si Presidente Duterte sa ABS-CBN tungod sang kuno “biased” reporting sini, gani ginpamalabagan niya ang paghatag diri sang frankisa agud liwat maka-broadcast.
english: However, President Duterte is angry with ABS-CBN for its allegedly “biased” reporting, so he opposed giving it a franchise to broadcast again.

text: Sa kaluoy sang Diyos, bisan paano namedyosan man sang ABS-CBN nga maka-broadcast gihapon paagi sa Free TV kag pakig-areglo sa iban nga TV Networks, katulad sang TV 5 kon diin daw naga-blocktime ini sang ila noontime show ASAP kon Domingo.
english: By the grace of God, ABS-CBN somehow managed to broadcast through Free TV and arrangements with other TV Networks, such as TV 5 where it seems to blocktime their noontime show ASAP on Sundays.

text: Nakahimo man ini sang pagwaragwag sang pila pa ka programa, katulad sang TV Patrol sa YouTube kag sa open social media.
english: It has also broadcast several other programs, such as TV Patrol on YouTube and open social media.

text: So, ang ginahimo ko amo ang pagsaylo-saylo sa ila Sunday noontime program sunu sa kon ano ang naluyagan ko nga palagwaon sa kada tion.
english: So, what I do is switch between their Sunday noontime program according to what show I like each time.

text: Lain gid man kon may mainit nga pag-indisanay sang mga top TV networks.
english: It’s quite another when there’s heated competition between the top TV networks.

text: Masadya gid kon may competition.
english: It’s fun when there’s competition.

text: Ang diktador lang ang wala luyag sang kumpetensya; luyag niya siya lang pirme ang bida.
english: Only the dictator does not want competition; he always wanted to be the hero.

text: Katulad ni Hitler kag sang iya kasubong.
english: Like Hitler and his ilk.

text: Ginabug-usan sang 24 tanan ka mga judges ang magahukom sa apat ka mga kompetisyon sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: A total of 24 judges will judge the four competitions at the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elvert Bañares, Director for arts and culture initiatives sang Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Elvert Bañares, Director for arts and culture initiatives of the Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.

text: (IFFI), iya ginpahayag ang apat ka kompetisyon amo ang Dinagyang ILOmination, Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan, Dagyang Tribes Competition, kag Sadsad sa Calle Real.
english: (IFFI), he said the four competitions are Dinagyang ILOmination, Kasadyahan sa Babanwahahan, Dagyang Tribes Competition, and Sadsad sa Calle Real.

english: According to Bañares, multi-awarded theater director, arts, & heritage advocate Director Chris Millado will serve as the chief judge of the Dinagyang ILOmination.
