english: Chief judge of the Dagyang Tribes competition was Former Dance Artist, Filipiniana Dance Company Mr. Nestor Jardin.

text: Si Executive Director, National Commission for Culture and the Arts Dr. Eric Zerrudo naman ang magaserbe nga chief judge sang Sadsad sa Calle Real.
english: Executive Director, National Commission for Culture and the Arts Dr. Eric Zerrudo will serve as the chief judge of Sadsad in Calle Real.

text: Ginpadayaw ni President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr.

text:
nga ang iya mga kandidato sa pagka-senador ang wala nagasalig sa iligal nga industriya kaangay sang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO.)

Kadungan ini sa iya speech sa pagpangampanya sang Alyansa Para sa Bagong Pilipinas sa Dumaguete, Negros Oriental, Pebrero 20.
english:
that his senatorial candidates do not rely on illegal industries such as the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO.)

This is in conjunction with his campaign speech for the Alliance for a New Philippines in Dumaguete, Negros Oriental, February 20.

text: Pahayag sang chief executive, ang POGO ang nangin breeding ground para sa krimen sa pungsod.
english: The chief executive said POGO has become a breeding ground for crime in the country.

text: Ginpasalig sini nga ang ila nga solusyon amo ang disente nga trabaho kag sweldo kag suporta sa magagmay nga mga negosyo.
english: He assured that their solution is decent jobs and salaries and support for small businesses.

text: “Sa ekonomiya at trabaho, hindi natin kailangan umasa sa ilegal na industriya tulad ng POGO na naging pugad ng krimen, naging pugad ng karahasan,” suno kay Marcos.
english: “In the economy and jobs, we do not need to rely on illegal industries like POGO which has become a nest of crime, a nest of violence,” Marcos said.

text:
“Ang solusyon ay tunay na trabaho, disenteng suweldo, at suporta sa maliliit na negosyo.”

Nahibaluan nga gin-mandu na sang presidente ang pag-ban sa POGO sa Pilipinas, apang may mga report gihapon nga naga-operate pa ini nga industriya kaangay sang pagpakuno-kuno nga business process outsourcing firms ukon call center agud nga makapadayon sa ila nga operasyon kag mga krimen.
english:
“The solution is real jobs, decent wages, and support for small businesses.”

The president has already ordered the ban on POGO in the Philippines, but there are still reports that the industry is still operating as fake business process outsourcing firms or call centers in order to continue their operations and crimes.

text: May health news kita!
english: We have health news!

text: Kon nagakatol ang imo tutunlan, pag-um-om sang luy- a ang imo dalangpan.
english: If your throat is itchy, chewing ginger is your refuge.

text: Apang, dali lang, bangod ang pag-um-om sang luy-a, sa imo sex life makabulig man!
english: But, come on, because chewing ginger, in your sex life can help too!

text: Ang luy-a tradisyonal nga ginagamit sa pila na ka siglo agud mag-increase sang sex drive kag magboost sang sexual performance.
english: Ginger has been traditionally used for centuries to increase sex drive and boost sexual performance.

text: Sa libro ni Pedanius Dioscorides nga De Materia Medica nga ginsulat masobra duha ka siglo na ang nakaligad, nasaad ang stimulating effect sang luy-a sa male reproductive organ.
english: In Pedanius Dioscorides' book De Materia Medica written more than two centuries ago, the stimulating effect of ginger on the male reproductive organ is mentioned.

text: Mangin ang mga Portugese sadto ang nagagamit man sang luy-a sa ila mga ulipon para mapataas ang ila sexual activity agud mapadamo ang populasyon.
english: Even the Portuguese used ginger in their slaves to increase their sexual activity in order to increase the population.

text: Ang luy-a isa ka warming herb, nga ginagamit agud mapa- increase ang circulation sa peripheries sang lawas kaangay sang kamot kag tiil kag maka- increase sang circulation sa reproductive organs sang babaye kag lalake nga maka- stimulate naman sang arousal kag sensation kon nagapakighilawas.
english: Ginger is a warming herb, which is used to increase circulation in the periphery of the body such as hands and feet and increase circulation in the reproductive organs of women and men which can stimulate arousal and sensation during sexual intercourse.

text: Ini ang pinakamaayo nga um-umon antes ang pagpakighilawas agud mabatyagan ang epekto sini.Mangin ang paghaklo lang sang baho sini ang epektibo man.
english: It is best consumed before sex to feel its effects.Even just inhaling its scent is also effective.

text: May mga pagtuon man nga nakit-an nga nagapataas ini sang testosterone levels, kag naga-improve sang sperm count.Mangin ang philosopher nga si Confucius ang ginakabig man nga proponent sini.
english: Studies have also found that it increases testosterone levels, and improves sperm count. Even the philosopher Confucius is also considered a proponent of it.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagadugang siya sang luy-a sa tanan niya nga ginakaon.
english: He reportedly adds ginger to everything he eats.

text: Isa man ka kilala nga proponent amo ang French legend nga si Madame du Barry nga nagaserbe sang luy-an sa tanan niya nga lovers ilabi na si Louis XV.
english: Another well-known proponent is the French legend Madame du Barry who serves luy-an to all her lovers especially Louis XV.

text: Indi makatilingala nga ang luy-a makit-an sa Kama Sutra kag nalista bilang isa sa “best aphrodisiac herbs” nga nagadala sang success sa paghigugma.
english: No wonder ginger is found in the Kama Sutra and is listed as one of the “best aphrodisiac herbs” that bring success in love.

text: Gintudlo sang chairman sang Committee on Transportation sang Iloilo City Council sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang responsibilidad agud maklaro ang nahanungod sa fixed rate sa mga taxis kun nagadul-ong sang pasahero sa gwa sang syudad.
english: The chairman of the Committee on Transportation of the Iloilo City Council pointed out the responsibility to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) to clarify the fixed rate on taxis when transporting passengers outside the city.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa natabo sang damlag lang kun sa diin ginreklamo sang isa ka Cebuano vlogger nga ginsukot ini sang P600 sang taxi driver halin sa Mandurriao pakadto sa airport sa Cabatuan kag wala naggamit sang taxi meter ang driver.
english: May kaangtanan ini sa natabo sang damlag lang kun sa diin ginreklamo sang isa ka Cebuano vlogger nga ginsukot ini sang P600 sang taxi driver halin sa Mandurriao pakadto sa airport sa Cabatuan kag wala naggamit sang taxi meter ang driver.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, iya ginpahayag nga indi lang sa Iloilo nagakatabo nga may fixed rate bangud nagakesister man ini sa iban nga lugar sa pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna said that the fixed rate is not only happening in Iloilo because it also exists in other parts of the country.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, mas maayo nga matutukan ini sang regulatory board bangud madamo apektado diri ang madamo nga taxi drivers kag ang riding public.
english: According to Cabaluna, it is better for the regulatory board to focus on this because many taxi drivers and the riding public are affected.

text: Gindugan sang konsehal nga magapakig-angot man ini sa nasambit nga ahensya sang gobyerno agud makahatag man sang iya opinyon tuhoy diri.
english: The councilor added that he will also contact the said government agency to give his opinion on the matter.

text: Magaabot na subong nga adlaw sa Pilipinas ang bangkay sang pulis nga nalakip sa 67 nga napatay sang nagbungguanay ang eroplano kag army helicopter kag nahulog sa Potomac River sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The body of a policeman who was among the 67 killed when a plane collided with an army helicopter and fell into the Potomac River in the United States of America will arrive in the Philippines today.

text: Si Col.
english: Col.

text: Pergentino N. Malabed amo ang nagapungko nga supply management chief sang Philippine National Police (PNP) kag yara sa official duty sang natabo ang amo nga insidente.
english: Pergentino N. Malabed is the incumbent supply management chief of the Philippine National Police (PNP) and was on official duty when the incident occurred.

text: Suno kay PNP Public Information Office (PIO) chief Col.
english: According to PNP Public Information Office (PIO) chief Col.

text: Randulf Tuaño, sugataon ang bangkay ni Malabed sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) para sa foyer honors subong nga adlaw kag dal-on sa Campo Crame kun sa diin patigayunon ang arrival honors, religious ceremony, kag public viewing.
english: Randulf Tuaño, Malabed's body will be met at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) for foyer honors today and taken to Campo Crame where arrival honors, religious ceremony, and public viewing will be held.

text: Hatagan man ini sang Medalya ng Katapatan sa Paglilingkod kag Medalya ng Katangi-tanging Gawa.
english: He will also be awarded the Medal of Loyalty in Service and the Medal of Distinguished Service.

text: Magluwas diri, may ihatag man ang kapulisan nga malapit P2.7-million sa pamilya ni Malabed halin sa PNP Savings and Loan Association, Inc.
english: In addition, the police will also provide nearly P2.7-million to Malabed's family from the PNP Savings and Loan Association, Inc.

text: May gin-set man nga necrological services sa Multi-Purpose Center sa Camp Crame.
english: Necrological services were also set at the Multi-Purpose Center at Camp Crame.

text: Igalubong naman ini sa Memorial Gardens sa Sta.
english: He will be buried at the Memorial Gardens in Sta.

text: Rosa City, Laguna sa Pebrero 27.
english: Rosa City, Laguna on February 27.

text: Napatay na ang lalaki nga pinakauna nga nakabaton sang heart transplant gamit ang heart sang isa ka baboy makaligad ang duha ka bulan matapos ang surgery.
english: The man who was the first to receive a heart transplant using a pig's heart has died two months after the surgery.

text: Ang 57 anyos nga si David Bennette ang napatay matapos nga nakita sang mga doktor nga ini ang amat-amat nga nagpalangluya sa sulod na sang pila adlaw.
english: 57-year-old David Bennette died after doctors found that he had been slowly deteriorating for several days.

text: Si Bennette ang eligible nga nakabaton sang heart transplant gamit ang heart sang baboy bangud man sa iya kondisyon; bedridden kag naka life support.
english: Bennette was eligible to receive a heart transplant using a pig's heart due to his condition; bedridden and on life support.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang pamilya ni Bennette sa ospital nga amo ang nagpatigayon sang surgery para sa last-ditch experiment.
english: Bennette's family also thanked the hospital that performed the surgery for the last-ditch experiment.

text: Madamo sa mga tawo ang nagalaum nga mas mapasangkad pa ang amo na eksperimento agud nga masulusyonan ang kakulang sang organ transplant sa kalibutan.
english: Many people hope that the experiment will be expanded to solve the world's shortage of organ transplants.

text: Indi na pag-ipilit ni President Volodymyr Zelensky ang NATO membership para sa Ukraine.
english: President Volodymyr Zelensky will no longer press for NATO membership for Ukraine.

text: Ang isyu sa pagpa-myembro sa amo nga North Atlantic Treaty Organization amo ang ginapahayag rason kun ngaa nga ginsulod sang Russia ang Ukraine.
english: The issue of membership in the North Atlantic Treaty Organization is the alleged reason why Russia invaded Ukraine.

text:
Suno kay Zelensky, “I have cooled down regarding this question a long time ago after we understood that … NATO is not prepared to accept Ukraine.”

May pahayag man ang presidente nga may kahadlok ang NATO sa kontrobersyal nga mga isyu kag sa kontrobersiya nga nagalakip sa pungsod nga ginapamunuan ni Russian President Vladimir Putin: “The alliance is afraid of controversial things, and confrontation with Russia,” suno kay Zelensky.
english:
According to Zelensky, “I have cooled down regarding this question a long time ago after we understood that … NATO is not prepared to accept Ukraine.”

The president also said that NATO is afraid of controversial issues and controversy involving the country led by Russian President Vladimir Putin: “The alliance is afraid of controversial things, and confrontation with Russia,” Zelensky said.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Zelensky nga indi sini luyag mangin presidente sang pungsod nga nagapang-luhod luhod sa pagpakitluoy.
english: Zelensky also said he does not want to be the president of a country that is on its knees begging.

text: Una diri, ginpahayag sang Russia nga indi sini gusto ang kaiping nga pungsod Ukraine nga magsulod sa NATO, isa ka transatlantic alliance nga gintukod sa pag-umpisa sang Cold War agud proteheran ang Europa batok sa Soviet Union.
english: Earlier, Russia said it did not want neighboring Ukraine to join NATO, a transatlantic alliance formed at the start of the Cold War to protect Europe against the Soviet Union.

text: Apang kun madumduman, sang nabungkag ang Soviet Union ukon ang Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), nagpadayon ang NATO sa pagpalawig sang ila nga teritoryo kag pwersa sa nasidlangan nga bahin kag ginpanglakip sa alyansa ang anay Soviet domains.
english: However, when the Soviet Union collapsed, NATO continued to expand its territory and forces in the eastern part and included the former Soviet domains in the alliance.

text: Ini ang ginatudlo rason kun ngaa akig ang Russia.
english: This is said to be the reason why Russia is angry.

text: Ginalantaw ni Putin ang pagpadaku sang alyansa sang NATO bilang isa ka pamahog.
english: Putin sees the enlargement of the NATO alliance as a threat.

text:
NEGOSASYON SA RUSSIA

Madumduman nga antes ang pagsulod sa teritoryo sang Ukraine sang Pebrero 24, ginmandu ni Putin nga kilalahon sang Russia bilang independent ang duha ka separatist pro-Russian “republics” sa eastern Ukraine — ang Donetsk kag ang Lugansk.
english:
NEGOTIATIONS WITH RUSSIA

It will be recalled that before the invasion of Ukrainian territory on February 24, Putin ordered that Russia recognize as independent two separatist pro-Russian “republics” in eastern Ukraine — Donetsk and Lugansk.

text: Ini nga mga rehiyon ang nagaaway batok sa Kyiv (kapital sang Ukraine) halin pa sang 2014.
english: These regions have been fighting against Kyiv (capital of Ukraine) since 2014.

text: Luyag sang Russia nga kilalahon ini sang Ukraine bilang sovereign kag independent.
english: Russia wants Ukraine to recognize it as sovereign and independent.

text: Sang ginpamangkot may kaangtanan sa demand sang Russia, ginpahayag ni Zelensky nga bukas ang Ukraine para sa diskusyon.
english: When asked about Russia’s demand, Zelensky said Ukraine was open for discussion.

text: “I’m talking about security guarantees,” suno sa presidente.
english: “I’m talking about security guarantees,” the president said.

text: “What is important to me is how the people in those territories are going to live who want to be part of Ukraine, who in Ukraine will say that they want to have them in.
english: “What is important to me is how the people in those territories are going to live who want to be part of Ukraine, who in Ukraine will say that they want to have them in.

text: So the question is more difficult than simply acknowledging them.
english: So the question is more difficult than simply acknowledging them.

text: This is another ultimatum and we are not prepared for ultimatums.
english: This is another ultimatum and we are not prepared for ultimatums.

text: What needs to be done is for President Putin to start talking, start the dialogue instead of living in the informational bubble without oxygen,” pahayag ni Zelensky.
english: What needs to be done is for President Putin to start talking, start the dialogue instead of living in the informational bubble without oxygen,” Zelensky stated.

text: Nagpanawagan sanday Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David kag Manila Archbishop Cardinal Jose Advincula sa mga tumuluo nga ipangamuyo ang pag-ayo ni Pope Francis nga yara subong sa ospital bangud sa double pneumonia.
english: Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David and Manila Archbishop Cardinal Jose Advincula have called on the faithful to pray for the recovery of Pope Francis who is currently in hospital with double pneumonia.

text: Suno kay Cardinal David nga amo ang Caloocan diocese bishop kag president sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), dapat nga updan ang pagpangamuyo sa pag-recover sang Santo Papa sa sini nga mabudlay nga mga tinion.
english: Cardinal David, Caloocan diocese bishop and president of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), said the Pope's recovery should be accompanied by prayer in these difficult times.

text: Ginsulit man sini ang anunsyo sang Vatican nga ginkanselar anay ang mga hilikuton sang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa bangud sa ginasuprer sini nga complex respiratory infection.
english: He also reiterated the Vatican's announcement that the 88-year-old Pope's activities had been canceled due to his suffering from a complex respiratory infection.

text: “May I ask for your prayers for his healing and recovery during this challenging time,” pahayag sang Cardinal.
english: “I ask for your prayers for his healing and recovery during this challenging time,” the Cardinal said.

text: “Despite his condition, doctors say he remains in good spirits and has expressed gratitude for the prayers he has received.
english: “Despite his condition, doctors say he remains in good spirits and has expressed gratitude for the prayers he has received.

text:
The Vatican has canceled all of his engagements as he battles this complex respiratory infection.”

Sa bahin ni Cardinal Advincula, ginpalab-ot sini ang apelar ni Apostolic Nuncio to the Philippines, Archbishop Charles John Brown, nga magpangamuyo para sa Pope.
english:
The Vatican has canceled all of his engagements as he battles this complex respiratory infection.”

For his part, Cardinal Advincula conveyed the appeal of the Apostolic Nuncio to the Philippines, Archbishop Charles John Brown, to pray for the Pope.

text: Ginhingyo man sini ang mga parokya kag komunidad nga mag-organisar sang Holy Hour for the healing of the sick.
english: He also urged parishes and communities to organize Holy Hour for the healing of the sick.

text: “Let us likewise offer our personal and family prayers for this intention,” dugang sini.
english: “Let us likewise offer our personal and family prayers for this intention,” it added.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala pa sang kasiguruhan kun san-o makaguwa si Pope Francis sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma sa Italya kun sa diin gindala siya sang Pebrero 14.
english: It is known that there is no certainty when Pope Francis will be discharged from the Gemelli Hospital in Rome, Italy where he was taken on February 14.

text: Ang double pneumonia nga diagnosis nagakahulugan nga apektado ang iya duha ka mga baga.Ang mga sintomas sini nga balatian nagalakip sang pag-ubo, kabudlay sa pagginhawa, pagpalangapoy, kag pagpalanakit sang lawas.
english: The double pneumonia diagnosis means that both lungs are affected. Symptoms of this disease include coughing, difficulty breathing, fatigue, and body aches.

text: Nagpaguwa sang update ang Holy See Press Office Mierkules sang gab-i oras sa Roma kag pasado alas tres sa kaagahon naman oras diri sa Pilipinas nga may gamay nga improvement sa blood tests sang Santo Papa ilabi na sa inflammatory markers.
english: The Holy See Press Office issued an update Wednesday night Rome time and past 3 am Philippine time that there was a slight improvement in the Pope's blood tests especially in inflammatory markers.

text: Estable man ang kondisyon sini, kag nag-trabaho pa kaupod sa iya pinakasuod nga collaborators.
english: He is also in stable condition, and has even worked with his closest collaborators.

text: Sa hapon, ginbisita man ini sang punong ministro sang Italya kag nag-istoryahanay sa sulod sang 20 minutos.
english: In the afternoon, the Italian prime minister also visited it and held talks for 20 minutes.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Pope, nga lider sang Roman Catholic Church nga may 1.4-billion nga mga miyembro sa kalibutan, ang nagabatyag sang trangkaso kag iban pa nga health problems sang pila ka beses na sa nagligad nga duha ka tuig.
english: The Pope, who is the leader of the Roman Catholic Church with 1.4-billion members worldwide, has been suffering from the flu and other health problems several times in the past two years.

text: Sang 2021, na-ospital man ini bangud sa colon surgery.#
english: In 2021, he was also hospitalized for colon surgery.#

text: Napatay bangud sa COVID-19 ang isa ka Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) nga nagatrabaho sa HongKong.
english: An Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) working in Hong Kong has died of COVID-19.

text: Ini amu si Magelyn Distor Handoy, 53 anyos, tumandok sang Panit-an, Capiz kag masobra 10 na ka tuig nga nagatrabaho sa HongKong bilang isa ka domestic helper.
english: Magelyn Distor Handoy, 53, a native of Panit-an, Capiz, has been working in Hong Kong as a domestic helper for more than 10 years.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Jing Gabiazon– direkta sa Hongkong, gindala sa ospital si Handoy sang Pebrero 26 bangud sa nabatyagan sini nga sakit sa iya tyan.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Jing Gabiazon – directly from Hong Kong, Handoy was taken to the hospital on February 26 due to abdominal pain.

text: Nakagwa ini sa ospital makaligad ang isa ka adlaw.
english: He was discharged from the hospital a day later.

text: Liwat ini nga gindala sa ospital sang Marso 5 bangud nabudlayan ini magginhawa.
english: He was taken to the hospital again on March 5 because he had difficulty breathing.

text: Didto na kag nahibaluan nga positibo ini sa COVID-19.
english: It was there that he was found to be positive for COVID-19.

text: Marso 6 sang ini ang nagtaliwan.
english: He passed away on March 6.

text: Suno kay Gabiazon, base sa pagsulundan sa Hong Kong, kun napatay bangud sa COVID-19 ang isa ka Pilipino, kinahanglan nga i-cremate ini antes ipadala sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Gabiazon, based on the rules in Hong Kong, if a Filipino dies due to COVID-19, he must be cremated before being sent to the Philippines.

text: PADAYON nga naga-init ang isyu sang mandatory vaccination, partikular sa hingyo nga ipatuman ang “No vaccination, No work” policy, diri sa siyudad.
english: THE issue of mandatory vaccination, particularly the demand to implement the “No vaccination, No work” policy, continues to heat up in the city.

text: Angot diri, luyag ta pasalamatan si Mayor Jerry Treñas nga wala dayon nagmando sini, kundi ginkuha anay ang opinyon sang mga pumuluyo parti sini.
english: In this regard, we would like to thank Mayor Jerry Treñas who did not immediately order this, but first took the opinion of the residents about it.

text: Sa aton Demokrasya, naga-involver ini sang legal kag moral nga mga isyu angot sa kahilwayan sang tawo – sa iya konsyensya (Freedom of Religion), “right to have a choice” katulad sang kon magpabakuna ukon indi, “equal opportunity to survive”, kag  “Right to Life”.
english: In our Democracy, it involves legal and moral issues related to human freedom – Freedom of Religion, “right to have a choice” such as whether to be vaccinated or not, “equal opportunity to survive”, and “Right to Life”.

text: Ang iloy-iloy gid sining problema, para sa aton, amo kon bala mabaton sang aton pumuluyo ining mandatory vaccination sa ila konsyensya, nga mabudlay sikwayon kay gaangot ini sa ila pagtuo sa Diyos.
english: The heart of this problem, for us, is whether our people will accept this mandatory vaccination in their conscience, which is difficult to reject because it is linked to their faith in God.

text: Kontrahon mo na ang tanan indi lang ang Diyos!
english: You're against everyone except God!

text: Labi na gid kay may matudlo kita nga malain nga natabo sa pila ka tawo nga nagkontra sa Diyos.
english: Especially since we can learn from the bad things that happened to some people who rebelled against God.

text: Katulad abe sang nagpahambog nga mas popular pa siya kay Kristo.
english: Like the one who boasted that he was more popular than Christ.

text: Subong man ang isa ka diktador nga nag-agaw sang kinamatarong sang Diyos sa kabuhi nga Siya mismo ang nagtuga.
english: So is a dictator who usurped God's right to life that He Himself created.

text: Labi na gid kay sobra 6 ka milyon ka inosente nga mga tawo gid ang iya ginpapatay.
english: Especially since he had over 6 million innocent people killed.

text: Napatay ini sila sa indi ma-explicar nga kabangdanan kag sa iban pa nga hitabo nga pwede masiling naton nga nagdala na sa ila derecho sa Impiyerno.
english: They died of unexplained causes and other events that we can say led to their right to Hell.

text:
***

Well, ang mga dalagku nga mga relihiyon wala naga-prohibir sang ila mga tumuluo sa pagpa-bakuna.
english:
***

Well, the major religions don’t ban their believers from getting vaccinated.

text: Si Pope Francis sang Roman Catholic Church, nga may sobra isa ka bilyon nga sumulunod, nagpabakuna na gani sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Pope Francis of the Roman Catholic Church, which has more than a billion followers, even got vaccinated last week.

text: Ugaling ginatugutan man nila ang ila mga tumuluo sa pagsunod sang ila indibidwal nga konsyensya sa pagpa-bakuna ukon indi.
english: But they also allow their believers to follow their individual conscience whether to get vaccinated or not.

text: Daku ini nga rason kon ngaa mamalabag gid ang Simbahan, pati na ang ila sumulunod, batok sa mandatory vaccination.
english: This is a big reason why the Church, as well as its followers, are so opposed to mandatory vaccination.

text: In fact, madamo na ang nagpautwas sang ila magahod nga pagkontra sini.
english: In fact, many have already voiced their vociferous opposition to it.

text: Ano bala ka importante sa pumuluyo ang ila konsyensya?
english: How important is the people's conscience?

text: Gintilawan ini kontrahon sang gobyerno sang United Kingdom sadto.
english: The then United Kingdom government tried to oppose it.

text: Ginpa-compulsory sini ang infant vaccination, kag ginpatawan sang fine kag pagka-bilanggo ang mga ginikanan nga indi magsunod.
english: It made infant vaccination compulsory, and imposed fines and imprisonment on parents who did not comply.

text: Nag-riot ang mga pumuluyo batok sini.
english: The citizens rioted against it.

text: Tungod sini gin-introduce sa kasuguan ang “conscience clause” nga naga-exempt sa mga “parents who did not believe vaccination was efficacious or safe”.
english: As a result, a conscience clause was introduced into the law that exempted parents who did not believe vaccination was effective or safe.

text: In fact, diri mismo sa Filipinas indi compulsory ang pagpa-bakuna sa mga kabataan batok bisan gani sa labing makamamatay kag makahalalit nga mga balatian katulad sang measles, rubella, polio, rabies kag tetanus.
english: In fact, here in the Philippines it is not compulsory to vaccinate children against even the most deadly and harmful diseases such as measles, rubella, polio, rabies and tetanus.

text: Voluntary lang.
english: Only voluntary.

text: So, ngaa ipa-mandatory gid naton ining hingyo nga “No vaccination, No work”?
english: So, why should we make this request “No vaccination, No work” mandatory?

text: Madamo man dira medyos para makumbinse ang mga pumuluyo, katulad sang husto nga edukasyon kag mga perks agud mapasugot.
english: There are also many ways to convince the people, such as proper education and perks to agree.

text: Kon may ara gid man sing kasuguan nga pwede ipasar, katulad sang isa ka ordinansa sang siyudad, dapat updan ini sang “conscience cause”.
english: If there is a law that can be passed, such as a city ordinance, it must be accompanied by a “conscience cause”.

text: Katulad bala sang yara sa United Kingdom nga naga-exempt sa pagpabakuna sang sin-o man nga nagapati nga indi “efficacious ukon safe” ini para sa ila.
english: Is it like the one in the United Kingdom that exempts from vaccination anyone who believes it is not “efficacious or safe” for them.

text:
***

Indi man matarong nga kuhaan naton sing trabaho ang indi luyag magpabakuna.
english:
***

It is also unfair for us to hire someone who does not want to be vaccinated.

text: Madamo dira ang madulaan sing pangabuhian, nga magadugang pa sa problema naton sa aton ekonomiya.
english: Many of them will lose their livelihoods, which will add to our economic problems.

text: Maga-resulta man ini sa diskriminasyon, labi na gid kay pwede ta man proteksyunan ang tanan sa padayon nga pagpatuman sang health protocols.
english: This will also result in discrimination, especially since we can protect everyone by continuing to implement health protocols.

text: In fact, wala sing health expert ang makapasalig nga ang mga nabakunahan indi na ma-reinfect sang COVID-19.
english: In fact, no health expert can assure that the vaccinated will not be reinfected with COVID-19.

text: Madamo na gani kaso sang re-infection.
english: There have even been many cases of re-infection.

text: In other words, wala man sing kinalis ang ila kahimtangan kay pareho man sila tanan – ang nabakunahan kag wala nabakunahan – nga dapat gihapon mag-amlig kag magpadayon sa pagtuman sang health protocols.
english: In other words, their situation is no different because they are all the same – vaccinated and unvaccinated – who must still protect themselves and continue to follow health protocols.

text: Sa matuod, sunu sa mga health experts, bisan ang ginasiling nga “effective immunity” nga mahatag sang bakuna indi man makapasalig sing lubos sa pagpapas sang virus.
english: In fact, according to health experts, even the so-called “effective immunity” provided by the vaccine does not fully guarantee the eradication of the virus.

text: Ina tungod bisan ang virus nga na-block sang bakuna dala gihapon ina sang nabakunahan nga pwede niya ilaton sa iban, kag bisan sa iya mismo sa padayon nga pag-mutate sang virus sa bag-o nga kinaiya.
english: That's because even the virus that is blocked by the vaccine is still carried by the vaccinated person who can infect others, and even himself as the virus continues to mutate into new characteristics.

text: Kon may yara nga bakuna nga makahatag sing lubos nga immunity kag makapapas sing lubos sa virus amo gid lang ang ginatawag nga “sterilizing immunity” nga “rare” matabo.
english: Only if there is a vaccine that can provide complete immunity and completely eradicate the virus will the so-called “sterilizing immunity” be “rare”.

text: Kag wala ina sa karon nga vaccines, labi na gid kay pang-emergency lang ini./PN
english: And that's not in the current vaccines, especially since they're only for emergencies./PN

text: Magabisita sa Pilipinas ang Miss Universe Continental Queens sa Abril 26 kag magatinir sa pungsod tubtub sa Mayo 3.
english: The Miss Universe Continental Queens will visit the Philippines on April 26 and will stay in the country until May 3.

text: “Don’t miss your chance to witness beauty, grace, and empowerment as these queens represent their continents and celebrate diversity across the globe,” suno sa Miss Universe organization.
english: “Don’t miss your chance to witness beauty, grace, and empowerment as these queens represent their continents and celebrate diversity across the globe,” according to the Miss Universe organization.

text: Antes sa Pilipinas, magabisita anay ang apat ka mga reyna sa Thailand halin sa March 31 tubtub sa April 25.
english: Before the Philippines, the four queens will visit Thailand from March 31 to April 25.

text: Natalana pa nga ipaguwa ang dugang nga mga detalye sa tour.
english: More details on the tour are scheduled to be released.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang apat ka queens ang ginhatagan sang continental titles sang 2024 agud mag-represent sang continental groups.
english: The four queens were awarded continental titles in 2024 to represent continental groups.

text: Ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Chelsea Manalo amo ang napilian nga una nga Miss Universe Asia apisar nga nagtakop ang iya Miss Universe stint sa Top 30.
english: Philippine representative Chelsea Manalo was elected the first Miss Universe Asia despite ending her Miss Universe stint in the Top 30.

text: Nadag-an man ni Chelsea ang Best in National Costume award sa iya “Hiraya” costume sa ginpatigayon nga global pageant sa Mexico.
english: Chelsea also won the Best in National Costume award for her “Hiraya” costume at the global pageant in Mexico.

text: Ang tatlo ka iban pa nga queens amo sanday Miss Africa & Oceania Chidimma Adetshina halin sa Nigeria; Miss Europe & Middle East Matilda Wirtavuori halin sa Finland; kag Miss Americas Tatiana Calmell halin sa Peru.
english: The other three queens are Miss Africa & Oceania Chidimma Adetshina from Nigeria; Miss Europe & Middle East Matilda Wirtavuori from Finland; and Miss Americas Tatiana Calmell from Peru.

text: Balantayan naman ang koronasyon sang Miss Universe Philippines 2025 sa Mayo 2, 6 p.m., sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay City.
english: The coronation of Miss Universe Philippines 2025 will be held on May 2, 6 p.m., at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.

text: Nagapanguna sa latest medal tally sa Palarong Pambansa 2025 ang multi-time defending overall champion nga National Capital Region (NCR) ilabi na kasunod sang paghakot sang gold medals sa gymnastics sa una nga adlaw sang hinampang.
english: Multi-time defending overall champion National Capital Region (NCR) leads the latest medal tally in the Palarong Pambansa 2025 especially after picking up gold medals in gymnastics on the first day of the games.

text:
Yari ang medal tally (nagapasunod ang gold, silver kag bronze medals) as of press time:

Nahibaluan nga may 17 na ka korona ang NCR sa Palaro kun sa diin target nga madepensahan ini subong nga tuig sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte.
english:
Here is the medal tally (gold, silver and bronze medals in order) as of press time:

It is known that NCR already has 17 crowns in the Palaro where it is targeted to defend it this year in Laoag, Ilocos Norte.

text: Sang 2024, nagpangaduha sa overall rankings ang CALABARZON kag nagapangatlo ang Western Visayas.#
english: In 2024, CALABARZON will be second in the overall rankings and Western Visayas will be third.

text: Masami nga ang ginahunong sa karsel ukon ang ginadagdagan sang multa amo ang mga tawo nga nagapangawat, naga-maoy, nagatuga sang iban pa nga eskandalo, kag iban pa nga mga krimen.
english: Often, those who are imprisoned or fined are people who steal, cheat, cause other scandals, and other crimes.

text: Apang nakasugata ka na bala sang tawo nga nakasuhan bangud wala niya nadul-ong ang iya nobya?
english: But have you ever met someone who got sued for not delivering his girlfriend?

text: Kagamay nga bagay kun pamatian apang amo ina ang rason kun nga nagtapos ang masobra anum ka tuig nga relasyon sang magkahagugma didto sa New Zealand kag nakalab-ot pa sa korte ang ila away.
english: It sounds like a small thing but that's why the couple's more than six-year relationship in New Zealand ended and their fight went to court.

text: Ini nga reklamo ang napasaka sa Disputes Tribunal ukon mas kilala nga smaller claims court ukon less formal ipaanggid sa korte bangud diri ginabaton ang indi man gid daku nga mga complaints para madasig maresolba.
english: This complaint is filed in the Disputes Tribunal or better known as the smaller claims court or less formal compared to the court because it accepts small complaints for quick resolution.

text: Wala diri sang abogado kag huwes, apang may ginatawag nga tribunal referee para magpatunga sa duha ka kampo.
english: There are no lawyers and judges here, but a tribunal referee is called to mediate between the two camps.

text: Ang reklamo nga ini nag-ugat sang wala gintuman sang lalaki ang iya pasalig nga idul-ong ang iya nobya sa airport rason nga nabayaan ini sang eroplano.
english: The complaint stemmed from the man's failure to keep his promise to take his girlfriend to the airport, causing her to miss the plane.

text: Nagawangal ang girlfriend bangud concert ang iya kadtuan kaupod ang iya mga abyan.
english: The girlfriend is crying because she is going to a concert with her friends.

text: Ginsiling sini nga ginlapas sang iya nobyo ang ila nga verbal contract”.
english: She said her boyfriend violated their verbal contract”.

text: Ini bangud suno sa iya, sang ginmunuhan niya ini sa iya plano, nagtango man, buot silingon nagpasugot ini nga siya ang mabantay sang balay kag duha ka ido samtang wala ang nobya.
english: This is because, he said, when he told her about his plan, she nodded, meaning she agreed to take care of the house and two dogs while the girlfriend was away.

text: Bangud na-miss sang babaye ang iya flight, nagdugang ini sang bayad para sa lain naman nga flight pagkaaga.
english: Because the woman missed her flight, she increased the fee for another flight the next morning.

text: Gindala man sini pati ang iya mga ido para indi na ini magsalig sa iya nobyo, kag nagbayad pa ini sang extra sa shuttle service sa airport.
english: She also brought her dogs so she wouldn't have to rely on her boyfriend, and she even paid extra for the shuttle service at the airport.

text: Pati ang bakasyon nila sang Disyembre 2023, nadumduman pa sang babaye kag ginbutang man sa legal document nga siya man ang nagbayad sa pamasahe sa ferry gani nagapanukot man siya sang bayad sang iya boyfriend.
english: Even their vacation in December 2023, the woman remembers and put in the legal document that she also paid for the ferry fare so she also charges her boyfriend's fee.

text:
Sang ulihi, ginbasura man sang tribunal ang kaso bangud suno diri, agud mapanabat ang isa ka tawo, dapat maplastar nga may “intention to create a legally binding relationship.”

“Partners, friends and colleagues make social arrangements, but it is unlikely they can be legally enforced unless the parties perform some act that demonstrates an intention that they will be bound by their promises,” suno sa desisyon.
english:
Later, the tribunal also dismissed the case because it said that in order to hold a person accountable, it must be established that there is an “intention to create a legally binding relationship.”

“Partners, friends and colleagues make social arrangements, but it is unlikely they can be legally enforced unless the parties perform some act that demonstrates an intention that they will be bound by their promises,” according to the decision.

text:
“When friends fail to keep their promises, the other person may suffer a financial consequence but it may be that they cannot be compensated for that loss.”

Suno pa sa tribunal referee nga si Krysia Cowie, ang nature sang promisa nga ginahimo ang normal lamang nga give and take sa isa ka intimate relationship.
english:
“When friends fail to keep their promises, the other person may suffer a financial consequence but it may be that they cannot be compensated for that loss.”

Suno pa sa tribunal referee nga si Krysia Cowie, ang nature sang promisa nga ginahimo ang normal lamang nga give and take sa isa ka intimate relationship.

text: “As I have found that the parties made their agreement in the context of their friendship, CL has not shown she is entitled to the order that she seeks and her claim is dismissed,” suno pa sa desisyon nga ginpaguwa sang Marso apang subong lang nasapubliko.#
english: “As I have found that the parties made their agreement in the context of their friendship, CL has not shown she is entitled to the order that she seeks and her claim is dismissed,” according to the decision issued in March but only now made public.#

text: May gamay nga pagnubo sa presyo sang gasolina samtang magasaka naman ang presyo sang diesel kag kerosene sa ulihi nga semana sang Hulyo, suno sa mga anunsyo sang oil industry sources.
english: There will be a slight decline in petrol prices while diesel and kerosene prices will rise in the last week of July, according to announcements by oil industry sources.

text: Ipatuman ang mixed movements sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo buwas nga adlaw, Hulyo 29.
english: The mixed movements of petroleum product prices will be implemented tomorrow, July 29.

text:
Yari ang mga masunod nga ipatuman nga pagbag-o sa presyo:

Gasolina – maganubo sang ₱0.10 kada litroDiesel – magasaka sang ₱0.60 kada litroKerosene – magasaka sang ₱0.40 kada litro

Samtang, nagapabilin ang price freeze ukon pagpugong sa pagtaas sang presyo sang diesel sa pila ka lugar sa pungsod nga ginlaslas sang asud-asod nga bagyo.
english:
Here are the following price changes to be implemented:

Gasoline – to decrease by ₱0.10 per literDiesel – to increase by ₱0.60 per literKerosene – to increase by ₱0.40 per liter

Meanwhile, the price freeze on diesel prices remains in place in some parts of the country hit by the typhoon.

text: Suno sa oil industry, kalakip sa mga lugar nga sakop sang price freeze ang La Union, Ilocos Sur, kag pila ka banwa sa Pangasinan kasubong sang Dagupan, Alaminos, Mangaldan, San Fabian, Calasiao, Malasiqui, Bayambang, kag Binmaley.
english: According to the oil industry, among the areas covered by the price freeze are La Union, Ilocos Sur, and several towns in Pangasinan such as Dagupan, Alaminos, Mangaldan, San Fabian, Calasiao, Malasiqui, Bayambang, and Binmaley.

text: Ginapatuman ang price freeze bilang kabahin sang bulig sang gobyerno kag mga pribado nga kumpanya sa mga komunidad nga naapektuhan sang kalamidad.
english: The price freeze is being implemented as part of government and private companies’ assistance to disaster-affected communities.

text:
Inanunsiyo ni US President Donald Trump na nais niyang permanenteng itigil ang migration sa US ng mga galing sa mahihirap na bansa.English edition

Ito ay kasunod ng shooting incident sa dalawang miyembro ng National Guard sa Washington, D.C. kung saan isang afghan national ang natukoy na pangunahing suspek.
english:
US President Donald Trump has announced that he wants to permanently stop migration to the US from poor countries.

This follows the shooting incident of two members of the National Guard in Washington, D.C. where an Afghan national was identified as the main suspect.

text: Sa kaniyang online platform, sinabi ng US President na kaniya itong gagawin para bigyan daan ang ganap na pagrekober ng kanilang bansa at papaalisin ang lahat ng milyun-milyong illegal admissions umano ng nagdaang Biden administration.
english: In his online platform, the US President said he will do this to pave the way for the full recovery of their country and remove all the millions of illegal admissions allegedly by the Biden administration.

text: Aniya, ang sinuman na hindi “net asset’ sa Amerika o hindi kayang mahalin ang kanilang bansa ay papalayasin.
english: He said anyone who is not a “net asset” in America or cannot afford to leave their country will be deported.

text: Una rito, sinisisi ni Trump ang mga immigrant sa mga problema sa krimen hanggang sa kakulangan ng mga pabahay bilang parte ng social dysfunction sa Amerika at dinemand ang reverse migration o ang pagbabalik sa mga migrants sa kanilang pinagmulang lugar.
english: Earlier, Trump blamed immigrants for crime problems and housing shortages as part of America's social dysfunction and demanded reverse migration.

text: San-o ka katapusan nga naghibi?
english: When was the last time you cried?

text: May mga tawo nga palahibi, kag may yara man nga naanad kag natak-an na sa paghibi rason nga hangkilan na sa pagpugong sa pagtulo sang ila nga mga luha.
english: There are people who are cryers, and there are also those who are so used to crying that they have difficulty holding back their tears.

text: Apang pinasahi ang kondisyon sang isa ka lalaki didto sa China.
english: But one man in China was in a unique situation.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, na-obserbahan sang lalaki nga si Mr. Zhang nga indi niya mapunggan ang iya nga luha kun siya ang magkaon ukon mag-usap sang pagkaon.
english: Last year, a man named Mr. Zhang said she can't hold back her tears when she eats or chews food.

text: Sang una, daw okay pa man, tubtub nga naglala na kag nahuya na ini mag-dine in sa mga restaurant bangud nagakatingala ang mga tawo sa palibot kun ngaa wala untat ang iya hibi samtang nagakaon.
english: At first, it seemed okay, until it got worse and she was embarrassed to dine in at restaurants because people around her wondered why she kept crying while eating.

text: Bangud sa epekto sini sa iya nga social life, nagpa-konsulta si Mr. Zhang sa ophthalmologist kag didto nahibaluan nga may yara siya sang medical condition nga gamay lang nga mga tawo sa kalibutan ang nagasuprer.
english: Because of the impact on his social life, Mr. Zhang to the ophthalmologist and there learned that he had a medical condition that very few people in the world suffer from.

text: Ginatawag ini nga “crocodile tear syndrome” ukon “Bogorad syndrome”.
english: It is called “crocodile tear syndrome” or “Bogorad syndrome”.

text: Antes sini, naatake sang Bell’s Palsy si Mr. Zhang kag amo ini ang ginatudlo rason sang iya nga crocodile tear syndrome.
english: Earlier, Mr. Bell’s Palsy was attacked. Zhang and this is the alleged cause of his crocodile tear syndrome.

text: Suno sa mga doktor, bangud sa face paralysis sadto ni Mr. Zhang, nag-angkon sang abnormality ang lacrimal glands niya sa mata.Ang lacrimal glands ang parte sang mata nga amo ang nagapa-guwa sang luha sang tawo.
english: According to doctors, due to face paralysis, Mr. Zhang, the lacrimal glands in his eye developed an abnormality. The lacrimal glands are the part of the eye that produces tears.

text: Bangud sa sini nga abnormality, na-stimulate kag nagaguwa ang luha sa lacrimal glands kun makasimhot ukon makapanabor si Mr. Zhang sang pagkaon ukon ilimnon.
english: Because of this abnormality, tears are stimulated and released from the lacrimal glands when Mr. Zhang of food or drink.

text: Nagpaidalom na ini subong sa surgery kag subong gina-obserbaran kun makabulig ini sa iya nga kondisyon.
english: He has now undergone surgery and is now being observed to see if it will help his condition.

text: Ginaabisuhan ang mga magabyahe para sa mas mahal nga airfares sa masunod nga bulan matapos ginpataas sang Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) ang fuel surcharge level para sa domestic kag international flights.
english: Passengers are being warned of more expensive airfares next month after the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) increased the fuel surcharge level for domestic and international flights.

text: Sa advisory sang Board, ang passenger kag cargo fuel surcharge para sa domestic kag international flights ang i-set sa Level 5 para sa bilog nga Marso, nga mas mataas sa ginapatuman subong nga Level 4.
english: In the Board’s advisory, the passenger and cargo fuel surcharge for domestic and international flights will be set at Level 5 for the whole of March, which is higher than the current Level 4 in place.

text: Sa idalom sang Level 5, ang mga pasahero magabayad sang ₱151 tubtob ₱542 sa fuel surcharges para sa domestic flights, depende sa distansya.
english: Under Level 5, passengers will pay ₱151 to ₱542 in fuel surcharges for domestic flights, depending on the distance.

text: Para sa international flights, ang surcharge ang yara sa ₱498.03 tubtob ₱3,703.11.
english: For international flights, the surcharge ranges from ₱498.03 to ₱3,703.11.

text: Sa idalom sang Level 4, ang airlines makakolekta sang additional fuel fee para sa domestic flights nga ₱117 tubtob ₱342 para sa domestic flights, depende sa kalayuon.
english: Under Level 4, airlines can collect an additional fuel fee for domestic flights of ₱117 to ₱342 for domestic flights, depending on the distance.

text: Samtang ang surcharge para sa international flights ang naga-range halin sa ₱385.70 tubtob sa ₱2,867.82.
english: While the surcharge for international flights ranges from ₱385.70 to ₱2,867.82.

text: Ang fuel surcharge isa ka optional fee, nga wala nalakip sa base airfare, nga ginapasa sang mga airlines sa mga pasahero agud kuhaon diri ang dugang nga balayran gikan sa nagabag-o bag-og nga presyo sang jet fuel.
english: The fuel surcharge is an optional fee, not included in the base airfare, that airlines pass on to passengers to take the extra bill out of the fluctuating price of jet fuel.

text: Nagasinggitan ang barangay kagawad kag pila ka mga pumuluyo sang Barangay Cubay, Jaro, Iloilo City sa Samaritan Bayanihan Inc.
english: The barangay kagawad and some residents of Barangay Cubay, Jaro, Iloilo City are shouting at Samaritan Bayanihan Inc.

text: nga ibalik ang ila gin-invest nga kwarta.
english: to return their invested money.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kagawad Juan Grande, iya ginpahayag nga nagpangako sa ila ang Samaritan Bayanihan Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kagawad Juan Grande said the Samaritan Bayanihan Inc. promised them.

text: nga maghatag ukon mag-invest sang savings kag bisan ano nga oras, pwede ini makuha sa ila kon kinahanglanon.
english: to give or invest savings and at any time, it can be withdrawn from them as needed.

text: Apang, suno kay Grande, nagbaliskad ang paya bangud sang kuhaon na nila ang ila kwarta, nagpamalibad ang Samaritan Bayanihan Inc.
english: However, according to Grande, the paya turned upside down because when they were about to withdraw their money, Samaritan Bayanihan Inc. refused.

text: nga ihatag ini sa ila bangud may nakatalana nga oras kag adlaw para sa releasing.
english: to give it to them because there is a fixed time and day for the releasing.

text: Ginkadismaya man ini ni Grande kag sang mga pumuluyo bangud kinahanglan man nila ang ila nga kwarta.
english: Grande and the residents were also disappointed because they also need their money.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang natungdan sa Samaritan Bayanihan Inc.
english: He also called on the Samaritan Bayanihan Inc.

text: nga atubangon sila kag ang pumuluyo agud mabalik ang ila kwarta.
english: to confront them and the people to get their money back.

text: Nahibaluan masobra 40 ka indibidwal ang naghalin sa amo nga barangay ang nag-intra sa amo nga investment.
english: More than 40 individuals from the barangay participated in the investment.

text: Gintawag ni Pope Francis nga giyera na ang ginahimo sang Russia sa Ukraine— baliskad sa ginpahayag ni Russian President Vladimir Putin nga isa lang ka “special military operation” ang ila nga ginapatigayon sa amo nga pungsod halin pa sang Pebrero 24.
english: Pope Francis has called Russia's war in Ukraine— contrary to Russian President Vladimir Putin's claim that they have been conducting only one "special military operation" in the country since February 24.

text: Sa iya nga weekly address sa St.
english: In his weekly address in St.

text: Peter’s Square, ginpahayag sang Santo Papa nga nagabaha na ang dugo kag luha sa Ukraine kag ang amo nga gyera ang nagatuga sang dugang nga kamatayon, pagkaguba, kag pag-antos sang mga tawo.
english: Peter’s Square, the Pope said that blood and tears are already flowing in Ukraine and that the war is causing more death, destruction, and suffering.

text: Ini na ang ika-11 nga adlaw humalin sang ginpatigayon sang Russia ang invasion sa Ukraine.
english: This is the 11th day since Russia launched its invasion of Ukraine.

text: Apisar sini nga statement, gintalupangod man sang kadam-an nga wala pa gihapon ginsapubliko ni Pope Francis ang pagkondenar sa ginhimo sang Russia nga pagsulod sa teritoryo sang Ukraine.
english: Despite this statement, many also noted that Pope Francis has not yet publicly condemned Russia's invasion of Ukrainian territory.

text: Sa baylo sang pagkondenar, nag-apelar ini liwat para sa kalinong, pagtukod sang humanitarian corridors, kag pagbalik sang negosasyon.
english: Instead of condemnation, it again appealed for peace, the establishment of humanitarian corridors, and the resumption of negotiations.

text: Ang Holy See ang nagasulit-sulit sa pagpanawagan sa kalinong, cease-fire, kag pagbalik sang negosasyon kag nagtanyag man nga mangin mediator ukon magpatunga sa duha ka pungsod.
english: The Holy See has repeatedly called for peace, a ceasefire, and the resumption of negotiations and has also offered to mediate between the two countries.

text: Apang wala sang public condemnation halin sa Santo Papa kag ginahulat man sang publiko ang statement sang Vatican sa pag-atake sang Russia sa pinakadaku nga nuclear plant sang Europa nga nahamtang sa Ukraine.
english: However, there is no public condemnation from the Pope and the public is also waiting for the Vatican's statement on Russia's attack on Europe's largest nuclear plant located in Ukraine.

text: Gintalana sang Korte Suprema sa Abril 1, 2025, sa Supreme Court Baguio Session Hall ang hearing sa petisyon nga nagakwestiyon sa constitutionality sang RA No.
english: The Supreme Court scheduled April 1, 2025, at the Supreme Court Baguio Session Hall for the hearing on the petition questioning the constitutionality of RA No.

text: 12116 ukon ang General Appropriations Act of Fiscal Year 2025 (GAA).
english: 12116 or the General Appropriations Act of Fiscal Year 2025 (GAA).

text: Gin-file ang petisyon nanday Atty. Victor D. Rodriguez kag iban pa nga nagapanindugan nga ang GAA ang nagalapas sa Konstitusyon bangud nga wala ini nagpain sang mandatory funding para sa PhilHealth.
english: The petition was filed by Atty. Victor D. Rodriguez and others who insist that the GAA violates the Constitution because it did not allocate mandatory funding for PhilHealth.

text: Iligal man suno sa ila ang pagtaas sang mga appropriation sang labaw pa sa rekomendasyon sang Presidente kag nagpain ini sang pinakamataas nga budget sa imprastraktura sa baylo nga sa edukasyon.
english: They also said it was illegal to increase appropriations beyond the President's recommendation and that it allocated the highest budget to infrastructure instead of education.

text: Ginaalegar man nga may mga blangko sa Bicameral Committee Report on the General Appropriations Bill.
english: It is also alleged that there are blanks in the Bicameral Committee Report on the General Appropriations Bill.

text: Ang preliminary conference ang gintalana naman sa Pebrero 28, 2025, 1:00 P.M. sa Session Hall, SC Main Building, Manila.
english: The preliminary conference is scheduled for February 28, 2025, 1:00 P.M. at the Session Hall, SC Main Building, Manila.

text: Samtang, sa Abril 22, 2025, alas-2:00 sang hapon, ang hearing sa Supreme Court Baguio Session Hall para sa petisyon nga gin-file ni Sen.
english: Meanwhile, on April 22, 2025, at 2:00 pm, the hearing at the Supreme Court Baguio Session Hall for the petition filed by Sen.

text: Aquilino Pimentel III batok kay Executive Sec.
english: Aquilino Pimentel III against Executive Sec.

text: Lucas L. Bersamin, et al.
english: Lucas L. Bersamin, et al.

text: nga nagakwestiyon sa gahum sang Republic Act No.
english: questioning the power of Republic Act No.

text: 11954 ukon ang Maharlika Investment Fund Act of 2023.
english: 11954 or the Maharlika Investment Fund Act of 2023.

text: Ginahingyo man sang petisyon nga magpagwa ang Korte sang temporary restraining order kag writ of preliminary injunction.
english: The petition also requests the Court to issue a temporary restraining order and writ of preliminary injunction.

text: Ginlakip sang Korte bilang mga respondent sa kaso ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas kag government banks kag ginmanduan ang mga ini nga mag-file sang ila mga komento sa sulod sang 10 ka adlaw.
english: The Court included the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and government banks as respondents in the case and ordered them to file their comments within 10 days.

text: Ang preliminary conference ang gintalana sa February 26, 2025, alas-2:00 sang hapon sa Session Hall, SC Main Building, Manila.
english: The preliminary conference is scheduled for February 26, 2025, at 2:00 pm at the Session Hall, SC Main Building, Manila.

text: Nagsunod kag nagpatigayon sang delikado nga flight maneuvers ang People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLA-Navy) helicopter nga natumod nga may tail number 68 sa aircraft sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) sa tuman ka malapit nga distansiya nga tres metros lamang samtang nagapatigayon ang tropa sang Pilipinas sang Maritime Domain Awareness Flight sa territorial airspace sang Bajo De Masinloc.
english: The People's Liberation Army Navy (PLA-Navy) helicopter, identified as tail number 68, followed and conducted dangerous flight maneuvers on the aircraft of the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) at a very close distance of only three meters while the Philippine troops were conducting Marine Affairs Airtime in the Maritime Airspace Territory. Bajo De Masinloc.

text: Sa isa ka statement, ginpahayag ni Philippine Coast Guard spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Commodore Jay Tarriela nga nagdulot sang dako nga peligro sa safety sang mga piloto kag pasahero ang reckless action sang Chinese helicopter.
english: In a statement, Philippine Coast Guard spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Commodore Jay Tarriela said the reckless action of the Chinese helicopter posed a serious threat to the safety of the pilots and passengers.

text: Kasunod sang insidente, maga-file sang panibag-o nga diplomatic protest ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas kaangot sa ‘unprofessional kag reckless actions’ sang Chinese Navy helicopter.
english: Following the incident, the Philippine government will file a new diplomatic protest regarding the 'unprofessional and reckless actions' of the Chinese Navy helicopter.

text: Suno sa National Maritime Council, ang akto sang China nagpakita sang pagbalewala sini sa internationally accepted norms sa maayo nga airmanship kag flight safety.
english: According to the National Maritime Council, China’s act showed its disregard for internationally accepted norms on good airmanship and flight safety.

text: Ginpahayag man sini wala sang duda nga ang Pilipinas ang may soberanya kag hurisdiksyon sa Bajo de Masinloc.
english: He also said there is no doubt that the Philippines has sovereignty and jurisdiction over Bajo de Masinloc.

text: Dugang sini, indi mag-untat ang Pilipinas sa katungdanan sini nga bantayan ang maritime interests sa shoal, santo sa Republic Act 12064 ukon ang Philippine Maritime Zones Act kag international law, particular ang United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea kag ang 2016 South China Sea Arbitral Award.
english: He added that the Philippines will not abandon its duty to protect maritime interests in the shoal, in accordance with Republic Act 12064 or the Philippine Maritime Zones Act and international law, particularly the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea and the 2016 South China Sea Arbitral Award.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginlapas sang Russia ang ila ginkasugtan nga ceasefire sa tunga sang Ukraine bangud nagapadayaon ang ila pagbuya sang airstrike.
english: Russia allegedly violated its ceasefire agreement with Ukraine because its airstrike was deceptive.

text: Ang ceasefire ang pamaagi agud nga maka-evacuate ang mga tawo sa duha ka syudad sang Mariupol kag Volnovakha sa Ukraine.
english: The ceasefire is meant to allow people to evacuate the two Ukrainian cities of Mariupol and Volnovakha.

text: Ini ang pinakauna nga ceasefire nga ginakasugtan matapos ang 10 ka adlaw nga Russian invasion.
english: This is the first ceasefire to be agreed after the 10-day Russian invasion.

text: Suno kay Iryna Vereshchuk, Ukrainian Minister of Reintegration of Temporarily Occupied Territories, makabig nga gingamit lang sang Russia ang pag-untat sang kinagamo agud nga mas mapadasig ang pagsulod sang Russian troops sa Ukraine.
english: According to Iryna Vereshchuk, Ukrainian Minister of Reintegration of Temporarily Occupied Territories, it can be considered that Russia only used the ceasefire to speed up the entry of Russian troops into Ukraine.

text: Suno naman kay Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino,– direktas sa Ukraine, padayon ang pagpangbomba sang Russian troops sa syudad sang Volnovakha, ang eastern part sang Donetsk region, sa diin nahamtang ang evacuation corridor nga amu kuntani ang magapahanugot sa mga sibilyan nga maghalin sa Ukraine.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Joy Tolentino, – directly from Ukraine, Russian troops continue to bombard the city of Volnovakha, the eastern part of the Donetsk region, where the evacuation corridor is located that would have allowed civilians to leave Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, gin-postpone man ang evacuation sa Mariupol.
english: Tolentino said the evacuation of Mariupol was also postponed.

text: Apisar sang wala untat nga pagpangbomba sang Russia, wala man napunggan nga magdinugok ang mga tawo sa train stations suno kay Tolentino bangud halos tanan ang desperado na nga makalikaw sa pagpang-atake sang Russia.
english: Despite the relentless Russian bombing, Tolentino said people were not prevented from flocking to the train stations because almost everyone was desperate to escape the Russian attack.

text: Pila naman ka mga Pilipino suno sa natungdan ang nagpadulong na sa train stations agud nga mag-evacuate padulong sa iban nga pungsod.
english: Several Filipinos, he said, have already gone to train stations to evacuate to other countries.

text: Liwat nga pamatud-an sang Iloilo City ang titulo sini bilang United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) City of Gastronomy sa patigayunon nga food festival sa Dinagyang 2025 festivities.
english: Iloilo City will once again prove its title as the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) City of Gastronomy in the food festival to be held during the Dinagyang 2025 festivities.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jay Treñas, chairman sang Food Festival Committee, iya ginpahayag nga kahigayunan ini agud ma-showcase na naman sang mga Ilonggo ang original delicacies kag mapadayaw ang culinary heritage ilabi na sa mga dumuluong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jay Treñas, chairman of the Food Festival Committee, said this is an opportunity for Ilonggos to showcase their original delicacies and promote their culinary heritage especially to foreigners.

text: Suno kay Treñas, magalawig ang food festival sa mga dalanon sang syudad sa Enero 23 tubtob 26.
english: According to Treñas, the food festival will run through the streets of the city from January 23 to 26.

text: Pahayag niya, bastante ini nga mga adlaw agud mapakita sa mga turista ang manamit kag nanari-sari nga mga pagkaon sa Iloilo.
english: He said these days are enough to show tourists the delicious and varied foods in Iloilo.

text: Dugang niya, indi lang taga-Iloilo City ang magapakigbahin sa food festival bangud magaupod man diri ang taga-probinsya agud mapasundayag man kag mapatilaw nila ang ila mga pagkaon.
english: He added that not only Iloilo City residents will participate in the food festival as the provincial residents will also participate so that they can also showcase and taste their food.
